### FILE: `e2e/09-label-designer.spec.ts`

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { choosePassword, createUser, ensureEnglish, signIn, signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

const LAYOUT = "E2E tray label";

/** Pixels per millimetre of the label as drawn, from its real size on screen. */
async function pixelsPerMm(page: Page, widthMm: number): Promise<number> {
  const box = await page.getByTestId("label-canvas").boundingBox();
  return box!.width / widthMm;
}

const inCanvas = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId("label-canvas");
const selectedPanel = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("region", { name: "Selected element" });
const labelPanel = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("region", { name: "Label", exact: true });

async function openLayout(page: Page, name: string) {
  await page.goto("/settings/labels");
  await page.getByRole("link", { name, exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("label-canvas")).toBeVisible();
}

test("settings leads to the layouts, which start with an item, a box and a pallet layout", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings");
  // The settings are in groups; the menu moves between them, and the first is open.
  const menu = page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Settings groups" });
  await menu.getByRole("link", { name: /^Priority/ }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/section=priority/);
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Priority", exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await menu.getByRole("link", { name: /^Company and labels/ }).click();
  await expect(menu.getByRole("link", { name: /^Company and labels/ })).toHaveAttribute(
    "aria-current",
    "page",
  );
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Open the label designer" }).click();

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings\/labels$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Label layouts" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toHaveText("6 layouts");
  await expect(page.getByText("Item label", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Box label", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Pallet label", { exact: true }).first()).toBeVisible();

  // There is only one box layout: it cannot be copied (the three item layouts and the pallet layout can).
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Duplicate/ })).toHaveCount(5);
});

test("a new layout is created at a typed size and opens in the editor", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/labels");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New layout" }).click();

  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  // The box layout exists already, so that kind cannot be chosen again.
  await expect(dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: /Box label/ })).toBeDisabled();
  await dialog.getByLabel("Name").fill(LAYOUT);
  await dialog.getByLabel("Width (mm)").fill("60");
  await dialog.getByLabel("Height (mm)").fill("40");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Create and open" }).click();

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings\/labels\/[\w-]+$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole("group", { name: `${LAYOUT}: 60 by 40 millimetres` })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("The label is empty.")).toBeVisible();
});

test("an element is added, typed into, dragged, resized, saved and found again", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await openLayout(page, LAYOUT);

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Text", exact: true }).click();
  const element = inCanvas(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Text: Text", exact: true });
  await expect(element).toBeVisible();

  const panel = selectedPanel(page);
  await panel.getByLabel("Text", { exact: true }).fill("Fresh");
  await expect(inCanvas(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Text: Fresh" })).toBeVisible();

  // Drag it 8 mm to the right (it is 40 mm wide on a 60 mm label, so 10 mm is all it can move) and 5 mm down; the position follows, snapped to half a millimetre.
  const scale = await pixelsPerMm(page, 60);
  const startX = Number(await panel.getByLabel("From the left (mm)").inputValue());
  const startY = Number(await panel.getByLabel("From the top (mm)").inputValue());
  const box = (await inCanvas(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Text: Fresh" }).boundingBox())!;
  const cx = box.x + box.width / 2;
  const cy = box.y + box.height / 2;
  await page.mouse.move(cx, cy);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(cx + 8 * scale, cy + 5 * scale, { steps: 8 });
  await page.mouse.up();
  const movedX = Number(await panel.getByLabel("From the left (mm)").inputValue());
  const movedY = Number(await panel.getByLabel("From the top (mm)").inputValue());
  expect(movedX).toBeCloseTo(startX + 8, 0);
  expect(movedY).toBeCloseTo(startY + 5, 0);

  // Drag the bottom handle down by 3 mm: the height grows, the width does not.
  const startH = Number(await panel.getByLabel("Height (mm)").inputValue());
  const startW = Number(await panel.getByLabel("Width (mm)").inputValue());
  const handle = (await page.locator("[data-handle=s]").boundingBox())!;
  await page.mouse.move(handle.x + handle.width / 2, handle.y + handle.height / 2);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(handle.x + handle.width / 2, handle.y + handle.height / 2 + 3 * scale, {
    steps: 6,
  });
  await page.mouse.up();
  expect(Number(await panel.getByLabel("Height (mm)").inputValue())).toBeCloseTo(startH + 3, 0);
  expect(Number(await panel.getByLabel("Width (mm)").inputValue())).toBe(startW);

  // Saving, then opening the layout again, finds the element where it was left.
  await expect(page.getByText("Unsaved changes")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Layout saved")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Unsaved changes")).toBeHidden();

  await page.reload();
  await expect(inCanvas(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Text: Fresh" })).toBeVisible();
  await inCanvas(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Text: Fresh" }).click();
  expect(
    Number(await selectedPanel(page).getByLabel("From the left (mm)").inputValue()),
  ).toBeCloseTo(startX + 8, 0);
});

test("a field shows the preview item's value, in its own language, and undo takes changes back", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await openLayout(page, LAYOUT);

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Field", exact: true }).click();
  const panel = selectedPanel(page);
  await panel.getByLabel("Shows").selectOption({ label: "Name (English)" });
  const canvas = page.getByTestId("label-canvas");
  await expect(canvas).toContainText("Boneless beef shoulder cut");

  // Another item in the preview changes only what the label shows.
  await labelPanel(page).getByLabel("Preview with item").selectOption({ index: 4 });
  await expect(canvas).not.toContainText("Boneless beef shoulder cut");

  const before = await inCanvas(page)
    .getByRole("button", { name: /^Field:/ })
    .count();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" }).click(); // back to the first field choice
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo" }).click(); // the field is gone again
  expect(
    await inCanvas(page)
      .getByRole("button", { name: /^Field:/ })
      .count(),
  ).toBe(before - 1);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Redo" }).click();
  expect(
    await inCanvas(page)
      .getByRole("button", { name: /^Field:/ })
      .count(),
  ).toBe(before);
});

test("the keyboard works fully: choose several, move, copy, delete and undo, also with a Hebrew keyboard", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await openLayout(page, LAYOUT);
  const canvas = inCanvas(page);
  const layers = page.locator("[data-layer-id]");
  const chosen = page.locator("[data-layer-id][aria-pressed=true]");
  const start = await layers.count();

  // Two new texts to work with.
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Text", exact: true }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Text", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 2);
  const texts = canvas.getByRole("button", { name: "Text: Text", exact: true });
  const first = texts.nth(0);
  const second = texts.nth(1);
  const scale = await pixelsPerMm(page, 60);
  const left = async (locator: typeof first) => (await locator.boundingBox())!.x;
  // The second text sits two millimetres below the first: its lower edge is free of the first one's handles.
  const lowEdge = { x: 6, y: (await second.boundingBox())!.height - 2 };

  // After a click with the mouse the keys work at once: Delete deletes, Ctrl+Z brings it back.
  await first.click({ position: { x: 6, y: 2 } });
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(1);
  await page.keyboard.press("Delete");
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 1);
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+z"); // the focus stayed in the editor after the delete
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 2);

  // Ctrl+A chooses everything, Escape chooses nothing.
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+a");
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(start + 2);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("multiple-selected")).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(0);

  // Shift + click adds to the choice (and takes out again).
  await first.click({ position: { x: 6, y: 2 } });
  await second.click({ modifiers: ["Shift"], position: lowEdge });
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(2);
  await second.click({ modifiers: ["Shift"], position: lowEdge });
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(1);
  await second.click({ modifiers: ["Shift"], position: lowEdge });
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(2);

  // The arrow keys move everything chosen together (Shift: 5 mm).
  const firstLeft = await left(first);
  const secondLeft = await left(second);
  await page.keyboard.press("Shift+ArrowRight");
  await expect.poll(async () => (await left(first)) - firstLeft).toBeCloseTo(5 * scale, 0);
  expect((await left(second)) - secondLeft).toBeCloseTo(5 * scale, 0);

  // Dragging one of the chosen moves all of them.
  const grab = (await first.boundingBox())!;
  const x = grab.x + 6;
  const y = grab.y + 2;
  await page.mouse.move(x, y);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(x - 5 * scale, y, { steps: 6 });
  await page.mouse.up();
  expect(Math.abs((await left(first)) - firstLeft)).toBeLessThan(1);
  expect(Math.abs((await left(second)) - secondLeft)).toBeLessThan(1);
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(2);

  // Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V: a copy of both appears and is the choice; Ctrl+Z takes it away.
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+c");
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+v");
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 4);
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(2);
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+z");
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 2);

  // Delete removes all the chosen ones at once; undo brings them back.
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+a");
  await page.keyboard.press("Delete");
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+z");
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 2);

  // A Hebrew keyboard types other letters for the same keys (Ctrl+Z gives "ז"): it works the same.
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+a");
  await page.keyboard.press("Delete");
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.evaluate(() =>
    (document.activeElement ?? document.body).dispatchEvent(
      new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "ז", code: "KeyZ", ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true }),
    ),
  );
  await expect(layers).toHaveCount(start + 2);
  await page.evaluate(() =>
    (document.activeElement ?? document.body).dispatchEvent(
      new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "ש", code: "KeyA", ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true }),
    ),
  );
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(start + 2);

  // In the list of elements the arrows walk the list, and Shift chooses several in a row.
  const before = await left(first);
  await layers.nth(0).focus();
  await page.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");
  await expect(layers.nth(1)).toBeFocused();
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(1);
  await page.keyboard.press("Shift+ArrowDown");
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(2);
  await page.keyboard.press("Control+Enter"); // Ctrl with Enter takes the layer out of the choice
  await expect(chosen).toHaveCount(1);
  expect(await left(first)).toBe(before); // walking the list moved nothing

  // The help for the keys is there.
  await page.getByText("Show the keys").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("keyboard-help")).toContainText("Ctrl+A");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("keyboard-help")).toContainText("Delete");
});
````

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

const LAYOUT = "E2E codes label";

const canvasOf = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId("label-canvas");
const selectedPanel = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("region", { name: "Selected element" });

test("barcode, QR code and logo elements are added, drawn, changed and saved", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/labels");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New layout" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.getByLabel("Name").fill(LAYOUT);
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Create and open" }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page)).toBeVisible();

  // A barcode of the item barcode (an item label), drawn as a picture with the digits.
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Barcode", exact: true }).click();
  const barcode = canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Barcode: Item barcode" });
  await expect(barcode).toBeVisible();
  const withDigits = await canvasOf(page).locator("svg").first().innerHTML();

  // The digits can be switched off: the picture gets simpler.
  await selectedPanel(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Show the digits under the bars" }).click();
  const bare = await canvasOf(page).locator("svg").first().innerHTML();
  expect(bare.length).toBeLessThan(withDigits.length);

  // A QR code holds the whole item label by default; choosing another source changes the picture.
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "QR code", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(
    canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "QR code: The whole item label" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).locator("svg")).toHaveCount(2);
  const qrWhole = await canvasOf(page).locator("svg").nth(1).innerHTML();
  await selectedPanel(page).getByLabel("The QR code holds").selectOption({ label: "Item barcode" });
  const qrBarcode = await canvasOf(page).locator("svg").nth(1).innerHTML();
  expect(qrBarcode).not.toBe(qrWhole);

  // The logo is the company's own image from the server, and it loads.
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Logo", exact: true }).click();
  const logo = canvasOf(page).locator("img[src='/api/brand/full']");
  await expect(logo).toBeVisible();
  await expect
    .poll(() => logo.evaluate((img: HTMLImageElement) => img.naturalWidth))
    .toBeGreaterThan(0);
  await selectedPanel(page).getByRole("radio", { name: "Mark" }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).locator("img[src='/api/brand/mark']")).toBeVisible();

  // Saved, they come back as they were left.
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Layout saved")).toBeVisible();
  await page.reload();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Barcode: Item barcode" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "QR code: Item barcode" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).locator("img[src='/api/brand/mark']")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).locator("svg")).toHaveCount(2);
});

  page,

  await page
    .getByRole("region", { name: "Elements on the label" })
    .getByRole("button", { name: "Barcode: Item barcode" })
    .click();

  // The Hebrew name cannot be a Code 128 barcode (plain ASCII only).
  await selectedPanel(page).getByLabel("Shows").selectOption({ label: "Name (Hebrew)" });

  await expect(canvasOf(page).locator("div.border-dashed")).toHaveCount(1);

test("the test print is the label itself, on a page of exactly its size", async ({ page }) => {
  // The print window cannot be driven, so it is replaced by a note that it was asked for.
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed = 0;
    window.print = () => {
      (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed += 1;
    };
  });
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/labels");
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: LAYOUT, exact: true }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page)).toBeVisible();

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Test print" }).click();
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed)).toBe(1);
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toHaveClass(/printing-label/);

  // While printing, the page is the label: one page, as big as the label (100 x 60 mm).
  const pdf = (await page.pdf({ preferCSSPageSize: true })).toString("latin1");
  const pages = pdf.match(/\/Type\s*\/Page(?![s\w])/g) ?? [];
  expect(pages).toHaveLength(1);
  const box = pdf.match(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*0\s+0\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/);
  expect(box).not.toBeNull();
  // Chromium rounds the page to whole device pixels: within a point (a third of a millimetre).
  expect(Math.abs(Number(box![1]) - (100 / 25.4) * 72)).toBeLessThan(1);
  expect(Math.abs(Number(box![2]) - (60 / 25.4) * 72)).toBeLessThan(1);

  // When printing ends, the screen is back to normal.
  await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));
  await expect(page.locator("body")).not.toHaveClass(/printing-label/);
  await expect(canvasOf(page)).toBeVisible();
});
````

````ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { choosePassword, createUser, ensureEnglish, signIn, signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

interface SeedItem {
  partname: string;
  partdes: string;
  familydes: string;
  expiredays: number;
}

const seed: SeedItem[] = JSON.parse(readFileSync("db/seed/priority/items.json", "utf8"));
const ITEM = seed.find((i) => i.partname === "N2015D-S")!; // a beef burger, shelf life 12 days
const STARTER_LAYOUT = "תווית פריט"; // 100 x 60 mm, the one the system starts with
const OTHER_LAYOUT = "E2E tray label"; // 60 x 40 mm, made by an earlier spec
const MM_TO_PT = 72 / 25.4;

/** The window asked to print is replaced by a note, so the page can be looked at while "printing". */
async function stubPrint(page: Page) {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __printed: number };
    w.__printed = 0;
    window.print = () => {
      w.__printed += 1;
    };
  });
}

const printed = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed);

/** Opens the item; someone who may also see details then chooses to print. */
async function openPrintWindow(page: Page) {
  await page.goto("/catalog");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: `Open ${ITEM.partdes}` }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  // Either the item's details (with a print button) or, for someone who may only print, the form.
  await expect(
    dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print a label" }).or(dialog.getByLabel("Slaughter date")),
  ).toBeVisible();
  const printButton = dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print a label" });
  if (await printButton.isVisible()) await printButton.click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("heading", { name: "Print item label" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
}

/** The label type is chosen from the item layouts every time: nothing is chosen for you. */
async function chooseLayout(page: Page, name: string) {
  const option = page.getByRole("dialog").getByTestId("layout-option").filter({ hasText: name });
  await option.click();
  await expect(option).toHaveAttribute("data-chosen", "true");
}

async function fillForm(page: Page, { slaughter = "2026-10-20", certificate = "CERT-77" } = {}) {
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.getByLabel("Slaughter date").fill(slaughter);
  await dialog.getByLabel("Production certificate number").fill(certificate);
}

/** Pages and the size of the first page, read from a PDF of the page as it prints. */
async function pdfPages(page: Page) {
  const pdf = (await page.pdf({ preferCSSPageSize: true })).toString("latin1");
  const box = pdf.match(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*0\s+0\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/);
  return {
    pages: (pdf.match(/\/Type\s*\/Page(?![s\w])/g) ?? []).length,
    width: Number(box?.[1]),
    height: Number(box?.[2]),
  };
}

function near(actual: number, mm: number) {
  expect(Math.abs(actual - mm * MM_TO_PT)).toBeLessThan(1);
}

test("one label: the expiry follows the slaughter date, and what prints is that label", async ({

  // Several label types exist and none is chosen: printing asks for one first.

  await expect(dialog.locator("[data-chosen=true]")).toHaveCount(0);
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByText("Choose the label type.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await printed(page)).toBe(0);
  await chooseLayout(page, STARTER_LAYOUT);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("print-preview")).toContainText("CERT-77");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("print-preview")).toContainText("01/11/2026");

  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect.poll(() => printed(page)).toBe(1);
  await expect(page.locator("body")).toHaveClass(/printing-label/);

  const sheet = page.locator("#label-print-root .label-copy");
  await expect(sheet).toHaveCount(1);

  await expect(sheet).toContainText("CERT-77");
  await expect(sheet).toContainText("01/11/2026");
  await expect(sheet.locator("svg")).toHaveCount(1); // the QR code of the starter layout

  const { pages, width, height } = await pdfPages(page);
  expect(pages).toBe(1);
  near(width, 100);

  // When the print window closes, the screen is back to normal and the form is gone.

test("the label type is chosen from the item layouts each time, and prints on its own paper", async ({
  page,

  await stubPrint(page);
  await signInAsOwner(page);

  await expect(page.getByRole("dialog").locator("[data-chosen=true]")).toHaveCount(0);
````

````ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { choosePassword, createUser, ensureEnglish, signIn, signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

interface SeedItem {
  partname: string;
  partdes: string;
}

const seed: SeedItem[] = JSON.parse(readFileSync("db/seed/priority/items.json", "utf8"));
const ITEM = seed.find((i) => i.partname === "N2015D-S")!; // a beef burger with an open production order
// Slaughtered 20 Oct 2026, produced 21 Oct, expires 1 Nov (shelf life 12 days).
const QR = "{{QR_PREFIX}}1|N2015D-S|CERT-77|201026|211026|011126";

/** The print window is replaced by a counter, so the page can be looked at while "printing". */
async function stubPrint(page: Page) {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __printed: number };
    w.__printed = 0;
    window.print = () => {
      w.__printed += 1;
    };
  });
}

const printed = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed);

const finishPrint = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));

async function open(page: Page) {
  await page.goto("/receiving");
````

````ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { choosePassword, createUser, ensureEnglish, signIn, signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

interface SeedItem {
  partname: string;
  partdes: string;
  barcode: string;
  familydes: string;
}

const seed: SeedItem[] = JSON.parse(readFileSync("db/seed/priority/items.json", "utf8"));
const ITEM = seed.find((i) => i.partname === "N2015D-S")!;
const TAIL = ITEM.barcode.slice(-7);

/** A vendor barcode: 38, the item's last 7 digits, two dates, the vendor's number and the weight. */
const vendorCode = (running: string, weight = "1998") => `38${TAIL}100726090728${running}${weight}`;

async function open(page: Page) {
  await page.goto("/vendor-receiving");
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Vendor barcode on the box")).toBeVisible();
}

async function scan(page: Page, text: string) {
  const input = page.getByLabel("Vendor barcode on the box");
  await input.fill(text);
  await input.press("Enter");
}

  await expect(saved).toContainText("19.98");
  await expect(saved).toContainText("09/07/2028");

  const group = page.getByTestId("vendor-group").filter({ hasText: ITEM.partdes });
  await expect(group).toContainText(TAIL);
  const row = group.getByTestId("today-box").filter({ hasText: "19.98" });
  await expect(row.first()).toContainText("Sent");
  await expect(row.first()).toContainText("09/07/2028");

  await scan(page, vendorCode("63430"));
  const error = page.getByTestId("vendor-error");
  await expect(error).toContainText("already received");
  await expect(error).toContainText("E2E Owner");
  await expect(error).toContainText(/\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/);
});

test("scans are taken without waiting, and three sounds tell recorded, refused and not received", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  // Remember the pitch of every beep the screen makes.
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const heard: number[] = [];
    (window as unknown as { heard: number[] }).heard = heard;
    const start = OscillatorNode.prototype.start;
    OscillatorNode.prototype.start = function (...args: [number?]) {
      heard.push(Math.round(this.frequency.value));
      return start.apply(this, args);
    };
  });
  const pitches = (hz: number) =>
    page.evaluate(
      (wanted) =>
        (window as unknown as { heard: number[] }).heard.filter((h) => h === wanted).length,
      hz,
    );
  await open(page);

  // Three scans one right after the other, without waiting for the screen: none is lost.
  const input = page.getByLabel("Vendor barcode on the box");
  for (const running of ["71001", "71002", "71003"]) {
    await input.fill(vendorCode(running, "1000"));
    await input.press("Enter");
  }
  await expect.poll(() => pitches(1318)).toBe(3); // a high beep for each recorded box
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-problem")).toHaveCount(0);

  // The same box again: refused, two low beeps, and it stays in the list of what was not recorded.
  await scan(page, vendorCode("71001", "1000"));
  await expect.poll(() => pitches(560)).toBe(2);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-problem")).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-problem").first()).toHaveAttribute("data-kind", "refused");

  // The scan cannot reach the system: a long low buzz, and a Retry that records it later.
  await page.route("**/vendor-receiving", (route) => route.abort());
  await scan(page, vendorCode("71004", "1000"));
  await expect.poll(() => pitches(170)).toBe(1);
  const lost = page.getByTestId("vendor-problem").first();
  await expect(lost).toHaveAttribute("data-kind", "unreached");
  await page.unroute("**/vendor-receiving");
  await lost.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-saved")).toBeVisible();
  await expect.poll(() => pitches(1318)).toBe(4);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-problem")).toHaveCount(1); // only the refused one is left

  // The sounds can be turned off.
  await page.getByTestId("vendor-sound").click();
  await scan(page, vendorCode("71005", "1000"));
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-saved")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await pitches(1318)).toBe(4);
  await page.getByTestId("vendor-sound").click();
});

test("clearing the list of unrecorded scans does not stop the scanning", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await open(page);
  const input = page.getByLabel("Vendor barcode on the box");

  await scan(page, "3800000"); // refused: it lands in the list
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-problem")).toHaveCount(1);

  // Clear the list with the mouse, then type the next scan without clicking the scan box.
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear the list" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-problems")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(input).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.type(vendorCode("72001", "1000"));
  await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-saved")).toBeVisible();

  // Even when the focus was lost to the page, the scanner's keys go into the scan box.
  await input.evaluate((element) => (element as HTMLInputElement).blur());
  await page.keyboard.type(vendorCode("72002", "1000"));
  await page.keyboard.press("Enter");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("vendor-group").first()).toContainText("72002");
});
````

### FILE: `e2e/15-sends.spec.ts`

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

const QR = "{{QR_PREFIX}}1|N2015D-S|CERT-88|201026|211026|011126";

async function chooseStandIn(page: Page, mode: "Normal" | "Not answering") {
  await page.goto("/settings?section=priority");
  await page
    .getByRole("radiogroup", { name: "Stand-in control" })
    .getByRole("radio", { name: new RegExp(`^${mode}`) })
    .click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Stand-in behaviour changed").first()).toBeVisible();
}

test("a box saved while Priority is down is listed, then sent by the timer without anyone helping", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  test.setTimeout(240_000);
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    window.print = () => undefined;
  });
  await signInAsOwner(page);

  await page.goto("/admin?tab=sends");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("sends-empty")).toBeVisible();

  await chooseStandIn(page, "Not answering");
  try {
    await page.goto("/receiving");
    await expect(page.getByText(/Priority is not answering/).first()).toBeVisible();
    const scan = page.getByLabel("QR code on the item label");
    await scan.fill(QR);
    await scan.press("Enter");
    await page.getByLabel("Weight (simulated scale)").fill("12.3");
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save and print label" }).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId("saved-notice")).toContainText("will be sent again by itself");
    await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));

    // The box is in the list of what Priority does not have yet.
    await page.goto("/admin?tab=sends");
    const row = page.getByTestId("sends-table").getByRole("row").filter({ hasText: "12.3" });
    await expect(row).toContainText("Retrying");
    await expect(row).toContainText("Priority did not answer");
  } finally {
    await chooseStandIn(page, "Normal");
  }

  // Priority is back. The timer (every 30 seconds) sends the box once its wait is over.
  await expect
    .poll(
      async () => {
        await page.goto("/admin?tab=sends");
        return page.getByTestId("sends-empty").isVisible();
      },
      { timeout: 150_000, intervals: [10_000] },
    )
    .toBe(true);
});
````

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

/** The "in date" number of every warehouse card, as the legend shows it. */
async function inDateCounts(page: Page): Promise<number[]> {
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  return page
    .locator("li", { hasText: "In date" })
    .locator("b")
    .evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((node) => Number(node.textContent)));
}

test("an item that needs attention opens to show each box with its dates", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/dashboard");

  // The items are folded away until the list is opened.
  const list = page.getByTestId("attention-list").first();
  await expect(list.getByTestId("attention-line").first()).toBeHidden();
  await list.locator("summary").first().click();
  const line = list.getByTestId("attention-line").first();
  await expect(line).toBeVisible();
  await expect(line.getByTestId("attention-boxes")).toBeHidden();

  await line.locator("summary").click();
  const boxes = line.getByTestId("attention-boxes");
  await expect(boxes).toBeVisible();
  await expect(boxes.getByRole("listitem").first()).toContainText(/\d{4}/); // a barcode
  await expect(boxes.getByRole("listitem").first()).toContainText(/\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/); // the dates
  await expect(boxes).toContainText("Slaughter date");

  await line.locator("summary").click();
  await expect(boxes).toBeHidden();
});

test("the alert days chosen for the categories decide which boxes count as expiring soon", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  const before = await inDateCounts(page);
  expect(before.some((n) => n > 0)).toBe(true);

  // A year ahead: far more boxes count as expiring soon, so fewer are "in date".
  await page.goto("/settings?section=receiving");
  const inputs = page.getByLabel(/^Alert days for/);
  const count = await inputs.count();
  expect(count).toBeGreaterThan(1);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    await inputs.nth(i).fill("365");
    await inputs.nth(i).press("Enter");
    await expect(page.getByText("Alert days saved").first()).toBeVisible();
  }
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByLabel(/^Alert days for/).first()).toHaveValue("365");

  const widened = await inDateCounts(page);
  const total = (counts: number[]) => counts.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n, 0);
  expect(total(widened)).toBeLessThan(total(before));

  // Back to the default for the tests after this one.
  await page.goto("/settings?section=receiving");
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const input = page.getByLabel(/^Alert days for/).nth(i);
    await input.fill("");
    await input.press("Enter");
    await expect(page.getByText("Alert days saved").first()).toBeVisible();
  }
  expect(await inDateCounts(page)).toEqual(before);
});

test("alert days must be whole days from 1 to 365", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings?section=receiving");
  const input = page.getByLabel(/^Alert days for/).first();
  await input.fill("400");
  await input.press("Enter");
  await expect(page.getByText("Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 365.")).toBeVisible();
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByLabel(/^Alert days for/).first()).toHaveValue("");
});

test("pressing the need-attention number lists every item that needs attention", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Show the \d+ boxes that need attention/ }).click();

  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await expect(dialog.getByRole("heading", { name: "Items that need attention" })).toBeVisible();
  const items = dialog.getByTestId("attention-popup-item");

  expect(firstBadge).toMatch(/expired|expiring soon/);
````

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import {
  choosePassword,
  createUser,
  ensureEnglish,
  openBoxes,
  openItemWithBoxes,
  signIn,
  signInAsOwner,
} from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

const MM_TO_PT = 72 / 25.4;

/** The print window is replaced by a counter, so the page can be looked at while "printing". */
async function stubPrint(page: Page) {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __printed: number };
    w.__printed = 0;
    window.print = () => {
      w.__printed += 1;
    };
  });
}
const printed = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed);
const finishPrint = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));

let palletNumber = 0;
let boxes: string[] = [];

test("boxes ticked in the inventory become a pallet, and its label prints on A5", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await stubPrint(page);
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/inventory");
  const total = await page.getByTestId("inventory-summary").innerText();

  // No ticks until building a pallet is started; Cancel takes them away again.
  await expect(page.getByRole("checkbox")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Build a pallet" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Make a pallet of/ })).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Build a pallet" }).click();
  const makeButton = page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Make a pallet of/ });
  await expect(makeButton).toBeDisabled();

  await openItemWithBoxes(page, 3);
  const rows = openBoxes(page);
  boxes = [];
  for (const index of [0, 1, 2]) {
    const row = rows.nth(index);
    boxes.push((await row.getAttribute("data-barcode"))!);
    await row.getByRole("checkbox").check();
  }
  await expect(page.getByTestId("pallet-selected")).toContainText("3 boxes ticked");
  await rows.nth(1).getByRole("checkbox").uncheck();
  boxes.splice(1, 1);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("pallet-selected")).toContainText("2 boxes ticked");

  await makeButton.click();
  const toast = page.getByText(/Pallet \d+ made with 2 boxes\./).first();
  await expect(toast).toBeVisible();
  palletNumber = Number(/Pallet (\d+) made/.exec(await toast.innerText())![1]);
  expect(palletNumber).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  await expect.poll(() => printed(page)).toBe(1);
  const sheet = page.locator("#label-print-root .label-copy");
  await expect(sheet).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(sheet).toContainText(String(palletNumber));
  await expect(sheet).toContainText("2"); // the boxes on it
  await expect(sheet.locator("svg")).toHaveCount(1); // the pallet's QR code

  const pdf = (await page.pdf({ preferCSSPageSize: true })).toString("latin1");
  const box = pdf.match(/\/MediaBox\s*\[\s*0\s+0\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s*\]/)!;
  expect(Math.abs(Number(box[1]) - 210 * MM_TO_PT)).toBeLessThan(1);
  expect(Math.abs(Number(box[2]) - 148 * MM_TO_PT)).toBeLessThan(1);
  await finishPrint(page);

  // The ticks are gone and no stock was touched.
  // Building is over: the panel closed and the ticks left the list.
  await expect(page.getByTestId("pallet-toolbar")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(page.getByRole("checkbox")).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.reload();
  await expect.poll(() => page.getByTestId("inventory-summary").innerText()).toBe(total);
});
````

### FILE: `e2e/21-priority-check.spec.ts`

````ts
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server } from "node:http";
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net";
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

// A pretend Priority on this computer, so the whole path (settings, sign-in, request, answer) is
// tried without any real key. It accepts one made-up key and answers like Priority would.
const KEY = "E2E-TEST-KEY-0123456789";
let server: Server;
let address: string;
const asked: { method: string; path: string; signedInAs: string }[] = [];
// A key whose account the pretend Priority has locked, like the real one did. Counts the requests it got.
const LOCKED_KEY = "E2E-LOCKED-KEY-0123456789";
let askedWithLockedKey = 0;

function signedInAs(request: IncomingMessage): string {
  const header = request.headers.authorization ?? "";
  return Buffer.from(header.replace(/^Basic /, ""), "base64").toString();
}

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  server = createServer((request, response) => {
    const credentials = signedInAs(request);
    const path = new URL(request.url ?? "/", "http://x").pathname.split("/").pop() ?? "";
    asked.push({ method: request.method ?? "", path, signedInAs: credentials });
    const send = (status: number, body: unknown) => {
      response.writeHead(status, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
      response.end(JSON.stringify(body));
    };
    if (credentials === `${LOCKED_KEY}:PAT`) {
      askedWithLockedKey += 1;
      return send(429, {
        error: {
          message: "Account locked due to too many failed login attempts. Try again later.",
        },
      });
    }
    if (credentials !== `${KEY}:PAT`) return send(401, { error: { message: "Unauthorized" } });
    if (path === "LOGPART")
      return send(200, {
        value: [
          {
            PARTNAME: "N2015D-S",
            PARTDES: "המבורגר בקר",
            EXPIREDAYS: 12,
            BARCODE: "7290001234567",
          },
        ],
      });
    if (path === "WAREHOUSES")
      return send(404, { error: { message: "Form WAREHOUSES not found" } });
    if (path === "PARTBAL") return send(200, { value: [] });
    return send(404, { error: { message: `Form ${path} not found` } });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve));
  address = `http://127.0.0.1:${(server.address() as AddressInfo).port}/odata/Priority/x.ini/democo`;
});

test.afterAll(async () => {
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
});

test("the access key is saved without being shown, and the data check asks Priority and reports each form", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings?section=priority");

  // Nothing to check before the connection is set up.
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Check LOGPART/ })).toBeDisabled();
````

````ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { ensureEnglish, signIn, signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

interface SeedItem {
  partname: string;
  partdes: string;
  expiredays: number;
}

const seed: SeedItem[] = JSON.parse(readFileSync("db/seed/priority/items.json", "utf8"));
const FIRST = seed.find((i) => i.partname === "N2015D-S")!; // shelf life 12 days
const SECOND = seed.find((i) => i.partname !== FIRST.partname && i.partdes !== FIRST.partdes)!;
const STARTER_LAYOUT = "תווית פריט"; // 100 x 60 mm, the one the system starts with

/** The window asked to print is replaced by a counter, so the page can be looked at while "printing". */
async function stubPrint(page: Page) {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const w = window as unknown as { __printed: number };
    w.__printed = 0;
    window.print = () => {
      w.__printed += 1;
    };
  });
}

const printed = (page: Page) =>
  page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed);

/** dd/mm/yyyy of a day plus a shelf life, as the label shows the expiry. */
function expiry(iso: string, days: number): string {
  const [year, month, day] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day + days));
  const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${two(date.getUTCDate())}/${two(date.getUTCMonth() + 1)}/${date.getUTCFullYear()}`;
}

/** Starts choosing items, picks them, and opens the window that prints them together. */
async function openBatch(page: Page, names: string[]) {
  await page.goto("/catalog");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Print several items" }).click();
  for (const name of names) {
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: `Select ${name}`, exact: true }).click();
  }
  await expect(page.getByTestId("select-count")).toContainText(`${names.length} items selected`);
  await page.getByTestId("select-bar").getByRole("button", { name: "Print labels" }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("heading", { name: "Print labels for several items" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
}

const rowOf = (page: Page, item: SeedItem) =>
  page.getByRole("dialog").getByTestId("batch-row").filter({ hasText: item.partname });

async function fillRow(
  row: ReturnType<typeof rowOf>,
  { slaughter, certificate, copies }: { slaughter: string; certificate: string; copies?: string },
) {
  await row.getByLabel("Slaughter date").fill(slaughter);
  await row.getByLabel("Production certificate number").fill(certificate);
  if (copies) await row.getByLabel("Copies").fill(copies);
}

async function chooseLayout(page: Page, name: string) {
  const option = page.getByRole("dialog").getByTestId("layout-option").filter({ hasText: name });
  await option.click();
  await expect(option).toHaveAttribute("data-chosen", "true");
}

test("several items print together, each with its own details, and an empty label between them", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await stubPrint(page);
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await openBatch(page, [FIRST.partdes, SECOND.partdes]);
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");

  // One row for each item, in the order they were chosen.
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("batch-row")).toHaveCount(2);
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("batch-row").first()).toContainText(FIRST.partname);

  await chooseLayout(page, STARTER_LAYOUT);
  await fillRow(rowOf(page, FIRST), { slaughter: "2026-10-20", certificate: "ORD-1", copies: "2" });
  await fillRow(rowOf(page, SECOND), { slaughter: "2026-10-22", certificate: "ORD-2" });

  // Each row works out its own expiry date from its own slaughter date and shelf life.
  await expect(rowOf(page, FIRST).getByTestId("batch-expiry")).toHaveText(expiry("2026-10-20", 12));
  await expect(rowOf(page, SECOND).getByTestId("batch-expiry")).toHaveText(
    expiry("2026-10-22", SECOND.expiredays),
  );
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("batch-summary")).toHaveText(
    "3 labels for 2 items, plus 1 empty label between the items",
  );

  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect.poll(() => printed(page)).toBe(1);

  // Item one twice, an empty label, then item two.
  const pages = page.locator("#label-print-root .label-copy");
  await expect(pages).toHaveCount(4);
  await expect(pages.nth(0)).toContainText(FIRST.partdes);
  await expect(pages.nth(0)).toContainText("ORD-1");
  await expect(pages.nth(0)).toContainText(expiry("2026-10-20", 12));
  await expect(pages.nth(1)).toContainText("ORD-1");
  await expect(pages.nth(2)).toHaveAttribute("data-blank", "true");
  await expect(pages.nth(2)).toHaveText("");
  await expect(pages.nth(2).locator("svg")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(pages.nth(3)).toContainText(SECOND.partdes);
  await expect(pages.nth(3)).toContainText("ORD-2");
  await expect(pages.nth(3)).not.toContainText("ORD-1");

  // The empty label is a page of its own, the size of the others.
  const pdf = (await page.pdf({ preferCSSPageSize: true })).toString("latin1");
  expect((pdf.match(/\/Type\s*\/Page(?![s\w])/g) ?? []).length).toBe(4);

  // When the print window closes, the choice is over and the catalog is back to normal.
  await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));
  await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("select-bar")).toBeHidden();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Print several items" })).toBeVisible();

  // Each item is in the activity log.
  await page.goto("/admin?tab=log&action=catalog.itemLabelPrinted");
  await expect(page.getByRole("row", { name: /Printed item labels/ }).first()).toContainText(
    "E2E Owner",
  );
});

test("nothing prints until the label type and every item's details are right", async ({ page }) => {
  await stubPrint(page);
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await openBatch(page, [FIRST.partdes, SECOND.partdes]);
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");

  // Nothing is chosen for you, and every item needs its own details.
  await expect(dialog.locator("[data-chosen=true]")).toHaveCount(0);
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByText("Choose the label type.")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(rowOf(page, FIRST).getByText("Enter the slaughter date.")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(rowOf(page, SECOND).getByText("Enter the slaughter date.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await printed(page)).toBe(0);

  // The first item is right; the second still is not.
  await chooseLayout(page, STARTER_LAYOUT);
  await fillRow(rowOf(page, FIRST), { slaughter: "2026-10-20", certificate: "ORD-1" });
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(rowOf(page, FIRST).getByRole("alert")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(rowOf(page, SECOND).getByText("Enter the slaughter date.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await printed(page)).toBe(0);

  // An item taken out leaves one: no empty label is needed, and it prints.
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: `Take ${SECOND.partdes} out of this print` }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("batch-row")).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("batch-summary")).toHaveText("1 label for 1 item");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect.poll(() => printed(page)).toBe(1);
  const pages = page.locator("#label-print-root .label-copy");
  await expect(pages).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(pages.first()).not.toHaveAttribute("data-blank", "true");
  await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));
});

test("someone who may only print gets one copy of each item, and the server holds them to it", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await stubPrint(page);
  await signIn(page, "pia.printer@e2e.test", USER_NEW_PASSWORD);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/catalog/);
  await ensureEnglish(page);
  await openBatch(page, [FIRST.partdes, SECOND.partdes]);
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");

  await chooseLayout(page, STARTER_LAYOUT);
  await fillRow(rowOf(page, FIRST), { slaughter: "2026-10-20", certificate: "ORD-1" });
  await fillRow(rowOf(page, SECOND), { slaughter: "2026-10-22", certificate: "ORD-2" });
  await expect(rowOf(page, FIRST).getByLabel("Copies")).toBeDisabled();
  await expect(rowOf(page, SECOND).getByLabel("Copies")).toBeDisabled();

  // Even if the page is tampered with, the server refuses more than one copy of an item.
  const copies = rowOf(page, SECOND).getByLabel("Copies");
  await copies.evaluate((input) => input.removeAttribute("disabled"));
  await copies.fill("3");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByText("You do not have permission for this.")).toBeVisible();
  expect(await printed(page)).toBe(0);

  // One copy of each goes through.
  await copies.fill("1");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Print", exact: true }).click();
  await expect.poll(() => printed(page)).toBe(1);
  await expect(page.locator("#label-print-root .label-copy")).toHaveCount(3); // two items and one empty label
  await page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));
});

test("someone who may only look at the catalog cannot choose items to print", async ({ page }) => {
  await signIn(page, "cleo@e2e.test", USER_NEW_PASSWORD);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/catalog/);
  await ensureEnglish(page);
  await expect(page.getByRole("status")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Print several items" })).toHaveCount(0);
});
````

### FILE: `e2e/23-label-sections.spec.ts`

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

const LAYOUT = "E2E sections label";

const canvasOf = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId("label-canvas");
const selectedPanel = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("region", { name: "Selected element" });
const addPanel = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("region", { name: "Add to the label" });
const DATE = /\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}/g;

/** How many lines of the drawn boxes have a line under them of this kind (dotted, solid). */
const separators = (page: Page, kind: string) =>
  canvasOf(page).evaluate(
    (canvas, wanted) =>
      [...canvas.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("div[dir]")].filter((row) => {
        const style = getComputedStyle(row);
        return style.borderBottomStyle === wanted && parseFloat(style.borderBottomWidth) > 0;
      }).length,
    kind,
  );

/** What is drawn on the label, as text (the drawn elements, not the frames laid over them). */
async function drawn(page: Page): Promise<string> {
  return canvasOf(page).innerText();
}

test("every detail can be put on the label with one press, with the item names and the dates ready-made", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/labels");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New layout" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.getByLabel("Name").fill(LAYOUT);
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Create and open" }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page)).toBeVisible();

  // Every detail of an item label is a button of its own; a pallet's details are not offered here.
  const details = addPanel(page).getByTestId("add-details");
  for (const key of [
    "itemNumber",
    "name",
    "nameEn",
    "itemBarcode",
    "category",
    "weightAvg",
    "shelfLife",
    "storageText",
    "packingCode",
    "origin",
    "slaughterDate",
    "productionDate",
    "expiryDate",
    "weightKg",
    "certificateNo",
    "runningNumber",
    "boxBarcode",
  ]) {
    await expect(details.locator(`[data-detail=${key}]`)).toBeVisible();
  }
  await expect(details.locator("[data-detail=palletNumber]")).toHaveCount(0);

  // The names in Hebrew and in English, ready-made, each in its own writing.
  await addPanel(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Item name (Hebrew)" }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Field: Name (Hebrew)" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(selectedPanel(page).getByRole("radio", { name: "Hebrew" })).toBeChecked();
  await addPanel(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Item name (English)" }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Field: Name (English)" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(selectedPanel(page).getByRole("radio", { name: "English" })).toBeChecked();

  // Any other detail is one press too.
  await details.locator("[data-detail=origin]").click();
  await expect(
    canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Field: Country of origin" }),
  ).toBeVisible();
});

test("the dates are one box, written day/month/year, and every line of it can be designed", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/labels");
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: LAYOUT, exact: true }).click();
  await expect(canvasOf(page)).toBeVisible();

  await addPanel(page).getByRole("button", { name: "Dates box" }).click();
  const box = canvasOf(page).getByRole("button", { name: /^Lines box:/ });
  await expect(box).toBeVisible();

  // Three dates in one frame, each as DD/MM/YYYY and none as year-month-day.
  const text = await drawn(page);
  expect(text).toContain("תאריך שחיטה:");
  expect(text).toContain("תאריך ייצור:");
  expect(text).toContain("תאריך תפוגה:");
  expect(text.match(DATE)).toHaveLength(3);
  expect(text).not.toMatch(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/);
  // A dotted line between the three lines, as in the photo (two lines for three rows).
  await expect.poll(() => separators(page, "dotted")).toBe(2);

  // The box is one element that can be sized: width and height are typed in.
  const panel = selectedPanel(page);
  await expect(panel.getByTestId("lines-properties")).toBeVisible();
  await panel.getByLabel("Width (mm)").fill("52");
  await panel.getByLabel("Height (mm)").fill("18");
  await expect(panel.getByLabel("Width (mm)")).toHaveValue("52");
  const frame = (await box.boundingBox())!;
  const canvas = (await canvasOf(page).boundingBox())!;
  const scale = canvas.width / 100;
  expect(frame.width / scale).toBeCloseTo(52, 0);
  expect(frame.height / scale).toBeCloseTo(18, 0);

  // The frame, the corners and what lies between the lines are set for the whole box.
  await panel.getByLabel("Frame (mm, 0 = none)").fill("0.8");
  await panel.getByLabel("Rounded corners (mm)").fill("4");
  await panel.getByRole("radio", { name: "Solid" }).click();
  await expect(panel.getByRole("radio", { name: "Solid" })).toBeChecked();
  await expect.poll(() => separators(page, "solid")).toBe(2);
  await expect.poll(() => separators(page, "dotted")).toBe(0);

  // Each line has its own words, value, typeface, size and writing.
  const second = panel.getByRole("group", { name: "Line 2" });
  await second.getByLabel("Words before the value").fill("תאריך ייצור חדש:");
  await second.getByLabel("Size (pt)").fill("14");
  await second.getByRole("button", { name: "Bold" }).click();
  await expect(second.getByRole("button", { name: "Bold" })).toHaveAttribute(
    "aria-pressed",
    "false",
  );
  await expect.poll(() => drawn(page)).toContain("תאריך ייצור חדש:");

  // A line with words before its value is spread across, or set together in the centre.
  await second.getByRole("radio", { name: "Center" }).click();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      canvasOf(page).evaluate(
        (canvas) =>
          [...canvas.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("div[dir]")].filter(
            (row) => getComputedStyle(row).justifyContent === "center",
          ).length,
      ),
    )
    .toBe(1);

  // A line can show any detail, or a text typed in the designer.
  const third = panel.getByRole("group", { name: "Line 3" });
  await third.getByLabel("Shows").selectOption({ label: "A text typed here" });
  await third.getByLabel("Text", { exact: true }).fill("שמור בקירור");
  await expect.poll(() => drawn(page)).toContain("שמור בקירור");
  expect((await drawn(page)).match(DATE)).toHaveLength(2);

  // Lines are moved, taken away and added.
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Move line 1 down" }).click();
  await expect
    .poll(async () => {
      const now = await drawn(page);
      return now.indexOf("תאריך ייצור חדש:") < now.indexOf("תאריך שחיטה:");
    })
    .toBe(true);
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove line 3" }).click();
  await expect(panel.getByRole("group", { name: /^Line / })).toHaveCount(2);
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Add a line" }).click();
  await expect(panel.getByRole("group", { name: /^Line / })).toHaveCount(3);

  // The last line cannot be removed: a box keeps at least one.
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove line 3" }).click();
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove line 2" }).click();
  await expect(panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Remove line 1" })).toBeDisabled();
});

test("a warning box shows the storage text or a text of its own, and it is saved and printed", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed = 0;
    window.print = () => {
      (window as unknown as { __printed: number }).__printed += 1;
    };
````

### FILE: `e2e/24-room-order.spec.ts`

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

/** The codes of the storage rooms on the dashboard, in the order shown. */
async function dashboardOrder(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  return page
    .getByTestId("dashboard-rooms")
    .getByTestId("room-slot")
    .evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((node) => node.getAttribute("data-code") ?? ""));
}

/** The codes of the storage rooms in the inventory, in the order shown (without "All rooms"). */
async function inventoryOrder(page: Page): Promise<string[]> {
  await page.goto("/inventory");
  return page
    .getByTestId("room-cards")
    .getByTestId("room-slot")
    .evaluateAll((nodes) => nodes.map((node) => node.getAttribute("data-code") ?? ""));
}

test("the storage rooms are arranged with the arrows and the order is kept on both screens", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  const before = await dashboardOrder(page);
  expect(before.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Arrange the rooms" }).click();
  const second = page.getByTestId("dashboard-rooms").getByTestId("room-slot").nth(1);
  await second.getByRole("button", { name: /Move .* earlier/ }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Done" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("The order of the rooms was saved")).toBeVisible();

  const expected = [before[1], before[0], ...before.slice(2)];
  await expect.poll(() => dashboardOrder(page)).toEqual(expected);
  // The inventory shows the same order.
  expect(await inventoryOrder(page)).toEqual(expected);
});

test("a room is dragged to a new place, and Cancel leaves the order as it was", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  const before = await dashboardOrder(page);

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Arrange the rooms" }).click();
  const slots = page.getByTestId("dashboard-rooms").getByTestId("room-slot");
  await slots.first().dragTo(slots.last());
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
  expect(await dashboardOrder(page)).toEqual(before);

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Arrange the rooms" }).click();
  await slots.first().dragTo(slots.last());
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Done" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("The order of the rooms was saved")).toBeVisible();
  const moved = [...before.slice(1), before[0]];
  await expect.poll(() => dashboardOrder(page)).toEqual(moved);
});

test("choosing a room in the inventory still works, and arranging there saves too", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  const order = await inventoryOrder(page);
  const cards = page.getByTestId("room-cards").getByTestId("room-card");
  // The first card is "All rooms"; a room card filters while not arranging.
  await cards.nth(1).click();
  await expect(cards.nth(1)).toHaveAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Arrange the rooms" }).click();
  const slots = page.getByTestId("room-cards").getByTestId("room-slot");
  await slots
    .last()
    .getByRole("button", { name: /Move .* earlier/ })
    .click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Done" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("The order of the rooms was saved")).toBeVisible();
  const swapped = [...order];
  [swapped[order.length - 2], swapped[order.length - 1]] = [
    order[order.length - 1],
    order[order.length - 2],
  ];
  await expect.poll(() => inventoryOrder(page)).toEqual(swapped);
});
````

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

const MINUTE = 60_000;

async function chooseSignOutTime(page: Page, label: string) {
  await page.goto("/admin?tab=security");
  await page.getByTestId("idle-minutes").selectOption({ label });
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("The sign-out time was saved.")).toBeVisible();
}

test("the sign-out time is set in the system settings and kept", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/admin?tab=security");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-minutes")).toHaveValue("30");
  await chooseSignOutTime(page, "5 minutes");
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-minutes")).toHaveValue("5");
});

test("a screen left alone is warned, can be kept with one press, and is then signed out", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.clock.install();
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-warning")).toHaveCount(0);

  // 4 minutes 15 seconds without touching: the notice appears (it is shown the last minute).
  await page.clock.fastForward(4 * MINUTE + 15_000);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-warning")).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Stay signed in" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-warning")).toHaveCount(0);

  // Staying counted as activity: another 4 minutes pass without a sign-out.
  await page.clock.fastForward(4 * MINUTE);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);

  // Nothing touched for the whole time: signed out, with a message on the login page.
  await page.clock.fastForward(2 * MINUTE);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-notice")).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);
});

test("with the time set to never, nobody is signed out; the time is put back to normal", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await chooseSignOutTime(page, "Never");
  await page.clock.install();
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  await page.clock.fastForward(10 * 60 * MINUTE);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("idle-warning")).toHaveCount(0);
  await chooseSignOutTime(page, "30 minutes");
});

test("an old time of last activity from an earlier visit does not sign a new login out", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  // The browser still holds the time of the last activity from long ago (set once, before the
  // login page loads).
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    if (window.sessionStorage.getItem("seeded")) return;
    window.sessionStorage.setItem("seeded", "1");
    window.localStorage.setItem("{{APP_ID}}.lastActivity", String(Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  });
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/dashboard");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
  await page.waitForTimeout(2500);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
});
````

````ts
import { createHmac } from "node:crypto";
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { E2E_OWNER, OWNER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { signIn, signInAsOwner, signOut } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

/** The 6-digit code an authenticator app shows now, from the base32 key on the screen. */
function codeNow(base32: string, offsetSteps = 0): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  let bits = "";
  for (const char of base32.toUpperCase().replace(/[=\s]/g, "")) {
    bits += alphabet.indexOf(char).toString(2).padStart(5, "0");
  }
  const key = Buffer.from(bits.match(/.{8}/g)!.map((b) => parseInt(b, 2)));
  const counter = Buffer.alloc(8);
  counter.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 30_000) + offsetSteps));
  const hmac = createHmac("sha1", key).update(counter).digest();
  const offset = hmac[hmac.length - 1] & 0xf;
  return String((hmac.readUInt32BE(offset) & 0x7fffffff) % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");
}

let secret = "";

async function askForPassword(page: Page, buttonTestId: string) {
  await page.getByTestId(buttonTestId).click();
  await page.locator("#two-factor-password").fill(OWNER_NEW_PASSWORD);
  await page.getByTestId("two-factor-continue").click();
}

test("two-step verification is turned on from the account page with a code from the phone", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.goto("/account");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("two-factor-status")).toContainText("Off");

  await askForPassword(page, "two-factor-start");
  await expect(page.getByRole("img", { name: /authenticator app/ })).toBeVisible();
  secret = (await page.getByTestId("two-factor-secret").innerText()).trim();
  expect(secret.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("backup-codes").getByRole("listitem").first()).toBeVisible();

  // A wrong code does not turn it on.
  await page.locator("#two-factor-code").fill("000000");
  await page.getByTestId("two-factor-confirm").click();
  await expect(page.getByText("The code is wrong")).toBeVisible();

  await page.locator("#two-factor-code").fill(codeNow(secret));
  await page.getByTestId("two-factor-confirm").click();
  await page.getByTestId("two-factor-done").click();
  await expect(page.getByTestId("two-factor-status")).toContainText("On");
});

test("the password alone no longer signs in: the code is asked", async ({ page }) => {

  await expect(page.getByText(/Wrong code|הקוד שגוי/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);

  // The code check allows only a few tries in ten seconds.
  await page.waitForTimeout(11_000);
  await page.locator("#code").fill(codeNow(secret));
  await page.locator("#code").press("Enter");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
});

test("it is turned off again from the account page", async ({ page }) => {
````

````ts
import http from "node:http";
import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { USER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";
import { choosePassword, createUser, ensureEnglish, signIn, signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

// A pretend of the service behind the question helper: it records what it was asked.
const ANSWER =
  "1. Press **Print several items**.\n2. Tap the items you want.\n3. Press **Print labels**.";
const asked: Array<{
  key: string;
  body: { system: Array<{ text: string }>; messages: Array<{ content: string }> };
}> = [];
let pretend: http.Server;

test.beforeAll(async () => {
  pretend = http.createServer((request, response) => {
    let data = "";
    request.on("data", (chunk) => (data += chunk));
    request.on("end", () => {
      asked.push({ key: String(request.headers["x-api-key"]), body: JSON.parse(data) });
      response.setHeader("content-type", "application/json");
      response.end(JSON.stringify({ content: [{ type: "text", text: ANSWER }] }));
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((done) => pretend.listen(3199, "127.0.0.1", done));
});

test.afterAll(async () => {
  await new Promise((done) => pretend.close(done));
});

const MIA = "mia.messenger@e2e.test";

  await expect(page.getByTestId("ask-assistant")).toContainText("Print several items");
  expect(asked).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(asked[0].key).toBe("e2e-test-key");
````

### FILE: `e2e/31-shipping-labels.spec.ts`

````ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInAsOwner } from "./helpers";

test.describe.configure({ mode: "serial" });

let apiUrl = "";

/** The shipping section starts closed, like the labels one; press its button to open it. */
async function openShippingCard(page: Page) {
  const toggle = page.getByTestId("shipping-toggle");
  await expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
  await expect(page.getByTestId("shipping-url")).toHaveCount(0);
  await toggle.click();
  await expect(toggle).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
}

/** The address Priority is given, as the settings show it. */
async function readAddress(page: Page): Promise<string> {
  await page.goto("/settings");
  await openShippingCard(page);
  const field = page.getByTestId("shipping-url");
  await expect(field).toBeVisible();
  return field.inputValue();
}

test("the settings show the address to give Priority, with a key inside it", async ({ page }) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  apiUrl = await readAddress(page);
  expect(apiUrl).toMatch(/^http:\/\/localhost:3100\/api\/shipping-labels\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}$/);
  await expect(page.getByTestId("shipping-status")).toContainText("No order has arrived");
});

test("Priority can send an order without signing in, as JSON, as form fields or in the address", async ({
  request,
}) => {
  // The wrong key is refused, and tells nothing.
  const wrong = await request.post(apiUrl.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, "/not-the-key"), {
    data: { ordname: "SO900" },
  });
  expect(wrong.status()).toBe(404);

  // Priority's own column names, as JSON.
  const json = await request.post(apiUrl, {
    data: {
      ORDNAME: "SO900",
      CUSTNAME: "C77",
      CDES: "Cohen Foods",
      ADDRESS: "15 Herzl St",
      STATE: "Tiberias",
      CURDATE: "2026-11-09T00:00:00+02:00",
      labels: 3,
    },
  });
  expect(json.status()).toBe(200);
  expect(await json.json()).toEqual({ ok: true, order: "SO900", updated: false });

  // Form fields.
  const form = await request.post(apiUrl, {
    form: { orderNumber: "SO901", customerName: "Levi Market", city: "Haifa" },
  });
  expect(form.status()).toBe(200);

  // In the address itself.
  const query = await request.get(`${apiUrl}?docno=SO902&cdes=Mizrahi`);
  expect(query.status()).toBe(200);

  // The same order again updates it.
  const again = await request.post(apiUrl, { data: { ordname: "SO900", city: "Haifa" } });
  expect((await again.json()).updated).toBe(true);

  // No order number, nothing to print.
  const empty = await request.post(apiUrl, { data: { cdes: "Nobody" } });
  expect(empty.status()).toBe(422);
  expect((await empty.json()).error).toBe("NO_ORDER_NUMBER");
  const broken = await request.post(apiUrl, {
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    data: Buffer.from("{not json"),
  });
  expect(broken.status()).toBe(400);
});

test("the orders wait in the list, and their labels print numbered Box 1 of 3, Box 2 of 3, Box 3 of 3", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await signInAsOwner(page);
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    window.print = () => {
      const copies = [...document.querySelectorAll("#label-print-root .label-copy")];
      (window as unknown as { __labels: string[] }).__labels = copies.map(
        (copy) => (copy as HTMLElement).innerText,
      );
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint"));
    };
  });
  await page.goto("/shipping-labels");
  const rows = page.getByTestId("shipping-order");
  await expect(rows).toHaveCount(3);

  const row = rows.filter({ hasText: "SO900" });
  await expect(row).toContainText("Cohen Foods");
  await expect(row).toContainText("Haifa");
  await expect(row.getByTestId("shipping-not-printed")).toBeVisible();

  // Search.
  await page.getByLabel("Search the orders").fill("levi");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Search", exact: true }).click();
  await expect(rows).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(rows.first()).toContainText("SO901");
  await page.goto("/shipping-labels");

  await row.getByTestId("shipping-print").click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  // Priority asked for 3 labels, so that is the number to start from.
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-count")).toHaveValue("3");
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-sequence")).toContainText(
    "Box 1 of 3, Box 2 of 3, Box 3 of 3",
  );
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-preview")).toContainText("SO900");
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-preview")).toContainText("Box 1 of 3");

  // Ten labels instead.
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-count").fill("10");
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-sequence")).toContainText("Box 10 of 10");
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-do-print").click();

  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __labels?: string[] }).__labels?.length),
    )
    .toBe(10);
  const labels = await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __labels: string[] }).__labels);
  labels.forEach((text, index) => {
    expect(text).toContain(`Box ${index + 1} of 10`);
    expect(text).toContain("SO900");
    expect(text).toContain("Cohen Foods");
  });

  // The list now says it was printed.
  await expect(row.getByTestId("shipping-printed")).toContainText("Printed once");
  await expect(rows.filter({ hasText: "SO901" }).getByTestId("shipping-not-printed")).toBeVisible();

  // Boxes get one label each, so there is no number of labels per box to choose.
  await row.getByTestId("shipping-print").click();
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-copies")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-sequence")).toContainText("One label for each box");

  // Pallets: the word changes, and each pallet number gets 4 labels (the default).
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-unit-pallet").click();
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-count").fill("2");
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-copies")).toHaveValue("4");
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-sequence")).toContainText(
    "4 labels for each pallet: Pallet 1 of 2, Pallet 2 of 2 (8 labels in all)",
  );
  await expect(dialog.getByTestId("shipping-do-print")).toContainText("Print 8 labels");
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-do-print").click();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __labels?: string[] }).__labels?.length),
    )
    .toBe(8);
  const pallets = await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __labels: string[] }).__labels);
  pallets.slice(0, 4).forEach((text) => expect(text).toContain("Pallet 1 of 2"));
  pallets.slice(4).forEach((text) => expect(text).toContain("Pallet 2 of 2"));

  // 10 pallets with 4 labels each is 40 labels, 4 of each number in a row.
  await row.getByTestId("shipping-print").click();
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-unit-pallet").click();
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-count").fill("10");
  await dialog.getByTestId("shipping-do-print").click();
  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __labels?: string[] }).__labels?.length),
    )
    .toBe(40);
  const forty = await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { __labels: string[] }).__labels);
  expect(forty[3]).toContain("Pallet 1 of 10");
  expect(forty[4]).toContain("Pallet 2 of 10");
  expect(forty[39]).toContain("Pallet 10 of 10");

  // A bad number cannot be printed.
  await row.getByTestId("shipping-print").click();
````
