````ts
import { expect, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { E2E_OWNER, OWNER_NEW_PASSWORD } from "./constants";

export async function signIn(page: Page, email: string, password: string) {
  await page.goto("/login");
  // Under `next dev` the form hydrates late; clicking earlier submits it as a plain page form.
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await page.locator("#email").fill(email);
  await page.locator("#password").fill(password);
  await page.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
}

export async function choosePassword(page: Page, current: string, next: string) {
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/change-password/);
  // After a temporary password the form does not ask for it again.
  if ((await page.locator("#currentPassword").count()) > 0) {
    await page.locator("#currentPassword").fill(current);
  }
  await page.locator("#newPassword").fill(next);
  await page.locator("#confirmPassword").fill(next);
  await page.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
}

/** The language button names the language you will get, so this works from either language. */
export async function ensureEnglish(page: Page) {
  if ((await page.locator("html").getAttribute("lang")) !== "en") {
    await page.getByTitle("English").click();
    await expect(page.locator("html")).toHaveAttribute("lang", "en");
  }
}

/** Needs 02-accounts.spec.ts to have run first (it replaces the seed password). */
export async function signInAsOwner(page: Page) {
  await signIn(page, E2E_OWNER.email, OWNER_NEW_PASSWORD);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
  await ensureEnglish(page);
}

export async function signOut(page: Page) {
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out" }).first().click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);
}

type Level = "No access" | "View only" | "Everything";

export interface NewUser {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  /** Screen name (as in the menu) to access level. */
  screens: Record<string, Level>;
  /** Single actions to tick on a screen, by the text beside their checkbox. */
  actions?: Record<string, string[]>;
  desktop: boolean;
  phone: boolean;
}

/** Creates a user through the administration screen and returns the temporary password. */
export async function createUser(page: Page, user: NewUser): Promise<string> {
  await page.goto("/admin");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New user" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog");
  await dialog.locator("#user-name").fill(user.name);
  await dialog.locator("#user-email").fill(user.email);
  await dialog.getByRole("radio", { name: "English" }).click();
  for (const [screen, level] of Object.entries(user.screens)) {
    await dialog
      .getByRole("radiogroup", { name: screen, exact: true })
      .getByRole("radio", { name: level })
      .click();
  }
  for (const [screen, labels] of Object.entries(user.actions ?? {})) {
    const row = dialog
      .getByRole("listitem")
      .filter({ has: page.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: screen, exact: true }) });
    await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Single actions" }).click();
    for (const label of labels) await row.getByRole("checkbox", { name: label }).click();
  }
  if (user.desktop) await dialog.getByRole("switch", { name: "Desktop computer" }).click();
  if (user.phone) await dialog.getByRole("switch", { name: "Phone" }).click();
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Create user" }).click();

  const secret = page.getByRole("dialog").locator("code");
  await expect(secret).toBeVisible();
  const password = (await secret.innerText()).trim();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "I gave it to the user" }).click();
  return password;
}

/** The boxes of the item that is open on the inventory screen. */
export const openBoxes = (page: Page) => page.getByTestId("inventory-box");

/** The total number of boxes the inventory summary shows. */
export async function summaryBoxes(page: Page): Promise<number> {
  const text = await page.getByTestId("inventory-summary").innerText();
  return Number(/([\d,]+) box/.exec(text)![1].replace(/,/g, ""));
}

/** Opens the first item that has at least `count` boxes and returns their barcodes. */
export async function openItemWithBoxes(page: Page, count: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const items = page.getByTestId("inventory-item");
  await expect(items.first()).toBeVisible();
  for (let i = 0; i < (await items.count()); i++) {
    await items.nth(i).click();
    await expect(items.nth(i)).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    const barcodes = await openBoxes(page).evaluateAll((nodes) =>
      nodes.map((node) => node.getAttribute("data-barcode")!),
    );
    if (barcodes.length >= count) return barcodes;
  }
  throw new Error(`no item has ${count} boxes`);
}

/** Opens "More filters" on the inventory screen when it is closed. */
export async function openMoreFilters(page: Page) {
  if (!(await page.locator("#inv-barcode").isVisible())) {
    await page.getByText("More filters").click();
  }
}
````

````js
// Tailwind classes that hard-code a physical side. The UI must mirror between

const PHYSICAL_SIDE_CLASS =
  /(^|[\s"'`:!])-?(ml|mr|pl|pr|left|right|inset-x-?[lr]?|rounded-[lr]|rounded-[tb][lr]|border-[lr]|scroll-[mp][lr]|text-left|text-right|float-left|float-right)(-|\b)/;
````

### FILE: `manual/build.mjs`

````js
// Builds the two manuals (English and Hebrew) as PDF files from manual/content/*.mjs and the
// pictures in manual/shots. Run: node manual/build.mjs [en|he]
//
// In the content, [[some.key]] is replaced with the exact words the system shows for that key
// (from messages/en.json or messages/he.json), so a button or a menu name in the manual is always
// the one on the screen.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import path from "node:path";
import { chromium } from "@playwright/test";

const root = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");
const out = path.join(root, "Manual PDF");
const work = path.join(root, "manual", "build");
mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
mkdirSync(work, { recursive: true });

const css = readFileSync(path.join(root, "manual", "style.css"), "utf8");
const only = process.argv[2];
const langs = only ? [only] : ["en", "he"];

const esc = (s) => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;");

function lookup(messages, key) {
  let node = messages;
  for (const part of key.split(".")) node = node?.[part];
  return typeof node === "string" ? node : null;
}

const missing = new Set();
let currentMessages;

function make(lang) {
  const messages = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(root, "messages", `${lang}.json`), "utf8"));
  /** Words of the interface, then simple inline marks: **bold**, `code`. */
  const rich = (text) =>
    text
      .replace(/\[\[([\w.]+)\]\]/g, (_, key) => {
        const value = lookup(messages, key);
        if (value === null) {
          missing.add(`${lang}: ${key}`);
          return `<span class="ui missing">${key}</span>`;
        }
        return `<span class="ui">${esc(value)}</span>`;
      })
      .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "<b>$1</b>")
      .replace(/`(.+?)`/g, "<code>$1</code>");
  return { messages, rich };
}

function figure(lang, block, rich) {
  const file = path.join(root, "manual", "shots", lang, `${block.img}.png`);
  if (!existsSync(file)) {
    missing.add(`${lang}: picture ${block.img}`);
    return `<p class="missing">[picture ${block.img} missing]</p>`;
  }
  const src = pathToFileURL(file).href;
  const legend = block.legend
    ? `<ol class="legend">${block.legend.map((l, i) => `<li><span class="n">${i + 1}</span><span>${rich(l)}</span></li>`).join("")}</ol>`
    : "";
  const MEDIUM = ["81-receiving-priority-down", "51-inventory-filters", "67-label-editor-box", "68-label-editor-pallet", "55-pallet-detail", "50-inventory"];
  const cls = (MEDIUM.includes(block.img) ? "fig medium" : block.narrow ? "fig narrow" : block.phone ? "fig phone" : "fig") + (block.legend ? "" : " alone");
  return `<figure class="${cls}"><div class="figbox"><img src="${src}"/><figcaption>${rich(block.caption)}</figcaption></div>${legend}</figure>`;
}

function renderBlock(lang, block, rich) {
  switch (block.type) {
    case "h3":
      return `<h3>${rich(block.text)}</h3>`;
    case "h4":
      return `<h4>${rich(block.text)}</h4>`;
    case "p":
      return `<p>${rich(block.text)}</p>`;
    case "ul":
      return `<ul>${block.items.map((i) => `<li>${rich(i)}</li>`).join("")}</ul>`;
    case "ol":
      return `<ol class="steps">${block.items.map((i) => `<li>${rich(i)}</li>`).join("")}</ol>`;
    case "note":
    case "tip":
    case "warn":
      return `<div class="callout ${block.type}"><b class="label">${rich(block.label)}</b><div>${rich(block.text)}</div></div>`;
    case "table":
      return `<table><thead><tr>${block.head.map((h) => `<th>${rich(h)}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${block.rows
        .map((r) => `<tr>${r.map((c) => `<td>${rich(c)}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`)
        .join("")}</tbody></table>`;
    case "fig":
      return figure(lang, block, rich);
    case "perms": {
      // Every single action a person can be allowed, straight from the system's own list.
      const m = currentMessages;
      const screens = [
        ["dashboard", "nav.dashboard"],
        ["catalog", "nav.catalog"],
        ["receiving", "nav.receiving"],
        ["vendor", "nav.vendor"],
        ["shipping", "nav.shipping"],
        ["inventory", "nav.inventory"],
        ["settings", "nav.settings"],
        ["admin", "nav.admin"],
        ["device", "admin.permissions.devices.title"],
      ];
      const leaves = (node, prefix = "") =>
        Object.entries(node).flatMap(([k, v]) =>
          typeof v === "string" ? [v] : leaves(v, `${prefix}${k}.`),
        );
      const rows = screens.map(([key, nameKey]) => {
        const actions = leaves(m.admin.perm[key]);
        return `<tr><td class="permscreen">${esc(lookup(m, nameKey))}</td><td><ul class="compact">${actions
          .map((a) => `<li>${esc(a)}</li>`)
          .join("")}</ul></td></tr>`;
      });
      return `<table><thead><tr><th>${block.head[0]}</th><th>${block.head[1]}</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join("")}</tbody></table>`;
    }
    case "row":
      return `<div class="row n${block.items.length}">${block.items
        .map((item) => {
          const file = path.join(root, "manual", "shots", lang, `${item.img}.png`);
          if (!existsSync(file)) {
            missing.add(`${lang}: picture ${item.img}`);
            return `<figure class="missing">[${item.img}]</figure>`;
          }
          return `<figure><img src="${pathToFileURL(file).href}"/><figcaption>${rich(item.caption)}</figcaption></figure>`;
        })
        .join("")}</div>`;
    case "flow":
      return `<div class="flow">${block.steps
        .map((s, i) => `<div class="flowstep"><span class="n">${i + 1}</span><b>${rich(s[0])}</b><span>${rich(s[1])}</span></div>`)
        .join('<span class="arrow">›</span>')}</div>`;
    default:
      throw new Error(`unknown block ${block.type}`);
  }
}

const logoLight = pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "public", "brand", "logo-light.png")).href;

function chapterHtml(lang, content, chapter, index, rich) {
  const body = chapter.blocks.map((b) => renderBlock(lang, b, rich)).join("\n");
  return `<section class="chapter" id="c${index}">
  <div class="chapter-head"><span class="chapter-no">${index}</span><h1>${rich(chapter.title)}</h1></div>
  ${chapter.intro ? `<p class="lead">${rich(chapter.intro)}</p>` : ""}
  ${body}
</section>`;
}

function coverHtml(content, rich) {
  return `<section class="cover">
  <img class="logo" src="${logoLight}"/>
  <h1>${rich(content.cover.title)}</h1>
  <p class="sub">${rich(content.cover.subtitle)}</p>
  <p class="date">${rich(content.cover.date)}</p>
</section>`;
}

function tocHtml(content, rich, pages) {
  const rows = content.chapters
    .map(
      (c, i) =>
        `<li><a href="#c${i + 1}"><span class="t"><span class="no">${i + 1}</span>${rich(c.title)}</span><span class="dots"></span><span class="pg">${pages ? pages[i] : ""}</span></a>${c.summary ? `<p>${rich(c.summary)}</p>` : ""}</li>`,
    )
    .join("");
  return `<section class="toc"><h1>${rich(content.tocTitle)}</h1><ol>${rows}</ol></section>`;
}

function page(lang, content, inner) {
  const dir = lang === "he" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
  return `<!doctype html><html lang="${lang}" dir="${dir}"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><title>${esc(content.cover.title)}</title><style>${css}</style></head><body>${inner}</body></html>`;
}

async function pdfOf(browser, html, file, { footer = true } = {}) {
  const htmlFile = path.join(work, path.basename(file).replace(/\.pdf$/, ".html"));
  writeFileSync(htmlFile, html);
  const tab = await browser.newPage();
  await tab.goto(pathToFileURL(htmlFile).href, { waitUntil: "load" });
  await tab.evaluate(() => document.fonts.ready);
  await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
  const buffer = await tab.pdf({
    path: file,
    format: "A4",
    printBackground: true,
    preferCSSPageSize: true,
  });
  await tab.close();
  const text = buffer.toString("latin1");
  const counts = [...text.matchAll(/\/Count\s+(\d+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  return counts.length ? Math.max(...counts) : 1;
}

const plain = (html) =>
  html
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();

/** The text on every page of a PDF, so the contents page can name the page of each chapter. */
async function pageTexts(buffer) {
  const { getDocument } = await import("pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs");
  const doc = await getDocument({ data: new Uint8Array(buffer), verbosity: 0 }).promise;
  const texts = [];
  for (let n = 1; n <= doc.numPages; n++) {
    const content = await (await doc.getPage(n)).getTextContent();
    texts.push(content.items.map((i) => i.str).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " "));
  }
  return texts;
}

const reversed = (text) => [...text].reverse().join("");

const browser = await chromium.launch();
for (const lang of langs) {
  const content = (await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "manual", "content", `${lang}.mjs`)).href)).default;
  const { rich, messages } = make(lang);
  currentMessages = messages;
  const chapters = content.chapters.map((c, i) => chapterHtml(lang, content, c, i + 1, rich));
  const build = (starts) =>
    page(lang, content, coverHtml(content, rich) + tocHtml(content, rich, starts) + chapters.join(""));
  const file = path.join(out, content.fileName);

  // First pass: build it without page numbers, find the page where each chapter starts,
  // then build it again with the numbers (they do not change the number of pages).
  await pdfOf(browser, build(null), file);
  const texts = await pageTexts(readFileSync(file));
  let from = 1; // the contents page is page 2 (index 1); chapters come after it
  const starts = content.chapters.map((c, i) => {
    const marker = plain(rich(c.intro)).slice(0, 28);
    const found = texts.findIndex(
      (t, idx) => idx >= from && (t.includes(marker) || t.includes(reversed(marker))),
    );
    if (found < 0) {
      missing.add(`${lang}: could not find chapter ${i + 1} in the PDF`);
      return "";
    }
    from = found;
    return found + 1;
  });
  const total = await pdfOf(browser, build(starts), file);
  console.log(`${lang}: ${total} pages -> ${file}; chapters start on pages ${starts.join(", ")}`);
}
await browser.close();
if (missing.size) {
  console.log("MISSING:\n" + [...missing].join("\n"));
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
````

````ts
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import http from "node:http";
import { expect, test, type Browser, type Locator, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

/**
 * Takes the pictures for the manual, in English and in Hebrew, from a private copy of the system
 * with made-up data (manual/server.sh). Numbered red marks are drawn on the page before a picture
 * is taken, so the text of the manual can say "see 1, 2, 3".
 */

const ITEM_QR = "{{QR_PREFIX}}1|N2015D-S|CERT-77|051126|061126|171126";
const SECOND_QR = "{{QR_PREFIX}}1|N2015D-S|CERT-78|051126|061126|171126";
const OWNER = { email: "manager@example.com", first: "e2e-owner-password", next: "Tz7!kQm29rLw" };
const NEW_USER_PASSWORD = "Vh4#wPn83xYd";
const OUT = "manual/shots";

type Lang = "en" | "he";
const messages: Record<Lang, unknown> = {
  en: JSON.parse(readFileSync("messages/en.json", "utf8")),
  he: JSON.parse(readFileSync("messages/he.json", "utf8")),
};
const seedItems: Array<{ partname: string; barcode: string }> = JSON.parse(
  readFileSync("db/seed/priority/items.json", "utf8"),
);
const TAIL = seedItems.find((i) => i.partname === "N2015D-S")!.barcode.slice(-7);

function lookup(lang: Lang, key: string): string {
  let node: unknown = messages[lang];
  for (const part of key.split(".")) node = (node as Record<string, unknown>)?.[part];
  if (typeof node !== "string") throw new Error(`no message ${key} in ${lang}`);
  return node;
}

class Ctx {
  where = "";
  constructor(
    public page: Page,
    public lang: Lang,
  ) {}
  t(key: string, vars: Record<string, string | number> = {}): string {
    return lookup(this.lang, key).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, k) => String(vars[k] ?? `{${k}}`));
  }
  text(key: string, exact = true): Locator {
    return this.page.getByText(this.t(key), { exact }).first();
  }
  button(key: string, vars: Record<string, string | number> = {}, exact = true): Locator {
    return this.page.getByRole("button", { name: this.t(key, vars), exact }).first();
  }
}

let current: Ctx;
const problems: string[] = [];

async function step(name: string, body: () => Promise<void>) {
  if (process.env.ONLY && !new RegExp(process.env.ONLY).test(name)) return;
  try {
    await body();
  } catch (error) {
    const message = `${current.lang} · ${name}: ${(error as Error).message.split("\n").slice(0, 3).join(" | ")}`;
    problems.push(message);
    console.log(`!! ${message}`);
    await current.page.keyboard.press("Escape").catch(() => undefined);
    await unmark(current.page).catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

/** Draws numbered red marks around elements, in page coordinates. */
async function mark(
  page: Page,
  targets: Array<Locator | null | undefined>,
  area: { min: number; max: number },
) {
  const rects: Array<{ n: number; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }> = [];
  for (const [index, target] of targets.entries()) {
    if (!target) continue;
    try {
      await target.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout: 2500 });
      const box = await target.first().boundingBox();
      if (box) {
        const pad = box.height < 44 || box.width < 120 ? 7 : 2;
        rects.push({
          n: index + 1,
          x: box.x - pad,
          y: box.y - pad,
          w: box.width + pad * 2,
          h: box.height + pad * 2,
        });
      }
    } catch {
      problems.push(`${current.lang} · mark ${index + 1} not found (${current.where})`);
    }
  }
  const rtl = (await page.locator("html").getAttribute("dir")) === "rtl";
  await page.evaluate(
    ({ rects, rtl, area }) => {
      const root = document.createElement("div");
      root.id = "manual-marks";
      document.body.appendChild(root);
      const sx = window.scrollX;
      const sy = window.scrollY;
      for (const r of rects) {
        const box = document.createElement("div");
        box.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:${r.x + sx - 3}px;top:${r.y + sy - 3}px;width:${r.w + 6}px;height:${r.h + 6}px;border:3px solid #d62828;border-radius:10px;pointer-events:none;z-index:2147483000;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #fff;`;
        const badge = document.createElement("div");
        badge.textContent = String(r.n);
        const size = 28;
        const fitsOutside = rtl ? r.x + r.w + 8 + size <= area.max : r.x - size - 8 >= area.min;
        let left = rtl ? r.x + sx + r.w + 8 : r.x + sx - size - 8;
        if (!fitsOutside) left = rtl ? r.x + sx + r.w - size - 8 : r.x + sx + 8;
        const top = r.h > 56 ? r.y + sy + 8 : r.y + sy + r.h / 2 - size / 2;
        badge.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:${left}px;top:${top}px;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#d62828;color:#fff;font:700 15px/28px Arial,sans-serif;text-align:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:2147483001;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff;`;
        root.append(box, badge);
      }
    },
    { rects, rtl, area },
  );
}

async function unmark(page: Page) {
  await page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById("manual-marks")?.remove());
}

interface ShotOptions {
  marks?: Array<Locator | null | undefined>;
  /** Make the window as tall as the page, so the whole page is in the picture. */
  tall?: boolean;
  of?: Locator;
  wait?: number;
  keepScroll?: boolean;
  /** Keep the side menu in the picture (by default it is cropped away, to show the screen larger). */
  keepSidebar?: boolean;
  /** A fixed part of the page, in pixels, for pages without a side menu. */
  clip?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
}

async function shot(name: string, options: ShotOptions = {}) {
  const { page, lang } = current;
  current.where = name;
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle").catch(() => undefined);
  if (options.tall) {
    const height = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollHeight);
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: Math.min(Math.max(height, 800), 3200) });
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  }
  if (!options.keepScroll && !options.of) await page.evaluate(() => window.scrollTo(0, 0));
  await page.waitForTimeout(options.wait ?? 800);
  let clip = options.clip;
  const size = page.viewportSize()!;
  if (!clip && !options.keepSidebar && !options.of && size.width >= 1000) {
    const rtl = (await page.locator("html").getAttribute("dir")) === "rtl";
    const hasMenu = (await page.locator("nav").count()) > 0;
    if (hasMenu) clip = { x: rtl ? 0 : 230, y: 0, width: size.width - 230, height: size.height };
  }
  if (options.marks) {
    await mark(
      page,
      options.marks,
      clip ? { min: clip.x, max: clip.x + clip.width } : { min: 0, max: size.width },
    );
  }
  const path = `${OUT}/${lang}/${name}.png`;
  if (options.of) await options.of.screenshot({ path });
  else await page.screenshot({ path, clip });
  await unmark(page);
  if (options.tall) await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
}

async function ensureLang(page: Page, lang: Lang) {
  if ((await page.locator("html").getAttribute("lang")) !== lang) {
    await page.getByTitle(lang === "he" ? "עברית" : "English").click();
    await expect(page.locator("html")).toHaveAttribute("lang", lang);
  }
}

async function signIn(page: Page, email: string, password: string) {
  await page.goto("/login");
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await page.locator("#email").fill(email);
  await page.locator("#password").fill(password);
  await page.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
}

async function choosePassword(page: Page, next: string) {
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/change-password/);
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await page.locator("#newPassword").fill(next);
  await page.locator("#confirmPassword").fill(next);
  await page.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
}

async function setLocaleCookie(page: Page, lang: Lang) {
  await page.context().addCookies([{ name: "locale", value: lang, url: "http://localhost:3100" }]);
}

async function ownerSession(page: Page, lang: Lang) {
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await setLocaleCookie(page, lang);
  await signIn(page, OWNER.email, OWNER.next);
  const reached = await page
    .waitForURL(/\/dashboard/, { timeout: 8000 })
    .then(() => true)
    .catch(() => false);
  if (!reached) {
    await signIn(page, OWNER.email, OWNER.first);
    await choosePassword(page, OWNER.next);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
  }
  await ensureLang(page, lang);
}

async function go(page: Page, path: string) {
  await page.goto(path);
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
}

const run = Date.now().toString().slice(-6);

async function captureLogin(browser: Browser, lang: Lang) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ locale: lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-US" });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  current = new Ctx(page, lang);
  await setLocaleCookie(page, lang);
  await go(page, "/login");
  const card = { x: 430, y: 60, width: 420, height: 680 };
  await shot("01-login", {
    clip: card,
    marks: [page.locator("#email"), page.locator("#password"), page.locator("button[type=submit]")],
  });
  await step("login wrong password", async () => {
    await page.locator("#email").fill(OWNER.email);
    await page.locator("#password").fill("wrong-password-1");
    await page.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
    await page.getByRole("alert").first().waitFor();
    await shot("02-login-wrong", { clip: card });
  });
  await context.close();
}

async function captureNewUser(browser: Browser, lang: Lang, email: string, password: string) {
  const context = await browser.newContext({ locale: lang === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-US" });
  const page = await context.newPage();
  current = new Ctx(page, lang);
  await setLocaleCookie(page, lang);
  await signIn(page, email, password);
  await page.waitForURL(/\/change-password/);
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await step("first login page", async () => {
    await page.locator("#newPassword").fill(NEW_USER_PASSWORD);
    await page.locator("#confirmPassword").fill(NEW_USER_PASSWORD);
    await shot("03-first-login", {
      clip: { x: 430, y: 40, width: 420, height: 720 },
      marks: [
        page.locator("#newPassword"),
        page.locator("#confirmPassword"),
        page.locator("button[type=submit]"),
      ],
    });
  });
  await page.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
  await page.waitForLoadState("networkidle");
  await step("worker landing", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 1000 });
    await shot("04-worker-landing", { keepSidebar: true });
  });
  await context.close();
}

test("pictures for the manual", async ({ page, browser }) => {
  test.setTimeout(2_400_000);
  if (!process.env.ONLY) rmSync(OUT, { recursive: true, force: true });
  mkdirSync(`${OUT}/en`, { recursive: true });
  mkdirSync(`${OUT}/he`, { recursive: true });
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    window.print = () => undefined;
  });

  const pretend = http.createServer((request, response) => {
    let data = "";
    request.on("data", (chunk) => (data += chunk));
    request.on("end", () => {
      const body = JSON.parse(data) as { system: Array<{ text: string }> };
      const lang: Lang = body.system[0].text.includes("Answer in Hebrew") ? "he" : "en";
      const t = (key: string) => lookup(lang, key);
      const text =
        lang === "en"
          ? `1. Open **${t("nav.catalog")}** and press **${t("catalog.select.start")}**.\n2. Tap the items you want. The bar at the bottom counts them.\n3. Press **${t("catalog.select.print")}**.\n4. Choose one label type for all, fill in each item's slaughter date, certificate number and copies, and press **${t("catalog.print.submit")}**.`
          : `1. פתחו את **${t("nav.catalog")}** ולחצו **${t("catalog.select.start")}**.\n2. הקישו על הפריטים שאתם רוצים. הסרגל בתחתית סופר אותם.\n3. לחצו **${t("catalog.select.print")}**.\n4. בחרו סוג תווית אחד לכולם, מלאו לכל פריט תאריך שחיטה, מספר תעודה ועותקים, ולחצו **${t("catalog.print.submit")}**.`;
      response.setHeader("content-type", "application/json");
      response.end(JSON.stringify({ content: [{ type: "text", text }] }));
    });
  });
  await new Promise<void>((done) => pretend.listen(3199, "127.0.0.1", done));

  for (const lang of ["en", "he"] as const) {
    if (process.env.LANG_ONLY && process.env.LANG_ONLY !== lang) continue;
    if (!process.env.ONLY) await captureLogin(browser, lang);
    current = new Ctx(page, lang);
    await ownerSession(page, lang);
    await captureApp(page, browser, lang);
  }

  await new Promise((done) => pretend.close(done));
  console.log("\nPROBLEMS:\n" + (problems.join("\n") || "none"));
});

  page.evaluate(() => window.dispatchEvent(new Event("afterprint")));

      await go(page, "/settings?section=priority");

        .getByRole("radiogroup", { name: c.t("settings.standIn.title") })
        .getByRole("radio", { name: new RegExp("^" + c.t(`settings.standIn.modes.${mode}.name`)) })
        .click();
      await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
    };
    await choose("down");
    try {
      await go(page, "/receiving");
      const scan = page.locator("#scan-input");
      await scan.fill(SECOND_QR.replace("CERT-78", "CERT-79"));
      await scan.press("Enter");
      await page.locator("#simulated-weight").fill("12.30");
      await c.button("receiving.save").click();
      await page.getByTestId("saved-notice").waitFor();
      await finishPrint(page);
      await shot("81-receiving-priority-down", { tall: true });
      await go(page, "/admin?tab=sends");
      await shot("82-admin-sends", { tall: true });
    } finally {
      await choose("normal");
    }
    // Priority is back: the timer sends the waiting box, so the next language starts clean.
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      await page.waitForTimeout(10_000);
      await go(page, "/admin?tab=sends");
      if (await page.getByTestId("sends-empty").isVisible()) break;
    }
  });

    await shot("93-phone-menu");
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
````

### FILE: `manual/content/blocks.mjs`

````js
// Small helpers so the chapters of the manual read as plain lists of blocks.
export const h3 = (text) => ({ type: "h3", text });
export const h4 = (text) => ({ type: "h4", text });
export const p = (text) => ({ type: "p", text });
export const ul = (...items) => ({ type: "ul", items });
export const steps = (...items) => ({ type: "ol", items });
export const fig = (img, caption, legend, extra = {}) => ({ type: "fig", img, caption, legend, ...extra });
export const row = (...items) => ({ type: "row", items });
export const table = (head, ...rows) => ({ type: "table", head, rows });
export const flow = (...steps) => ({ type: "flow", steps });
export const permTable = (head) => ({ type: "perms", head });
export const callout = (type, label) => (text) => ({ type, label, text });
````

### FILE: `manual/make-knowledge.mjs`

````js
// Turns the manual's text (English and Hebrew) into plain text for the question helper, and
// writes it to src/server/assistant/knowledge.ts. Run after the manual text changes:
//   node manual/make-knowledge.mjs
// [[some.key]] becomes the words the screen itself uses, so the helper names buttons exactly.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import path from "node:path";

const root = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..");

const lookup = (messages, key) => key.split(".").reduce((n, p) => n?.[p], messages);

function plainText(lang, content, messages) {
  const rich = (text) =>
    String(text)
      .replace(/\[\[([\w.]+)\]\]/g, (_, key) => {
        const value = lookup(messages, key);
        if (typeof value !== "string") throw new Error(`no ${key} in ${lang}`);
        return `“${value}”`;
      })
      .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "$1")
      .replace(/`(.+?)`/g, "$1");

  const leaves = (node) =>
    Object.values(node).flatMap((v) => (typeof v === "string" ? [v] : leaves(v)));

  const out = [];
  content.chapters.forEach((chapter, i) => {
    out.push(`\n# ${i + 1}. ${rich(chapter.title)}`);
    if (chapter.intro) out.push(rich(chapter.intro));
    for (const block of chapter.blocks) {
      switch (block.type) {
        case "h3":
        case "h4":
          out.push(`\n## ${rich(block.text)}`);
          break;
        case "p":
          out.push(rich(block.text));
          break;
        case "ul":
          out.push(...block.items.map((item) => `- ${rich(item)}`));
          break;
        case "ol":
          out.push(...block.items.map((item, n) => `${n + 1}. ${rich(item)}`));
          break;
        case "note":
        case "tip":
        case "warn":
          out.push(`${block.label}: ${rich(block.text)}`);
          break;
        case "table":
          out.push(block.head.map(rich).join(" | "));
          out.push(...block.rows.map((row) => row.map(rich).join(" | ")));
          break;
        case "fig":
          out.push(`[Picture: ${rich(block.caption)}]`);
          if (block.legend) out.push(...block.legend.map((l, n) => `  (${n + 1}) ${rich(l)}`));
          break;
        case "flow":
          out.push(...block.steps.map((s, n) => `${n + 1}) ${rich(s[0])}: ${rich(s[1])}`));
          break;
        case "perms": {
          const perm = messages.admin.perm;
          for (const [screen, node] of Object.entries(perm)) {
            out.push(`- ${screen}: ${leaves(node).join("; ")}`);
          }
          break;
        }
        default:
          break; // row of pictures: nothing to say in words
      }
    }
  });
  return out.join("\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
}

const result = {};
for (const lang of ["en", "he"]) {
  const content = (await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, "manual", "content", `${lang}.mjs`)).href)).default;
  const messages = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(root, "messages", `${lang}.json`), "utf8"));
  result[lang] = plainText(lang, content, messages);
}

const file = path.join(root, "src", "server", "assistant", "knowledge.ts");
writeFileSync(
  file,
  `/* eslint-disable */\n// Generated by manual/make-knowledge.mjs from the manual's text. Do not edit by hand.\n` +
    `export const KNOWLEDGE: Record<"en" | "he", string> = ${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)};\n`,
);
console.log(`knowledge: en ${result.en.length} characters, he ${result.he.length} characters -> ${file}`);
````

````ts
import { defineConfig, devices } from "@playwright/test";

// Takes the pictures for the manual from a private copy of the system with made-up data
// (started by manual/server.sh on port 3100). It never touches the live system.
export default defineConfig({
  testDir: ".",
  testMatch: "capture.spec.ts",
  workers: 1,
  reporter: [["list"]],
  timeout: 900_000,
  use: {
    baseURL: "http://localhost:3100",
    ...devices["Desktop Chrome"],
    viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 },
    deviceScaleFactor: 1.5,
    actionTimeout: 8000,
  },
});
````

````css
@page {
  size: A4;
  margin: 15mm 14mm 17mm;
  @bottom-center {
    content: counter(page);
    font: 9pt "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: #8a8176;
  }
}
@page cover {
  margin: 0;
  @bottom-center {
    content: none;
  }
}

:root {
  --ink: #25221f;
  --muted: #6f675d;
  --brand: {{BRAND_COLOR}};
  --gold: {{ACCENT_COLOR}};
  --cream: #f5f0e8;

}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
html {
  font: 10.2pt/1.5 "Segoe UI", Arial, "Noto Sans Hebrew", Tahoma, sans-serif;

body {
  margin: 0;
}
[dir="rtl"] body {
  font-size: 11pt;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- cover and contents */
.cover {
  page: cover;
  height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;

}

  width: 120mm;

}

}

}
.cover .date {
  font-size: 10.5pt;
  color: #a79d8c;
  border-top: 1px solid #5a5249;

}

.toc {
  break-after: page;
}
.toc h1 {
  font-size: 22pt;

}

  list-style: none;

  padding: 0;
}

  margin: 0 0 1.5mm;
}

}

}

}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ chapters */
.chapter {

}

}

  background: var(--brand);

}

}

}

}

  margin: 5mm 0 1.5mm;

}
p {
  margin: 0 0 2.6mm;

}
ul,
ol.steps {

}
li {

}
ol.steps {
  list-style: none;

}
ol.steps > li {
  counter-increment: step;

}
ol.steps > li::before {

}
tr {
  break-inside: avoid;
}
tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background: #faf7f1;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- figures */
.fig {
  margin: 3mm 0 4mm;
}
.figbox {

}
.fig img {
  display: block;

}
.fig.alone img {

}
.fig.narrow img {

}
.fig figcaption {

  text-align: center;

}
.legend {
  list-style: none;

}

}
.n {
  flex: none;

  height: 5.6mm;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #d62828;
  color: #fff;
  font: 700 8.6pt/5.6mm Arial, sans-serif;

}
.row {

}

}
.row img {

}
.row figcaption {
  font-size: 8.4pt;

}

.flow {

}
.flowstep {

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1mm;
}
.flowstep b {
  font-size: 9.4pt;
}
.flowstep .n {
  background: var(--brand);
}
.arrow {
  align-self: center;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-size: 16pt;
  font-weight: 700;
}
[dir="rtl"] .arrow {
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

ul.compact {
  margin: 0;
  padding-inline-start: 4mm;
}
ul.compact li {
  margin: 0 0 0.6mm;
}
td.permscreen {
  font-weight: 700;
  width: 34mm;
}

.row.n2 figure {
  max-width: 82mm;
}
.row.n3 figure {
  max-width: 57mm;
}

.chapter-head {
  break-after: avoid;
  break-inside: avoid;
}
.chapter > .lead {
  break-before: avoid;
}
.chapter > .lead {
  break-after: avoid;
}
.fig img {
  max-height: 142mm;
}
/* Every chapter starts on a new page. */
.chapter {
  break-before: page;
  margin-top: 0;
}
.fig img {
  max-height: 128mm;
}
.fig.alone img {
  max-height: 185mm;
}
table {
  font-size: 9.3pt;
}

.fig.medium img {
  max-width: 76%;
}
td,
th {
  padding-block: 1.3mm;
}
h3 {
  margin: 5mm 0 1.5mm;
}
li {
  margin-bottom: 0.9mm;
}
ol.steps > li {
  min-height: 0;
}
p {
  margin-bottom: 2mm;
}
````

````json
    "pages": {
      "dashboard": {
        "title": "Dashboard",
        "purpose": "The factory at a glance: how much stock there is, in which warehouse, and which boxes have expired or are about to.",
        "steps": "The four tiles at the top show the total weight, the number of boxes, the number of different items and the boxes that need attention.\nPress the tile “Need attention” to see every item that has expired or soon-to-expire boxes, and open an item to see its boxes.\nEach warehouse has its own card: its weight, boxes and items, and a bar showing how many boxes are in date (green), expiring soon (amber) or expired (red).\nPress the line “items need attention” on a card to see the items and boxes of that warehouse.\nPress “Refresh data from Priority” to read the stock again now; otherwise it is read at most once a minute.\nPress “Arrange the rooms” to put the warehouse cards in the order you want. The order is kept for you only: every person arranges their own.",
        "tips": "How many days before expiry counts as “soon” is set per category in System settings, under Receiving.\nIf Priority does not answer, nothing is lost: try again in a moment."
      },
      "catalog": {
        "title": "Item catalog",
        "purpose": "All the items from Priority. Look an item up here and print its label. Items are created and changed only in Priority.",
        "steps": "Type a name (Hebrew or English), an item number or a barcode in the search box. ### FILE: `next.config.ts`
````

````ts
import type { NextConfig } from "next";
import createNextIntlPlugin from "next-intl/plugin";

const withNextIntl = createNextIntlPlugin();

const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production";

// What a page may load and do. Scripts and styles are the app's own (Next injects small inline
// ones); nothing may frame the app, and forms and links go nowhere else.
const CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY = [
  "default-src 'self'",
  `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'${isDev ? " 'unsafe-eval'" : ""}`,
  "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'",
  "img-src 'self' data: blob:",
  "font-src 'self' data:",
  `connect-src 'self'${isDev ? " ws: wss:" : ""}`,
  "frame-ancestors 'none'",
  "base-uri 'self'",
  "form-action 'self'",
  "object-src 'none'",
].join("; ");

const SECURITY_HEADERS = [
  { key: "Content-Security-Policy", value: CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY },
  { key: "Strict-Transport-Security", value: "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains" },
  { key: "X-Frame-Options", value: "DENY" },
  { key: "X-Content-Type-Options", value: "nosniff" },
  { key: "Referrer-Policy", value: "no-referrer" },
  { key: "Permissions-Policy", value: "camera=(self), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()" },
  { key: "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", value: "same-origin" },
  { key: "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", value: "same-origin" },
];

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  poweredByHeader: false,
  headers: async () => [
    // The pages hold per-person data: never kept in a shared or browser cache.
    {
      source: "/((?!_next/static).*)",
      headers: [...SECURITY_HEADERS, { key: "Cache-Control", value: "no-store, max-age=0" }],
    },
    // Built files are fingerprinted and may be cached. (Not while developing: the files keep
    // their names there, and the browser would keep showing old code.)
    ...(isDev
      ? []
      : [
          {
            source: "/_next/static/:path*",
            headers: [{ key: "Cache-Control", value: "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" }],
          },
        ]),
  ],
  // The end-to-end tests run their own server beside the dev server and need a separate build folder.
  distDir: process.env.NEXT_DIST_DIR || ".next",
  // Every screen is per-user and dynamic (session, permissions, language),
  // so the static-shell model of cache components buys nothing here and
  // would forbid reading the language cookie in the root layout.
  cacheComponents: false,
  // Other devices on the same network (a phone) may open the dev server by its network address.
  allowedDevOrigins: (process.env.TRUSTED_ORIGINS ?? "")
    .split(",")
    .map((origin) => origin.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    // The host alone (no scheme or port); a leading "*." allows every subdomain.
    .map((origin) => origin.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").replace(/:\d+$/, "")),
  // Native/WASM database drivers must not be bundled.
  serverExternalPackages: ["@electric-sql/pglite", "pg"],
  turbopack: {
    rules: {
      "*.css": {
        loaders: ["@tailwindcss/turbopack"],
        as: "*.css",
      },
    },
  },
};

export default withNextIntl(nextConfig);
````

````ts
import path from "node:path";
import { defineConfig, devices } from "@playwright/test";
import { E2E_OWNER } from "./e2e/constants";

const PORT = 3100;

const WIPE_DATABASE = `node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('data/e2e-pglite',{recursive:true,force:true})"`;

// E2E_DEV=1 runs the tests against `next dev` the way `pnpm dev` starts it (database in its own
// process), to check that setup. The default is a production build, which is faster to start.
const command = process.env.E2E_DEV
  ? `${WIPE_DATABASE} && pnpm exec pglite-server --db=data/e2e-pglite --port=54330 --max-connections=10 --run "node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --port ${PORT}" --include-database-url`
  : `${WIPE_DATABASE} && pnpm exec next build && pnpm exec next start --port ${PORT}`;

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: "./e2e",
  // One embedded database, one server: tests share state, so run them in order.
  workers: 1,
  fullyParallel: false,
  reporter: [["list"]],
  use: {
    baseURL: `http://localhost:${PORT}`,
    trace: "retain-on-failure",
  },
  projects: [{ name: "chromium", use: { ...devices["Desktop Chrome"] } }],
  webServer: {
    // `next dev` serves pages and API routes from two processes, and a file PGlite can only be
    // opened by one process at a time, so the default is a production build (one process).
    // The throwaway database lives under ./data (git-ignored) and is wiped before every run,
    // so the running dev server and its data are never touched.
    command,
    url: `http://localhost:${PORT}/login`,
    reuseExistingServer: false,
    timeout: 300_000,
    env: {
      NEXT_DIST_DIR: ".next-e2e",
      E2E_RELAXED_RATE_LIMIT: "1",
      PGLITE_DIR: path.join(process.cwd(), "data", "e2e-pglite"),
      // Empty means the embedded database; pglite-server fills it in for the dev run.
      ...(process.env.E2E_DEV ? {} : { DATABASE_URL: "" }),
      APP_URL: `http://localhost:${PORT}`,
      AUTH_SECRET: "e2e-only-secret-not-used-anywhere-else-0123456789",
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: "",
      GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: "",
      PRIORITY_MODE: "fake",
      // The question helper talks to a pretend service that the specs start on this port.
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "e2e-test-key",
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: "http://127.0.0.1:3199",
      SEED_OWNER_EMAIL: E2E_OWNER.email,
      SEED_OWNER_PASSWORD: E2E_OWNER.password,
      SEED_OWNER_NAME: E2E_OWNER.name,
    },
  },
});
````

### FILE: `scripts/dev.mjs`

````js
// `pnpm dev`: runs the embedded database (PGlite) in its own process and Next.js against it.
//
// `next dev` serves pages and API routes from two processes, and a PGlite folder can only be
// opened by one process at a time, so the database gets a process of its own (pglite-server)
// that both Next.js processes connect to through DATABASE_URL.
//
// The local database is disposable (the seed recreates it), so before starting this clears the
// lock a killed server leaves behind and, if the folder still cannot start, moves it aside.
import { spawn, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, renameSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import net from "node:net";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const dataDir = path.resolve(process.env.PGLITE_DIR || "data/pglite");
const port = process.env.PGLITE_PORT || "54329";

/** True when something already listens on the port (another `pnpm dev`, most likely). */
function portInUse(number) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const socket = net.connect({ host: "127.0.0.1", port: Number(number) });
    const done = (busy) => {
      socket.destroy();
      resolve(busy);
    };
    socket.setTimeout(1500, () => done(false));
    socket.once("connect", () => done(true));
    socket.once("error", () => done(false));
  });
}

// First of all, and before touching the database folder: a running server owns it, and
// clearing its lock or moving the folder aside would hurt that server.
if (await portInUse(port)) {
  console.error(
    `[dev] The database port ${port} is already in use. Another "pnpm dev" is probably running ` +
      `(look for its terminal, or stop the process that holds port ${port}). ` +
      `Nothing was changed.`,
  );
  process.exit(1);
}

const stalePid = path.join(dataDir, "postmaster.pid");
if (existsSync(stalePid)) rmSync(stalePid, { force: true });

if (existsSync(dataDir)) {
  // Tried in a separate process: a PGlite that aborted keeps the folder's files open, and
  // Windows will not rename a folder while any handle is open.
  const probe = spawnSync(
    process.execPath,
    [
      "--input-type=module",
      "-e",
      `import { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
       const db = new PGlite(${JSON.stringify(dataDir)});
       await db.waitReady;
       await db.close();`,
    ],
    { encoding: "utf8", timeout: 120_000 },
  );
  if (probe.status !== 0) {
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, "-");
    const target = `${dataDir}.damaged-${stamp}`;
    renameSync(dataDir, target);
    console.warn(
      `[dev] PGlite could not start from ${dataDir} (${(probe.stderr || "").split("\n")[0].slice(0, 120)}). ` +
        `The folder was moved to ${target}; a fresh database will be created and seeded.`,
    );
  }
}

const server = fileURLToPath(
  new URL("../node_modules/@electric-sql/pglite-socket/dist/scripts/server.js", import.meta.url),
);
const child = spawn(
  process.execPath,
  [
    server,
    `--db=${dataDir}`,
    `--port=${port}`,
    "--max-connections=10",
    "--run",
    "node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev",
    "--include-database-url",
  ],
  { stdio: "inherit" },
);

for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"]) {
  process.on(signal, () => child.kill(signal));
}
child.on("exit", (code) => process.exit(code ?? 0));
````

### FILE: `scripts/serve-remote.mjs`

````js
// `node scripts/serve-remote.mjs`: the built app (light and fast) on port 3001, for opening the
// system from another computer through a link. It uses the database of the running `pnpm dev`,
// so start that first. Build it once with: NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod pnpm exec next build
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const port = process.env.PGLITE_PORT || "54329";
const next = path.join(root, "node_modules", "next", "dist", "bin", "next");

const child = spawn(process.execPath, [next, "start", "-p", "3001"], {
  cwd: root,
  stdio: "inherit",
  env: {
    ...process.env,
    NEXT_DIST_DIR: ".next-prod",
    DATABASE_URL:
      process.env.DATABASE_URL || `postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:${port}/postgres`,
  },
});
child.on("exit", (code) => process.exit(code ?? 0));
for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"]) process.on(signal, () => child.kill(signal));
````

````tsx
import { KeyRound, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { requireActiveUser } from "@/server/auth/session";
import { TwoFactorCard } from "./two-factor-card";

/** A person's own account: their password and two-step verification. Open to everyone who is signed in. */
export default async function AccountPage() {
  const { user } = await requireActiveUser();
  const t = await getTranslations("account");
  const shell = await getTranslations("shell.groups");

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        icon={<ShieldCheck />}
        eyebrow={shell("system")}
        title={t("title")}
        description={t("description")}
        help="account"
      />
      <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{t("password.title")}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>{t("password.description")}</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            nativeButton={false}
            render={<Link href="/change-password" data-testid="change-password" />}
          >
            <KeyRound data-icon="inline-start" />
            {t("password.change")}
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <TwoFactorCard enabled={Boolean(user.twoFactorEnabled)} />
    </>
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/app/(app)/account/two-factor-card.tsx`

````tsx
"use client";

import { ShieldCheck, ShieldOff } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { PasswordInput } from "@/components/password-input";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { qrSvg } from "@/lib/labels/codes";

type Step =
  | { name: "idle" }
  | { name: "password"; goal: "enable" | "disable" | "codes" }
  | { name: "scan"; uri: string; secret: string; backupCodes: string[] }
  | { name: "codes"; backupCodes: string[] };

type Problem = "password" | "code" | "generic" | null;

/** The secret inside the otpauth link, for typing by hand when the picture cannot be scanned. */
function secretOf(uri: string): string {
  try {
    return new URL(uri).searchParams.get("secret") ?? "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/**
 * Two-step verification for the signed-in person: turn it on (password, scan the picture,
 * type one code), turn it off (password), or get new backup codes (password).
 */
export function TwoFactorCard({ enabled }: { enabled: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("account.twoFactor");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>({ name: "idle" });
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<Problem>(null);

  function begin(goal: "enable" | "disable" | "codes") {
    setProblem(null);
    setStep({ name: "password", goal });
  }

  function cancel() {
    setProblem(null);
    setStep({ name: "idle" });
  }

  function submitPassword(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (step.name !== "password") return;
    const goal = step.goal;
    const password = String(new FormData(event.currentTarget).get("password") ?? "");
    if (!password) return;
    setProblem(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      if (goal === "enable") {
        const result = await authClient.twoFactor.enable({ password });
        if (result.error || !result.data || !("totpURI" in result.data)) {
          return void setProblem(
            result.error?.code === "INVALID_PASSWORD" ? "password" : "generic",
          );
        }
        const uri = String(result.data.totpURI);
        setStep({
          name: "scan",
          uri,
          secret: secretOf(uri),
          backupCodes: result.data.backupCodes ?? [],
        });
      } else if (goal === "disable") {
        const result = await authClient.twoFactor.disable({ password });
        if (result.error) {
          return void setProblem(result.error.code === "INVALID_PASSWORD" ? "password" : "generic");
        }
        toast.success(t("turnedOff"));
        setStep({ name: "idle" });
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        const result = await authClient.twoFactor.generateBackupCodes({ password });
        if (result.error || !result.data) {
          return void setProblem(
            result.error?.code === "INVALID_PASSWORD" ? "password" : "generic",
          );
        }
        setStep({ name: "codes", backupCodes: result.data.backupCodes });
      }
    });
  }

  function confirmCode(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (step.name !== "scan") return;
    const backupCodes = step.backupCodes;
    const code = String(new FormData(event.currentTarget).get("code") ?? "").replace(/\s/g, "");
    if (!code) return;
    setProblem(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await authClient.twoFactor.verifyTotp({ code });
      if (result.error) return void setProblem("code");
      toast.success(t("turnedOn"));
      // The backup codes stay on screen until the person has saved them.
      setStep({ name: "codes", backupCodes });
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="rise max-w-2xl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl">
          {enabled ? (
            <ShieldCheck className="size-6 text-success" />
          ) : (
            <ShieldOff className="size-6 text-muted-foreground" />
          )}
          {t("title")}
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-5">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium" data-testid="two-factor-status">
          {enabled ? t("statusOn") : t("statusOff")}
        </p>

        {problem ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{t(`problems.${problem}`)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        {step.name === "idle" ? (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {enabled ? (
              <>
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => begin("codes")}>
                  {t("newCodes")}
                </Button>
                <Button type="button" variant="destructive" onClick={() => begin("disable")}>
                  {t("turnOff")}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button type="button" data-testid="two-factor-start" onClick={() => begin("enable")}>
                {t("turnOn")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {step.name === "password" ? (
          <form onSubmit={submitPassword} className="space-y-3" noValidate>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="two-factor-password">{t("passwordLabel")}</Label>
              <PasswordInput
                id="two-factor-password"
                name="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                dir="ltr"
                autoFocus
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} data-testid="two-factor-continue">
                {t("continue")}
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={cancel} disabled={pending}>
                {t("cancel")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : null}

        {step.name === "scan" ? (
          <form onSubmit={confirmCode} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
            <ol className="list-decimal space-y-1 ps-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <li>{t("stepInstall")}</li>
              <li>{t("stepScan")}</li>
              <li>{t("stepType")}</li>
            </ol>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-5">
              <QrPicture uri={step.uri} label={t("qrLabel")} />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("manual")}</p>
                <p
                  dir="ltr"
                  data-testid="two-factor-secret"
                  className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3 py-2 font-mono text-sm break-all select-all"
                >
                  {step.secret}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <BackupCodes codes={step.backupCodes} />
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="two-factor-code">{t("codeLabel")}</Label>
              <Input
                id="two-factor-code"
                name="code"
                autoComplete="one-time-code"
                inputMode="numeric"
                dir="ltr"
                className="max-w-48 text-center font-mono text-lg tracking-widest"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} data-testid="two-factor-confirm">
                {t("confirm")}
              </Button>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={cancel} disabled={pending}>
                {t("cancel")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : null}

        {step.name === "codes" ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <BackupCodes codes={step.backupCodes} />
            <Button type="button" onClick={cancel} data-testid="two-factor-done">
              {t("done")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function QrPicture({ uri, label }: { uri: string; label: string }) {
  const svg = qrSvg(uri);
  if (!svg) return null;
  return (
    // A picture from data, so no markup is injected into the page.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img
      src={`data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`}
      alt={label}
      className="size-44 shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-border bg-white p-2"
    />
  );
}

function BackupCodes({ codes }: { codes: string[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations("account.twoFactor");
  if (codes.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 p-4">
      <p className="text-sm font-medium">{t("backupTitle")}</p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("backupHint")}</p>
      <ul
        dir="ltr"
        data-testid="backup-codes"
        className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-1 font-mono text-sm select-all"
      >
        {codes.map((code) => (
          <li key={code}>{code}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/app/(app)/admin/actions.ts`

````ts
"use server";

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  AdminError,
  createUser,
  deleteUser,
  resetTwoFactor,
  resetUserPassword,
  setUserDisabled,
  setUserPermissions,
  updateUserProfile,
} from "@/server/auth/admin";
import { listActivityReport } from "@/server/auth/admin-queries";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { users } from "@/server/db/schema";
import { retryFailed } from "@/server/receiving";
import { sendMail } from "@/server/mail";
import { welcomeEmail } from "@/server/mail/welcome";
import { handleMessage } from "@/server/messages";
import { markAlertsSeen } from "@/server/security/alerts";
import { endSession } from "@/server/security/sessions";
import { isIdleMinutes, setIdleMinutes } from "@/server/security";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError, type Access } from "@/server/permissions";
import { isPermission } from "@/server/permissions/registry";

export type AdminErrorCode =
  | "EMAIL_TAKEN"
  | "USER_NOT_FOUND"
  | "OWNER_PROTECTED"
  | "HAS_HISTORY"
  | "SELF_PROTECTED"
  | "INVALID_PERMISSION"
  | "NOT_ALLOWED"
  | "INVALID_INPUT"
  | "GENERIC";

export type AdminResult<T = object> = ({ ok: true } & T) | { ok: false; error: AdminErrorCode };

const profileSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().trim().min(2).max(80),
  displayName: z.string().trim().max(40),
  jobTitle: z.string().trim().max(60),
  locale: z.enum(["he", "en"]),
});

const createSchema = profileSchema.extend({
  email: z.string().trim().toLowerCase().max(120).pipe(z.email()),
  permissions: z.array(z.string()).max(200),
});

const updateSchema = profileSchema.extend({
  id: z.string().min(1),
  /** Undefined leaves the permissions as they are (the caller may not hold admin.permissions). */
  permissions: z.array(z.string()).max(200).optional(),
});

async function run<T extends object>(
  work: () => Promise<T>,
): Promise<({ ok: true } & T) | { ok: false; error: AdminErrorCode }> {
  try {
    const result = await work();
    revalidatePath("/admin");
    return { ok: true, ...result };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AdminError) return { ok: false, error: error.code };
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    console.error("[admin] action failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/** Anyone below the owner may only hand out keys they hold themselves. */
function assertCanGrant(access: Access, keys: string[]): void {
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (!isPermission(key)) throw new AdminError("INVALID_PERMISSION");
    if (!access.isOwner && !access.permissions.has(key)) throw new PermissionError(key);
  }
}

async function targetIsOwner(userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ isOwner: users.isOwner })
    .from(users)
    .where(eq(users.id, userId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!row) throw new AdminError("USER_NOT_FOUND");
  return row.isOwner;
}

/** Only the owner may touch the owner's account. */
async function assertMayTouch(access: Access, userId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!access.isOwner && (await targetIsOwner(userId))) throw new AdminError("OWNER_PROTECTED");
}

export async function createUserAction(
  input: z.input<typeof createSchema>,
): Promise<AdminResult<{ temporaryPassword: string; email: string; emailed: boolean }>> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.users.create");
    const data = createSchema.parse(input);
    // Permissions can only be given by someone who may edit them.
    const permissions = access.can("admin.permissions") ? data.permissions : [];
    assertCanGrant(access, permissions);
    const created = await createUser(
      db,
      {
        email: data.email,
        name: data.name,
        displayName: data.displayName,
        jobTitle: data.jobTitle,
        locale: data.locale,
        permissions,
      },
      access.actor,
    );
    // The sign-in details also go to the new person by email; if mail is not set up or fails,
    // the screen still shows the password so the person who created the user can hand it over.
    const emailed = await sendMail(
      welcomeEmail({
        to: data.email,
        name: data.displayName || data.name,
        temporaryPassword: created.temporaryPassword,
        appUrl: process.env.APP_URL || "http://localhost:3000",
        locale: data.locale,
      }),
    );
    return { temporaryPassword: created.temporaryPassword, email: data.email, emailed };
  });
}

export async function updateUserAction(input: z.input<typeof updateSchema>): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.users.edit");
    const data = updateSchema.parse(input);
    await assertMayTouch(access, data.id);
    await updateUserProfile(db, data.id, data, access.actor);

    if (data.permissions !== undefined) {
      await assertPermission("admin.permissions");
      assertCanGrant(access, data.permissions);
      await setUserPermissions(db, data.id, data.permissions, access.actor);
    }
    return {};
  });
}

/** Permissions alone, for someone who may change them but not edit profiles. */
export async function setPermissionsAction(input: {
  id: string;
  permissions: string[];
}): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.permissions");
    const data = z.object({ id: z.string().min(1), permissions: z.array(z.string()) }).parse(input);
    await assertMayTouch(access, data.id);
    assertCanGrant(access, data.permissions);
    await setUserPermissions(db, data.id, data.permissions, access.actor);
    return {};
  });
}

export async function resetPasswordAction(
  userId: string,
): Promise<AdminResult<{ temporaryPassword: string }>> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.resetPassword");
    await assertMayTouch(access, userId);
    if (access.user.id === userId) throw new AdminError("SELF_PROTECTED");
    return resetUserPassword(db, userId, access.actor);
  });
}

export async function resetTwoFactorAction(userId: string): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.resetPassword");
    await assertMayTouch(access, userId);
    if (access.user.id === userId) throw new AdminError("SELF_PROTECTED");
    await resetTwoFactor(db, userId, access.actor);
    return {};
  });
}

export async function setDisabledAction(userId: string, disabled: boolean): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.users.disable");
    await setUserDisabled(db, userId, disabled, access.actor);
    return {};
  });
}

/** Without `force`, a user with history is refused (HAS_HISTORY) so the screen can warn first. */
export async function deleteUserAction(userId: string, force = false): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.users.delete");
    await deleteUser(db, userId, access.actor, { force: force === true });
    return {};
  });
}

/** Puts failed sends to Priority back in the queue. Needs "admin.sends". */
export async function retrySendsAction(
  ids: number[],
): Promise<{ ok: true; count: number } | { ok: false }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.sends");
    const parsed = z.array(z.number().int()).max(500).parse(ids);
    const count = await retryFailed(db, parsed, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/admin");
    return { ok: true, count };
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof PermissionError) && !(error instanceof z.ZodError))
      console.error("[admin] retrying sends failed", error);
    return { ok: false };
  }
}

export interface ActivityReportRow {
  /** ISO time */
  at: string;
  user: string;
  action: string;
  subject: string;
  device: "desktop" | "phone" | null;
}

const reportSchema = z.object({
  user: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  action: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  from: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)
    .optional(),
  to: z
    .string()
    .regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)
    .optional(),
});

/** Every log entry matching the filter, for the printed report. */
export async function activityReportAction(
  input: z.input<typeof reportSchema>,
): Promise<
  | { ok: true; rows: ActivityReportRow[]; total: number }
  | { ok: false; error: "NOT_ALLOWED" | "GENERIC" }
> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("admin.activityLog");
    const filter = reportSchema.parse(input);
    const { rows, total } = await listActivityReport(db, {
      userId: filter.user || undefined,
      action: filter.action || undefined,
      from: filter.from,
      to: filter.to,
    });
    return {
      ok: true,
      total,
      rows: rows.map((row) => ({
        at: row.at.toISOString(),
        user: row.userId === null && row.userDisplay === "system" ? "" : row.userDisplay,
        action: row.action,
        subject: typeof row.details?.email === "string" ? row.details.email : "",
        device: row.deviceType,
      })),
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    console.error("[admin] the activity report failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/** Marks the security warnings as seen, so the red number in the menu goes away until a new one. */
export async function markAlertsSeenAction(): Promise<AdminResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.security");
    await markAlertsSeen(db, access.user.id);
    revalidatePath("/", "layout");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    console.error("[admin] marking the security warnings as seen failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/** Sets after how many minutes without activity people are signed out (0 = never). Needs "security". */
export async function setIdleMinutesAction(minutes: number): Promise<AdminResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.security");
    if (!isIdleMinutes(minutes)) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    await setIdleMinutes(db, minutes, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/", "layout");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    console.error("[admin] changing the idle sign-out time failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/** Signs one place out. The place this is done from stays, so nobody locks themselves out by accident. */
export async function endSessionAction(sessionId: string): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.security");
    const id = z.string().min(1).parse(sessionId);
    if (access.session.id === id) throw new AdminError("SELF_PROTECTED");
    await endSession(db, id, access.actor, { mayEndOwner: access.isOwner });
    return {};
  });
}

/** Marks a message as done, with an optional answer for the sender. */
export async function handleMessageAction(id: string, reply: string): Promise<AdminResult> {
  return run(async () => {
    const access = await assertPermission("admin.messages");
    await handleMessage(db, access.actor, String(id), String(reply ?? ""));
    return {};
  });
}
````
