````tsx
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Filter, Monitor, Smartphone } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatDateTime, formatInteger } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import {
  listActivity,
  listActivityActions,
  type ActivityFilter,
} from "@/server/auth/admin-queries";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { PrintLogButton } from "./print-log-button";
import { users } from "@/server/db/schema";

const SELECT_CLASS =
  "h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50";

export type LogSearch = Partial<Record<"user" | "action" | "from" | "to" | "page", string>>;

const ISO_DATE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

export function parseLogSearch(search: LogSearch): ActivityFilter {
  return {
    userId: search.user || undefined,
    action: search.action || undefined,
    from: search.from && ISO_DATE.test(search.from) ? search.from : undefined,
    to: search.to && ISO_DATE.test(search.to) ? search.to : undefined,
    page: Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(search.page ?? "1", 10) || 1),
  };
}

function href(search: LogSearch, page: number): string {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ tab: "log" });
  for (const key of ["user", "action", "from", "to"] as const) {
    if (search[key]) params.set(key, search[key]);
  }
  if (page > 1) params.set("page", String(page));
  return `/admin?${params.toString()}`;
}

/** The activity log: filters on top, newest entries first, 25 per page. Read only. */
export async function ActivityLog({ search }: { search: LogSearch }) {
  const t = await getTranslations("admin");
  const device = await getTranslations("auth.device");
  const filter = parseLogSearch(search);
  const [{ rows, total, pageCount }, actions, people] = await Promise.all([
    listActivity(db, filter),
    listActivityActions(db),
    db
      .select({ id: users.id, displayName: users.displayName })
      .from(users)
      .orderBy(users.displayName),
  ]);
  const page = Math.min(filter.page, pageCount);
  const filtered = Boolean(filter.userId || filter.action || filter.from || filter.to);

  function actionLabel(action: string): string {
    return t.has(`log.actions.${action}` as never) ? t(`log.actions.${action}` as never) : action;
  }

  const actionLabels = Object.fromEntries(actions.map((a) => [a, actionLabel(a)]));
  const filterText = [
    filter.userId
      ? `${t("log.filters.user")}: ${people.find((p) => p.id === filter.userId)?.displayName ?? ""}`
      : "",
    filter.action ? `${t("log.filters.action")}: ${actionLabel(filter.action)}` : "",
    filter.from ? `${t("log.filters.from")} ${filter.from}` : "",
    filter.to ? `${t("log.filters.to")} ${filter.to}` : "",
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");

  return (
    <Card className="rise gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-5 py-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("log.title")}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("log.count", { count: total })}
            {" · "}
            {t("log.subtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>
        {total > 0 ? (
          <PrintLogButton
            filter={{
              user: filter.userId,
              action: filter.action,
              from: filter.from,
              to: filter.to,
            }}
            actionLabels={actionLabels}
            filterText={filterText}
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {/* The filters are always shown, above the entries. */}
      <div className="border-t border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-muted/40 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold">
          <Filter className="size-4 text-gold" aria-hidden />
          {t("log.filters.title")}
          {filtered ? <Badge variant="soft">{t("log.filters.active")}</Badge> : null}
        </div>
        <form method="get" className="grid gap-4 p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 lg:items-end">
          <input type="hidden" name="tab" value="log" />
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="log-user">{t("log.filters.user")}</Label>
            <select
              id="log-user"
              name="user"
              defaultValue={filter.userId ?? ""}
              className={SELECT_CLASS}
            >
              <option value="">{t("log.filters.allUsers")}</option>
              {people.map((p) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                  {p.displayName}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="log-action">{t("log.filters.action")}</Label>
            <select
              id="log-action"
              name="action"
              defaultValue={filter.action ?? ""}
              className={SELECT_CLASS}
            >
              <option value="">{t("log.filters.allActions")}</option>
              {actions.map((a) => (
                <option key={a} value={a}>
                  {actionLabel(a)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="log-from">{t("log.filters.from")}</Label>
            <Input
              id="log-from"
              name="from"
              type="date"
              defaultValue={filter.from ?? ""}
              dir="ltr"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="log-to">{t("log.filters.to")}</Label>
            <Input id="log-to" name="to" type="date" defaultValue={filter.to ?? ""} dir="ltr" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Button type="submit" size="lg" className="flex-1">
              {t("log.filters.apply")}
            </Button>
            {filtered ? (
              <Button
                size="lg"
                variant="outline"
                nativeButton={false}
                render={<Link href="/admin?tab=log" />}
              >
                {t("log.filters.clear")}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="border-t px-5 py-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">{t("log.empty")}</p>
      ) : (
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow className="bg-muted/40 hover:bg-muted/40">
              <TableHead className="ps-5">{t("log.columns.when")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("log.columns.user")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("log.columns.action")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">{t("log.columns.subject")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden pe-5 xl:table-cell">{t("log.columns.device")}</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {rows.map((row) => {
              const subject = typeof row.details?.email === "string" ? row.details.email : "";
              const DeviceIcon = row.deviceType === "phone" ? Smartphone : Monitor;
              return (
                <TableRow key={row.id}>
                  <TableCell
                    dir="ltr"
                    className="ps-5 text-start text-muted-foreground tabular-nums"
                  >
                    {formatDateTime(row.at)}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">
                    {row.userId === null && row.userDisplay === "system"
                      ? t("log.system")
                      : row.userDisplay}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>{actionLabel(row.action)}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell
                    dir="ltr"
                    className="hidden text-start text-muted-foreground md:table-cell"
                  >
                    {subject}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="hidden pe-5 xl:table-cell">
                    {row.deviceType ? (
                      <span title={device(row.deviceType)} className="inline-flex">
                        <DeviceIcon aria-hidden className="size-4 text-gold" />
                        <span className="sr-only">{device(row.deviceType)}</span>
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              );
            })}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { CircleCheck, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { AlertKind } from "@/server/security/alerts";
import { markAlertsSeenAction } from "./actions";

export interface AlertRow {
  kind: AlertKind;
  subject: string;
  count: number;
  /** ISO time of the newest attempt. */
  lastAt: string;
  ips: string[];
  /** Newer than the last time the warnings were marked as seen. */
  unseen: boolean;
}

/** Sign-in attempts that look like a break-in, from the last days, with the new ones marked. */
export function AlertsCard({ alerts }: { alerts: AlertRow[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.alerts");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const unseen = alerts.filter((alert) => alert.unseen).length;

  function markSeen() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await markAlertsSeenAction();
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("failed"));
      toast.success(t("marked"));
      // Stay on this tab: without it the screen would open on the first tab.
      router.replace("/admin?tab=security");
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl">
          {alerts.length === 0 ? (
            <CircleCheck className="size-6 text-success" />
          ) : (
            <ShieldAlert className="size-6 text-destructive" />
          )}
          {t("title")}
          {unseen > 0 ? (
            <Badge variant="destructive" data-testid="alerts-new">
              {t("new", { count: unseen })}
            </Badge>
          ) : null}
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {alerts.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" data-testid="alerts-empty">
            {t("none")}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-2" data-testid="alerts-list">
            {alerts.map((alert) => (
              <li
                key={`${alert.kind}-${alert.subject}`}
                className={cn(
                  "rounded-xl border px-4 py-3",
                  alert.unseen
                    ? "border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/5"
                    : "border-border bg-muted/30",
                )}
              >
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{t(`kinds.${alert.kind}.title`)}</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {t(`kinds.${alert.kind}.body`, { subject: alert.subject, count: alert.count })}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="auto">
                  {t("last", { time: formatDateTime(alert.lastAt) })}
                  {alert.ips.length > 0 ? ` · ${t("from")} ${alert.ips.join(", ")}` : ""}
                </p>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {unseen > 0 ? (
          <Button type="button" onClick={markSeen} disabled={pending} data-testid="alerts-seen">
            {t("markSeen")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("hint")}</p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { KeyRound, ShieldOff, Trash2, UserCheck, UserX, type LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import type { AdminErrorCode } from "./actions";

export type ConfirmKind = "reset" | "resetTwoFactor" | "disable" | "enable" | "delete";

const ICONS: Record<ConfirmKind, LucideIcon> = {
  reset: KeyRound,
  resetTwoFactor: ShieldOff,
  disable: UserX,
  enable: UserCheck,
  delete: Trash2,
};

/** One window for the four actions that need a second look. `run` returns an error code, or null on success. */
export function ConfirmDialog({
  kind,
  name,
  onClose,
  run,
}: {
  kind: ConfirmKind | null;
  name: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  run: (kind: ConfirmKind, force: boolean) => Promise<AdminErrorCode | null>;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<AdminErrorCode | null>(null);
  // A user with history: the person was warned and may still delete.
  const warned = error === "HAS_HISTORY";

  function close() {
    setError(null);
    onClose();
  }

  const Icon = kind ? ICONS[kind] : KeyRound;
  const destructive = kind === "delete" || kind === "disable";

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={kind !== null}
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open && !pending) close();
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        {kind ? (
          <>
            <DialogTitleBlock
              icon={<Icon />}
              title={t(`confirm.${kind}.title`)}
              description={t(`confirm.${kind}.body`, { name })}
            />
            {error ? (
              <Alert variant="destructive" data-testid={warned ? "history-warning" : undefined}>
                <AlertDescription>
                  {warned ? t("confirm.delete.historyWarning", { name }) : t(`errors.${error}`)}
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            ) : null}
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="lg" onClick={close} disabled={pending}>
                {t("confirm.cancel")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="lg"
                variant={destructive ? "destructive" : "default"}
                disabled={pending}
                onClick={() =>
                  startTransition(async () => {
                    const failure = await run(kind, warned);
                    if (failure) setError(failure);
                    else close();
                  })
                }
              >
                {warned ? t("confirm.delete.anyway") : t(`confirm.${kind}.action`)}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { CheckCircle2, Inbox } from "lucide-react";

            {FILTERS.map((key) => (
              <Link
                key={key}
                href={key === "new" ? "/admin?tab=messages" : `/admin?tab=messages&status=${key}`}
                data-testid={`messages-filter-${key}`}
                aria-current={filter === key ? "page" : undefined}

              </Link>
            ))}

        </CardHeader>

      {messages.length === 0 ? (

                  {formatDateTime(message.createdAt)}
                </span>

              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {t("from")}:{" "}
                <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{message.senderDisplay}</span>
                {message.deviceType ? ` · ${users(message.deviceType)}` : ""}
                {message.pagePath ? (
                  <>
                    {" · "}
                    {t("page")}:{" "}
                    <Link href={message.pagePath} className="underline" dir="ltr">
                      {message.pagePath}
                    </Link>
                  </>
                ) : null}
              </p>

              <p className="rounded-xl bg-muted/50 p-3 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                {message.details}

              {message.status === "done" ? (

              )}

      )}

}

function Answer({ id, onDone }: { id: string; onDone: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.messages");
  const [reply, setReply] = useState("");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function done() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await handleMessageAction(id, reply);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("failed"));
      toast.success(t("saved"));
      onDone();
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <label htmlFor={`reply-${id}`} className="text-sm font-medium">
        {t("answer")}
      </label>
      <textarea
        id={`reply-${id}`}
        value={reply}
        rows={2}
        maxLength={1000}
        placeholder={t("answerPlaceholder")}
        disabled={pending}
        onChange={(event) => setReply(event.target.value)}
        className="w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-60"
      />
      <Button type="button" size="sm" onClick={done} disabled={pending} data-testid="message-done">
        <CheckCircle2 data-icon="inline-start" />
        {pending ? t("saving") : t("markDone")}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { CloudUpload, History, Inbox, ShieldCheck, UsersRound } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SectionLayout } from "@/components/section-menu";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { listUsers } from "@/server/auth/admin-queries";
import { assistantConfigured } from "@/server/assistant";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { countNewMessages, listMessages } from "@/server/messages";
import { requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getIdleMinutes } from "@/server/security";
import { listActiveSessions } from "@/server/security/sessions";
import { countUnseen, getAlertsSeenAt, getSecurityAlerts } from "@/server/security/alerts";
import { ActivityLog, type LogSearch } from "./activity-log";
import { AlertsCard } from "./alerts-card";
import { SecurityCard } from "./security-card";
import { SessionsCard } from "./sessions-card";
import { SendsPanel } from "./sends-panel";
import { MessagesPanel } from "./messages-panel";
import { UsersPanel } from "./users-panel";

type Search = LogSearch & { tab?: string; status?: string };
type Tab = "users" | "log" | "sends" | "security" | "messages";

const TAB_ICONS: Record<Tab, React.ComponentType> = {
  users: UsersRound,
  log: History,
  sends: CloudUpload,
  security: ShieldCheck,
  messages: Inbox,
};

/**
 * Administration: the people who use the system and what they may do, and the
 * activity log. Each part appears only for those holding its permissions.
 */
export default async function AdminPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<Search> }) {
  const access = await requireScreen("admin");
  const t = await getTranslations("nav");
  const tabs = await getTranslations("admin.tabs");
  const screens = await getTranslations("screens");
  const shell = await getTranslations("shell.groups");
  const search = await searchParams;

  const canUsers =
    access.isOwner ||
    (
      [
        "admin.view",
        "admin.users.create",
        "admin.users.edit",
        "admin.users.disable",
        "admin.users.delete",
        "admin.permissions",
        "admin.resetPassword",
      ] as const
    ).some((permission) => access.can(permission));
  const canLog = access.isOwner || access.can("admin.activityLog");

  const canSends = access.isOwner || access.can("admin.sends");

  const canSecurity = access.isOwner || access.can("admin.security");

  const canMessages = access.isOwner || access.can("admin.messages");
  const newMessages = canMessages ? await countNewMessages(db) : 0;

  // Warnings about attempts to break in: the newest ones open this screen on the security tab.
  const alerts = canSecurity ? await getSecurityAlerts(db) : [];
  const seenAt = canSecurity ? await getAlertsSeenAt(db) : null;
  const hasNewAlerts = countUnseen(alerts, seenAt) > 0;

  const available = [
    canUsers && "users",
    canLog && "log",
    canSends && "sends",
    canSecurity && "security",
    canMessages && "messages",
  ].filter((key): key is Tab => key !== false);
  const tab: Tab =
    available.find((key) => key === search.tab) ??
    (hasNewAlerts && canSecurity
      ? "security"
      : newMessages > 0 && canMessages
        ? "messages"
        : available[0]) ??
    "users";
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.admin;

  const items = [
    canUsers ? { key: "users", href: "/admin?tab=users" } : null,
    canLog ? { key: "log", href: "/admin?tab=log" } : null,
    canSends ? { key: "sends", href: "/admin?tab=sends" } : null,
    canSecurity ? { key: "security", href: "/admin?tab=security" } : null,
    canMessages ? { key: "messages", href: "/admin?tab=messages" } : null,
  ].filter((item): item is { key: Tab; href: string } => item !== null);

  async function messagesBody() {
    const filter = (["new", "done", "all"] as const).find((f) => f === search.status) ?? "new";
    const rows = await listMessages(db, filter);
    const all = await listMessages(db, "done", 1000);
    return (
      <MessagesPanel
        filter={filter}
        counts={{ new: newMessages, done: all.length }}
        helperOn={assistantConfigured()}
        messages={rows.map((row) => ({
          id: row.id,
          createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
          senderDisplay: row.senderDisplay,
          kind: row.kind,
          screen: row.screen,
          subject: row.subject,
          urgent: row.urgent,
          details: row.details,
          pagePath: row.pagePath,
          deviceType: row.deviceType,
          status: row.status,
          handledByDisplay: row.handledByDisplay,
          handledAt: row.handledAt ? row.handledAt.toISOString() : null,
          reply: row.reply,
        }))}
      />
    );
  }

  const body =
    tab === "messages" ? (
      await messagesBody()
    ) : tab === "log" ? (
      <ActivityLog search={search} />
    ) : tab === "sends" ? (
      <SendsPanel canRetry={access.isOwner || access.can("admin.sends")} />
    ) : tab === "security" ? (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <AlertsCard
          alerts={alerts.map((alert) => ({
            ...alert,
            lastAt: alert.lastAt.toISOString(),
            unseen: !seenAt || alert.lastAt > seenAt,
          }))}
        />
        <SessionsCard
          sessions={(await listActiveSessions(db)).map((row) => ({
            ...row,
            signedInAt: row.signedInAt.toISOString(),
            lastSeenAt: row.lastSeenAt.toISOString(),
            current: row.id === access.session.id,
          }))}
        />
        <SecurityCard minutes={await getIdleMinutes(db)} />
      </div>
    ) : (
      <UsersPanel
        users={await listUsers(db)}
        can={{
          create: access.can("admin.users.create"),
          edit: access.can("admin.users.edit"),
          permissions: access.can("admin.permissions"),
          disable: access.can("admin.users.disable"),
          delete: access.can("admin.users.delete"),
          reset: access.can("admin.resetPassword"),
        }}
        currentUserId={access.user.id}
        actorIsOwner={access.isOwner}
        grantable={access.isOwner ? null : Array.from(access.permissions)}
      />
    );

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        icon={<Icon />}
        eyebrow={shell("system")}
        title={t("admin")}
        description={screens("admin")}
        help={
          tab === "log"
            ? "adminLog"
            : tab === "sends"
              ? "adminSends"
              : tab === "security"
                ? "adminSecurity"
                : tab === "messages"
                  ? "adminMessages"
                  : "adminUsers"
        }
      />

      {items.length > 1 ? (
        <SectionLayout
          label={tabs("menu")}
          current={tab}
          items={items.map((item) => {
            const TabIcon = TAB_ICONS[item.key];
            return {
              key: item.key,
              href: item.href,
              title: tabs(item.key),
              hint: tabs(`hints.${item.key}`),
              icon: <TabIcon />,
            };
          })}
        >
          {body}
        </SectionLayout>
      ) : (
        body
      )}
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { ChevronDown, Monitor, Smartphone } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  DEVICE_PERMISSIONS,
  SCREEN_KEYS,
  screenPermissions,
  viewPermission,
  type Permission,
  type ScreenKey,
} from "@/server/permissions/registry";

type Level = "none" | "view" | "full" | "custom";

function levelOf(selected: ReadonlySet<string>, screen: ScreenKey): Level {
  const all = screenPermissions(screen);
  const chosen = all.filter((p) => selected.has(p));
  if (chosen.length === 0) return "none";
  if (chosen.length === all.length) return "full";
  if (chosen.length === 1 && chosen[0] === viewPermission(screen)) return "view";
  return "custom";
}

const LEVELS: Exclude<Level, "custom">[] = ["none", "view", "full"];

/**
 * Per screen: no access, view only or everything, with the single actions one
 * click away. Ticking any action also ticks "view"; clearing "view" clears the
 * screen. `grantable` limits what can be switched on (null = everything).
 */
export function PermissionEditor({
  value,
  onChange,
  grantable,
}: {
  value: ReadonlySet<string>;
  onChange: (next: Set<string>) => void;
  grantable: ReadonlySet<string> | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin");
  const nav = useTranslations("nav");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<ScreenKey | null>(null);
  const allowed = (p: Permission) => grantable === null || grantable.has(p);

  function setLevel(screen: ScreenKey, level: Exclude<Level, "custom">) {
    const next = new Set(value);
    for (const p of screenPermissions(screen)) next.delete(p);
    if (level === "view" && allowed(viewPermission(screen))) next.add(viewPermission(screen));
    if (level === "full") {
      for (const p of screenPermissions(screen)) if (allowed(p)) next.add(p);
    }
    onChange(next);
  }

  function toggle(screen: ScreenKey, permission: Permission, on: boolean) {
    const next = new Set(value);
    if (on) {
      next.add(permission);
      if (allowed(viewPermission(screen))) next.add(viewPermission(screen));
    } else if (permission === viewPermission(screen)) {
      for (const p of screenPermissions(screen)) next.delete(p);
    } else {
      next.delete(permission);
    }
    onChange(next);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <ul className="divide-y divide-border overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card">
        {SCREEN_KEYS.map((screen) => {
          const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS[screen];
          const level = levelOf(value, screen);
          const actions = screenPermissions(screen);
          const count = actions.filter((p) => value.has(p)).length;
          const expanded = open === screen;
          return (
            <li key={screen}>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2 px-3 py-2.5 sm:px-4">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setOpen(expanded ? null : screen)}
                  aria-expanded={expanded}
                  aria-label={t("permissions.details")}
                  className="flex min-w-0 basis-full items-center gap-3 rounded-lg text-start outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 sm:flex-1 sm:basis-0"
                >
                  <span className="grid size-9 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold [&_svg]:size-4">
                    <Icon />
                  </span>
                  <span className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="block truncate font-medium">{nav(screen)}</span>
                    <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {level === "custom"
                        ? t("permissions.allowed", { allowed: count, total: actions.length })
                        : t(`permissions.levels.${level}`)}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  <ChevronDown
                    className={cn(
                      "ms-auto size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground transition-transform",
                      expanded && "rotate-180",
                    )}
                  />
                </button>

                <div
                  role="radiogroup"
                  aria-label={nav(screen)}
                  className="flex w-full shrink-0 rounded-lg bg-muted p-0.5 sm:w-auto"
                >
                  {LEVELS.map((option) => {
                    const disabled = option !== "none" && !allowed(viewPermission(screen));
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={option}
                        type="button"
                        role="radio"
                        aria-checked={level === option}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        onClick={() => setLevel(screen, option)}
                        className={cn(
                          "h-9 flex-1 rounded-md px-3 text-xs font-medium transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 sm:h-8 sm:flex-none",
                          level === option
                            ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-card"
                            : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
                        )}
                      >
                        {t(`permissions.levels.${option}`)}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {expanded ? (
                <div className="grid gap-x-6 gap-y-1 border-t border-dashed border-border bg-background/60 px-4 py-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {actions.map((permission) => (
                    <label
                      key={permission}
                      className={cn(
                        "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md py-1.5 text-sm",
                        allowed(permission) ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50",
                      )}
                    >
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={value.has(permission)}
                        disabled={!allowed(permission)}
                        onCheckedChange={(checked) => toggle(screen, permission, checked === true)}
                      />
                      <span>{t(`perm.${permission}`)}</span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>

      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <p className="font-medium">{t("permissions.devices.title")}</p>
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("permissions.devices.hint")}</p>
        <div className="grid gap-1 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {DEVICE_PERMISSIONS.map((permission) => {
            const Icon = permission === "device.desktop" ? Monitor : Smartphone;
            return (
              <label
                key={permission}
                className={cn(
                  "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md py-1.5 text-sm",
                  allowed(permission) ? "cursor-pointer" : "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50",
                )}
              >
                <Switch
                  checked={value.has(permission)}
                  disabled={!allowed(permission)}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                    const next = new Set(value);
                    if (checked) next.add(permission);
                    else next.delete(permission);
                    onChange(next);
                  }}
                />
                <Icon className="size-4 text-gold" />
                <span>
                  {t(
                    `permissions.devices.${permission === "device.desktop" ? "desktop" : "phone"}`,
                  )}
                </span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { ReportPrintSheet, printReport } from "@/components/report-print";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatDate, formatDateTime } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { activityReportAction, type ActivityReportRow } from "./actions";

interface Report {
  rows: ActivityReportRow[];
  total: number;
}

/**
 * Prints the activity log as a report: every entry that matches the filters on the page (not
 * only the page shown), on A4 across the page. Choosing "Save as PDF" in the print window makes a file.
 */
export function PrintLogButton({
  filter,
  actionLabels,
  filterText,
}: {
  filter: { user?: string; action?: string; from?: string; to?: string };
  /** Action key to its words, for every action in the log. */
  actionLabels: Record<string, string>;
  /** The filters in use, in words, printed under the heading. */
  filterText: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.log");
  const device = useTranslations("auth.device");
  const locale = useLocale();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [report, setReport] = useState<Report | null>(null);

  function print() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await activityReportAction(filter);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("printFailed"));
      if (result.rows.length === 0) return void toast.error(t("empty"));
      setReport({ rows: result.rows, total: result.total });
      // Let the report reach the page, then open the print window.
      requestAnimationFrame(() => printReport(() => setReport(null)));
    });
  }

  const cell = "border border-neutral-400 px-2 py-1 text-start align-top";
  return (
    <>
      <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={pending} onClick={print}>
        <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
        {pending ? t("preparing") : t("print")}
      </Button>
      {report ? (
        <ReportPrintSheet dir={locale === "he" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}>
          <div style={{ fontSize: "10pt", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>
            <h1 style={{ fontSize: "16pt", fontWeight: 700 }}>{t("title")}</h1>
            <p>
              {formatDate(new Date())} · {t("count", { count: report.rows.length })}
              {filterText ? ` · ${filterText}` : ""}
            </p>
            {report.total > report.rows.length ? (
              <p style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>
                {t("truncated", { shown: report.rows.length, total: report.total })}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", marginTop: "6mm" }}>
              <thead>
                <tr style={{ background: "#eee" }}>
                  <th className={cell}>{t("columns.when")}</th>
                  <th className={cell}>{t("columns.user")}</th>
                  <th className={cell}>{t("columns.action")}</th>
                  <th className={cell}>{t("columns.subject")}</th>
                  <th className={cell}>{t("columns.device")}</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {report.rows.map((row, index) => (
                  <tr key={index}>
                    <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                      {formatDateTime(row.at)}
                    </td>
                    <td className={cell}>{row.user || t("system")}</td>
                    <td className={cell}>{actionLabels[row.action] ?? row.action}</td>
                    <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                      {row.subject}
                    </td>
                    <td className={cell}>{row.device ? device(row.device) : ""}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </ReportPrintSheet>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { RotateCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { retrySendsAction } from "./actions";

/** Puts failed sends back in the queue; `all` is the button above the table, otherwise one row's. */
export function RetryButton({ ids, all }: { ids: number[]; all: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.sends");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function retry() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await retrySendsAction(ids);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("retryFailed"));
      toast.success(t("retried", { count: result.count }));
    });
  }

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant={all ? "default" : "outline"}
      size={all ? "default" : "sm"}
      disabled={pending}
      onClick={retry}
    >
      <RotateCw data-icon="inline-start" />
      {all ? t("retryAll", { count: ids.length }) : t("retry")}
    </Button>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Check, Copy, KeyRound } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";

export interface SecretInfo {
  email: string;
  temporaryPassword: string;
  /** Created a user, or reset a password. */
  reason: "created" | "reset";
  /** The sign-in details were also sent to the person by email. */
  emailed?: boolean;
}

/** Shows a temporary password once. It is never stored in clear, so closing the window loses it. */
export function SecretDialog({
  secret,
  onClose,
}: {
  secret: SecretInfo | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.password");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  // The details were emailed: the password stays hidden unless someone wants to hand it over too.
  const emailed = secret?.reason === "created" && secret.emailed === true;

  function close() {
    setShown(false);
    onClose();
  }

  async function copy() {
    if (!secret) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(secret.temporaryPassword);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard blocked: the password is selectable on screen.
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={secret !== null}
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open) close();
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        {secret ? (
          <>
            <DialogTitleBlock
              icon={<KeyRound />}
              title={secret.reason === "created" ? t("createdTitle") : t("resetTitle")}
              description={
                emailed
                  ? t("emailedDescription", { email: secret.email })
                  : t("description", { email: secret.email })
              }
            />
            {emailed && !shown ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <p data-testid="secret-emailed" className="text-sm text-success">
                  {t("emailSent", { email: secret.email })}
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("checkSpam")}</p>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  data-testid="secret-show"
                  onClick={() => setShown(true)}
                >
                  {t("showPassword")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.18em] text-gold uppercase">
                  {t("temporary")}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <code
                    dir="ltr"
                    className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft px-4 py-3 text-center font-mono text-2xl font-semibold tracking-widest select-all"
                  >
                    {secret.temporaryPassword}
                  </code>
                  <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="lg" onClick={copy}>
                    {copied ? (
                      <Check data-icon="inline-start" />
                    ) : (
                      <Copy data-icon="inline-start" />
                    )}
                    {copied ? t("copied") : t("copy")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
                {secret.reason === "created" ? (
                  <p
                    data-testid="secret-emailed"
                    className={
                      secret.emailed ? "text-sm text-success" : "text-sm font-medium text-warning"
                    }
                  >
                    {secret.emailed
                      ? t("emailSent", { email: secret.email })
                      : t("emailNotSent", { email: secret.email })}
                  </p>
                ) : null}
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("warning")}</p>
              </div>
            )}
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" size="lg" onClick={close}>
                {emailed ? t("doneEmailed") : t("done")}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Save } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { setIdleMinutesAction } from "./actions";

/** The times to choose from, in minutes; 0 is "never". */
const CHOICES = [5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 0];

const SELECT_CLASS =
  "h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-60 sm:max-w-xs";

/** After how long without touching the screen a person is signed out. */
export function SecurityCard({ minutes }: { minutes: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.security");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(minutes);
  // A time saved some other way stays in the list.
  const choices = CHOICES.includes(minutes) ? CHOICES : [minutes, ...CHOICES].sort(order);

  function label(value: number): string {
    if (value === 0) return t("never");
    if (value % 60 === 0) return t("hours", { count: value / 60 });
    return t("minutes", { count: value });
  }

  function save() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setIdleMinutesAction(chosen);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("failed"));
      toast.success(t("saved"));
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{t("title")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="idle-minutes">{t("label")}</Label>
          <select
            id="idle-minutes"
            data-testid="idle-minutes"
            className={SELECT_CLASS}
            disabled={pending}
            value={chosen}
            onChange={(event) => setChosen(Number(event.target.value))}
          >
            {choices.map((value) => (
              <option key={value} value={value}>
                {label(value)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {chosen === 0 ? t("neverHint") : t("hint")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button type="button" onClick={save} disabled={pending || chosen === minutes}>
          <Save data-icon="inline-start" />
          {t("save")}
        </Button>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** Shortest first, with "never" last. */
function order(a: number, b: number): number {
  return (a === 0 ? Infinity : a) - (b === 0 ? Infinity : b);
}
````

````tsx
import { CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatDateTime, formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { listUnsent } from "@/server/receiving";
import { RetryButton } from "./retry-button";

/**
 * What is saved here but not in Priority yet: boxes received. The
 * ones still retrying go by themselves; the ones Priority refused (or that ran out of tries)
 * wait for a person to look and send them again.
 */
export async function SendsPanel({ canRetry }: { canRetry: boolean }) {
  const t = await getTranslations("admin.sends");
  const rows = await listUnsent(db);
  const failed = rows.filter((row) => row.status === "failed");

  return (
    <Card className="gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("title")}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("subtitle")}</p>
        </div>
        {canRetry && failed.length > 0 ? (
          <RetryButton ids={failed.map((row) => row.id)} all />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <CheckCircle2 className="size-8 text-success" aria-hidden />
          <p data-testid="sends-empty">{t("empty")}</p>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {rows.length > 0 ? (
        <Table data-testid="sends-table">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>{t("columns.received")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("columns.item")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("columns.barcode")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("columns.weight")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("columns.state")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("columns.why")}</TableHead>
              {canRetry ? <TableHead /> : null}
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <TableRow key={row.id}>
                <TableCell className="tabular-nums" dir="ltr">
                  {formatDateTime(row.receivedAt)}
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.receivedBy}</div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell dir="ltr" className="text-start">
                  {row.itemNumber}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs">
                  {row.barcode}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="tabular-nums" dir="ltr">
                  {formatWeight(row.weightKg)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <State status={row.status} attempts={row.attempts} lastError={row.lastError} />
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {row.lastError ? t(`reasons.${reason(row.lastError)}`) : "—"}
                </TableCell>
                {canRetry ? (
                  <TableCell>
                    {row.status === "failed" ? <RetryButton ids={[row.id]} all={false} /> : null}
                  </TableCell>
                ) : null}
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      ) : null}
    </Card>
  );
}

async function State({
  status,
  attempts,
  lastError,
}: {
  status: "pending" | "failed";
  attempts: number;
  lastError: string | null;
}) {
  const t = await getTranslations("admin.sends");
  return status === "failed" ? (
    <Badge className="bg-destructive text-white">{t("states.failed")}</Badge>
  ) : lastError === "WRITE_NOT_OPEN" ? (
    <Badge variant="warning">{t("states.writeClosed")}</Badge>
  ) : (
    <Badge variant="warning">{t("states.pending", { attempts })}</Badge>
  );
}

const KNOWN = [
  "UNAVAILABLE",
  "WRITE_NOT_OPEN",
  "UNKNOWN_ITEM",
  "UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE",
  "UNKNOWN_ORDER",
  "UNKNOWN_BOX",
  "DUPLICATE_BOX",
] as const;

function reason(code: string): (typeof KNOWN)[number] | "OTHER" {
  return (KNOWN as readonly string[]).includes(code) ? (code as (typeof KNOWN)[number]) : "OTHER";
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { LogOut, Monitor, Smartphone } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { describeAgent } from "@/lib/user-agent";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { endSessionAction } from "./actions";

export interface SessionRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  isOwner: boolean;
  deviceType: "desktop" | "phone";
  ip: string | null;
  userAgent: string | null;
  /** ISO times */
  signedInAt: string;
  lastSeenAt: string;
  /** The device this screen is open on. */
  current: boolean;
}

/** Every place where someone is signed in right now, with a button to sign a place out. */
export function SessionsCard({ sessions }: { sessions: SessionRow[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.sessions");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function signOut(row: SessionRow) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await endSessionAction(row.id);
      setAsking(null);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("failed"));
      toast.success(t("ended"));
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl">
          {t("title")}
          <Badge variant="secondary" data-testid="sessions-count">
            {t("count", { count: sessions.length })}
          </Badge>
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {sessions.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="space-y-2" data-testid="sessions-list">
            {sessions.map((row) => {
              const agent = describeAgent(row.userAgent);
              const Icon = row.deviceType === "phone" ? Smartphone : Monitor;
              const device =
                [agent.browser, agent.system].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || t("unknown");
              return (
                <li
                  key={row.id}
                  data-testid="session-row"
                  className={cn(
                    "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3",
                    row.current ? "border-primary/40 bg-primary/5" : "border-border bg-muted/30",
                  )}
                >
                  <Icon className="size-5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-0.5">
                    <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold">
                      <span>{row.name}</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">
                        {row.email}
                      </span>
                      {row.isOwner ? <Badge variant="outline">{t("owner")}</Badge> : null}
                      {row.current ? <Badge>{t("thisOne")}</Badge> : null}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {t(row.deviceType)} · {device}
                      {row.ip ? ` · ${t("address")} ` : ""}
                      {row.ip ? <bdi>{shortAddress(row.ip)}</bdi> : null}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("signedIn")}: {formatDateTime(row.signedInAt)} · {t("lastSeen")}:{" "}
                      {formatDateTime(row.lastSeenAt)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  {row.current ? null : asking === row.id ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm">{t("confirm", { name: row.name })}</span>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="destructive"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={pending}
                        onClick={() => signOut(row)}
                        data-testid="session-confirm"
                      >
                        {t("signOut")}
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={pending}
                        onClick={() => setAsking(null)}
                      >
                        {t("cancel")}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => setAsking(row.id)}
                      data-testid="session-signout"
                    >
                      <LogOut data-icon="inline-start" />
                      {t("signOut")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("hint")}</p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** Long IPv6 addresses written out in full are shortened, for example 0000:…:0001 becomes ::1. */
function shortAddress(address: string): string {
  if (!address.includes(":")) return address;
  try {
    return new URL(`http://[${address}]`).hostname.replace(/^[|]$/g, "");
  } catch {
    return address;
  }
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { UserPlus, UserRoundPen } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import type { AdminUserRow } from "@/server/auth/admin-queries";
import { createUserAction, updateUserAction, type AdminErrorCode } from "./actions";
import { PermissionEditor } from "./permission-editor";

export interface UserDialogProps {
  /** Null creates a new user. */
  user: AdminUserRow | null;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** The actor may change permissions (admin.permissions). */
  canEditPermissions: boolean;
  /** Keys the actor may hand out; null for the owner (everything). */
  grantable: string[] | null;
  onCreated: (result: { email: string; temporaryPassword: string; emailed: boolean }) => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}

/** Create or edit: details first, then the permission editor. Remounted per user so the fields start fresh. */
export function UserDialog(props: UserDialogProps) {
  const key = props.user?.id ?? "new";
  return (
    <Dialog open={props.open} onOpenChange={props.onOpenChange}>
      {props.open ? <UserDialogBody key={key} {...props} /> : null}
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function UserDialogBody({
  user,
  onOpenChange,
  canEditPermissions,
  grantable,
  onCreated,
  onSaved,
}: UserDialogProps) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<AdminErrorCode | null>(null);

  const [email, setEmail] = useState(user?.email ?? "");
  const [name, setName] = useState(user?.name ?? "");
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(user?.displayName ?? "");
  const [jobTitle, setJobTitle] = useState(user?.jobTitle ?? "");
  const [locale, setLocale] = useState<"he" | "en">(user?.locale ?? "he");
  const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(user?.permissions ?? []));

  const editing = user !== null;
  const showPermissions = canEditPermissions && !user?.isOwner;
  const grantableSet = grantable === null ? null : new Set(grantable);

  function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const profile = { name, displayName, jobTitle, locale };
      if (editing) {
        const result = await updateUserAction({
          id: user.id,
          ...profile,
          permissions: showPermissions ? Array.from(permissions) : undefined,
        });
        if (!result.ok) return setError(result.error);
        onSaved();
        onOpenChange(false);
      } else {
        const result = await createUserAction({
          ...profile,
          email,
          permissions: Array.from(permissions),
        });
        if (!result.ok) return setError(result.error);
        onOpenChange(false);
        onCreated({
          email: result.email,
          temporaryPassword: result.temporaryPassword,
          emailed: result.emailed,
        });
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-2xl">
      <DialogTitleBlock
        icon={editing ? <UserRoundPen /> : <UserPlus />}
        title={editing ? t("form.editTitle", { name: user.displayName }) : t("form.createTitle")}
        description={editing ? t("form.editDescription") : t("form.createDescription")}
      />

      <form id="user-form" onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-6" noValidate>
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{t(`errors.${error}`)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="user-name">{t("form.name")}</Label>
            <Input
              id="user-name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="off"
              required
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="user-display">{t("form.displayName")}</Label>
            <Input
              id="user-display"
              value={displayName}
              onChange={(e) => setDisplayName(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="off"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="user-email">{t("form.email")}</Label>
            <Input
              id="user-email"
              type="email"
              dir="ltr"
              inputMode="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              disabled={editing}
              autoComplete="off"
              required
            />
            {editing ? null : (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("form.emailHint")}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="user-job">{t("form.jobTitle")}</Label>
            <Input
              id="user-job"
              value={jobTitle}
              onChange={(e) => setJobTitle(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="off"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2 sm:col-span-2">
            <Label>{t("form.language")}</Label>
            <div role="radiogroup" className="inline-flex rounded-lg bg-muted p-0.5">
              {(["he", "en"] as const).map((option) => (
                <button
                  key={option}
                  type="button"
                  role="radio"
                  aria-checked={locale === option}
                  onClick={() => setLocale(option)}
                  className={
                    "h-9 rounded-md px-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 " +
                    (locale === option
                      ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-card"
                      : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground")
                  }
                >
                  {option === "he" ? "עברית" : "English"}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {showPermissions ? (
          <section className="space-y-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-serif text-xl font-semibold">{t("permissions.title")}</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("permissions.intro")}</p>
              {grantableSet ? (
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-warning">{t("permissions.limited")}</p>
              ) : null}
            </div>
            <PermissionEditor
              value={permissions}
              onChange={setPermissions}
              grantable={grantableSet}
            />
          </section>
        ) : user?.isOwner ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-gold/30 bg-gold-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm">
            {t("permissions.ownerNote")}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </form>

      <DialogFooter>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          size="lg"
          onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
          disabled={pending}
        >
          {t("confirm.cancel")}
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" form="user-form" size="lg" disabled={pending}>
          {pending ? t("form.saving") : editing ? t("form.save") : t("form.create")}
        </Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import {
  CircleCheck,
  Clock3,
  Crown,
  EllipsisVertical,
  KeyRound,
  ShieldOff,
  Monitor,
  Pencil,
  Smartphone,
  Trash2,
  UserCheck,
  UserPlus,
  UserX,
  UserRoundX,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { AdminUserRow } from "@/server/auth/admin-queries";
import { SCREEN_KEYS, screenOf } from "@/server/permissions/registry";
import {
  deleteUserAction,
  resetPasswordAction,
  resetTwoFactorAction,
  setDisabledAction,
  type AdminErrorCode,
} from "./actions";
import { ConfirmDialog, type ConfirmKind } from "./confirm-dialog";
import { SecretDialog, type SecretInfo } from "./secret-dialog";
import { UserDialog } from "./user-dialog";

export interface AdminCapabilities {
  create: boolean;
  edit: boolean;
  permissions: boolean;
  disable: boolean;
  delete: boolean;
  reset: boolean;
}

type DialogState =
  | { type: "none" }
  | { type: "form"; user: AdminUserRow | null }
  | { type: "confirm"; kind: ConfirmKind; user: AdminUserRow };

function StatusBadges({ user }: { user: AdminUserRow }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.users.badges");
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {user.isOwner ? (
        <Badge variant="soft">
          <Crown />
          {t("owner")}
        </Badge>
      ) : null}
      {user.isDisabled ? (
        <Badge variant="destructive">
          <UserRoundX />
          {t("disabled")}
        </Badge>
      ) : (
        <Badge variant="success">
          <CircleCheck />
          {t("active")}
        </Badge>
      )}
      {user.mustChangePassword ? (
        <Badge variant="warning">
          <KeyRound />
          {t("mustChange")}
        </Badge>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The screens a person can open, and whether they may use a computer and a phone. */
function UserAccess({ user }: { user: AdminUserRow }) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin.users");
  const nav = useTranslations("nav");
  const screens = user.isOwner
    ? SCREEN_KEYS
    : SCREEN_KEYS.filter((screen) => user.permissions.some((p) => screenOf(p) === screen));
  const devices = [
    {
      key: "desktop",
      icon: Monitor,
      on: user.isOwner || user.permissions.includes("device.desktop"),
    },
    {
      key: "phone",
      icon: Smartphone,
      on: user.isOwner || user.permissions.includes("device.phone"),
    },
  ] as const;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5 rounded-xl bg-muted/40 p-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
          {user.isOwner ? t("allScreens") : t("screens")}
        </p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5" data-testid="user-devices">
          {devices.map(({ key, icon: DeviceIcon, on }) => (
            <span
              key={key}
              data-on={on}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-xs",
                on
                  ? "border-success/30 bg-success-soft text-success"
                  : "border-border text-muted-foreground line-through opacity-60",
              )}
            >
              <DeviceIcon className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              {t(key)}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {screens.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("noScreens")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" data-testid="user-screens">
          {screens.map((screen) => {
            const ScreenIcon = SCREEN_ICONS[screen];
            return (
              <li
                key={screen}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium"
              >
                <ScreenIcon className="size-3.5 text-gold" aria-hidden />
                {nav(screen)}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function UsersPanel({
  users,
  can,
  currentUserId,
  actorIsOwner,
  grantable,
}: {
  users: AdminUserRow[];
  can: AdminCapabilities;
  currentUserId: string;
  actorIsOwner: boolean;
  /** Keys the actor holds, or null for the owner. */
  grantable: string[] | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("admin");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<DialogState>({ type: "none" });
  const [secret, setSecret] = useState<SecretInfo | null>(null);

  async function runConfirmed(kind: ConfirmKind, force: boolean): Promise<AdminErrorCode | null> {
    if (dialog.type !== "confirm") return "GENERIC";
    const user = dialog.user;
    if (kind === "reset") {
      const result = await resetPasswordAction(user.id);
      if (!result.ok) return result.error;
      setSecret({
        email: user.email,
        temporaryPassword: result.temporaryPassword,
        reason: "reset",
      });
    } else if (kind === "resetTwoFactor") {
      const result = await resetTwoFactorAction(user.id);
      if (!result.ok) return result.error;
      toast.success(t("toast.twoFactorReset"));
    } else if (kind === "delete") {
      const result = await deleteUserAction(user.id, force);
      if (!result.ok) return result.error;
      toast.success(t("toast.deleted"));
    } else {
      const result = await setDisabledAction(user.id, kind === "disable");
      if (!result.ok) return result.error;
      toast.success(t(kind === "disable" ? "toast.disabled" : "toast.enabled"));
    }
    router.refresh();
    return null;
  }

  /** Which menu entries this row offers to this actor. */
  function entries(user: AdminUserRow) {
    const self = user.id === currentUserId;
    const protectedOwner = user.isOwner && !actorIsOwner;
    return {
      edit: (can.edit || can.permissions) && !protectedOwner,
      reset: can.reset && !self && !protectedOwner,
      toggle: can.disable && !user.isOwner && !self,
      delete: can.delete && !user.isOwner && !self,
    };
  }

  const confirmUser = dialog.type === "confirm" ? dialog.user : null;

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="rise gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-5 py-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("users.title")}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("users.count", { count: users.length })}
              {" · "}
              {t("users.subtitle")}
            </p>
          </div>
          {can.create ? (
            <Button size="lg" onClick={() => setDialog({ type: "form", user: null })}>
              <UserPlus data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("users.new")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {users.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-5 py-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          {t("users.empty")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="grid auto-rows-fr gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2" aria-label={t("users.title")}>
          {users.map((user, i) => {
            const allowed = entries(user);
            const hasMenu = Object.values(allowed).some(Boolean);
            return (
              <li
                key={user.id}
                aria-label={user.displayName}
                data-testid="user-card"
                className={cn(
                  "rise flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-card",
                  user.isDisabled && "opacity-70",
                )}
                style={{ "--i": 2 + i } as React.CSSProperties}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-sidebar font-serif text-xl text-sidebar-primary">
                    {user.displayName.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-0.5">
                    <p className="truncate font-serif text-lg font-semibold">{user.displayName}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">{user.jobTitle || "—"}</p>
                    <p dir="ltr" className="truncate text-start text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {user.email}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  {hasMenu ? (
                    <DropdownMenu>
                      <DropdownMenuTrigger
                        render={
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            aria-label={t("users.menu.label", { name: user.displayName })}
                          />
                        }
                      >
                        <EllipsisVertical />
                      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
                      <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="min-w-52">
                        {allowed.edit ? (
                          <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => setDialog({ type: "form", user })}>
                            <Pencil />
                            {t("users.menu.edit")}
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        ) : null}
                        {allowed.reset ? (
                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onClick={() => setDialog({ type: "confirm", kind: "reset", user })}
                          >
                            <KeyRound />
                            {t("users.menu.reset")}
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        ) : null}
                        {allowed.reset && user.twoFactorEnabled ? (
                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onClick={() =>
                              setDialog({ type: "confirm", kind: "resetTwoFactor", user })
                            }
                          >
                            <ShieldOff />
                            {t("users.menu.resetTwoFactor")}
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        ) : null}
                        {allowed.toggle ? (
                          <DropdownMenuItem
                            onClick={() =>
                              setDialog({
                                type: "confirm",
                                kind: user.isDisabled ? "enable" : "disable",
                                user,
                              })
                            }
                          >
                            {user.isDisabled ? <UserCheck /> : <UserX />}
                            {user.isDisabled ? t("users.menu.enable") : t("users.menu.disable")}
                          </DropdownMenuItem>
                        ) : null}
                        {allowed.delete ? (
                          <>
                            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                            <DropdownMenuItem
                              variant="destructive"
                              onClick={() => setDialog({ type: "confirm", kind: "delete", user })}
                            >
                              <Trash2 />
                              {t("users.menu.delete")}
                            </DropdownMenuItem>
                          </>
                        ) : null}
                      </DropdownMenuContent>
                    </DropdownMenu>
                  ) : null}
                </div>

                <StatusBadges user={user} />

                <UserAccess user={user} />

                <p className="mt-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 border-t border-border pt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <Clock3 className="size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                  {user.lastSeen ? (
                    <>
                      {t("users.columns.lastSeen")}:{" "}
                      <span dir="ltr" className="tabular-nums">
                        {formatDateTime(user.lastSeen)}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    t("users.never")
                  )}
                </p>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      <UserDialog
        user={dialog.type === "form" ? dialog.user : null}
        open={dialog.type === "form"}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setDialog({ type: "none" });
        }}
        canEditPermissions={can.permissions}
        grantable={grantable}
        onCreated={(created) => {
          setSecret({ ...created, reason: "created" });
          router.refresh();
        }}
        onSaved={() => {
          toast.success(t("toast.saved"));
          router.refresh();
        }}
      />

      <ConfirmDialog
        kind={dialog.type === "confirm" ? dialog.kind : null}
        name={confirmUser?.displayName ?? ""}
        onClose={() => setDialog({ type: "none" })}
        run={runConfirmed}
      />

      <SecretDialog secret={secret} onClose={() => setSecret(null)} />
    </>
  );
}
````
