````ts
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  MAX_BATCH_ITEMS,
  MAX_BATCH_LABELS,
  MAX_COPIES,
  checkItemLabelInput,
  itemLabelDates,
  itemLabelValues,
} from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import type { ItemLabelProblem } from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import type { LabelElement, LabelValues } from "@/lib/labels/model";
import { logFor } from "@/server/activity-log";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { getLayout } from "@/server/labels";
import { PackagingError, setItemPackaging } from "@/server/packaging";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError } from "@/server/priority";
import { formatDate } from "@/lib/i18n/format";

export type PrintErrorCode =
  | "INVALID_INPUT"
  | "NOT_ALLOWED"
  | "UNAVAILABLE"
  | "ITEM_NOT_FOUND"
  | "ITEM_NOT_PRINTABLE"
  | "LAYOUT_NOT_FOUND"
  | "TOO_MANY"
  | "GENERIC";

export interface PrintJobData {
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  values: LabelValues;
  copies: number;
}

/** Several items on one label type: each item's values and copies, in the order they print. */
export interface BatchPrintJobData {
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  groups: { values: LabelValues; copies: number }[];
}

export type BatchPrintResult =
  | { ok: true; job: BatchPrintJobData }
  /** `itemNumber` names the item that stopped the print, when it is one item's doing. */
  | { ok: false; error: PrintErrorCode; itemNumber?: string };

export type PrintResult =
  | { ok: true; job: PrintJobData }
  | { ok: false; error: PrintErrorCode; problems?: ItemLabelProblem[] };

const inputSchema = z.object({
  itemNumber: z.string().min(1).max(100),
  slaughterDate: z.string().max(10),
  productionDate: z.string().max(10),
  certificateNo: z.string().max(100),
  origin: z.string().max(200).optional(),
  /** The item label type to print with. */
  layoutId: z.string().min(1).max(64),
  copies: z.number().max(MAX_COPIES * 10),
});

/**
 * Checks everything again on the server, then hands back what the print window should
 * draw: the layout, the values for this item, and the number of copies. The checks do not
 * trust the screen: a different layout needs "change the layout", other than one copy
 * needs "change the number of copies". The request is written to the activity log.
 */
export async function prepareItemLabelsAction(
  input: z.input<typeof inputSchema>,
): Promise<PrintResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("catalog.print");
    const data = inputSchema.parse(input);

    const problems = checkItemLabelInput(data, { originRequired: true });
    if (problems.length > 0) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT", problems };

    const items = await getPriorityClient().getItems();
    const item = items.find((candidate) => candidate.itemNumber === data.itemNumber);
    if (!item) return { ok: false, error: "ITEM_NOT_FOUND" };

    // The label type is chosen every time, and only an item label layout can be chosen.
    const layout = await getLayout(db, data.layoutId);
    if (!layout || layout.type !== "item") return { ok: false, error: "LAYOUT_NOT_FOUND" };
    if (data.copies !== 1) await assertPermission("catalog.changeCopies");

    let values: LabelValues;
    try {
      values = itemLabelValues(item, data);
    } catch {
      // The item number has a space or "|", which the QR text cannot hold.
      return { ok: false, error: "ITEM_NOT_PRINTABLE" };
    }
    const dates = itemLabelDates(item, data)!;
    await logFor(
      access.actor,
      "catalog.itemLabelPrinted",
      {
        entityType: "item",
        entityId: item.itemNumber,
        details: {
          item: item.itemNumber,
          layout: layout.name,
          copies: data.copies,
          certificateNo: values.certificateNo,
          slaughterDate: formatDate(dates.slaughter),
          productionDate: formatDate(dates.production),
          expiryDate: formatDate(dates.expiry),
        },
      },
      db,
    );

    return {
      ok: true,
      job: {
        widthMm: layout.widthMm,
        heightMm: layout.heightMm,
        elements: layout.elements,
        values,
        copies: data.copies,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    if (error instanceof PriorityError && error.code === "UNAVAILABLE") {
      return { ok: false, error: "UNAVAILABLE" };
    }
    console.error("[catalog] preparing item labels failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

const batchSchema = z.object({
  /** One label type for the whole print: a print job has one paper size. */
  layoutId: z.string().min(1).max(64),
  items: z
    .array(
      z.object({
        itemNumber: z.string().min(1).max(100),
        slaughterDate: z.string().max(10),
        productionDate: z.string().max(10),
        certificateNo: z.string().max(100),
        origin: z.string().max(200).optional(),
        copies: z.number().max(MAX_COPIES * 10),
      }),
    )
    .min(1)
    .max(MAX_BATCH_ITEMS),
});

/**
 * Several items printed together on one label type, each with its own dates, certificate number
 * and copies. Everything is checked first and nothing is logged unless the whole print is good.
 * The labels of one item come together, with an empty label between one item and the next
 * (drawn by the print sheet). Other than one copy of an item needs "change the number of copies".
 */
export async function prepareBatchLabelsAction(
  input: z.input<typeof batchSchema>,
): Promise<BatchPrintResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("catalog.print");
    const data = batchSchema.parse(input);

    for (const entry of data.items) {
      if (checkItemLabelInput(entry, { originRequired: true }).length > 0) {
        return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT", itemNumber: entry.itemNumber };
      }
    }
    if (data.items.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.copies, 0) > MAX_BATCH_LABELS) {
      return { ok: false, error: "TOO_MANY" };
    }

    const layout = await getLayout(db, data.layoutId);
    if (!layout || layout.type !== "item") return { ok: false, error: "LAYOUT_NOT_FOUND" };
    if (data.items.some((entry) => entry.copies !== 1)) {
      await assertPermission("catalog.changeCopies");
    }

    const catalog = await getPriorityClient().getItems();
    const groups: BatchPrintJobData["groups"] = [];
    const logs: { item: string; values: LabelValues; entry: (typeof data.items)[number] }[] = [];
    for (const entry of data.items) {
      const item = catalog.find((candidate) => candidate.itemNumber === entry.itemNumber);
      if (!item) return { ok: false, error: "ITEM_NOT_FOUND", itemNumber: entry.itemNumber };
      let values: LabelValues;
      try {
        values = itemLabelValues(item, entry);
      } catch {
        // The item number has a space or "|", which the QR text cannot hold.
        return { ok: false, error: "ITEM_NOT_PRINTABLE", itemNumber: entry.itemNumber };
      }
      groups.push({ values, copies: entry.copies });
      logs.push({ item: item.itemNumber, values, entry });
    }

    for (const { item, values, entry } of logs) {
      const dates = itemLabelDates(
        catalog.find((c) => c.itemNumber === item)!,
        entry,
      )!;
      await logFor(
        access.actor,
        "catalog.itemLabelPrinted",
        {
          entityType: "item",
          entityId: item,
          details: {
            item,
            layout: layout.name,
            copies: entry.copies,
            certificateNo: values.certificateNo,
            slaughterDate: formatDate(dates.slaughter),
            productionDate: formatDate(dates.production),
            expiryDate: formatDate(dates.expiry),
            together: data.items.length,
          },
        },
        db,
      );
    }

    return {
      ok: true,
      job: {
        widthMm: layout.widthMm,
        heightMm: layout.heightMm,
        elements: layout.elements,
        groups,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    if (error instanceof PriorityError && error.code === "UNAVAILABLE") {
      return { ok: false, error: "UNAVAILABLE" };
    }
    console.error("[catalog] preparing several item labels failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/** Chooses (or with an empty id clears) the packaging an item is packed in. Needs "packaging". */
export async function setItemPackagingAction(
  itemNumber: string,
  typeId: string,
): Promise<
  { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: "NOT_ALLOWED" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "NOT_FOUND" | "GENERIC" }
> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("catalog.packaging");
    const data = z
      .object({ itemNumber: z.string().min(1).max(100), typeId: z.string().max(100) })
      .parse({ itemNumber, typeId });
    await setItemPackaging(db, data.itemNumber, data.typeId || null, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/catalog");
    revalidatePath("/receiving");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    if (error instanceof PackagingError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_FOUND" };
    console.error("[catalog] choosing the packaging of an item failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Printer, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { LabelPrintSheet, printLabelSheet } from "@/components/labels/label-print";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { formatDate, todayIso } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import {
  MAX_COPIES,
  MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS,
  checkItemLabelInput,
  itemLabelDates,
  type ItemLabelInput,
  type ItemLabelProblem,
} from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { prepareBatchLabelsAction, type BatchPrintJobData, type PrintErrorCode } from "./actions";
import { firstLayoutId, LayoutChooser, type PrintSettings } from "./print-dialog";

/** What is typed for one item; the dates and the copies stay text until they are checked. */
interface Row {
  slaughterDate: string;
  productionDate: string;
  certificateNo: string;
  origin: string;
  copies: string;
}

/** A new row; the country of origin starts as the item's own, when Priority has one. */
const emptyRow = (item: PriorityItem): Row => ({
  slaughterDate: "",
  productionDate: todayIso(),
  certificateNo: "",
  origin: item.origin ?? "",
  copies: "1",
});

const asInput = (row: Row): ItemLabelInput => ({
  slaughterDate: row.slaughterDate,
  productionDate: row.productionDate,
  certificateNo: row.certificateNo.trim(),
  origin: row.origin.trim(),
  copies: Number(row.copies),
});

/**
 * Printing the labels of several items together: one label type for all of them (a print job
 * has one paper size), and for each item its own dates, certificate number and copies. The print
 * has an empty label between one item and the next. Everything is checked again on the server.
 */
export function BatchPrintDialog({
  items,
  settings,
  onRemove,
  onClose,
  onDone,
}: {
  /** The chosen items in the order they print; null while the window is closed. */
  items: PriorityItem[] | null;
  settings: PrintSettings;
  /** Takes an item out of this print (and out of the choice). */
  onRemove: (itemNumber: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** After the print window has closed. */
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog open={items !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => (open ? undefined : onClose())}>
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-3xl">
        {items ? (
          <BatchForm
            items={items}
            settings={settings}
            onRemove={onRemove}
            onCancel={onClose}
            onDone={onDone}
          />
        ) : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function BatchForm({
  items,
  settings,
  onRemove,
  onCancel,
  onDone,
}: {
  items: PriorityItem[];
  settings: PrintSettings;
  onRemove: (itemNumber: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog.batch");
  const print = useTranslations("catalog.print");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  // With several label types nothing is chosen yet: the person picks one for every print.
  const [layoutId, setLayoutId] = useState(() => firstLayoutId(settings));
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Record<string, Row>>({});
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<{ error: PrintErrorCode; item?: string } | null>(null);
  const [job, setJob] = useState<BatchPrintJobData | null>(null);

  const rowOf = (item: PriorityItem): Row => rows[item.itemNumber] ?? emptyRow(item);
  function change(item: PriorityItem, patch: Partial<Row>) {
    setRows((current) => ({ ...current, [item.itemNumber]: { ...rowOf(item), ...patch } }));
  }

  const layout = settings.layouts.find((l) => l.id === layoutId) ?? null;
  const problems = new Map(
    items.map((item) => [
      item.itemNumber,
      checkItemLabelInput(asInput(rowOf(item)), { originRequired: true }),
    ]),
  );
  const complete = [...problems.values()].every((list) => list.length === 0);
  const labels = items.reduce((sum, item) => {
    const copies = Number(rowOf(item).copies);
    return sum + (Number.isInteger(copies) && copies > 0 ? copies : 0);
  }, 0);
  const blanks = Math.max(0, items.length - 1);

  // Once the server has agreed, the labels are on the page: open the print window for them.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!job) return;
    printLabelSheet(job.widthMm, job.heightMm, () => {
      setJob(null);
      onDone();
    });
  }, [job, onDone]);

  function submit() {
    setSubmitted(true);
    setFailure(null);
    if (!complete || !layout || items.length === 0) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await prepareBatchLabelsAction({
        layoutId,
        items: items.map((item) => ({ itemNumber: item.itemNumber, ...asInput(rowOf(item)) })),
      });
      if (!result.ok) return setFailure({ error: result.error, item: result.itemNumber });
      setJob(result.job);
    });
  }

  const shown = (item: PriorityItem, problem: ItemLabelProblem) =>
    submitted && (problems.get(item.itemNumber) ?? []).includes(problem);

  return (
    <>
      <DialogTitleBlock icon={<Printer />} title={t("title")} description={t("description")} />

      {settings.layouts.length === 0 ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{print("noLayout")}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {failure ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" data-testid="batch-failure">
          <AlertDescription>
            {failure.item
              ? t("itemProblem", { error: print(`errors.${failure.error}`), item: failure.item })
              : print(`errors.${failure.error}`)}
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <LayoutChooser
        layouts={settings.layouts}
        value={layoutId}
        onChange={setLayoutId}
        missing={submitted && !layout}
        name="batch-layout"
      />

      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          {t("empty")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="space-y-3" data-testid="batch-rows">
          {items.map((item, index) => {
            const row = rowOf(item);
            const dates = itemLabelDates(item, row);
            const id = `batch-${index}`;
            return (
              <li
                key={item.itemNumber}
                role="group"
                aria-label={item.name}
                data-testid="batch-row"
                data-item={item.itemNumber}
                className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p dir="auto" className="font-semibold">
                      {item.name}
                    </p>
                    <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {item.itemNumber}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="icon"
                    aria-label={t("remove", { name: item.name })}
                    disabled={pending || job !== null}
                    onClick={() => onRemove(item.itemNumber)}
                  >
                    <X />
                  </Button>
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <RowField
                    id={`${id}-slaughter`}
                    label={print("fields.slaughter")}
                    problem={
                      shown(item, "SLAUGHTER_DATE") ? print("problems.SLAUGHTER_DATE") : null
                    }
                  >
                    <Input
                      id={`${id}-slaughter`}
                      type="date"
                      dir="ltr"
                      value={row.slaughterDate}
                      onChange={(e) => change(item, { slaughterDate: e.target.value })}
                      aria-invalid={shown(item, "SLAUGHTER_DATE") || shown(item, "DATES_ORDER")}
                    />
                  </RowField>
                  <RowField
                    id={`${id}-production`}
                    label={print("fields.production")}
                    problem={
                      shown(item, "PRODUCTION_DATE")
                        ? print("problems.PRODUCTION_DATE")
                        : shown(item, "DATES_ORDER")
                          ? print("problems.DATES_ORDER")
                          : null
                    }
                  >
                    <Input
                      id={`${id}-production`}
                      type="date"
                      dir="ltr"
                      value={row.productionDate}
                      onChange={(e) => change(item, { productionDate: e.target.value })}
                      aria-invalid={shown(item, "PRODUCTION_DATE") || shown(item, "DATES_ORDER")}
                    />
                  </RowField>
                  <RowField
                    id={`${id}-certificate`}
                    label={print("fields.certificate")}
                    problem={shown(item, "CERTIFICATE") ? print("problems.CERTIFICATE") : null}
                  >
                    <Input
                      id={`${id}-certificate`}
                      dir="ltr"
                      autoComplete="off"
                      value={row.certificateNo}
                      onChange={(e) => change(item, { certificateNo: e.target.value })}
                      aria-invalid={shown(item, "CERTIFICATE")}
                    />
                  </RowField>
                  <RowField
                    id={`${id}-origin`}
                    label={print("fields.origin")}
                    problem={
                      shown(item, "ORIGIN_MISSING")
                        ? print("problems.ORIGIN_MISSING")
                        : shown(item, "ORIGIN")
                          ? print("problems.ORIGIN", { max: MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS })
                          : null
                    }
                  >
                    <Input
                      id={`${id}-origin`}
                      dir="auto"
                      autoComplete="off"
                      placeholder={print("originHint")}
                      value={row.origin}
                      onChange={(e) => change(item, { origin: e.target.value })}
                      aria-invalid={shown(item, "ORIGIN") || shown(item, "ORIGIN_MISSING")}
                    />
                  </RowField>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <RowField
                      id={`${id}-copies`}
                      label={print("fields.copies")}
                      problem={
                        shown(item, "COPIES") ? print("problems.COPIES", { max: MAX_COPIES }) : null
                      }
                    >
                      <Input
                        id={`${id}-copies`}
                        type="number"
                        inputMode="numeric"
                        dir="ltr"
                        min={1}
                        max={MAX_COPIES}
                        step={1}
                        value={row.copies}
                        disabled={!settings.canChangeCopies}
                        onChange={(e) => change(item, { copies: e.target.value })}
                        aria-invalid={shown(item, "COPIES")}
                      />
                    </RowField>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      <Label className="text-sm">{print("fields.expiry")}</Label>
                      <p
                        dir="ltr"
                        data-testid="batch-expiry"
                        className="flex h-11 items-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 px-3.5 text-start tabular-nums"
                      >
                        {dates ? formatDate(dates.expiry) : "—"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}

      <DialogFooter className="items-center sm:justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground" data-testid="batch-summary">
          {t("summary", { labels, items: items.length })}
          {blanks > 0 ? t("summaryBlanks", { blanks }) : ""}
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="lg"
            onClick={onCancel}
            disabled={pending || job !== null}
          >
            {print("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"

            disabled={

          >
            <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
            {pending ? print("preparing") : print("submit")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </DialogFooter>

      {job ? <LabelPrintSheet job={job} /> : null}
    </>
  );
}

function RowField({
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Check, Layers, ListChecks, Package, Printer, Search, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { categoryCounts, filterItems, sortByName } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { MAX_BATCH_ITEMS } from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { ItemPackaging, type PackagingChoices } from "./item-packaging";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { BatchPrintDialog } from "./batch-print";
import { PrintForm, type PrintSettings } from "./print-dialog";

/**
 * The catalog: search, every category as a card with its count (opening shows its items), and
 * every item as a card under its category. Opening an item shows its details and, for people who
 * may, prints its label. Read only; the names, categories and texts are Priority's own and are
 * shown as they are in either language. Every item is on the page already, so search is instant.
 */
export function CatalogBrowser({
  items,
  canOpenDetails,
  print,
  packaging,
}: {
  items: PriorityItem[];
  canOpenDetails: boolean;
  /** The packaging types and each item's choice; null for people who may not open the details. */
  packaging: PackagingChoices | null;
  /** Present for people who may print item labels: the layouts, and what else they may change. */
  print: PrintSettings | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [openCategory, setOpenCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [openItem, setOpenItem] = useState<PriorityItem | null>(null);
  // Choosing several items to print their labels together: the chosen ones, in the order chosen.
  const [selecting, setSelecting] = useState(false);
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [batchOpen, setBatchOpen] = useState(false);

  // Categories, and the items inside each, always in alphabetical order so an item is easy to find.
  const categories = useMemo(() => categoryCounts(items), [items]);
  const sorted = useMemo(() => sortByName(items), [items]);
  const shown = useMemo(() => filterItems(sorted, { category: null, query }), [sorted, query]);
  // The shown items under their categories, in the order of the category cards.
  const sections = useMemo(
    () =>
      categories
        .map(({ category }) => ({
          category,
          items: shown.filter((item) => item.category === category),
        }))
        .filter((section) => section.items.length > 0),
    [categories, shown],
  );
  const categoryLabel = (value: string) => (value === "" ? t("uncategorized") : value);
  // An item opens only for someone who may see its details or print its label.
  const canOpen = canOpenDetails || print !== null;

  const byNumber = useMemo(() => new Map(items.map((item) => [item.itemNumber, item])), [items]);
  const chosenItems = chosen.flatMap((number) => byNumber.get(number) ?? []);

  function toggle(item: PriorityItem) {
    setChosen((current) =>
      current.includes(item.itemNumber)
        ? current.filter((number) => number !== item.itemNumber)
        : current.length >= MAX_BATCH_ITEMS
          ? current
          : [...current, item.itemNumber],
    );
  }

  function stopSelecting() {
    setSelecting(false);
    setChosen([]);
    setBatchOpen(false);
  }

  function chooseItem(item: PriorityItem) {
    if (selecting) return toggle(item);
    setOpenCategory(null);
    setOpenItem(item);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="rise relative" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <Search
          aria-hidden
          className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
        />
        <Input
          type="search"
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
          placeholder={t("searchPlaceholder")}
          aria-label={t("searchLabel")}
          className="ps-10"
          autoComplete="off"
        />
      </div>

      <Card className="rise p-4" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label={t("categories")}
          className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-6"
        >
          <CategoryCard
            active
            label={t("allCategories")}
            count={items.length}
            onClick={() => setQuery("")}
            ariaLabel={t("allCategoriesAction", { count: items.length })}
          />
          {categories.map(({ category, count }) => (
            <CategoryCard
              key={category || "none"}
              label={categoryLabel(category)}
              count={count}
              onClick={() => setOpenCategory(category)}
              ariaLabel={t("openCategory", { category: categoryLabel(category), count })}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div
        className="rise flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card px-4 py-3"
        style={{ "--i": 3 } as React.CSSProperties}
      >
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {selecting ? t("select.hint") : canOpen ? t("listHint") : t("listHintReadOnly")}
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {print !== null ? (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant={selecting ? "default" : "outline"}
              size="sm"
              aria-pressed={selecting}
              onClick={() => (selecting ? stopSelecting() : setSelecting(true))}
            >
              {selecting ? <X data-icon="inline-start" /> : <ListChecks data-icon="inline-start" />}
              {selecting ? t("select.cancel") : t("select.start")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          <Badge variant="soft" className="tabular-nums">
            <span role="status">{t("totalShown", { count: shown.length })}</span>
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      {shown.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-14 text-center">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("empty")}</p>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setQuery("")}>
            {t("clear")}
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        sections.map((section) => (
          <section
            key={section.category || "none"}
            aria-label={categoryLabel(section.category)}
            className="space-y-3"
            data-testid="catalog-section"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/50 px-4 py-2.5">
              <h2 className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 font-semibold">
                <Layers className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gold" aria-hidden />
                <span dir="auto" className="truncate">
                  {categoryLabel(section.category)}
                </span>
              </h2>
              <Badge variant="soft" className="tabular-nums">
                {t("count", { count: section.items.length })}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <ul className="grid auto-rows-fr grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 2xl:grid-cols-8">
              {section.items.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.itemNumber} className="min-w-0">
                  <ItemCard
                    item={item}
                    category={categoryLabel(item.category)}
                    onOpen={canOpen ? () => chooseItem(item) : null}
                    selected={selecting ? chosen.includes(item.itemNumber) : undefined}
                    openLabel={selecting ? t("select.selectItem", { name: item.name }) : undefined}
                  />
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
        ))
      )}

      <CategoryDialog
        category={openCategory}
        label={openCategory === null ? "" : categoryLabel(openCategory)}
        items={openCategory === null ? [] : sorted.filter((i) => i.category === openCategory)}
        onOpenItem={canOpen ? chooseItem : null}
        chosen={selecting ? chosen : null}
        onClose={() => setOpenCategory(null)}
      />
      <ItemDialog
        packaging={packaging}
        item={openItem}
        canOpenDetails={canOpenDetails}
        print={print}
        onClose={() => setOpenItem(null)}
      />

      {selecting && print ? (
        <>
          <div
            className="sticky bottom-4 z-20 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-primary/30 bg-card px-4 py-3 shadow-lg"
            data-testid="select-bar"
          >
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold" role="status" data-testid="select-count">
              {t("select.count", { count: chosen.length })}
              {chosen.length >= MAX_BATCH_ITEMS ? (
                <span className="ms-2 font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("select.limit", { max: MAX_BATCH_ITEMS })}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                disabled={chosen.length === 0}
                onClick={() => setChosen([])}
              >
                {t("select.clear")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                disabled={chosen.length === 0}
                onClick={() => setBatchOpen(true)}
              >
                <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
                {t("select.print")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <BatchPrintDialog
            items={batchOpen ? chosenItems : null}
            settings={print}
            onRemove={(number) => setChosen((current) => current.filter((n) => n !== number))}
            onClose={() => setBatchOpen(false)}
            onDone={stopSelecting}
          />
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CategoryCard({
  active = false,
  label,
  count,
  onClick,
  ariaLabel,
}: {
  active?: boolean;
  label: string;
  count: number;
  onClick: () => void;
  ariaLabel: string;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
      className={cn(
        "flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-start text-sm font-semibold transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
        active
          ? "border-primary/40 bg-primary/5 text-primary"
          : "border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:border-gold/60 hover:bg-secondary/60",
      )}
    >
      <span dir="auto" className="min-w-0 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      <Badge variant={active ? "default" : "outline"} className="shrink-0 tabular-nums" aria-hidden>
        {count}
      </Badge>
    </button>
  );
}

/** One item: its category, both names, and the item number at the foot. */
export function ItemCard({
  item,
  category,
  onOpen,
  openLabel,
  selected,
}: {
  item: PriorityItem;
  category: string;
  onOpen: (() => void) | null;
  /** What the button says to a screen reader; opening the item's window by default. */
  openLabel?: string;
  /** Set while items are being chosen: whether this one is chosen. Left out when not choosing. */
  selected?: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog");
  const body = (
    <>
      <Badge variant="soft" className="max-w-full self-start truncate text-[0.7rem]">
        <span dir="auto" className="truncate">
          {category}
        </span>
      </Badge>
      {/* The name always has room for two lines and the English name for one, so every card is the same height. */}
      <span
        dir="auto"
        title={item.name}
        className="mt-2 line-clamp-2 min-h-[2lh] text-sm leading-snug font-semibold"
      >
        {item.name}
      </span>
      <span
        dir="auto"
        title={item.nameEn || undefined}
        className="mt-0.5 block min-h-[1lh] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground"
      >
        {item.nameEn}
      </span>
      <span className="mt-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-border pt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <span>{t("itemNumberLabel")}</span>
        <span dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-foreground">
          {item.itemNumber}
        </span>
      </span>
    </>
  );
  const box = cn(
    "relative flex h-full w-full flex-col gap-1 rounded-xl border bg-card p-3 text-start shadow-card",
    selected ? "border-primary/60 bg-primary/5 ring-2 ring-primary/30" : "border-border",
  );
  if (!onOpen) return <div className={box}>{body}</div>;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onOpen}
      aria-label={openLabel ?? t("openItem", { name: item.name })}
      aria-pressed={selected}
      data-selected={selected}
      className={cn(
        box,
        "transition-colors outline-none hover:border-gold/60 focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
      )}
    >
      {selected !== undefined ? (
        <span
          aria-hidden
          className={cn(
            "absolute end-2 top-2 grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full border",
            selected ? "border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "border-input bg-card",
          )}
        >
          {selected ? <Check className="size-3" /> : null}
        </span>
      ) : null}
      {body}
    </button>
  );
}

/** The items of one category, as small cards; opening one shows the item. */
function CategoryDialog({
  category,
  label,
  items,
  onOpenItem,
  chosen,
  onClose,
}: {
  category: string | null;
  label: string;
  items: PriorityItem[];
  onOpenItem: ((item: PriorityItem) => void) | null;
  /** The item numbers chosen for printing together while items are being chosen; otherwise null. */
  chosen: string[] | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog.categoryDialog");
  return (
    <Dialog open={category !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => (open ? undefined : onClose())}>
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-5xl">
        {category !== null ? (
          <>
            <DialogTitleBlock
              icon={<Layers />}
              title={t("title", { category: label })}
              description={t("found", { count: items.length })}
            />
            <ul
              className="grid auto-rows-fr grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5"
              data-testid="category-items"
            >
              {items.map((item) => {
                const body = (
                  <>
                    {/* Room for two lines always, so every box is the same height. */}
                    <span
                      dir="auto"
                      title={item.name}
                      className="line-clamp-2 min-h-[2lh] text-sm leading-snug font-semibold"
                    >
                      {item.name}
                    </span>
                    <span dir="ltr" className="mt-1.5 block font-mono text-xs text-info">
                      {t("itemNumber", { number: item.itemNumber })}
                    </span>
                  </>
                );
                const picked = chosen?.includes(item.itemNumber);
                const box = cn(
                  "flex h-full w-full flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border px-2.5 py-3 text-center",
                  picked
                    ? "border-primary/60 bg-primary/5 ring-2 ring-primary/30"
                    : "border-border bg-muted/40",
                );
                return (
                  <li key={item.itemNumber} className="min-w-0">
                    {onOpenItem ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenItem(item)}
                        aria-pressed={chosen ? picked : undefined}
                        className={cn(
                          box,
                          "transition-colors outline-none hover:border-gold/60 hover:bg-card focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
                        )}
                      >
                        {body}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <div className={box}>{body}</div>
                    )}
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
            <DialogFooter>
              <Button type="button" size="lg" onClick={onClose}>
                {t("close")}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

/**
 * One item's window: its details as Priority has them, and printing its label. Someone who may
 * only print goes straight to printing; someone who may only look sees the details.
 */
function ItemDialog({
  item,
  canOpenDetails,
  print,
  packaging,
  onClose,
}: {
  item: PriorityItem | null;
  canOpenDetails: boolean;
  packaging: PackagingChoices | null;
  print: PrintSettings | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  const showPrint = print !== null && (printing || !canOpenDetails);

  function close() {
    setPrinting(false);
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={item !== null} onOpenChange={(open) => (open ? undefined : close())}>
      <DialogContent
        className={cn("max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto", showPrint ? "sm:max-w-3xl" : "sm:max-w-xl")}
      >
        {item && showPrint && print ? (
          <PrintForm
            key={item.itemNumber}
            item={item}
            settings={print}
            onDone={close}
            onCancel={canOpenDetails ? () => setPrinting(false) : close}
          />
        ) : item ? (
          <ItemDetails
            key={item.itemNumber}
            item={item}
            packaging={packaging}
            onPrint={print ? () => setPrinting(true) : null}
            onClose={close}
          />
        ) : null}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ItemDetails({
  item,
  packaging,
  onPrint,
  onClose,
}: {
  item: PriorityItem;
  packaging: PackagingChoices | null;
  onPrint: (() => void) | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog.details");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const catalog = useTranslations("catalog");

  const rows: { label: string; value: string; mono?: boolean; auto?: boolean }[] = [
    { label: t("fields.itemNumber"), value: item.itemNumber, mono: true },
    { label: t("fields.name"), value: item.name, auto: true },
    { label: t("fields.nameEn"), value: item.nameEn, auto: true },
    { label: t("fields.barcode"), value: item.barcode, mono: true },
    {
      label: t("fields.category"),
      value: item.category === "" ? catalog("uncategorized") : item.category,
      auto: true,
    },
    {
      label: t("fields.weight"),
      value: item.weightKg === null ? "" : `${formatWeight(item.weightKg)} ${common("kg")}`,
    },
    { label: t("fields.shelfLife"), value: catalog("shelfLifeDays", { days: item.shelfLifeDays }) },
    { label: t("fields.storage"), value: item.storageText, auto: true },
    { label: t("fields.packing"), value: item.packingCode, auto: true },
    { label: t("fields.origin"), value: item.origin, auto: true },
    {
      label: t("fields.inventoryManaged"),
      value: item.inventoryManaged ? common("yes") : common("no"),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <DialogTitleBlock icon={<Package />} title={item.name} description={t("readOnly")} />
      <dl className="grid gap-x-6 gap-y-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {rows.map((row) => (
          <div key={row.label} className="min-w-0">
            <dt className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">{row.label}</dt>
            {/* The text keeps its own direction, but always lines up under its title. */}
            <dd className={cn("mt-0.5 break-words", row.mono && "font-mono text-sm")}>
              {row.value === "" ? (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("notSet")}</span>
              ) : (
                <span dir={row.mono ? "ltr" : row.auto ? "auto" : undefined}>{row.value}</span>
              )}
            </dd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </dl>
      {packaging ? <ItemPackaging itemNumber={item.itemNumber} choices={packaging} /> : null}
      <DialogFooter>
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="lg" onClick={onClose}>
          {common("close")}
        </Button>
        {onPrint ? (
          <Button type="button" size="lg" onClick={onPrint}>
            <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
            {t("printLabel")}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </DialogFooter>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { formatPackingWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import type { PackagingType } from "@/server/packaging";
import { setItemPackagingAction } from "./actions";

/** What the catalog knows about packaging: the kinds there are, and the one chosen for each item. */
export interface PackagingChoices {
  types: PackagingType[];
  byItem: Record<string, string>;
  /** Whether this person may choose the packaging of an item. */
  canEdit: boolean;
}

const SELECT_CLASS =
  "h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-60";

/**
 * The packaging an item is packed in, chosen from the list kept in the system settings. A box of
 * this item is recorded at the scale weight less the weight of its packaging. A choice is saved
 * at once.
 */
export function ItemPackaging({
  itemNumber,
  choices,
}: {
  itemNumber: string;
  choices: PackagingChoices;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog.packaging");
  const errors = useTranslations("settings.packaging.errors");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const initial = choices.byItem[itemNumber] ?? "";
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(
    choices.types.some((type) => type.id === initial) ? initial : "",
  );

  const label = (type: PackagingType) =>
    `${type.name} · ${formatPackingWeight(type.weightKg)} ${common("kg")}`;
  const current = choices.types.find((type) => type.id === chosen);

  function choose(typeId: string) {
    const before = chosen;
    setChosen(typeId);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setItemPackagingAction(itemNumber, typeId);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setChosen(before);
        return void toast.error(errors(result.error));
      }
      toast.success(t("saved"));
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/30 px-4 py-3">
      <Label htmlFor="item-packaging" className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
        {t("label")}
      </Label>
      {choices.canEdit ? (
        <select
          id="item-packaging"
          data-testid="item-packaging"
          value={chosen}
          disabled={pending}
          onChange={(event) => choose(event.target.value)}
          className={SELECT_CLASS}
        >
          <option value="">{t("none")}</option>
          {choices.types.map((type) => (
            <option key={type.id} value={type.id}>
              {label(type)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      ) : (
        <p data-testid="item-packaging-readonly">
          {current ? label(current) : <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</span>}
        </p>
      )}
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("hint")}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { CloudOff } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { getDefaultItemLayout, listItemLayouts } from "@/server/labels";
import { getItemPackaging, getPackagingTypes } from "@/server/packaging";
import { requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError, type PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority";
import { RefreshButton } from "../dashboard/refresh-button";
import { CatalogBrowser } from "./catalog-browser";
import type { PrintSettings } from "./print-dialog";

/** The item catalog, read from Priority (the stand-in until phase 6) every time the page opens. */
export default async function CatalogPage() {
  const access = await requireScreen("catalog");
  const t = await getTranslations();
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.catalog;

  const header = (
    <PageHeader
      icon={<Icon />}
      eyebrow={t("shell.groups.operations")}
      title={t("nav.catalog")}
      description={t("screens.catalog")}
      help="catalog"
    />
  );

  let items: PriorityItem[];
  try {
    items = await getPriorityClient().getItems();
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof PriorityError) || error.code !== "UNAVAILABLE") throw error;
    return (
      <>
        {header}
        <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-14 text-center">
            <span className="grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full border border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft text-warning [&_svg]:size-9">
              <CloudOff />
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("catalog.unavailable.title")}</h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("catalog.unavailable.body")}</p>
            <RefreshButton />
          </div>
        </Card>
      </>
    );
  }

  // Only for people who may print: the item label types to choose from (chosen every time), and
  // whether they may change the number of copies.
  let print: PrintSettings | null = null;
  if (access.can("catalog.print")) {
    const [layouts, defaultLayoutId] = await Promise.all([
      listItemLayouts(db),
      getDefaultItemLayout(db),
    ]);
    print = {
      layouts: layouts.map(({ id, name, widthMm, heightMm, elements }) => ({
        id,
        name,
        widthMm,
        heightMm,
        elements,
      })),
      defaultLayoutId,
      canChangeCopies: access.can("catalog.changeCopies"),
    };
  }

  // The packaging of each item, for people who open the details of an item.
  const canOpenDetails = access.can("catalog.details");
  const packaging = canOpenDetails
    ? {
        types: await getPackagingTypes(db),
        byItem: await getItemPackaging(db),
        canEdit: access.can("catalog.packaging"),
      }
    : null;

  return (
    <>
      {header}
      <CatalogBrowser
        items={items}
        canOpenDetails={canOpenDetails}
        print={print}
        packaging={packaging}
      />
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Check, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { ElementView } from "@/components/labels/element-view";
import { LabelPrintSheet, printLabelSheet } from "@/components/labels/label-print";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { formatDate, todayIso } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  MAX_COPIES,
  MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS,
  checkItemLabelInput,
  itemLabelDates,
  itemLabelValues,
  type ItemLabelProblem,
} from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import type { LabelElement, LabelValues } from "@/lib/labels/model";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { prepareItemLabelsAction, type PrintErrorCode, type PrintJobData } from "./actions";

export interface PrintableLayout {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
}

export interface PrintSettings {
  /** The item label types to choose from, every time. */
  layouts: PrintableLayout[];
  /** The item layout chosen in advance (set in the label layouts); it can still be changed. */
  defaultLayoutId: string | null;
  canChangeCopies: boolean;
}

/** The label type chosen when the print window opens: the default, or the only one there is. */
export function firstLayoutId(settings: PrintSettings): string {
  if (settings.defaultLayoutId && settings.layouts.some((l) => l.id === settings.defaultLayoutId))
    return settings.defaultLayoutId;
  return settings.layouts.length === 1 ? settings.layouts[0].id : "";
}

/**
 * Printing item labels, shown inside the item's window: the label type (chosen from the item
 * layouts every time, with one only when there is just one), the dates, the production
 * certificate number and the copies (one unless the user may change it). The expiry date is worked out from the shelf life. Everything
 * is checked again on the server, which also writes the print to the activity log.
 */
export function PrintForm({
  item,
  settings,
  onDone,
  onCancel,
}: {
  item: PriorityItem;
  settings: PrintSettings;
  /** After the print window has closed. */
  onDone: () => void;
  /** The cancel button: back to the item's details, or closing the window. */
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog.print");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const today = todayIso();
  const [slaughterDate, setSlaughterDate] = useState("");
  const [productionDate, setProductionDate] = useState(today);
  const [certificateNo, setCertificateNo] = useState("");
  // Starts as the item's own country of origin when Priority has one; it must not stay empty.
  const [origin, setOrigin] = useState(item.origin ?? "");
  // With several label types nothing is chosen yet: the person picks one for every print.
  const [layoutId, setLayoutId] = useState(() => firstLayoutId(settings));
  const [copies, setCopies] = useState("1");
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<PrintErrorCode | null>(null);
  const [job, setJob] = useState<PrintJobData | null>(null);

  const layout = settings.layouts.find((l) => l.id === layoutId) ?? null;
  const input = { slaughterDate, productionDate, certificateNo, origin, copies: Number(copies) };
  const problems = checkItemLabelInput(input, { originRequired: true });
  const dates = itemLabelDates(item, input);

  // The preview shows the real label once the form is complete, and sample values before.
  const complete = problems.length === 0;
  // An item number with a space or "|" cannot go into the QR text: that item cannot be printed.
  let previewValues: LabelValues | null = null;
  try {
    previewValues = itemLabelValues(item, {
      slaughterDate: complete ? slaughterDate : productionDate || today,
      productionDate: complete ? productionDate : productionDate || today,
      certificateNo: complete ? certificateNo : "000000",
      origin: origin.length <= MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS ? origin : "",
      copies: 1,
    });
  } catch {
    previewValues = null;
  }

  // Once the server has agreed, the labels are on the page: open the print window for them.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!job) return;
    printLabelSheet(job.widthMm, job.heightMm, () => {
      setJob(null);
      onDone();
    });
  }, [job, onDone]);

  function print() {
    setSubmitted(true);
    setFailure(null);
    if (!complete || !layout || !previewValues) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await prepareItemLabelsAction({
        itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
        slaughterDate,
        productionDate,
        certificateNo: certificateNo.trim(),
        origin: origin.trim(),
        layoutId,
        copies: input.copies,
      });
      if (!result.ok) return setFailure(result.problems?.length ? "INVALID_INPUT" : result.error);
      setJob(result.job);
    });
  }

  const shown = (problem: ItemLabelProblem) => submitted && problems.includes(problem);

  return (
    <>
      <DialogTitleBlock
        icon={<Printer />}
        title={t("title")}
        description={`${item.itemNumber} · ${item.name}`}
      />

      {settings.layouts.length === 0 ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{t("noLayout")}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {previewValues === null ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{t("errors.ITEM_NOT_PRINTABLE")}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {failure ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{t(`errors.${failure}`)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,18rem)]">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-4">
          <LayoutChooser
            layouts={settings.layouts}
            value={layoutId}
            onChange={setLayoutId}
            missing={submitted && !layout}
          />

          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field
              label={t("fields.slaughter")}
              id="print-slaughter"
              problem={shown("SLAUGHTER_DATE") ? t("problems.SLAUGHTER_DATE") : null}
            >
              <Input
                id="print-slaughter"
                type="date"
                dir="ltr"
                value={slaughterDate}
                onChange={(e) => setSlaughterDate(e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={shown("SLAUGHTER_DATE") || shown("DATES_ORDER")}
              />
            </Field>
            <Field
              label={t("fields.production")}
              id="print-production"
              problem={
                shown("PRODUCTION_DATE")
                  ? t("problems.PRODUCTION_DATE")
                  : shown("DATES_ORDER")
                    ? t("problems.DATES_ORDER")
                    : null
              }
            >
              <Input
                id="print-production"
                type="date"
                dir="ltr"
                value={productionDate}
                onChange={(e) => setProductionDate(e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={shown("PRODUCTION_DATE") || shown("DATES_ORDER")}
              />
            </Field>
          </div>

          <Field
            label={t("fields.certificate")}
            id="print-certificate"
            problem={shown("CERTIFICATE") ? t("problems.CERTIFICATE") : null}
          >
            <Input
              id="print-certificate"
              dir="ltr"
              autoComplete="off"
              value={certificateNo}
              onChange={(e) => setCertificateNo(e.target.value)}
              aria-invalid={shown("CERTIFICATE")}
            />
          </Field>

          <Field
            label={t("fields.origin")}
            id="print-origin"
            problem={
              shown("ORIGIN_MISSING")
                ? t("problems.ORIGIN_MISSING")
                : shown("ORIGIN")
                  ? t("problems.ORIGIN", { max: MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS })
                  : null
            }
          >
            <Input
              id="print-origin"
              dir="auto"
              autoComplete="off"
              placeholder={t("originHint")}
              value={origin}
              onChange={(e) => setOrigin(e.target.value)}
              aria-invalid={shown("ORIGIN") || shown("ORIGIN_MISSING")}
            />
          </Field>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label className="text-sm">{t("fields.expiry")}</Label>
            <p
              data-testid="expiry"
              dir="ltr"
              className="flex h-11 items-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 px-3.5 text-start tabular-nums"
            >
              {dates ? formatDate(dates.expiry) : "—"}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {dates ? t("expiryHint", { days: item.shelfLifeDays }) : t("expiryUnknown")}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="max-w-40">
            <Field
              label={t("fields.copies")}
              id="print-copies"
              problem={shown("COPIES") ? t("problems.COPIES", { max: MAX_COPIES }) : null}
            >
              <Input
                id="print-copies"
                type="number"
                inputMode="numeric"
                dir="ltr"
                min={1}
                max={MAX_COPIES}
                step={1}
                value={copies}
                disabled={!settings.canChangeCopies}
                onChange={(e) => setCopies(e.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={shown("COPIES")}
              />
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium">{t("preview")}</p>
          {layout && previewValues ? (
            <LabelPreview layout={layout} values={previewValues} />
          ) : (
            <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-3 py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {t("previewChoose")}
            </p>
          )}
          {layout && !complete ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("previewIncomplete")}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <DialogFooter>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          size="lg"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={pending || job !== null}
        >
          {t("cancel")}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          size="lg"
          onClick={print}
          disabled={pending || job !== null || settings.layouts.length === 0 || !previewValues}
        >
          <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
          {pending ? t("preparing") : t("submit")}
        </Button>
      </DialogFooter>

      {job ? <LabelPrintSheet job={job} /> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The item label types to choose from, one tapped for this print. Nothing is chosen for you when
 * there are several, so the person decides at every print; with a single type it is chosen already.
 */
export function LayoutChooser({
  layouts,
  value,
  onChange,
  missing,
  name = "print-layout",
}: {
  layouts: PrintableLayout[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
  /** Show that a choice is still needed. */
  missing: boolean;
  name?: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("catalog.print");
  const unit = useTranslations("labels.list");
  return (
    <fieldset className="space-y-2">
      <legend className="text-sm font-medium">{t("fields.layout")}</legend>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("layoutHint")}</p>
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-label={t("fields.layout")} className="grid gap-2">
        {layouts.map((option) => {
          const chosen = option.id === value;
          return (
            <label
              key={option.id}
              data-testid="layout-option"
              data-chosen={chosen}
              className={cn(
                "flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 transition-colors has-focus-visible:ring-3 has-focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
                chosen
                  ? "border-primary/50 bg-primary/5"
                  : "border-border bg-card hover:border-gold/60",
              )}
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name={name}
                value={option.id}
                checked={chosen}
                onChange={() => onChange(option.id)}
                className="sr-only"
              />
              <span dir="auto" className="min-w-0 truncate font-medium">
                {option.name}
              </span>
              <span className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                <span>
                  <span dir="ltr">
                    {t("size", { width: option.widthMm, height: option.heightMm })}
                  </span>{" "}
                  {unit("unit")}
                </span>
                <span
                  aria-hidden
                  className={cn(
                    "grid size-5 place-items-center rounded-full border",
                    chosen ? "border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground" : "border-input",
                  )}
                >
                  {chosen ? <Check className="size-3" /> : null}
                </span>
              </span>
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {missing ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
          {t("problems.LAYOUT")}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function Field({
  label,
  id,
  problem,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  id: string;
  problem: string | null;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-sm">
        {label}
      </Label>
      {children}
      {problem ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
          {problem}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** The label as it will print, scaled to the width of the box it is in. */
function LabelPreview({ layout, values }: { layout: PrintableLayout; values: LabelValues }) {
  const box = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [boxWidth, setBoxWidth] = useState(280);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = box.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => setBoxWidth(entry.contentRect.width));
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const scale = Math.min(6, Math.max(1, boxWidth / layout.widthMm));
  return (
    <div ref={box} className="rounded-xl bg-muted/60 p-3">
      <div
        dir="ltr"
        data-testid="print-preview"
        className="relative mx-auto bg-white shadow-card ring-1 ring-border"
        style={{ width: layout.widthMm * scale, height: layout.heightMm * scale }}
      >
        {layout.elements.map((element) => (
          <ElementView key={element.id} element={element} scale={scale} values={values} />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { ChevronDown, TriangleAlert, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { slaughterDateOf } from "@/lib/barcodes";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { AttentionLine as Line } from "@/server/priority/summary";

/**
 * One item that has boxes close to expiry or past it. Closed, it says how many; opened, it lists
 * each box with its barcode, weight, dates and when it came in. Uses the browser's own
 * open/close, so it needs no script.
 */
export async function AttentionLine({ line }: { line: Line }) {
  const t = await getTranslations("dashboard.warehouse");
  const common = await getTranslations("common");

  return (
    <details className="group bg-card" data-testid="attention-line">
      <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5 px-4 py-2.5 outline-none marker:hidden focus-visible:bg-muted/60 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
          <ChevronDown
            aria-hidden
            className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground transition-transform group-open:rotate-180"
          />
          <span dir="auto" className="min-w-0 truncate text-sm font-medium">
            {line.itemName}
          </span>
        </span>
        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {line.expired > 0 ? (
            <Badge variant="destructive">
              <XCircle /> {t("expiredBoxes", { count: line.expired })}
            </Badge>
          ) : null}
          {line.soon > 0 ? (
            <Badge variant="warning">
              <TriangleAlert /> {t("soonBoxes", { count: line.soon })}
            </Badge>
          ) : null}
        </span>
      </summary>

      <ul
        data-testid="attention-boxes"
        className="divide-y divide-border/70 border-t border-border bg-muted/30"
      >
        {line.boxes.map((box, index) => {
          const slaughter = slaughterDateOf(box.barcode);
          return (
            <li key={`${box.barcode}-${index}`} className="space-y-2 px-4 py-3">
              <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs break-all">
                {box.barcode}
              </p>
              <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-sm sm:grid-cols-4">
                <Fact label={t("details.weight")}>
                  {formatWeight(box.weightKg)} {common("kg")}
                </Fact>
                <Fact label={t("details.slaughter")}>
                  {slaughter ? formatDate(slaughter) : "—"}
                </Fact>
                <Fact label={t("details.entered")}>{formatDate(box.enteredDate)}</Fact>
                <Fact
                  label={t("details.expiry")}
                  className={cn(
                    "font-medium",
                    box.status === "expired" ? "text-destructive" : "text-warning",
                  )}
                >
                  {formatDate(box.expiryDate)}
                </Fact>
              </dl>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </details>
  );
}

function Fact({
  label,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
      <dd dir="ltr" className={cn("text-start tabular-nums", className)}>
        {children}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";

  formatLongDate,

  todayIso,
} from "@/lib/i18n/format";

import { requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError } from "@/server/priority";
import { summarize } from "@/server/priority/summary";

import { AttentionTile, type AttentionItem } from "./attention-tile";
import { RefreshButton } from "./refresh-button";

const PERIOD_ICON = { morning: Sun, afternoon: Sun, evening: Sunset, night: Moon } as const;

/**
 * The first screen after login: a warm greeting, four numbers that say how the
 * factory stands, and one card per warehouse. Stock comes from Priority (the
 * stand-in until phase 6) every time the page is opened or refreshed.
 */
export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const access = await requireScreen("dashboard");
  const t = await getTranslations("dashboard");
  const locale = (await getLocale()) as Locale;
  const now = new Date();

  const period = dayPeriod(now);
  const PeriodIcon = PERIOD_ICON[period];
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.dashboard;
  const common = await getTranslations("common");

  const header = (
    <PageHeader
      icon={<Icon />}
      eyebrow={formatLongDate(now, locale)}
      title={t("welcome", { greeting: t(`greeting.${period}`), name: access.user.displayName })}
      description={t("subtitle")}
      help="dashboard"
      actions={
        <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5">
          {access.can("dashboard.refresh") ? <RefreshButton /> : null}
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <PeriodIcon className="size-3.5 text-gold" />
            {t("updatedAt", { time: formatTime(now) })}
          </span>
        </div>
      }
    />
  );

  const client = getPriorityClient();
  let warehouses: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof client.getWarehouses>>;
  let boxes: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof client.getStockBoxes>>;
  let items: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof client.getItems>>;
  try {
    [warehouses, boxes, items] = await Promise.all([
      client.getWarehouses(),
      client.getStockBoxes(),
      client.getItems(),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof PriorityError) || error.code !== "UNAVAILABLE") throw error;
    return (
      <>
        {header}
        <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-14 text-center">
            <span className="grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full border border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft text-warning [&_svg]:size-9">
              <CloudOff />
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("unavailable.title")}</h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("unavailable.body")}</p>
            <RefreshButton />
          </div>
        </Card>
      </>
    );
  }

  // The days before expiry that count as "about to expire" are chosen per item category.
  const alerts = await getAlertSettings(db);
  const categoryOf = new Map(items.map((item) => [item.itemNumber, item.category]));
  const summaries = inRoomOrder(
    summarize(warehouses, boxes, todayIso(now), (box) =>
      alertDaysFor(alerts, categoryOf.get(box.itemNumber) ?? ""),
    ),
    await getRoomOrder(db, access.user.id),
  );
  const kg = summaries.reduce((sum, w) => sum + w.kg, 0);
  const boxCount = boxes.length;
  const itemCount = new Set(boxes.map((b) => b.itemNumber)).size;
  const attention = summaries.reduce((sum, w) => sum + w.soon + w.expired, 0);
  // Every item with boxes expired or about to expire, in every warehouse, the most urgent first.
  const attentionItems: AttentionItem[] = summaries
    .flatMap((w) =>
      w.attention.map((line) => ({
        warehouseCode: w.code,
        warehouseName: w.name,
        itemNumber: line.itemNumber,
        itemName: line.itemName,
        expired: line.expired,
        soon: line.soon,
        boxes: line.boxes,
      })),
    )
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        b.expired - a.expired ||
        a.boxes[0].expiryDate.localeCompare(b.boxes[0].expiryDate) ||
        a.itemName.localeCompare(b.itemName, "he"),
    );

  return (
    <>
      {header}

      <section className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4" aria-label={t("stats.title")}>
        <StatTile
          index={1}
          icon={<Scale />}
          label={t("stats.weight")}
          value={formatWeight(kg)}
          unit={common("kg")}
        />
        <StatTile
          index={2}
          icon={<Archive />}
          label={t("stats.boxes")}
          value={formatInteger(boxCount)}
        />
        <StatTile
          index={3}
          icon={<Layers />}
          label={t("stats.items")}
          value={formatInteger(itemCount)}
        />
        <AttentionTile
          index={4}
          count={attention}
          label={t("stats.attention")}
          value={formatInteger(attention)}
          items={attentionItems}
        />
      </section>

      <section className="space-y-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("warehouses.title")}</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("warehouses.subtitle")}</p>
        </div>
        <RoomGrid
          canArrange={access.can("dashboard.reorder")}
          rooms={summaries.map((summary, i) => ({
            code: summary.code,
            name: summary.name,
            card: <WarehouseCard summary={summary} index={5 + i} />,
          }))}
        />
      </section>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

/** Re-reads the stock from Priority and redraws the dashboard. */
export function RefreshButton() {
  const t = useTranslations("dashboard");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  return (
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      onClick={() => startTransition(() => router.refresh())}
      disabled={pending}
    >
      <RefreshCw data-icon="inline-start" className={pending ? "animate-spin" : undefined} />
      {pending ? t("refreshing") : t("refresh")}
    </Button>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { ArrangeBar, ArrangeSlot, useRoomArranger } from "@/components/room-arranger";

/** The room cards, which can be arranged by hand by whoever is allowed to. */
export function RoomGrid({
  rooms,
  canArrange,
}: {
  rooms: { code: string; name: string; card: React.ReactNode }[];
  canArrange: boolean;
}) {
  const arranger = useRoomArranger(rooms.map((room) => room.code));
  const byCode = new Map(rooms.map((room) => [room.code, room]));
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {canArrange && rooms.length > 1 ? <ArrangeBar arranger={arranger} /> : null}
      <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2" data-testid="dashboard-rooms">
        {arranger.order.map((code) => {
          const room = byCode.get(code);
          if (!room) return null;
          return (
            <ArrangeSlot key={code} arranger={arranger} code={code} name={room.name}>
              {room.card}
            </ArrangeSlot>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````ts
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import { RoomOrderError, setRoomOrder } from "@/server/room-order";

/** Saves the order the storage rooms are shown in for this person, on the dashboard and in the inventory. */
export async function saveRoomOrderAction(codes: string[]): Promise<{ ok: boolean }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("dashboard.reorder");
    const parsed = z.array(z.string().max(60)).max(200).parse(codes);
    await setRoomOrder(db, access.user.id, parsed, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/dashboard");
    revalidatePath("/inventory");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      !(error instanceof PermissionError) &&
      !(error instanceof RoomOrderError) &&
      !(error instanceof z.ZodError)
    )
      console.error("[rooms] saving the order failed", error);
    return { ok: false };
  }
}
````
