````tsx
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, ChevronDown, Warehouse } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { AttentionLine } from "./attention-line";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import type { WarehouseSummary } from "@/server/priority/summary";

/**
 * One warehouse: how much is in it, how much of that is in date, and which
 * items need attention. Names and codes come from Priority and are shown as is.
 */
export async function WarehouseCard({
  summary,
  index,
}: {
  summary: WarehouseSummary;
  index: number;
}) {
  const t = await getTranslations("dashboard.warehouse");
  const common = await getTranslations("common");
  const { boxes, valid, soon, expired } = summary;
  const percent = (n: number) => (boxes === 0 ? 0 : (n / boxes) * 100);
  const lines = summary.attention;

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": index } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{summary.name}</CardTitle>
            <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {t("code", { code: summary.code })}
            </p>
          </div>
          <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold">
            <Warehouse className="size-5" />
          </span>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="space-y-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="font-serif text-5xl leading-none font-semibold tabular-nums">
            {formatWeight(summary.kg)}
            <span className="ms-2 font-sans text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              {common("kg")}
            </span>
          </p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Badge variant="outline">{t("boxes", { count: boxes })}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">{t("items", { count: summary.items })}</Badge>
          </div>
        </div>

        {boxes === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("empty")}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div>
              <div
                className="flex h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted"
                role="img"
                aria-label={`${t("legend.valid")} ${valid}, ${t("legend.soon")} ${soon}, ${t("legend.expired")} ${expired}`}
              >
                <span className="bg-success" style={{ width: `${percent(valid)}%` }} />
                <span className="bg-warning" style={{ width: `${percent(soon)}%` }} />
                <span className="bg-destructive" style={{ width: `${percent(expired)}%` }} />
              </div>
              <ul className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-success" />
                  {t("legend.valid")}{" "}
                  <b className="font-semibold text-foreground tabular-nums">{valid}</b>
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-warning" />
                  {t("legend.soon")}{" "}
                  <b className="font-semibold text-foreground tabular-nums">{soon}</b>
                </li>
                <li className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-destructive" />
                  {t("legend.expired")}{" "}
                  <b className="font-semibold text-foreground tabular-nums">{expired}</b>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </div>

            {lines.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl border border-success/20 bg-success-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-success">
                <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 shrink-0" />
                {t("allValid")}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <details
                data-testid="attention-list"
                className="group/list overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border"
              >
                <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-muted/60 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold outline-none marker:hidden hover:bg-muted focus-visible:bg-muted [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <AlertTriangle className="size-4 shrink-0 text-destructive" />
                    {t("attentionItems", { count: lines.length })}
                  </span>
                  <ChevronDown className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground transition-transform group-open/list:rotate-180" />
                </summary>
                <ul className="divide-y divide-border border-t border-border">
                  {lines.map((line) => (
                    <li key={line.itemNumber}>
                      <AttentionLine line={line} />
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </details>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````ts
"use server";

import { getLocale, getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { z } from "zod";
import { logFor } from "@/server/activity-log";
import {
  AssistantError,
  assistantConfigured,
  askAssistant,
  type AssistantErrorCode,
} from "@/server/assistant";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { isHelpTopic } from "@/lib/help-topics";
import { MessageError, listMessagesOf, sendMessage, type MessageInput } from "@/server/messages";
import { getAccess } from "@/server/permissions";

/** What the "Ask a question" and "Message the admin" parts of the help window use. */

export async function helpStatusAction(): Promise<{ assistant: boolean }> {
  await getAccess();
  return { assistant: assistantConfigured() };
}

const askSchema = z.object({
  question: z.string().max(600),
  topic: z.string(),
  history: z
    .array(z.object({ role: z.enum(["user", "assistant"]), text: z.string().max(4000) }))
    .max(12),
});

export type AskResult =
  { ok: true; answer: string } | { ok: false; error: AssistantErrorCode | "GENERIC" };

export async function askAssistantAction(input: unknown): Promise<AskResult> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  const parsed = askSchema.safeParse(input);
  if (!parsed.success || !isHelpTopic(parsed.data.topic))
    return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
  const { question, topic, history } = parsed.data;
  const locale = (await getLocale()) === "en" ? "en" : "he";
  const nav = await getTranslations("nav");
  const help = await getTranslations("help.pages");
  try {
    const answer = await askAssistant({
      userId: access.user.id,
      question,
      history,
      locale,
      page: help(`${topic}.title`),
      screens: access.visibleScreens().map((screen) => nav(screen)),
    });
    await logFor(
      access.actor,
      "assistant.asked",
      { details: { topic, question: question.trim().slice(0, 200) } },
      db,
    );
    return { ok: true, answer };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AssistantError) return { ok: false, error: error.code };
    console.error("[assistant] failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

export type SendMessageResult =
  { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: "INVALID_INPUT" | "RATE_LIMITED" | "GENERIC" };

export async function sendMessageAction(input: unknown): Promise<SendMessageResult> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  const locale = (await getLocale()) === "en" ? "en" : "he";
  try {
    await sendMessage(db, access.actor, access.deviceType, {
      ...(input as object),
      locale,
    } as MessageInput);
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof MessageError && error.code !== "NOT_FOUND") {
      return { ok: false, error: error.code };
    }
    console.error("[messages] sending failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

export interface MyMessage {
  id: string;
  kind: string;
  screen: string;
  subject: string;
  details: string;
  createdAt: string;
  status: "new" | "done";
  reply: string | null;
  handledByDisplay: string | null;
}

export async function myMessagesAction(): Promise<MyMessage[]> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  const rows = await listMessagesOf(db, access.user.id, 10);
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    kind: row.kind,
    screen: row.screen,
    subject: row.subject,
    details: row.details,
    createdAt: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    status: row.status,
    reply: row.reply,
    handledByDisplay: row.handledByDisplay,
  }));
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { PackagePlus } from "lucide-react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

/** The address flag that opens the pallet builder below the filters. */
export const BUILD_PARAM = "build";

/** Sets or clears the builder flag in the address, without asking the server for the page again. */
export function setBuilding(on: boolean) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  if (on) params.set(BUILD_PARAM, "1");
  else params.delete(BUILD_PARAM);
  const query = params.toString();
  const url = `${window.location.pathname}${query ? `?${query}` : ""}`;
  if (on) window.history.pushState(null, "", url);
  else window.history.replaceState(null, "", url);
}

/** "Build a pallet", at the top of the inventory: opens the pallet builder. */
export function BuildPalletButton() {
  const t = useTranslations("pallets.create");
  const building = useSearchParams().get(BUILD_PARAM) === "1";
  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant={building ? "default" : "outline"}
      aria-pressed={building}
      onClick={() => setBuilding(true)}
    >
      <PackagePlus data-icon="inline-start" />
      {t("start")}
    </Button>
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/app/(app)/inventory/export-excel.ts`

````ts
import type { InventoryRow } from "@/lib/inventory";

/** The words the sheet's header row and status column use, in the language of the screen. */
export interface ExcelWords {
  sheet: string;
  columns: {
    itemNumber: string;
    item: string;
    category: string;
    warehouse: string;
    barcode: string;
    weight: string;
    slaughter: string;
    expiry: string;
    entered: string;
    status: string;
  };
  status: { valid: string; soon: string; expired: string };
}

/** "2026-10-22" as the Date it names (a calendar day, with no time of day). */
function day(iso: string): Date {
  const [year, month, date] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(year, month - 1, date);
}

/**
 * Writes the rows as an Excel file and offers it for saving. Weights are real numbers and
 * dates are real dates, so the sheet can be sorted and added up in Excel. The library is
 * loaded only when the button is pressed.
 */
export async function downloadInventoryExcel(
  rows: readonly InventoryRow[],
  words: ExcelWords,
  rightToLeft: boolean,
  fileName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const { default: writeExcelFile } = await import("write-excel-file/browser");
  const header = Object.values(words.columns).map((value) => ({
    value,
    fontWeight: "bold" as const,
    backgroundColor: "#f4ede0",
  }));
  const date = (iso: string | null) =>
    iso === null ? { value: "" } : { value: day(iso), type: Date, format: "dd/mm/yyyy" };

  const data = [
    header,
    ...rows.map((row) => [
      { value: row.itemNumber },
      { value: row.itemName },
      { value: row.category },
      { value: row.warehouseName },
      { value: row.barcode },
      { value: row.weightKg, type: Number, format: "0.00" },
      date(row.slaughterDate),
      date(row.expiryDate),
      date(row.enteredDate),
      {
        value: words.status[row.status],
        textColor:
          row.status === "expired" ? "#b3261e" : row.status === "soon" ? "#a8620a" : undefined,
      },
    ]),
  ];

  await writeExcelFile(data, {
    sheet: words.sheet,
    rightToLeft,
    stickyRowsCount: 1,
    columns: [
      { width: 14 },
      { width: 32 },
      { width: 18 },
      { width: 20 },
      { width: 28 },
      { width: 10 },
      { width: 14 },
      { width: 14 },
      { width: 14 },
      { width: 14 },
    ],
  }).toFile(fileName);
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import {
  AlertTriangle,
  Boxes,
  ChevronDown,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileText,
  FilterX,
  Package,
  Search,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  Warehouse,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { LabelPrintSheet, printLabelSheet } from "@/components/labels/label-print";
import { ArrangeBar, ArrangeSlot, useRoomArranger } from "@/components/room-arranger";
import { ReportPrintSheet, printReport } from "@/components/report-print";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { formatDate, formatInteger, formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import {
  NO_FILTERS,
  filterRows,
  groupByItem,
  hasFilters,
  totals,
  type InventoryFilters,
  type InventoryRow,
  type ItemGroup,
  type StatusFilter,
} from "@/lib/inventory";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PrintJobData } from "../catalog/actions";
import { BUILD_PARAM, setBuilding } from "./build-pallet-button";
import { PalletBuilder } from "./pallet-builder";
import { createPalletAction } from "./pallets/actions";
import { downloadInventoryExcel } from "./export-excel";

const PAGE = 100;
const SELECT_CLASS =
  "h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50";
const STATUSES: StatusFilter[] = ["all", "attention", "expired", "soon", "valid"];
/** From this width the items and the chosen item's boxes stand side by side. */
const WIDE = "(min-width: 1024px)";

/** True on screens wide enough for two columns. Starts wide, like the server render. */
function useWide(): boolean {
  const [wide, setWide] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia(WIDE);
    const update = () => setWide(query.matches);
    update();
    query.addEventListener("change", update);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", update);
  }, []);
  return wide;
}

/**
 * The stock in three steps: the storage rooms on top, the items of the chosen room, and the
 * boxes of the chosen item. The search and the other filters narrow all three. Read only.
 * Every box is on the page already, so choosing and filtering are instant.
 */
export function InventoryBrowser({
  rows,
  warehouses,
  canArrange,
  today,
  can,
}: {
  rows: InventoryRow[];
  warehouses: { code: string; name: string }[];
  /** Whether this person may arrange the order of the storage rooms. */
  canArrange: boolean;
  today: string;
  can: { filters: boolean; export: boolean; pallets: boolean; palletsScan: boolean };
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const locale = useLocale();
  const wide = useWide();
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<InventoryFilters>(NO_FILTERS);
  const [chosenItem, setChosenItem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(PAGE);
  const [printing, setPrinting] = useState(false);
  // Boxes ticked to make a pallet of, and the pallet label that is being printed.
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  // The ticks and the scan box are there only while a pallet is being built (opened by the
  // "Build a pallet" button at the top of the screen).
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const building = (can.pallets || can.palletsScan) && params.get(BUILD_PARAM) === "1";
  const [palletJob, setPalletJob] = useState<PrintJobData | null>(null);
  const [making, startMaking] = useTransition();
  const palletErrors = useTranslations("pallets.errors");
  const pallets = useTranslations("pallets.create");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!palletJob) return;
    printLabelSheet(palletJob.widthMm, palletJob.heightMm, () => setPalletJob(null));
  }, [palletJob]);

  function toggle(barcode: string) {
    setSelected((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      if (next.has(barcode)) next.delete(barcode);
      else next.add(barcode);
      return next;
    });
  }

  function addScanned(barcode: string) {
    setSelected((current) => new Set(current).add(barcode));
  }

  function makePallet() {
    const barcodes = [...selected];
    startMaking(async () => {
      // Boxes that were only scanned need only the scan permission; ticking needs the other one.
      const result = await createPalletAction(barcodes, can.pallets ? "select" : "scan");
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(palletErrors(result.error));
      setSelected(new Set());
      setBuilding(false);
      setPalletJob(result.job);
      toast.success(pallets("made", { number: result.number, count: result.boxes }));
    });
  }

  const filtered = useMemo(() => filterRows(rows, filters), [rows, filters]);
  const sums = useMemo(() => totals(filtered), [filtered]);
  const groups = useMemo(() => groupByItem(filtered), [filtered]);

  // Each room with its whole stock, whatever the other filters say, in the order set by hand.
  const arranger = useRoomArranger(warehouses.map((w) => w.code));
  const rooms = useMemo(() => {
    const byCode = new Map(warehouses.map((w) => [w.code, w]));
    return arranger.order.flatMap((code) => {
      const w = byCode.get(code);
      return w ? [{ ...w, sums: totals(rows.filter((row) => row.warehouseCode === w.code)) }] : [];
    });
  }, [rows, warehouses, arranger.order]);

  // On wide screens one item is always open; on phones only the one tapped.
  const openItem =
    groups.find((group) => group.itemNumber === chosenItem)?.itemNumber ??
    (wide ? (groups[0]?.itemNumber ?? null) : null);
  const openGroup = groups.find((group) => group.itemNumber === openItem) ?? null;

  function change<K extends keyof InventoryFilters>(key: K, value: InventoryFilters[K]) {
    setFilters((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setShown(PAGE);
  }

  function choose(itemNumber: string) {
    setChosenItem(!wide && openItem === itemNumber ? null : itemNumber);
    setShown(PAGE);
  }

  const statusWord = (status: InventoryRow["status"]) => t(`status.${status}`);

  async function excel() {
    try {
      await downloadInventoryExcel(
        filtered,
        {
          sheet: t("title"),
          columns: {
            itemNumber: t("columns.itemNumber"),
            item: t("columns.item"),
            category: t("columns.category"),
            warehouse: t("columns.warehouse"),
            barcode: t("columns.barcode"),
            weight: t("columns.weight"),
            slaughter: t("columns.slaughter"),
            expiry: t("columns.expiry"),
            entered: t("columns.entered"),
            status: t("columns.status"),
          },
          status: {
            valid: statusWord("valid"),
            soon: statusWord("soon"),
            expired: statusWord("expired"),
          },
        },
        locale === "he",
        `inventory-${today}.xlsx`,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("[inventory] the Excel file could not be made", error);
      toast.error(t("exportFailed"));
    }
  }

  function pdf() {
    setPrinting(true);
    // Let the report reach the page, then open the print window (choose "Save as PDF" in it).
    requestAnimationFrame(() => printReport(() => setPrinting(false)));
  }

  const moreFilters =
    filters.barcode ||
    filters.expiryFrom ||
    filters.expiryTo ||
    filters.enteredFrom ||
    filters.enteredTo;

  const details = openGroup ? (
    <ItemDetails
      group={openGroup}
      showRoom={!filters.warehouse}
      shown={shown}
      onMore={() => setShown((n) => n + PAGE)}
      pick={
        can.pallets && building
          ? { selected, toggle, label: (b) => pallets("pick", { barcode: b }) }
          : null
      }
    />
  ) : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {canArrange && warehouses.length > 1 ? <ArrangeBar arranger={arranger} /> : null}
      {/* The storage rooms: choosing one shows only its items. */}
      <div
        // On a wide screen all the rooms stand in one line, side by side.
        className="rise grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:auto-cols-fr lg:grid-flow-col lg:grid-cols-none"
        style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}
        data-testid="room-cards"
      >
        <RoomCard
          name={t("rooms.all")}
          sums={totals(rows)}
          active={filters.warehouse === ""}
          onClick={() => change("warehouse", "")}
          icon={<Boxes className="size-5" />}
        />
        {rooms.map((room) => (
          <ArrangeSlot key={room.code} arranger={arranger} code={room.code} name={room.name}>
            <RoomCard
              name={room.name}
              code={room.code}
              sums={room.sums}
              active={filters.warehouse === room.code}
              onClick={() => (arranger.editing ? undefined : change("warehouse", room.code))}
              icon={<Warehouse className="size-5" />}
            />
          </ArrangeSlot>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Search and filters, the totals of what they show, and the exports. */}
      <Card className="rise gap-0 p-0" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 p-4">
          {can.filters ? (
            <>
              <div className="relative min-w-56 flex-1">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-item" className="sr-only">
                  {t("filters.item")}
                </Label>
                <Search
                  aria-hidden
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
                />
                <Input
                  id="inv-item"
                  type="search"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  className="ps-10"
                  placeholder={t("filters.itemPlaceholder")}
                  value={filters.item}
                  onChange={(event) => change("item", event.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="w-full sm:w-52">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-status" className="sr-only">
                  {t("filters.status")}
                </Label>
                <select
                  id="inv-status"
                  className={SELECT_CLASS}
                  value={filters.status}
                  onChange={(event) => change("status", event.target.value as StatusFilter)}
                >
                  {STATUSES.map((status) => (
                    <option key={status} value={status}>
                      {t(`filters.statuses.${status}`)}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : null}
          {can.export ? (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={excel}
                disabled={filtered.length === 0}
              >
                <FileSpreadsheet data-icon="inline-start" />
                {t("export.excel")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={pdf}
                disabled={filtered.length === 0 || printing}
              >
                <FileText data-icon="inline-start" />
                {t("export.pdf")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {can.filters ? (
          <details
            className="group/more border-t border-border"
            open={moreFilters ? true : undefined}
          >
            <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground outline-none marker:hidden hover:text-foreground focus-visible:bg-muted [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
              <SlidersHorizontal className="size-4" />
              {t("filters.more")}
              <ChevronDown className="size-4 transition-transform group-open/more:rotate-180" />
            </summary>
            <div className="grid gap-4 px-4 pb-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="inv-barcode" className="text-sm">
                  {t("filters.barcode")}
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="inv-barcode"
                  dir="ltr"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  autoComplete="off"
                  value={filters.barcode}
                  onChange={(event) => change("barcode", event.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <DateRange
                label={t("filters.expiry")}
                from={filters.expiryFrom}
                to={filters.expiryTo}
                onFrom={(value) => change("expiryFrom", value)}
                onTo={(value) => change("expiryTo", value)}
                id="inv-expiry"
              />
              <DateRange
                label={t("filters.entered")}
                from={filters.enteredFrom}
                to={filters.enteredTo}
                onFrom={(value) => change("enteredFrom", value)}
                onTo={(value) => change("enteredTo", value)}
                id="inv-entered"
              />
            </div>
          </details>
        ) : null}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-t border-border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-2.5">
          <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm" data-testid="inventory-summary">
            <Badge variant="outline">{t("summary.boxes", { count: sums.boxes })}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">
              {formatWeight(sums.kg)} {common("kg")}
            </Badge>
            {sums.expired > 0 ? (
              <Badge variant="destructive">{t("summary.expired", { count: sums.expired })}</Badge>
            ) : null}
            {sums.soon > 0 ? (
              <Badge variant="warning">{t("summary.soon", { count: sums.soon })}</Badge>
            ) : null}
          </p>
          {hasFilters(filters) ? (
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              className="ms-auto"
              onClick={() => {
                setFilters(NO_FILTERS);
                setShown(PAGE);
              }}
            >
              <FilterX data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("filters.clear")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {building ? (
        <PalletBuilder
          rows={rows}
          shown={filtered}
          selected={selected}
          onSelect={setSelected}
          onAdd={addScanned}
          onRemove={toggle}
          onMake={makePallet}
          onCancel={() => {
            setSelected(new Set());
            setBuilding(false);
          }}
          making={making}
          busy={making || palletJob !== null}
          canTick={can.pallets}
          canScan={can.palletsScan}
        />
      ) : null}

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="rise p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground" data-testid="inventory-empty">
          {rows.length === 0 ? t("noStock") : t("noMatch")}
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div
          className="rise grid items-start gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,3fr)]"
          style={{ "--i": 3 } as React.CSSProperties}
        >
          <section className="space-y-2">
            <h2 className="px-1 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
              {t("items.title", { count: groups.length })}
            </h2>
            <ul
              className="space-y-2 lg:max-h-[75vh] lg:overflow-y-auto lg:p-1"
              data-testid="inventory-items"
            >
              {groups.map((group) => (
                <li key={group.itemNumber} className="space-y-2">
                  <ItemButton
                    group={group}
                    open={group.itemNumber === openItem}
                    onClick={() => choose(group.itemNumber)}
                  />
                  {!wide && group.itemNumber === openItem ? details : null}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </section>
          {wide ? <div className="lg:sticky lg:top-4">{details}</div> : null}
        </div>
      )}

      {palletJob ? <LabelPrintSheet job={palletJob} /> : null}

      {printing ? (
        <ReportPrintSheet dir={locale === "he" ? "rtl" : "ltr"}>
          <ReportBody rows={filtered} sums={sums} today={today} filters={filters} />
        </ReportPrintSheet>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function RoomCard({
  name,
  code,
  sums,
  active,
  onClick,
  icon,
}: {
  name: string;
  code?: string;
  sums: ReturnType<typeof totals>;
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      onClick={onClick}
      data-testid="room-card"
      className={cn(
        "flex size-full items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-start transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
        active
          ? "border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-md"
          : "border-border bg-card hover:border-gold/60 hover:bg-gold-soft/40",
      )}
    >
      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
        <p dir="auto" className="text-start text-lg leading-tight font-semibold">
          {name}
        </p>
        {code ? (
          <p
            dir="ltr"
            className={cn(
              "text-start font-mono text-xs",
              active ? "text-primary-foreground/70" : "text-muted-foreground",
            )}
          >
            {code}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        <p
          className={cn(
            "flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 pt-1 text-sm tabular-nums",
            active ? "text-primary-foreground/85" : "text-muted-foreground",
          )}
        >
          <span>{t("summary.boxes", { count: sums.boxes })}</span>
          <span>
            {formatWeight(sums.kg)} {common("kg")}
          </span>
          {sums.expired > 0 ? (
            <span className={cn("font-semibold", !active && "text-destructive")}>
              {t("summary.expired", { count: sums.expired })}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </p>
      </div>
      <span
        className={cn(
          "grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full",
          active
            ? "bg-primary-foreground/15 text-primary-foreground"
            : "border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold",

        {icon}

}

function ItemButton({
  group,
  open,
  onClick,
}: {
  group: ItemGroup;
  open: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-expanded={open}
      onClick={onClick}
      data-testid="inventory-item"
      data-item={group.itemNumber}
      className={cn(
        "flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-card px-4 py-3 text-start transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
        // The chosen item: its outline drawn inside the card, so the edge of the list never cuts it.
        open
          ? "border-primary bg-gold-soft/40 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-primary ring-inset"
          : cn(
              "hover:border-gold/60",
              group.sums.expired > 0 ? "border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5" : "border-border",
            ),
      )}
    >
      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span dir="auto" className="font-semibold">
            {group.itemName}
          </span>
          {group.category ? (
            <Badge variant="outline" className="font-normal">
              {group.category}
            </Badge>
          ) : null}
        </p>
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span dir="ltr">{group.itemNumber}</span>
          {group.sums.expired > 0 ? (
            <Badge variant="destructive">
              <AlertTriangle />
              {t("summary.expired", { count: group.sums.expired })}
            </Badge>
          ) : null}
          {group.sums.soon > 0 ? (
            <Badge variant="warning">{t("summary.soon", { count: group.sums.soon })}</Badge>
          ) : null}
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="shrink-0 text-end">
        <p className="font-semibold tabular-nums">
          {formatWeight(group.sums.kg)}{" "}
          <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">{common("kg")}</span>
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {t("summary.boxes", { count: group.sums.boxes })}
        </p>
      </div>

}

/** The chosen item: its totals and every one of its boxes. */
function ItemDetails({
  group,
  showRoom,
  shown,
  onMore,
  pick,
}: {
  group: ItemGroup;
  showRoom: boolean;
  shown: number;
  onMore: () => void;
  pick: {
    selected: Set<string>;
    toggle: (barcode: string) => void;
    label: (barcode: string) => string;
  } | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const visible = group.rows.slice(0, shown);
  const roomNames = [...new Set(group.rows.map((row) => row.warehouseName))];
  return (
    <Card className="gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0" data-testid="item-details">
      <div className="space-y-4 border-b border-border p-4">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold">
            <Package className="size-5" />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 dir="auto" className="font-serif text-xl font-semibold">
              {group.itemName}
            </h3>
            <p dir="ltr" className="text-start text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {group.itemNumber}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Stat label={t("items.weight")}>
            {formatWeight(group.sums.kg)} {common("kg")}
          </Stat>
          <Stat label={t("items.boxes")}>{t("summary.boxes", { count: group.sums.boxes })}</Stat>
          <Stat label={t("items.rooms")} className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
            <span dir="auto">{roomNames.join(", ")}</span>
          </Stat>
        </dl>
      </div>

      <p className="px-4 pt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
        {t("items.boxList", { count: group.rows.length })}
      </p>
      <ul className="space-y-2 p-3" data-testid="inventory-boxes">
        {visible.map((row, index) => (
          <li
            key={`${row.barcode}-${index}`}
            data-testid="inventory-box"
            data-status={row.status}
            data-barcode={row.barcode}
            data-warehouse={row.warehouseName}
            className={cn(
              "flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2.5",
              row.status === "expired" && "border-destructive/25 bg-destructive/5",
              row.status === "soon" && "border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft/70",
            )}
          >
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
              <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-sm break-all">
                {row.barcode}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                {t("columns.weight")}:{" "}
                <b dir="ltr" className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {formatWeight(row.weightKg)}
                </b>
                {showRoom ? (
                  <>
                    {" · "}
                    <span dir="auto">{row.warehouseName}</span>
                  </>
                ) : null}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-0.5 text-end text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                <p>
                  {t("columns.expiry")}:{" "}
                  <b
                    dir="ltr"
                    className={cn(
                      "font-semibold text-foreground",
                      row.status === "expired" && "text-destructive",
                      row.status === "soon" && "text-warning",
                    )}
                  >
                    {formatDate(row.expiryDate)}
                  </b>
                </p>
                <p>
                  {t("columns.entered")}: <span dir="ltr">{formatDate(row.enteredDate)}</span>
                  {row.slaughterDate ? (
                    <>
                      {" · "}
                      {t("columns.slaughter")}:{" "}
                      <span dir="ltr">{formatDate(row.slaughterDate)}</span>
                    </>
                  ) : null}
                </p>
              </div>
              <StatusNote row={row} />
              {pick ? (
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  className="size-5 accent-primary"
                  aria-label={pick.label(row.barcode)}
                  checked={pick.selected.has(row.barcode)}
                  onChange={() => pick.toggle(row.barcode)}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {group.rows.length > visible.length ? (
        <div className="border-t border-border bg-muted/40 p-3 text-center">
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onMore}>
            {t("showMore", { shown: visible.length, total: group.rows.length })}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </Card>
  );
}

function Stat({
  label,
  children,
  className,
}: {
  label: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2", className)}>
      <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-semibold tabular-nums">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatusNote({ row }: { row: InventoryRow }) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory");
  if (row.status === "valid") return null;
  return (
    <Badge variant={row.status === "expired" ? "destructive" : "warning"}>
      {row.status === "expired"
        ? t("expiredAgo", { count: -row.daysLeft })
        : row.daysLeft === 0
          ? t("expiresToday")
          : t("expiresIn", { count: row.daysLeft })}
    </Badge>
  );
}

function DateRange({
  label,
  from,
  to,
  onFrom,
  onTo,
  id,
}: {
  label: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  onFrom: (value: string) => void;
  onTo: (value: string) => void;
  id: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory.filters");
  return (
    <fieldset className="space-y-1.5">
      <legend className="mb-1.5 text-sm leading-none font-medium">{label}</legend>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Input
          id={`${id}-from`}
          type="date"
          dir="ltr"
          aria-label={`${label}: ${t("from")}`}
          value={from}
          onChange={(event) => onFrom(event.target.value)}
        />
        <Input
          id={`${id}-to`}
          type="date"
          dir="ltr"
          aria-label={`${label}: ${t("to")}`}
          value={to}
          onChange={(event) => onTo(event.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
    </fieldset>
  );
}

/** What the PDF holds: a heading, what was filtered, the totals and every box in plain black on white. */
function ReportBody({
  rows,
  sums,
  today,
  filters,
}: {
  rows: InventoryRow[];
  sums: ReturnType<typeof totals>;
  today: string;
  filters: InventoryFilters;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("inventory");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const cell = "border border-neutral-400 px-2 py-1 text-start align-top";
  return (
    <div style={{ fontSize: "10pt", fontFamily: "inherit" }}>
      <h1 style={{ fontSize: "16pt", fontWeight: 700 }}>{t("report.title")}</h1>
      <p>
        {t("report.date", { date: formatDate(today) })} ·{" "}
        {t("summary.boxes", { count: sums.boxes })} · {formatWeight(sums.kg)} {common("kg")} ·{" "}
        {t("summary.expired", { count: sums.expired })} · {t("summary.soon", { count: sums.soon })}
      </p>
      {hasFilters(filters) ? <p>{t("report.filtered")}</p> : null}
      <table style={{ width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", marginTop: "6mm" }}>
        <thead>
          <tr style={{ background: "#eee" }}>
            {(
              ["item", "warehouse", "barcode", "weight", "slaughter", "expiry", "entered"] as const
            ).map((column) => (
              <th key={column} className={cell}>
                {t(`columns.${column}`)}
              </th>
            ))}
            <th className={cell}>{t("columns.status")}</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((row, index) => (
            <tr
              key={`${row.barcode}-${index}`}
              style={{
                background:
                  row.status === "expired"
                    ? "#fbe3e1"
                    : row.status === "soon"
                      ? "#fcf1dc"
                      : undefined,
              }}
            >
              <td className={cell}>
                {row.itemName} <span dir="ltr">({row.itemNumber})</span>
              </td>
              <td className={cell}>{row.warehouseName}</td>
              <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                {row.barcode}
              </td>
              <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                {formatWeight(row.weightKg)}
              </td>
              <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                {row.slaughterDate ? formatDate(row.slaughterDate) : "—"}
              </td>
              <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                {formatDate(row.expiryDate)}
              </td>
              <td className={cell} dir="ltr">
                {formatDate(row.enteredDate)}
              </td>
              <td className={cell}>{t(`status.${row.status}`)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p style={{ marginTop: "4mm" }}>{t("report.count", { count: formatInteger(rows.length) })}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx`

````tsx
import { CloudOff, Package } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import Link from "next/link";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { todayIso } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { buildRows, sortRows } from "@/lib/inventory";
import { alertDaysFor, getAlertSettings } from "@/server/alerts";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError } from "@/server/priority";
import { getRoomOrder, inRoomOrder } from "@/server/room-order";
import { RefreshButton } from "../dashboard/refresh-button";
import { BuildPalletButton } from "./build-pallet-button";
import { InventoryBrowser } from "./inventory-browser";

/**
 * The stock down to the single box, read from Priority (the stand-in until phase 6) every time
 * the page is opened or refreshed. Read only: nothing here changes stock.
 */
export default async function InventoryPage() {
  const access = await requireScreen("inventory");
  const t = await getTranslations();
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.inventory;
  const now = new Date();
  const today = todayIso(now);

  // Either way of building pallets gives the button that starts one, and the pallets screen.
  const canBuild = access.can("inventory.pallets") || access.can("inventory.palletsScan");

  const header = (
    <PageHeader
      icon={<Icon />}
      eyebrow={t("shell.groups.operations")}
      title={t("nav.inventory")}
      description={t("screens.inventory")}
      help="inventory"
      actions={
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {canBuild ? <BuildPalletButton /> : null}
          {canBuild ? (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              nativeButton={false}
              render={<Link href="/inventory/pallets" />}
            >
              <Package data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("pallets.open")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
          <RefreshButton />
        </div>
      }
    />
  );

  const client = getPriorityClient();
  let loaded;
  try {
    loaded = await Promise.all([client.getStockBoxes(), client.getItems(), client.getWarehouses()]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof PriorityError) || error.code !== "UNAVAILABLE") throw error;
    return (
      <>
        {header}
        <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-14 text-center">
            <span className="grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full border border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft text-warning [&_svg]:size-9">
              <CloudOff />
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">
              {t("inventory.unavailable.title")}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("inventory.unavailable.body")}</p>
            <RefreshButton />
          </div>
        </Card>
      </>
    );
  }
  const [boxes, items, warehouses] = loaded;

  const alerts = await getAlertSettings(db);
  const rows = sortRows(
    buildRows(boxes, items, warehouses, today, (category) => alertDaysFor(alerts, category)),
  );

  return (
    <>
      {header}
      <InventoryBrowser
        rows={rows}
        warehouses={inRoomOrder(warehouses, await getRoomOrder(db, access.user.id))}
        canArrange={access.can("dashboard.reorder")}
        today={today}
        can={{
          filters: access.can("inventory.filters"),
          export: access.can("inventory.export"),
          pallets: access.can("inventory.pallets"),
          palletsScan: access.can("inventory.palletsScan"),
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { ListChecks, Package, ScanLine, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import type { InventoryRow } from "@/lib/inventory";
import { MAX_PALLET_BOXES } from "@/lib/pallets";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Notice = { kind: "added" | "again" | "unknown" | "full"; text: string };

/**
 * Building a pallet: the boxes for it are picked by ticking them in the list, or by scanning them
 * with the scanner (each way has its own permission), and both land in the same list shown here,
 * where a box can be taken off again. The button at the top makes the pallet. It is open only
 * after "Build a pallet" was pressed, so boxes are never ticked by chance.
 */
export function PalletBuilder({
  rows,
  shown,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  onAdd,
  onRemove,
  onMake,
  onCancel,
  making,
  busy,
  canTick,
  canScan,
}: {
  /** Every box in stock: a scan finds its box among them, whatever the filters show. */
  rows: InventoryRow[];
  /** The boxes the filters show now, for "tick the shown". */
  shown: InventoryRow[];
  selected: Set<string>;
  onSelect: (barcodes: Set<string>) => void;
  onAdd: (barcode: string) => void;
  onRemove: (barcode: string) => void;
  onMake: () => void;
  /** Stops building: the boxes picked are let go and the ticks leave the list. */
  onCancel: () => void;
  making: boolean;
  /** A pallet is being made or its label printed: nothing can be changed meanwhile. */
  busy: boolean;
  canTick: boolean;
  canScan: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("pallets.create");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice | null>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const panel = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  // The button that opens the builder is at the top of the screen: bring the builder into view,
  // ready for the first scan.
  useEffect(() => {
    panel.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    input.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, []);

  const byBarcode = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.barcode, row]));
  const picked = [...selected].flatMap((barcode) => {
    const row = byBarcode.get(barcode);
    return row ? [row] : [];
  });
  const kg = picked.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.weightKg, 0);
  const tickable = Math.min(shown.length, MAX_PALLET_BOXES);

  function scan() {
    const code = text.trim();
    setText("");
    input.current?.focus();
    if (!code) return;
    const row =
      byBarcode.get(code) ?? rows.find((r) => r.barcode.toLowerCase() === code.toLowerCase());
    if (!row) return setNotice({ kind: "unknown", text: t("scan.unknown", { barcode: code }) });
    if (selected.has(row.barcode))
      return setNotice({ kind: "again", text: t("scan.again", { name: row.itemName }) });
    if (selected.size >= MAX_PALLET_BOXES)
      return setNotice({ kind: "full", text: t("scan.full", { max: MAX_PALLET_BOXES }) });
    onAdd(row.barcode);
    setNotice({
      kind: "added",
      text: t("scan.added", { name: row.itemName, weight: formatWeight(row.weightKg) }),
    });
  }

  return (
    <section
      ref={panel}
      className="rise scroll-mt-20 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card shadow-card"
      data-testid="pallet-toolbar"
    >
      {/* The pallet as it stands: how many boxes, their weight, and the button that makes it. */}
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold">
            <Package className="size-5" aria-hidden />
          </span>
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <h2 className="font-serif text-lg leading-tight font-semibold">{t("title")}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums" data-testid="pallet-selected">
              {t("selected", { count: selected.size })}
              {selected.size > 0 ? ` · ${formatWeight(kg)} ${common("kg")}` : null}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={onCancel}>
            <X data-icon="inline-start" />
            {t("cancel")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            disabled={selected.size === 0 || selected.size > MAX_PALLET_BOXES || busy}
            onClick={onMake}
          >
            <Package data-icon="inline-start" />
            {making ? t("making") : t("create", { count: selected.size })}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* The two ways of picking boxes, side by side. */}
      <div
        className={cn(
          "grid divide-y divide-border md:divide-y-0",
          canTick && canScan && "md:grid-cols-2 md:divide-x md:rtl:divide-x-reverse",
        )}
      >
        {canTick ? (
          <div className="space-y-3 px-5 py-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <ListChecks className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-primary" aria-hidden />
              <div className="space-y-0.5">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t("tick.title")}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("tick.hint")}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={shown.length === 0 || busy}
                onClick={() =>
                  onSelect(new Set(shown.slice(0, MAX_PALLET_BOXES).map((row) => row.barcode)))
                }
              >
                {t("selectShown", { count: tickable })}
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                disabled={selected.size === 0 || busy}
                onClick={() => onSelect(new Set())}
              >
                {t("clear")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {canScan ? (
          <div className="space-y-3 px-5 py-4" data-testid="pallet-scan">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <ScanLine className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-primary" aria-hidden />
              <div className="space-y-0.5">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t("scan.title")}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("scan.hint")}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* A barcode reads left to right, so the box and its icon do too. */}
            <div className="relative" dir="ltr">
              <ScanLine
                aria-hidden
                className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-primary"
              />
              <Input
                ref={input}
                autoComplete="off"
                aria-label={t("scan.label")}
                data-testid="pallet-scan-input"
                disabled={busy}
                value={text}
                placeholder={t("scan.placeholder")}
                className="h-10 border-primary/40 ps-9 focus-visible:border-primary"
                onChange={(event) => setText(event.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(event) => {
                  if (event.key !== "Enter") return;
                  event.preventDefault();
                  scan();
                }}
              />
            </div>
            {notice ? (
              <p
                role="status"
                data-testid="pallet-scan-notice"
                data-kind={notice.kind}
                className={cn(
                  "text-sm",
                  notice.kind === "added" && "text-success",
                  notice.kind === "again" && "text-muted-foreground",
                  (notice.kind === "unknown" || notice.kind === "full") && "text-destructive",
                )}
              >
                {notice.text}
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {/* The boxes picked so far, however they were picked. */}
      {picked.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-border bg-muted/30 px-5 py-4">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{t("picked")}</h3>
          <ul
            className="flex max-h-40 flex-wrap gap-2 overflow-y-auto"
            data-testid="pallet-scanned"
          >
            {picked.map((row) => (
              <li
                key={row.barcode}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card py-1 ps-3 pe-1 text-sm"
              >
                <span dir="auto" className="font-medium">
                  {row.itemName}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                  {formatWeight(row.weightKg)} {common("kg")}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={t("scan.remove", { name: row.itemName })}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onClick={() => onRemove(row.barcode)}
                  className="grid size-6 place-items-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground outline-none hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50"
                >
                  <X className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
````

````ts
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { parsePalletQr, palletLabelValues } from "@/lib/pallets";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { getPalletLayout } from "@/server/labels";
import { assertPermission, getAccess, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import {
  PalletError,
  createPallet,
  getPalletLabelData,
  viewPallet,
  type PalletBox,
  type PalletErrorCode,
} from "@/server/pallets";
import { getPriorityClient } from "@/server/priority";
import type { PrintJobData } from "../../catalog/actions";

export type PalletActionError =
  | PalletErrorCode
  | "NOT_ALLOWED"
  | "INVALID_INPUT"
  | "NOT_A_PALLET"
  | "NO_PALLET_LAYOUT"
  | "GENERIC";

type Failure = { ok: false; error: PalletActionError; barcodes?: string[] };

/** The label of a pallet, ready to print: the pallet layout drawn with this pallet's values. */
async function labelJob(number: number): Promise<PrintJobData | Failure> {
  const [layout, data] = await Promise.all([getPalletLayout(db), getPalletLabelData(db, number)]);
  if (!layout) return { ok: false, error: "NO_PALLET_LAYOUT" };
  if (!data) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_FOUND" };
  return {
    widthMm: layout.widthMm,
    heightMm: layout.heightMm,
    elements: layout.elements,
    values: palletLabelValues(data),
    copies: 1,
  };
}

/** Seeing a pallet and printing its label is open to whoever may build pallets in either way. */
async function assertPalletAccess(): Promise<void> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  if (!access.can("inventory.pallets") && !access.can("inventory.palletsScan"))
    throw new PermissionError("inventory.pallets");
}

function failure(error: unknown): Failure {
  if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
  if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
  if (error instanceof PalletError)
    return { ok: false, error: error.code, barcodes: error.barcodes.slice(0, 20) };
  console.error("[pallets] failed", error);
  return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
}

/**
 * Makes a pallet of the boxes picked and hands back its label to print. Boxes picked by ticking
 * them in the list need "pallets"; boxes scanned with the scanner need "palletsScan".
 * Checked before anything is made: there must be a pallet layout to print with.
 */
export async function createPalletAction(
  barcodes: string[],
  how: "select" | "scan" = "select",
): Promise<{ ok: true; number: number; boxes: number; job: PrintJobData } | Failure> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission(
      z.enum(["select", "scan"]).parse(how) === "scan"
        ? "inventory.palletsScan"
        : "inventory.pallets",
    );
    const list = z.array(z.string().max(100)).max(1000).parse(barcodes);
    if (!(await getPalletLayout(db))) return { ok: false, error: "NO_PALLET_LAYOUT" };
    const made = await createPallet(db, getPriorityClient(), list, access.actor);
    const job = await labelJob(made.number);
    if ("ok" in job) return job;
    revalidatePath("/inventory/pallets");
    return { ok: true, ...made, job };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error);
  }
}

/** The label of an existing pallet, printed again. */
export async function palletLabelAction(
  number: number,
): Promise<{ ok: true; job: PrintJobData } | Failure> {
  try {
    await assertPalletAccess();
    const job = await labelJob(z.number().int().min(1).parse(number));
    return "ok" in job ? job : { ok: true, job };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error);
  }
}

export interface PalletViewData {
  number: number;
  createdAt: string;
  createdBy: string;
  boxes: PalletBox[];
}

/** What is on a pallet now, from a scanned pallet QR code (or just its number). */
export async function openPalletAction(
  text: string,
): Promise<{ ok: true; pallet: PalletViewData } | Failure> {
  try {
    await assertPalletAccess();
    const scanned = z.string().max(100).parse(text).trim();
    const number = parsePalletQr(scanned) ?? (/^\d{1,9}$/.test(scanned) ? Number(scanned) : null);
    if (number === null || number < 1) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_A_PALLET" };
    const view = await viewPallet(db, getPriorityClient(), number);
    return {
      ok: true,
      pallet: {
        number: view.number,
        createdAt: view.createdAt.toISOString(),
        createdBy: view.createdBy,
        boxes: view.boxes,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error);
  }
}
````

````tsx
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { listPallets } from "@/server/pallets";
import { getAccess, requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient } from "@/server/priority";
import { PalletsScreen } from "./pallets-screen";

/** Pallets: what is on one (from its QR code), and the latest ones with their labels. */
export default async function PalletsPage() {
  await requireScreen("inventory");
  // Either way of building pallets leads to the pallets themselves.
  const access = await getAccess();
  if (!access.can("inventory.pallets") && !access.can("inventory.palletsScan")) notFound();
  const t = await getTranslations();
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.inventory;

  const list = await listPallets(db);
  // Warehouse names are Priority's; when it does not answer the codes are shown instead.
  const warehouses = await getPriorityClient()
    .getWarehouses()
    .catch(() => []);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        icon={<Icon />}
        eyebrow={t("nav.inventory")}
        title={t("pallets.title")}
        description={t("pallets.subtitle")}
        help="pallets"
        actions={
          <Button variant="outline" nativeButton={false} render={<Link href="/inventory" />}>
            <ArrowLeft data-icon="inline-start" className="rtl:rotate-180" />
            {t("pallets.back")}
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <PalletsScreen
        recent={list.map((pallet) => ({ ...pallet, createdAt: pallet.createdAt.toISOString() }))}
        warehouses={warehouses}
      />
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Eye, Package, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { LabelPrintSheet, printLabelSheet } from "@/components/labels/label-print";
import { ScanBar } from "@/components/scan-bar";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatDate, formatDateTime, formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import type { PrintJobData } from "../../catalog/actions";
import {
  openPalletAction,
  palletLabelAction,
  type PalletActionError,
  type PalletViewData,
} from "./actions";

export interface RecentPallet {
  number: number;
  createdAt: string;
  createdBy: string;
  boxes: number;
  kg: number;
}

/**
 * Pallets: scan a pallet's QR code to see every box on it (with where each one is now, and which
 * are no longer in stock), and print the label of the latest pallets again.
 */
export function PalletsScreen({
  recent,
  warehouses,
}: {
  recent: RecentPallet[];
  warehouses: { code: string; name: string }[];
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("pallets");
  const detail = useTranslations("pallets.detail");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [pallet, setPallet] = useState<PalletViewData | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<PalletActionError | null>(null);
  const [job, setJob] = useState<PrintJobData | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Once the label is on the page, open the print window for it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!job) return;
    printLabelSheet(job.widthMm, job.heightMm, () => setJob(null));
  }, [job]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pending) input.current?.focus();
  }, [pending]);

  function open(value: string) {
    if (!value.trim()) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await openPalletAction(value);
      setText("");
      if (!result.ok) {
        setPallet(null);
        return setError(result.error);
      }
      setError(null);
      setPallet(result.pallet);
    });
  }

  function printLabel(number: number) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await palletLabelAction(number);
      if (!result.ok) return setError(result.error);
      setError(null);
      setJob(result.job);
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <ScanBar
        id="pallet-scan"
        label={t("scan.label")}
        title={t("scan.title")}
        hint={t("scan.hint")}
        placeholder={t("scan.placeholder")}
        inputRef={input}
        disabled={pending}
        value={text}
        onChange={setText}
        onEnter={() => open(text)}
      >
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" data-testid="pallet-error">
            <AlertDescription>{t(`errors.${error}`)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
      </ScanBar>

      {pallet ? (
        <PalletDetail
          pallet={pallet}
          warehouses={warehouses}
          busy={pending || job !== null}
          onPrint={() => printLabel(pallet.number)}
        />
      ) : null}

      <section className="space-y-3">
        <h2 className="font-serif text-xl font-semibold">{t("recent.title")}</h2>
        {recent.length === 0 ? (
          <div
            className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-6 py-12 text-center"
            data-testid="pallets-empty"
          >
            <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
              <Package className="size-5" />
            </span>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("recent.empty")}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul
            className="grid auto-rows-fr gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3"
            data-testid="pallets-recent"
          >
            {recent.map((item) => (
              <li
                key={item.number}
                className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-card"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold">
                    <Package className="size-5" aria-hidden />
                  </span>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">
                      {t("recent.pallet", { number: item.number })}
                    </p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {detail("made", { date: formatDateTime(item.createdAt), by: item.createdBy })}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div className="rounded-xl bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2">
                    <p
                      className="font-serif text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums"
                      data-testid="pallet-boxes"
                    >
                      {item.boxes}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("stat.boxes")}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2">
                    <p className="font-serif text-xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
                      <span dir="ltr">{formatWeight(item.kg)}</span>{" "}
                      <span className="font-sans text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                        {common("kg")}
                      </span>
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("stat.weight")}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-auto flex gap-2">
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="flex-1"
                    disabled={pending}
                    onClick={() => open(String(item.number))}
                    aria-label={t("recent.openFor", { number: item.number })}
                  >
                    <Eye data-icon="inline-start" />
                    {t("recent.open")}
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="flex-1"
                    disabled={pending || job !== null}
                    onClick={() => printLabel(item.number)}
                    aria-label={t("recent.printFor", { number: item.number })}
                  >
                    <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
                    {t("recent.print")}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      {job ? <LabelPrintSheet job={job} /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function PalletDetail({
  pallet,
  warehouses,
  busy,
  onPrint,
}: {
  pallet: PalletViewData;
  warehouses: { code: string; name: string }[];
  busy: boolean;
  onPrint: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("pallets.detail");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const nameOf = (code: string) => warehouses.find((w) => w.code === code)?.name ?? code;
  const gone = pallet.boxes.filter((box) => !box.inStock).length;
  const kg = pallet.boxes.reduce((sum, box) => sum + Math.round(box.weightKg * 1000), 0) / 1000;

  return (
    <Card className="gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0" data-testid="pallet-detail">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">
            {t("title", { number: pallet.number })}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {t("made", { date: formatDateTime(pallet.createdAt), by: pallet.createdBy })}
          </p>
          <p className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
            <Badge variant="outline">{t("boxes", { count: pallet.boxes.length })}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">
              {formatWeight(kg)} {common("kg")}
            </Badge>
            {gone > 0 ? <Badge variant="warning">{t("gone", { count: gone })}</Badge> : null}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={busy} onClick={onPrint}>
          <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
          {t("print")}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
        {pallet.boxes.map((box) => (
          <li
            key={box.barcode}
            data-in-stock={box.inStock}
            className={
              box.inStock
                ? "space-y-1 px-5 py-3"
                : "space-y-1 bg-muted/60 px-5 py-3 text-muted-foreground"
            }
          >
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <p dir="auto" className="font-medium">
                {box.itemName}
              </p>
              {box.inStock ? null : <Badge variant="warning">{t("notInStock")}</Badge>}
            </div>
            <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs break-all">
              {box.barcode}
            </p>
            <p className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-sm">
              <span dir="ltr" className="tabular-nums">
                {formatWeight(box.weightKg)} {common("kg")}
              </span>
              {box.warehouseCode ? (
                <span dir="auto">{t("in", { warehouse: nameOf(box.warehouseCode) })}</span>
              ) : null}
              {box.expiryDate ? (
                <span dir="ltr" className="tabular-nums">
                  {t("expires", { date: formatDate(box.expiryDate) })}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { IdleLogout } from "@/components/idle-logout";
import { LanguageSwitcher } from "@/components/language-switcher";
import { MessageWatcher } from "@/components/message-watcher";
import { AppShell } from "@/components/shell/app-shell";
import { SignOutButton } from "@/components/sign-out-button";
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { countNewMessages } from "@/server/messages";
import { getAccess } from "@/server/permissions";
import { SCREENS } from "@/server/permissions/registry";
import { getIdleMinutes } from "@/server/security";
import { getUnseenAlertCount } from "@/server/security/alerts";

/**
 * Everything inside the app requires a logged-in, enabled user who has already
 * replaced a temporary password, and who is allowed on this device type.
 * The shell shows only the screens that user may open.
 */
export default async function AppLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const access = await getAccess();
  if (!access.deviceAllowed) return <DeviceNotAllowed deviceType={access.deviceType} />;

  const t = await getTranslations();
  const store = await cookies();
  const idleMinutes = await getIdleMinutes(db);
  const alertCount =
    access.isOwner || access.can("admin.security") ? await getUnseenAlertCount(db) : 0;
  const canMessages = access.isOwner || access.can("admin.messages");
  const messageCount = canMessages ? await countNewMessages(db) : 0;
  const items = access.visibleScreens().map((key) => ({
    badge: key === "admin" ? alertCount + messageCount : 0,
    key,
    href: SCREENS[key].path,
    label: t(`nav.${key}`),
    group: SCREENS[key].group,
  }));

  return (
    <AppShell
      items={items}
      user={{
        displayName: access.user.displayName,
        subtitle: access.isOwner ? t("access.owner") : access.user.jobTitle || "",
      }}
      company={t("app.company")}
      defaultCollapsed={store.get("sidebar")?.value === "collapsed"}
    >
      {children}
      <IdleLogout minutes={idleMinutes} />
      {canMessages ? <MessageWatcher initialCount={messageCount} /> : null}
    </AppShell>
  );
}

async function DeviceNotAllowed({ deviceType }: { deviceType: "desktop" | "phone" }) {
  const t = await getTranslations("access");
  return (
    <main className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-md flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-4 px-4 py-8">
      <Alert variant="destructive">
        <AlertTitle>{t("deviceNotAllowed.title")}</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>
          {t("deviceNotAllowed.body", { device: t(`device.${deviceType}`) })}
        </AlertDescription>
      </Alert>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <LanguageSwitcher />
        <SignOutButton />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
````
