````ts
"use server";

import { z } from "zod";
import { addDays } from "@/lib/barcodes";
import { parseItemLabelQr } from "@/lib/labels/codes";
import { checkItemLabelInput, parseIsoDate } from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import { boxLabelValues } from "@/lib/receiving/box-label";
import { logFor } from "@/server/activity-log";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { boxes } from "@/server/db/schema";
import { getBoxLayout } from "@/server/labels";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient } from "@/server/priority";
import {
  readCatalog,
  receiveInHouseBox,
  ReceivingError,
  type ReceivedBox,
  type ReceivingErrorCode,
} from "@/server/receiving";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { PrintJobData } from "../catalog/actions";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export type ReceiveErrorCode =
  | ReceivingErrorCode
  | "INVALID_INPUT"
  | "NOT_ALLOWED"
  | "NOT_ITEM_QR"
  | "NO_BOX_LAYOUT"
  | "BOX_NOT_FOUND"
  | "GENERIC";

export type ReceiveResult =
  | { ok: true; box: Omit<ReceivedBox, "item">; job: PrintJobData }
  | { ok: false; error: ReceiveErrorCode };

const weight = z.number().finite();

const inputSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("mode", [
  /** The text a scanner read from an item label's QR code. */
  z.object({ mode: z.literal("scan"), qr: z.string().max(500), weightKg: weight }),
  z.object({
    mode: z.literal("manual"),
    itemNumber: z.string().min(1).max(100),
    certificateNo: z.string().max(100),
    slaughterDate: z.string().max(10),
    productionDate: z.string().max(10),
    weightKg: weight,
  }),
]);

/**
 * Saves a weighed box and hands back its label to print. A scan needs "scan", typing the
 * box in by hand needs "manual"; both are decided here, not by the screen. The box is
 * saved even when Priority does not answer (the send retries later).
 */
export async function receiveBoxAction(input: z.input<typeof inputSchema>): Promise<ReceiveResult> {
  try {
    const data = inputSchema.parse(input);
    const access = await assertPermission(
      data.mode === "scan" ? "receiving.scan" : "receiving.manual",
    );

    let fields: {
      itemNumber: string;
      certificateNo: string;
      slaughterDate: Date;
      productionDate: Date;
      expiryDate: Date | null;
    };
    if (data.mode === "scan") {
      const qr = parseItemLabelQr(data.qr);
      if (!qr) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ITEM_QR" };
      fields = { ...qr, expiryDate: qr.expiryDate };
    } else {
      const problems = checkItemLabelInput({ ...data, copies: 1 });
      const slaughterDate = parseIsoDate(data.slaughterDate);
      const productionDate = parseIsoDate(data.productionDate);
      if (problems.length > 0 || !slaughterDate || !productionDate)
        return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
      fields = {
        itemNumber: data.itemNumber,
        certificateNo: data.certificateNo.trim(),
        slaughterDate,
        productionDate,
        expiryDate: null, // worked out below from the item's shelf life
      };
    }

    const layout = await getBoxLayout(db);
    if (!layout) return { ok: false, error: "NO_BOX_LAYOUT" };

    const priority = getPriorityClient();
    let expiryDate = fields.expiryDate;
    if (!expiryDate) {
      const { items } = await readCatalog(db, priority);
      const item = items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === fields.itemNumber);
      if (!item) return { ok: false, error: "UNKNOWN_ITEM" };
      expiryDate = addDays(fields.slaughterDate, item.shelfLifeDays);
    }

    const { item, ...box } = await receiveInHouseBox(
      db,
      priority,
      {
        itemNumber: fields.itemNumber,
        certificateNo: fields.certificateNo,
        slaughterDate: fields.slaughterDate,
        productionDate: fields.productionDate,
        expiryDate,
        weightKg: data.weightKg,
      },
      access.actor,
    );
    revalidatePath("/receiving");
    return {
      ok: true,
      box,
      job: {
        widthMm: layout.widthMm,
        heightMm: layout.heightMm,
        elements: layout.elements,
        values: boxLabelValues(item, box),
        copies: 1,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error);
  }
}

/** The label of a box already received, printed again. Needs "reprint". */
export async function reprintBoxAction(barcode: string): Promise<ReceiveResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("receiving.reprint");
    z.string().min(1).max(60).parse(barcode);
    const [row] = await db.select().from(boxes).where(eq(boxes.barcode, barcode)).limit(1);
    if (!row) return { ok: false, error: "BOX_NOT_FOUND" };
    const layout = await getBoxLayout(db);
    if (!layout) return { ok: false, error: "NO_BOX_LAYOUT" };
    const { items } = await readCatalog(db, getPriorityClient());
    const item = items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === row.itemNumber);
    if (!item) return { ok: false, error: "UNKNOWN_ITEM" };
    await logFor(
      access.actor,
      "receiving.labelReprinted",
      { entityType: "box", entityId: row.barcode, details: { item: row.itemNumber } },
      db,
    );
    return {
      ok: true,
      box: {
        id: row.id,
        barcode: row.barcode,
        itemNumber: row.itemNumber,
        itemName: item.name,
        running: row.running,
        weightKg: row.weightKg,
        slaughterDate: row.slaughterDate,
        productionDate: row.productionDate,
        expiryDate: row.expiryDate,
        certificateNo: row.certificateNo,
        docno: row.docno,
        warehouseCode: row.warehouseCode,
        sent: "sent",
      },
      job: {
        widthMm: layout.widthMm,
        heightMm: layout.heightMm,
        elements: layout.elements,
        values: boxLabelValues(item, row),
        copies: 1,
      },
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error);
  }
}

function failure(error: unknown): { ok: false; error: ReceiveErrorCode } {
  if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
  if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
  if (error instanceof ReceivingError) return { ok: false, error: error.code };
  console.error("[receiving] failed", error);
  return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Layers, Package, Search } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { categoryCounts, filterItems, sortByName } from "@/lib/catalog";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { CategoryCard, ItemCard } from "../catalog/catalog-browser";

/**
 * Choosing an item the way the catalog shows them: search, the categories as cards, and the
 * items as cards under their category. Choosing a category shows only its items. Picking an
 * item calls onPick (the caller closes the window); closing it without one calls onClose.
 */
export function ItemPicker({
  open,
  items,
  onPick,
  onClose,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  items: PriorityItem[];
  onPick: (item: PriorityItem) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving.picker");
  const catalog = useTranslations("catalog");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const categories = useMemo(() => categoryCounts(items), [items]);
  const sorted = useMemo(() => sortByName(items), [items]);
  const shown = useMemo(() => filterItems(sorted, { category, query }), [sorted, category, query]);
  const sections = useMemo(
    () =>
      categories
        .map(({ category: name }) => ({
          category: name,
          items: shown.filter((item) => item.category === name),
        }))
        .filter((section) => section.items.length > 0),
    [categories, shown],
  );
  const categoryLabel = (value: string) => (value === "" ? catalog("uncategorized") : value);

  function close() {
    setQuery("");
    setCategory(null);
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(next) => (next ? undefined : close())}>
      <DialogContent
        className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto sm:max-w-6xl"
        data-testid="item-picker"
      >
        <DialogTitleBlock icon={<Package />} title={t("title")} description={t("description")} />

        <div className="relative">
          <Search
            aria-hidden
            className="pointer-events-none absolute start-3.5 top-1/2 size-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground"
          />
          <Input
            type="search"
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
            placeholder={catalog("searchPlaceholder")}
            aria-label={catalog("searchLabel")}
            className="ps-10"
            autoComplete="off"
          />
        </div>

        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label={catalog("categories")}
          className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4"
        >
          <CategoryCard
            active={category === null}
            label={catalog("allCategories")}
            count={items.length}
            onClick={() => setCategory(null)}
            ariaLabel={catalog("allCategoriesAction", { count: items.length })}
          />
          {categories.map(({ category: name, count }) => (
            <CategoryCard
              key={name || "none"}
              active={category === name}
              label={categoryLabel(name)}
              count={count}
              onClick={() => setCategory(name)}
              ariaLabel={catalog("openCategory", { category: categoryLabel(name), count })}
            />
          ))}
        </div>

        {shown.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">{catalog("empty")}</p>
        ) : (
          sections.map((section) => (
            <section
              key={section.category || "none"}
              aria-label={categoryLabel(section.category)}
              className="space-y-3"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/50 px-4 py-2.5">
                <h3 className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 font-semibold">
                  <Layers className="size-4 shrink-0 text-gold" aria-hidden />
                  <span dir="auto" className="truncate">
                    {categoryLabel(section.category)}
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <Badge variant="soft" className="tabular-nums">
                  {catalog("count", { count: section.items.length })}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <ul className="grid auto-rows-fr grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5">
                {section.items.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.itemNumber} className="min-w-0">
                    <ItemCard
                      item={item}
                      category={categoryLabel(item.category)}
                      openLabel={t("choose", { name: item.name, number: item.itemNumber })}
                      onOpen={() => {
                        setQuery("");
                        setCategory(null);
                        onPick(item);
                      }}
                    />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </section>
          ))
        )}

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="lg" onClick={close}>
            {t("cancel")}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { CloudOff } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getTares } from "@/server/packaging";
import { getPriorityClient } from "@/server/priority";
import { listTodayBoxes, readCatalog, ReceivingError, sendDue } from "@/server/receiving";
import { RefreshButton } from "../dashboard/refresh-button";
import { ReceivingScreen } from "./receiving-screen";
import type { TodayRow } from "./today-list";

export default async function ReceivingPage() {
  const access = await requireScreen("receiving");
  const t = await getTranslations();
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.receiving;

  const header = (
    <PageHeader
      icon={<Icon />}
      eyebrow={t("shell.groups.operations")}
      title={t("nav.receiving")}
      description={t("screens.receiving")}
      help="receiving"
    />
  );

  const priority = getPriorityClient();
  let catalog;
  try {
    catalog = await readCatalog(db, priority);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof ReceivingError)) throw error;
    return (
      <>
        {header}
        <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-14 text-center">
            <span className="grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full border border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft text-warning [&_svg]:size-9">
              <CloudOff />
            </span>
            <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">
              {t("receiving.unavailable.title")}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("receiving.unavailable.body")}</p>
            <RefreshButton />
          </div>
        </Card>
      </>
    );
  }

  // Opening the screen is also a chance to send what Priority could not take earlier.
  if (!catalog.saved) void sendDue(db, priority).catch(() => 0);

  let today: TodayRow[] | null = null;
  if (access.can("receiving.todayList")) {
    const names = new Map(catalog.items.map((i) => [i.itemNumber, i.name]));
    today = (await listTodayBoxes(db, "production")).map((box) => ({
      barcode: box.barcode,
      itemName: names.get(box.itemNumber) ?? box.itemNumber,
      running: box.running,
      weightKg: box.weightKg,
      receivedAt: box.receivedAt.toISOString(),
      receivedBy: box.receivedBy,
      sent: box.sent,
    }));
  }

  return (
    <>
      {header}
      <ReceivingScreen
        items={catalog.items}
        packing={Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(await getTares(db)).map(([category, tare]) => [
            category,
            { totalKg: tare.totalKg, name: tare.box?.name ?? "" },
          ]),
        )}
        today={today}
        usingSavedCatalog={catalog.saved}
        can={{
          manual: access.can("receiving.manual"),
          reprint: access.can("receiving.reprint"),
          autoPrint: access.can("receiving.autoPrint"),
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import {
  CalendarDays,
  Clock,
  CloudOff,
  Keyboard,
  LayoutGrid,
  Printer,
  QrCode,
  RotateCcw,
  ShieldCheck,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { LabelPrintSheet, printLabelSheet } from "@/components/labels/label-print";
import { RealScale, type ScaleState } from "@/components/scale/real-scale";
import { SimulatedScale, parseWeight, useStable } from "@/components/scale/simulated-scale";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { formatDate, formatPackingWeight, formatWeight, todayIso } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { parseItemLabelQr } from "@/lib/labels/codes";
import { addDays } from "@/lib/barcodes";
import { checkItemLabelInput, parseIsoDate } from "@/lib/labels/item-label";
import { netWeight } from "@/lib/packaging";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import type { PrintJobData } from "../catalog/actions";
import { ItemPicker } from "./item-picker";
import { TodayList, type TodayRow } from "./today-list";
import {
  receiveBoxAction,
  reprintBoxAction,
  type ReceiveErrorCode,
  type ReceiveResult,
} from "./actions";

/** The items as Priority has them, so hand entry can show them the way the catalog does. */
export type ScreenItem = PriorityItem;

/** The packaging an item is packed in, with what it weighs. */
export interface PackingInfo {
  totalKg: number;
  name: string;
}

/** What a scan or a hand entry has filled in, shown to the worker before weighing. */
interface Pending {
  itemNumber: string;
  certificateNo: string;
  slaughter: Date;
  production: Date;
  expiry: Date;
}

const AUTO_PRINT_AFTER_MS = 2000;
const AUTO_PRINT_KEY = "receiving.autoPrint";

/**
 * Goods receiving from production: scan the item label's QR code, put the box on the scale,
 * Enter saves the box and prints its label. The scale is simulated until phase 3.
 */
export function ReceivingScreen({
  items,
  packing,
  today,
  usingSavedCatalog,
  can,
}: {
  items: ScreenItem[];
  /** What the packaging of each item weighs, by item number. */
  packing: Record<string, PackingInfo>;
  /** Null when the user may not see today's list. */
  today: TodayRow[] | null;
  usingSavedCatalog: boolean;
  can: { manual: boolean; reprint: boolean; autoPrint: boolean };
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving");
  const [saving, startSaving] = useTransition();
  const scanRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const weightRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const [scanText, setScanText] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<Pending | null>(null);
  const [manual, setManual] = useState(false);
  const [weightText, setWeightText] = useState("");
  const [scaleState, setScaleState] = useState<ScaleState>("off");
  const [error, setError] = useState<ReceiveErrorCode | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ name: string; weight: number; sent: string } | null>(null);
  const [job, setJob] = useState<PrintJobData | null>(null);
  const [autoPrint, setAutoPrint] = useState(false);

  const stable = useStable(weightText);
  const weight = parseWeight(weightText);
  // The packing of the item being weighed: the scale shows it with its bag and box.
  const pack = pending ? packing[pending.itemNumber] : undefined;
  const itemName = (number: string) => items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === number)?.name ?? number;

  // The switch is a convenience of this computer: it is remembered here.
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      setAutoPrint(localStorage.getItem(AUTO_PRINT_KEY) === "1"); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect
    } catch {
      /* storage can be blocked; the switch just starts off */
    }
  }, []);
  function changeAutoPrint(on: boolean) {
    setAutoPrint(on);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(AUTO_PRINT_KEY, on ? "1" : "0");
    } catch {
      /* not remembered */
    }
  }

  // Once the server has saved the box, its label is on the page: open the print window.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!job) return;
    printLabelSheet(job.widthMm, job.heightMm, () => {
      setJob(null);
      scanRef.current?.focus();
    });
  }, [job]);

  function accept(result: ReceiveResult, reprint: boolean) {
    if (!result.ok) {
      setError(result.error);
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setJob(result.job);
    if (!reprint) {
      setNotice({
        name: result.box.itemName,
        weight: result.box.weightKg,
        sent: result.box.sent,
      });
      setPending(null);
      setManual(false);
      setScanText("");
      setWeightText("");
    }
  }

  function save() {
    if (saving || job) return;
    if (!pending) return setError("NOT_ITEM_QR");
    if (weight === null) return setError("INVALID_WEIGHT");
    setError(null);
    const base = { weightKg: weight };
    startSaving(async () => {
      const result = await receiveBoxAction(
        manual
          ? {
              mode: "manual",
              itemNumber: pending.itemNumber,
              certificateNo: pending.certificateNo,
              slaughterDate: pending.slaughter.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
              productionDate: pending.production.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
              ...base,
            }
          : { mode: "scan", qr: scanText, ...base },
      );
      accept(result, false);
    });
  }

  // Automatic printing: the box is saved about two seconds after the weight stops changing.
  const saveRef = useRef(save);
  useEffect(() => {
    saveRef.current = save;
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!autoPrint || !pending || weight === null) return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => saveRef.current(), AUTO_PRINT_AFTER_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [autoPrint, pending, weight, weightText]);

  function scan(text: string) {
    const qr = parseItemLabelQr(text);
    if (!qr) {
      setError("NOT_ITEM_QR");
      setScanText("");
      return;
    }
    if (!items.some((i) => i.itemNumber === qr.itemNumber)) {
      setError("UNKNOWN_ITEM");
      setScanText("");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setNotice(null);
    setScanText(text.trim());
    setPending({
      itemNumber: qr.itemNumber,
      certificateNo: qr.certificateNo,
      slaughter: qr.slaughterDate,
      production: qr.productionDate,
      expiry: qr.expiryDate,
    });
    weightRef.current?.focus();
  }

  function clear() {
    setPending(null);
    setScanText("");
    setManual(false);
    setError(null);
    scanRef.current?.focus();
  }

  function reprint(barcode: string) {
    startSaving(async () => accept(await reprintBoxAction(barcode), true));
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {usingSavedCatalog ? (
        <Alert>
          <CloudOff aria-hidden />
          <AlertDescription>{t("savedCatalog")}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert">
          <AlertDescription>{t(`errors.${error}`)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}
      {notice ? (
        <Alert role="status" data-testid="saved-notice">
          <AlertDescription>
            {t("saved", { name: notice.name, weight: formatWeight(notice.weight) })}
            {notice.sent !== "sent" ? ` ${t("willSend")}` : ""}
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      ) : null}

      <div
        className={cn(
          "grid items-start gap-5",
          today ? "lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,30rem)_minmax(0,1fr)]" : "max-w-2xl",
        )}
      >
        {/* The box: scan, check what the label says, weigh, save and print. */}
        <form
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            save();
          }}
        >
          <Card className="gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0">
            <div className="space-y-3 border-b border-border bg-muted/40 p-5">
              <h2 className="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">{t("scanTitle")}</h2>
              {manual ? null : (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="scan-input" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
                    <QrCode className="size-4" aria-hidden />
                    {t("scanLabel")}
                  </Label>
                  <Input
                    id="scan-input"
                    ref={scanRef}
                    dir="ltr"
                    autoFocus
                    autoComplete="off"
                    className="h-12 bg-card text-base"
                    value={scanText}
                    placeholder={t("scanPlaceholder")}
                    onChange={(event) => setScanText(event.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key !== "Enter") return;
                      event.preventDefault(); // a scan is not a save
                      scan(scanText);
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
              {!pending && !manual && can.manual ? (
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="text-muted-foreground"
                  onClick={() => setManual(true)}
                >
                  <Keyboard data-icon="inline-start" />
                  {t("manualButton")}
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-5 p-5">
              {pending ? (
                <PendingSummary
                  pending={pending}
                  name={itemName(pending.itemNumber)}
                  shelfLifeDays={
                    items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === pending.itemNumber)?.shelfLifeDays ?? null
                  }
                />
              ) : manual ? (
                <ManualEntry items={items} onReady={setPending} onCancel={clear} />
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-5 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <QrCode className="size-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                  {t("waiting")}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-border pt-5">
                <h2 className="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">{t("weighTitle")}</h2>
                <RealScale onWeight={setWeightText} onStateChange={setScaleState} />
                <SimulatedScale
                  text={weightText}
                  onChange={setWeightText}
                  stable={stable}
                  inputRef={weightRef}
                  live={scaleState === "on"}
                  below={
                    pending || manual ? (
                      <RecordedWeight pack={pack ?? null} scaleKg={weight} />
                    ) : null
                  }
                />
                {can.autoPrint ? (
                  <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                    {t("autoPrint")}
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      role="switch"
                      className="peer sr-only"
                      checked={autoPrint}
                      onChange={(event) => changeAutoPrint(event.target.checked)}
                    />
                    <span
                      aria-hidden
                      className="relative h-6 w-11 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-muted transition-colors peer-checked:bg-primary peer-focus-visible:ring-3 peer-focus-visible:ring-ring/50 after:absolute after:start-0.5 after:top-0.5 after:size-5 after:rounded-full after:bg-card after:shadow after:transition-transform peer-checked:after:translate-x-5 rtl:peer-checked:after:-translate-x-5"
                    />
                  </label>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-border bg-muted/40 p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {pending || manual ? (
                  <Button type="button" variant="ghost" onClick={clear}>
                    <RotateCcw data-icon="inline-start" />
                    {t("clear")}
                  </Button>
                ) : null}
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  size="lg"
                  className="flex-1"
                  disabled={saving || job !== null || !pending || weight === null}
                >
                  <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
                  {saving ? t("saving") : t("save")}
                </Button>
              </div>
              <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("enterHint")}</p>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </form>

        {today ? (
          <TodayList
            rows={today}
            canReprint={can.reprint}
            busy={saving || job !== null}
            onReprint={reprint}
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {job ? <LabelPrintSheet job={job} /> : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * The weight that goes into stock, as large as the scale's own reading and right under it: the
 * scale's weight, less the packaging when the item has one (then the packaging is named).
 */
function RecordedWeight({ pack, scaleKg }: { pack: PackingInfo | null; scaleKg: number | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving");
  const packaging = useTranslations("receiving.packaging");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const taken = pack && pack.totalKg > 0 ? pack.totalKg : 0;
  const recorded = scaleKg === null ? null : netWeight(scaleKg, taken);
  return (
    <div
      data-testid={taken > 0 ? "packing-summary" : "recorded-box"}
      className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border-2 border-gold/50 bg-gold-soft px-5 py-4"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">{t("scale.recorded")}</p>
        {taken > 0 && pack ? (
          <p className="flex gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span dir="auto">{packaging("carton", { name: pack.name })}</span>
            <span dir="ltr" className="tabular-nums">
              {packaging("taken", { weight: formatPackingWeight(taken), kg: common("kg") })}
            </span>
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <span
        dir="ltr"
        data-testid="recorded-weight"
        className="block font-serif text-5xl font-semibold tabular-nums sm:text-6xl"
      >
        {recorded === null ? "—" : formatWeight(recorded)}{" "}
        <span className="ms-2 text-2xl font-normal text-muted-foreground">{common("kg")}</span>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The item the label belongs to and what the label says, read only. */
function PendingSummary({
  pending,
  name,
  shelfLifeDays,
}: {
  pending: Pending;
  name: string;
  shelfLifeDays: number | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving");
  return (
    <div data-testid="pending-summary" className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
          <Badge variant="success">{t("facts.item")}</Badge>
          <p dir="auto" className="text-xl leading-tight font-semibold">
            {name}
          </p>
          <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {pending.itemNumber}
          </p>
        </div>
        {shelfLifeDays ? (
          <span className="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
            {t("facts.shelfLife", { days: shelfLifeDays })}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <Fact
          icon={<CalendarDays />}
          label={t("facts.slaughter")}
          value={formatDate(pending.slaughter)}
        />
        <Fact
          icon={<CalendarDays />}
          label={t("facts.production")}
          value={formatDate(pending.production)}
        />
        <Fact
          icon={<ShieldCheck />}
          label={t("facts.certificate")}
          value={pending.certificateNo}
          className="col-span-2"
        />
        <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/5 px-4 py-3">
          <div>
            <dt className="text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">{t("facts.expiry")}</dt>
            <dd dir="ltr" className="text-start text-lg font-semibold tabular-nums">
              {formatDate(pending.expiry)}
            </dd>
          </div>
          <Clock className="size-5 text-destructive" aria-hidden />
        </div>
      </dl>
    </div>
  );
}

function Fact({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  className,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("space-y-1", className)}>
      <dt className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground [&_svg]:size-3.5">
        {icon}
        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd
        dir="ltr"
        className="rounded-lg border border-input bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2 text-start font-semibold tabular-nums"
      >
        {value}
      </dd>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Picking the item and typing the dates and certificate, for a box with no QR code. */
function ManualEntry({
  items,
  onReady,
  onCancel,
}: {
  items: ScreenItem[];
  onReady: (pending: Pending) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving.manual");
  const catalog = useTranslations("catalog");
  // The catalog window opens at once: choosing the item is the first thing to do.
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState(true);
  const [itemNumber, setItemNumber] = useState("");
  const [slaughter, setSlaughter] = useState("");
  const [production, setProduction] = useState(todayIso());
  const [certificate, setCertificate] = useState("");
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState(false);

  const chosen = items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === itemNumber) ?? null;

  function use() {
    const item = items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === itemNumber);
    const input = {
      slaughterDate: slaughter,
      productionDate: production,
      certificateNo: certificate,
      copies: 1,
    };
    const slaughterDate = parseIsoDate(slaughter);
    const productionDate = parseIsoDate(production);
    if (!item || !slaughterDate || !productionDate || checkItemLabelInput(input).length > 0)
      return setProblem(true);
    setProblem(false);
    onReady({
      itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
      certificateNo: certificate.trim(),
      slaughter: slaughterDate,
      production: productionDate,
      expiry: addDays(slaughterDate, item.shelfLifeDays),
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3" data-testid="manual-entry">
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <p className="text-sm font-medium">{t("item")}</p>
        {chosen ? (
          <div
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 px-4 py-3"
            data-testid="manual-item"
          >
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <Badge variant="soft" className="max-w-full truncate text-[0.7rem]">
                <span dir="auto" className="truncate">
                  {chosen.category === "" ? catalog("uncategorized") : chosen.category}
                </span>
              </Badge>
              <p dir="auto" className="font-semibold">
                {chosen.name}
              </p>
              <p dir="ltr" className="text-start font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {chosen.itemNumber}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setPicking(true)}>
              {t("change")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            className="h-12 w-full"
            onClick={() => setPicking(true)}
          >
            <LayoutGrid data-icon="inline-start" />
            {t("pick")}
          </Button>
        )}
        <ItemPicker
          open={picking}
          items={items}
          onPick={(item) => {
            setItemNumber(item.itemNumber);
            setPicking(false);
          }}
          onClose={() => {
            setPicking(false);
            // Closing the window without an item goes back to scanning.
            if (!itemNumber) onCancel();
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="manual-slaughter" className="text-sm">
            {t("slaughter")}
          </Label>
          <Input
            id="manual-slaughter"
            type="date"
            dir="ltr"
            value={slaughter}
            onChange={(event) => setSlaughter(event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="manual-production" className="text-sm">
            {t("production")}
          </Label>
          <Input
            id="manual-production"
            type="date"
            dir="ltr"
            value={production}
            onChange={(event) => setProduction(event.target.value)}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor="manual-certificate" className="text-sm">
          {t("certificate")}
        </Label>
        <Input
          id="manual-certificate"
          dir="ltr"
          autoComplete="off"
          value={certificate}
          onChange={(event) => setCertificate(event.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
      {problem ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-destructive">
          {t("problem")}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button type="button" onClick={use}>
          {t("use")}
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onCancel}>
          <RotateCcw data-icon="inline-start" />
          {t("back")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { History, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatDate, formatTime, formatWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import { LIST_RESET_TIME } from "@/lib/receiving/today";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface TodayRow {
  barcode: string;
  itemName: string;
  running: string;
  weightKg: number;
  receivedAt: string;
  receivedBy: string;
  sent: "sent" | "pending" | "failed";
}

/** The boxes received since 21:00, shared by the receiving and vendor screens. */
export function TodayList({
  rows,
  canReprint,
  busy,
  onReprint,
}: {
  rows: TodayRow[];
  canReprint: boolean;
  busy: boolean;
  onReprint: (barcode: string) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving.today");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const total = rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.weightKg, 0);
  return (
    <Card className="gap-0 p-5">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border pb-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h2 className="font-serif text-xl font-semibold">{t("title")}</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("note", { time: LIST_RESET_TIME })}</p>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="outline" dir="ltr" className="tabular-nums">
          {formatDate(new Date())}
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <p className="sr-only" data-testid="today-total">
        {t("summary", { count: rows.length, weight: formatWeight(total) })}
      </p>
      <dl className="my-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3 text-center">
          <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("totalBoxes")}</dt>
          <dd className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">{rows.length}</dd>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/40 px-4 py-3 text-center">
          <dt className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("totalWeight")}</dt>
          <dd className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
            {formatWeight(total)}{" "}
            <span className="font-sans text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">
              {common("kg")}
            </span>
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-6 py-12 text-center">
          <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
            <History className="size-5" />
          </span>
          <p className="font-semibold">{t("empty")}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("emptyHint")}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Table data-testid="today-table">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>{t("time")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("item")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("running")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("barcode")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("weight")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("by")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("state")}</TableHead>
              {canReprint ? <TableHead /> : null}
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {rows.map((row) => (
              <TableRow key={row.barcode}>
                <TableCell className="tabular-nums" dir="ltr">
                  {formatTime(row.receivedAt)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell dir="auto">{row.itemName}</TableCell>
                <TableCell className="tabular-nums" dir="ltr">
                  {row.running}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr" data-testid="today-barcode">
                  {row.barcode}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="tabular-nums" dir="ltr">
                  {formatWeight(row.weightKg)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>{row.receivedBy}</TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <Badge
                    variant={
                      row.sent === "sent"
                        ? "success"
                        : row.sent === "pending"
                          ? "warning"
                          : "default"
                    }
                    className={cn(row.sent === "failed" && "bg-destructive text-white")}
                  >
                    {t(`states.${row.sent}`)}
                  </Badge>
                </TableCell>
                {canReprint ? (
                  <TableCell>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      disabled={busy}
                      onClick={() => onReprint(row.barcode)}
                      aria-label={t("reprint", { name: row.itemName, running: row.running })}
                    >
                      <Printer data-icon="inline-start" />
                      {t("reprintShort")}
                    </Button>
                  </TableCell>
                ) : null}
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````ts
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError } from "@/server/priority";
import { isStandInMode, setStandInMode } from "@/server/priority/behaviour";
import {
  getCooldown,
  minutesLeft,
  startCooldown,
  startsCooldown,
} from "@/server/priority/cooldown";
import {
  findItemTexts,
  OdataError,
  OdataHttp,
  probeForm,
  skippedProbe,
  type FormProbe,
} from "@/server/priority/odata";
import {
  getPriorityConnection,
  PriorityConnectionError,
  readPriorityCredentials,
  savePriorityConnection,
} from "@/server/priority/settings";
import { postReceiptLine } from "@/server/priority/write";
import { appSecret } from "@/server/settings/secret";

export type SettingsErrorCode =
  "INVALID_URL" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "NOT_ALLOWED" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "GENERIC";

const connectionSchema = z.object({
  baseUrl: z.string().trim().max(300),
  /** The access key. Left out keeps the stored one; an empty string removes it. */
  apiUser: z.string().trim().max(200).optional(),
  /** Left out keeps the stored password; an empty string removes it. */
  password: z.string().max(200).optional(),
});

export async function savePriorityConnectionAction(
  input: z.input<typeof connectionSchema>,
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.priority.edit");
    const data = connectionSchema.parse(input);
    await savePriorityConnection(db, data, access.actor, appSecret());
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PriorityConnectionError) return { ok: false, error: error.code };
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    console.error("[settings] saving the Priority connection failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

export type ConnectionTest =
  | { ok: true; mode: "fake"; warehouses: number; ms: number }
  | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode };

/** Asks the Priority client (the stand-in until phase 6) for the warehouses, to show that the path works. */
export async function testPriorityConnectionAction(): Promise<ConnectionTest> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("settings.priority.view");
    const started = performance.now();
    const warehouses = await getPriorityClient().getWarehouses();
    return {
      ok: true,
      mode: "fake",
      warehouses: warehouses.length,
      ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof PriorityError && error.code === "UNAVAILABLE") {
      return { ok: false, error: "UNAVAILABLE" };
    }
    console.error("[settings] Priority connection test failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/** Switches the stand-in between normal, slow and down, to try the system when Priority misbehaves. */
export async function setStandInModeAction(
  mode: string,
): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.priority.edit");
    if (!isStandInMode(mode)) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    await setStandInMode(db, mode, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/dashboard");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    console.error("[settings] changing the stand-in behaviour failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

export type FormsCheck =
  | { ok: true; probes: FormProbe[] }
  /** Priority refused us a moment ago, so it is being left alone for this many minutes. */
  | { ok: false; error: "COOLDOWN"; minutes: number }
  | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode | "NOT_CONFIGURED" };

export type FormsList =
  | { ok: true; forms: string[] }
  | { ok: false; error: "COOLDOWN"; minutes: number }
  | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode | "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "REFUSED" };

/** Asks Priority once for the names of all the forms its API lets this key read. Reads only. */
export async function listPriorityFormsAction(): Promise<FormsList> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("settings.priority.view");
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(await getPriorityConnection(db), appSecret());
    if (!credentials) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_CONFIGURED" };
    const resting = await getCooldown(db);
    if (resting) return { ok: false, error: "COOLDOWN", minutes: minutesLeft(resting) };
    try {
      const data = await new OdataHttp(credentials).get<{ value?: { name?: string }[] }>("");
      const forms = (Array.isArray(data.value) ? data.value : [])
        .map((entry) => entry.name)
        .filter((name): name is string => typeof name === "string")
        .sort();
      return { ok: true, forms };
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof OdataError)) throw error;
      if (startsCooldown(error.code)) await startCooldown(db, error.code);
      return { ok: false, error: "REFUSED" };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    console.error("[settings] listing Priority's forms failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

const MAX_FORMS = 12;

/**
 * Asks the real Priority (whatever mode the system is in) for one row of each form, to show which
 * forms and fields it has. Reads only: nothing is sent to Priority except a request for data.
 */
export async function checkPriorityFormsAction(
  forms: string[],
  itemNumber?: string,
): Promise<FormsCheck> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("settings.priority.view");
    const names = z.array(z.string().trim().max(60)).max(MAX_FORMS).parse(forms);
    // Letters, digits and a few signs only, since it is put into the question to Priority.
    const item = z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/)
      .optional()
      .parse(itemNumber || undefined);
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(await getPriorityConnection(db), appSecret());
    if (!credentials) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_CONFIGURED" };
    // After a refusal Priority is left alone for a while: a wrong key counts as a failed sign-in,
    // and a few of those lock the account.
    const resting = await getCooldown(db);
    if (resting) return { ok: false, error: "COOLDOWN", minutes: minutesLeft(resting) };

    const http = new OdataHttp(credentials);
    const probes: FormProbe[] = [];
    let refused = false;
    for (const name of [...new Set(names)]) {
      if (refused) {
        probes.push(skippedProbe(name));
        continue;
      }
      const probe = await probeForm(http, name, item);
      probes.push(probe);
      // The first "no" (wrong key, or a locked account) ends the check and starts the rest.
      if (startsCooldown(probe.code)) {
        refused = true;
        await startCooldown(db, probe.code);
      }
    }
    return { ok: true, probes };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    console.error("[settings] checking Priority's forms failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

/**
 * Looks through one item's screens in the real Priority for the texts they hold, to find where a
 * text such as the storage text is kept. Reads only.
 */
export async function findItemTextsAction(itemNumber: string): Promise<FormsCheck> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("settings.priority.view");
    const item = z
      .string()
      .trim()
      .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/)
      .parse(itemNumber);
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(await getPriorityConnection(db), appSecret());
    if (!credentials) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_CONFIGURED" };
    const resting = await getCooldown(db);
    if (resting) return { ok: false, error: "COOLDOWN", minutes: minutesLeft(resting) };
    try {
      return { ok: true, probes: await findItemTexts(new OdataHttp(credentials), item) };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof OdataError && startsCooldown(error.code)) {
        await startCooldown(db, error.code);
        const minutes = minutesLeft((await getCooldown(db))!);
        return { ok: false, error: "COOLDOWN", minutes };
      }
      throw error;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    console.error("[settings] finding an item's texts failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

export type WriteCheck =
  | { ok: true; status: number | null; detail: string; ms: number }
  | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode | "NOT_CONFIGURED" };

/**
 * Asks Priority whether this key may write. Sends one request that cannot create anything (a line
 * of a made-up document with a made-up field) and reports Priority's answer. A refusal here does not
 * start the rest that follows a wrong key, since it only tells what the key may do.
 */
export async function checkPriorityWriteAction(): Promise<WriteCheck> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("settings.priority.view");
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(await getPriorityConnection(db), appSecret());
    if (!credentials) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_CONFIGURED" };
    const answer = await new OdataHttp(credentials).probeWrite(
      "DOCUMENTS_H(DOCNO='ZZ-WRITE-CHECK',TYPE='T')/TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM",
    );
    return { ok: true, ...answer };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    console.error("[settings] the write check failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}

export type TestBox =
  | { ok: true; barcode: string }
  | { ok: false; error: SettingsErrorCode | "NOT_CONFIGURED" | "INVALID_INPUT"; words?: string };

/**
 * One deliberate test: adds a single small box line to a receipt document in Priority, to see that
 * writing works. Only by the owner's own press; shows Priority's own words if it refuses.
 */
export async function sendTestBoxAction(docno: string, itemNumber: string): Promise<TestBox> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.priority.edit");
    const data = z
      .object({
        docno: z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/),
        item: z
          .string()
          .trim()
          .regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/),
      })
      .parse({ docno, item: itemNumber });
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(await getPriorityConnection(db), appSecret());
    if (!credentials) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_CONFIGURED" };
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/\D/g, "").slice(2, 14);
    const barcode = `ZZTEST${stamp}`;
    const expiry = new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    try {
      await postReceiptLine(new OdataHttp(credentials), {
        source: "production",
        docno: data.docno,
        barcode,
        itemNumber: data.item,
        weightKg: 0.01,
        expiryDate: expiry,
        warehouseCode: "Main",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const words = error instanceof OdataError ? error.detail : "";
      console.log(
        `[priority] test box refused: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : error} ${words}`,
      );
      return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC", words };
    }
    console.log(`[priority] test box accepted: ${data.docno} ${data.item} ${barcode}`);
    void access;
    return { ok: true, barcode };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
    console.error("[settings] the test box failed", error);
    return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
  }
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** A number typed in millimetres or points. Keeps what is being typed until the field is left. */
export function NumberField({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  step = 0.5,
  min,
  max,
  disabled,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  onChange: (value: number) => void;
  step?: number;
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {label}
      </Label>
      <Input
        id={id}
        type="number"
        inputMode="decimal"
        dir="ltr"
        step={step}
        min={min}
        max={max}
        disabled={disabled}
        className="h-9"
        value={draft ?? String(value)}
        onChange={(event) => {
          setDraft(event.target.value);
          const parsed = Number(event.target.value);
          if (event.target.value.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(parsed)) onChange(parsed);
        }}
        onBlur={() => setDraft(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A plain drop-down, styled like the inputs. */
export function SelectField({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Label htmlFor={id} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {label}
      </Label>
      <select
        id={id}
        value={value}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        {children}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few choices side by side, one chosen. */
export function Segmented<T extends string>({
  label,
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  disabled,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: T;
  options: { value: T; label: string }[];
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <span id={id} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
        {label}
      </span>
      <div role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby={id} className="flex rounded-lg bg-muted p-0.5">
        {options.map((option) => (
          <button
            key={option.value}
            type="button"
            role="radio"
            aria-checked={value === option.value}
            disabled={disabled}
            onClick={() => onChange(option.value)}
            className={cn(
              "h-8 flex-1 rounded-md px-2 text-xs font-medium transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-50",
              value === option.value
                ? "bg-card text-foreground shadow-card"
                : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
            )}
          >
            {option.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useRef } from "react";
import { moveBox, moveBoxes, resizeBox, type Box, type Handle } from "@/lib/labels/geometry";
import type { LabelElement, LabelValues } from "@/lib/labels/model";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { ElementView } from "@/components/labels/element-view";

const HANDLES: { handle: Handle; className: string; cursor: string }[] = [
  { handle: "nw", className: "-start-1 -top-1", cursor: "nwse-resize" },
  { handle: "n", className: "start-1/2 -top-1 -translate-x-1/2", cursor: "ns-resize" },
  { handle: "ne", className: "-end-1 -top-1", cursor: "nesw-resize" },
  { handle: "e", className: "-end-1 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2", cursor: "ew-resize" },
  { handle: "se", className: "-end-1 -bottom-1", cursor: "nwse-resize" },
  { handle: "s", className: "start-1/2 -bottom-1 -translate-x-1/2", cursor: "ns-resize" },
  { handle: "sw", className: "-start-1 -bottom-1", cursor: "nesw-resize" },
  { handle: "w", className: "-start-1 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2", cursor: "ew-resize" },
];

interface Gesture {
  /** The element that was grabbed. */
  id: string;
  kind: "move" | "resize";
  handle: Handle | null;
  startX: number;
  startY: number;
  /** Where every element that moves with the gesture was when it began. */
  starts: Record<string, Box>;
  started: boolean;
  /** Several were chosen and one of them was clicked: a click without a drag chooses just that one. */
  collapse: boolean;
}

/** Whether a key or click asks to add to the choice instead of replacing it. */
export const isAdditive = (event: { shiftKey: boolean; ctrlKey: boolean; metaKey: boolean }) =>
  event.shiftKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;

/**
 * The label at real proportions (`scale` pixels per millimetre) with its elements.
 * A label is a physical object, so the canvas is always left to right, also in
 * Hebrew: x counts from the left edge of the label. Dragging an element moves it
 * (all the chosen ones, when it is one of several), dragging a handle resizes it
 * (one chosen element); both snap to half a millimetre. Shift or Ctrl with a click
 * adds an element to the choice or takes it out.
 */
export function LabelCanvas({
  name,
  widthMm,
  heightMm,
  elements,
  selectedIds,
  scale,
  values,
  readOnly,
  describe,
  onPick,
  onCollapse,
  onClear,
  onFocusElement,
  onGestureStart,
  onBoxes,
}: {
  name: string;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  selectedIds: string[];
  scale: number;
  values: LabelValues;
  readOnly: boolean;
  /** The accessible name of an element, for example "Field: Slaughter date". */
  describe: (element: LabelElement) => string;
  /** An element was clicked (or Space/Enter pressed on it); `additive` adds or removes it. */
  onPick: (id: string, additive: boolean) => void;
  /** One of several chosen elements was clicked without dragging: choose just that one. */
  onCollapse: (id: string) => void;
  /** The empty part of the label was clicked: choose nothing. */
  onClear: () => void;
  /** An element got the keyboard focus (Tab): choose just that one. */
  onFocusElement: (id: string) => void;
  /** Called once when a drag or resize really starts, so it can be undone as one step. */
  onGestureStart: () => void;
  /** Called while dragging with the new position and size of what moves. */
  onBoxes: (boxes: Record<string, Box>) => void;
}) {
  const gesture = useRef<Gesture | null>(null);
  // True while the pointer itself moves the focus, so that focusing does not change the choice.
  const focusingByPointer = useRef(false);
  const bounds = { width: widthMm, height: heightMm };
  const chosen = new Set(selectedIds);

  function begin(
    event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>,
    element: LabelElement,
    kind: Gesture["kind"],
    handle: Handle | null,
  ) {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    event.stopPropagation();
    event.preventDefault();

    // The default is cancelled (no text selection while dragging), so the focus goes there by hand:
    // the keys (Delete, arrows, Ctrl+A) must work right after a click.
    focusingByPointer.current = true;
    (event.currentTarget.closest("[data-element-id]") as HTMLElement | null)?.focus({
      preventScroll: true,
    });
    focusingByPointer.current = false;

    if (kind === "move" && isAdditive(event)) return onPick(element.id, true);
    const group = kind === "move" && chosen.has(element.id) && chosen.size > 1;
    if (!group) onPick(element.id, false);
    if (readOnly) return;

    const moving = group ? elements.filter((e) => chosen.has(e.id)) : [element];
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    gesture.current = {
      id: element.id,
      kind,
      handle,
      startX: event.clientX,
      startY: event.clientY,
      starts: Object.fromEntries(
        moving.map((e) => [e.id, { x: e.x, y: e.y, w: e.w, h: e.h }] as const),
      ),
      started: false,
      collapse: group,
    };
  }

  function drag(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLElement>) {
    const g = gesture.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const dx = (event.clientX - g.startX) / scale;
    const dy = (event.clientY - g.startY) / scale;
    const ids = Object.keys(g.starts);
    let next: Record<string, Box>;
    if (g.kind === "resize") {
      next = { [g.id]: resizeBox(g.starts[g.id], g.handle!, dx, dy, bounds) };
    } else if (ids.length === 1) {
      next = { [g.id]: moveBox(g.starts[g.id], dx, dy, bounds) };
    } else {
      const moved = moveBoxes(
        ids.map((id) => g.starts[id]),
        dx,
        dy,
        bounds,
      );
      next = Object.fromEntries(ids.map((id, i) => [id, moved[i]] as const));
    }
    const changed = ids.some((id) => {
      const a = next[id];
      const b = g.starts[id];
      return a.x !== b.x || a.y !== b.y || a.w !== b.w || a.h !== b.h;
    });
    if (!changed && !g.started) return;
    if (!g.started) {
      g.started = true;
      onGestureStart();
    }
    onBoxes(next);
  }

  function end() {
    const g = gesture.current;
    gesture.current = null;
    if (g && !g.started && g.collapse) onCollapse(g.id);
  }

  return (
    <div
      dir="ltr"
      role="group"
      aria-label={name}
      data-testid="label-canvas"
      className="relative shrink-0 bg-white shadow-card ring-1 ring-border"
      style={{ width: widthMm * scale, height: heightMm * scale }}
      onPointerDown={(event) => {
        if (!isAdditive(event)) onClear();
      }}
    >
      {elements.map((element) => (
        <ElementView key={element.id} element={element} scale={scale} values={values} />
      ))}

      {elements.map((element) => {
        const selected = chosen.has(element.id);
        const alone = selected && chosen.size === 1;
        return (
          <div
            key={element.id}
            data-element-id={element.id}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            aria-label={describe(element)}
            aria-pressed={selected}
            onPointerDown={(event) => begin(event, element, "move", null)}
            onPointerMove={drag}
            onPointerUp={end}
            onPointerCancel={end}
            onFocus={() => {
              if (!focusingByPointer.current) onFocusElement(element.id);
            }}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              // Space or Enter chooses the element; with Shift or Ctrl it is added to the choice.
              if (event.key !== " " && event.key !== "Enter") return;
              event.preventDefault();
              onPick(element.id, isAdditive(event));
            }}
            className={cn(
              "absolute touch-none outline-none",
              readOnly ? "cursor-default" : "cursor-move",
              selected
                ? "z-10 ring-2 ring-primary"
                : "outline-1 outline-transparent outline-dashed hover:outline-gold/70",
            )}
            style={{
              left: element.x * scale,
              top: element.y * scale,
              width: element.w * scale,
              height: element.h * scale,
              // A hairline is hard to catch with a pointer: keep a small hit area.
              minWidth: 6,
              minHeight: 6,
            }}
          >
            {alone && !readOnly
              ? HANDLES.map(({ handle, className, cursor }) => (
                  <span
                    key={handle}
                    data-handle={handle}
                    onPointerDown={(event) => begin(event, element, "resize", handle)}
                    onPointerMove={drag}
                    onPointerUp={end}
                    onPointerCancel={end}
                    className={cn(
                      "absolute size-2.5 touch-none rounded-[2px] border border-primary bg-white",
                      className,
                    )}
                    style={{ cursor }}
                  />
                ))
              : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import {
````
