````tsx
"use client";

import { ImageUp, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { BRAND_VARIANTS, MAX_LOGO_BYTES, type BrandVariant } from "@/server/brand/shared";

/** The shape each preview is shown in, matching where the logo appears in the interface. */
const PREVIEW: Record<BrandVariant, { box: string; image: string; width: number; height: number }> =
  {
    light: { box: "bg-sidebar", image: "w-44", width: 1000, height: 500 },
    full: { box: "bg-card", image: "w-44 mix-blend-multiply", width: 1000, height: 500 },
    mark: { box: "bg-background", image: "size-20", width: 320, height: 320 },
  };

type UploadError = "INVALID_TYPE" | "TOO_LARGE" | "EMPTY" | "NOT_ALLOWED" | "GENERIC";

/** Replace or restore each of the three logo files. Reloads the page afterwards so the menu and login show the change. */
export function LogoCard({
  custom,
  canEdit,
}: {
  custom: Record<BrandVariant, boolean>;
  canEdit: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.logo");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<BrandVariant | null>(null);
  const inputs = useRef<Partial<Record<BrandVariant, HTMLInputElement | null>>>({});

  function fail(code: string) {
    const known: UploadError[] = ["INVALID_TYPE", "TOO_LARGE", "EMPTY", "NOT_ALLOWED"];
    toast.error(
      t(`errors.${known.includes(code as UploadError) ? (code as UploadError) : "GENERIC"}`),
    );
  }

  async function send(variant: BrandVariant, init: RequestInit) {
    setBusy(variant);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/brand/${variant}`, init);
      if (!response.ok) {
        const body = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string };
        fail(body.error ?? "GENERIC");
        return;
      }
      window.location.reload();
    } catch {
      fail("GENERIC");
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  function upload(variant: BrandVariant, file: File | undefined) {
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > MAX_LOGO_BYTES) return fail("TOO_LARGE");
    const form = new FormData();
    form.set("file", file);
    void send(variant, { method: "POST", body: form });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{t("title")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
          {BRAND_VARIANTS.map((variant) => {
            const preview = PREVIEW[variant];
            return (
              <div
                key={variant}
                className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border p-3"
              >
                <div className={cn("grid h-32 place-items-center rounded-xl", preview.box)}>
                  <Image
                    src={`/api/brand/${variant}`}
                    alt=""
                    width={preview.width}
                    height={preview.height}
                    unoptimized
                    className={cn("h-auto object-contain", preview.image)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-medium">{t(`variants.${variant}.name`)}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t(`variants.${variant}.hint`)}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant={custom[variant] ? "info" : "soft"}>
                    {custom[variant] ? t("custom") : t("original")}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                {canEdit ? (
                  <div className="mt-auto flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <input
                      ref={(el) => {
                        inputs.current[variant] = el;
                      }}
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp"
                      className="sr-only"
                      tabIndex={-1}
                      aria-label={t(`variants.${variant}.name`)}
                      onChange={(event) => {
                        upload(variant, event.target.files?.[0]);
                        event.target.value = "";
                      }}
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      disabled={busy !== null}
                      onClick={() => inputs.current[variant]?.click()}
                    >
                      <ImageUp data-icon="inline-start" />
                      {busy === variant ? t("uploading") : t("upload")}
                    </Button>
                    {custom[variant] ? (
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        disabled={busy !== null}
                        onClick={() => void send(variant, { method: "DELETE" })}
                      >
                        <Undo2 data-icon="inline-start" />
                        {t("restore")}
                      </Button>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{canEdit ? t("rules") : t("readOnly")}</p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Plus, Save, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { formatPackingWeight } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import type { PackagingType } from "@/server/packaging";
import {
  addPackagingTypeAction,
  deletePackagingTypeAction,
  updatePackagingTypeAction,
} from "./receiving-actions";

/** What a typed weight means: kilograms, with a comma or a point. Null when it is not a number. */
function parseKg(text: string): number | null {
  const value = Number(text.trim().replace(",", "."));
  return text.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : null;
}

/**
 * The kinds of packaging the goods are packed in, each with what one empty packaging weighs: a
 * small list, two to a row on a wide screen. Each item picks its type in the catalog; the scale
 * shows the box with its packaging, and the weight kept is without it.
 */
export function PackagingTypesCard({
  types,
  canEdit,
  index,
}: {
  types: PackagingType[];
  canEdit: boolean;
  index: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.packaging");
  const errors = useTranslations("settings.packaging.errors");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState("");

  function add() {
    const kg = parseKg(weight);
    if (kg === null) return void toast.error(errors("INVALID_WEIGHT"));
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await addPackagingTypeAction(name, kg);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(errors(result.error));
      setName("");
      setWeight("");
      toast.success(t("added"));
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card
      role="region"
      aria-label={t("title")}
      className="rise gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0"
      style={{ "--i": index } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 border-b border-border px-4 py-2.5">
        <h2 className="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">{t("title")}</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("description")}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-2 p-3">
        {types.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-2 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2" data-testid="packaging-list">
            {types.map((type) => (
              <TypeRow
                key={`${type.id}:${type.name}:${type.weightKg}`}
                type={type}
                canEdit={canEdit}
              />
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}

        {canEdit ? (
          <form
            className="flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-border pt-2"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              add();
            }}
          >
            <Input
              value={name}
              maxLength={60}
              autoComplete="off"
              aria-label={t("name")}
              placeholder={t("example")}
              data-testid="packaging-name"
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
              className="h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm"
            />
            <Input
              dir="ltr"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={weight}
              aria-label={t("weight")}
              placeholder={t("weight")}
              data-testid="packaging-weight"
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(event) => setWeight(event.target.value)}
              className="h-8 w-24 text-sm"
            />
            <Button
              type="submit"
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={pending || name.trim() === "" || weight.trim() === ""}
            >
              <Plus data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("add")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

function TypeRow({ type, canEdit }: { type: PackagingType; canEdit: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.packaging");
  const errors = useTranslations("settings.packaging.errors");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [name, setName] = useState(type.name);
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState(String(type.weightKg));
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);

  const kg = parseKg(weight);
  const changed = name.trim() !== type.name || kg !== type.weightKg;

  function save() {
    if (kg === null) return void toast.error(errors("INVALID_WEIGHT"));
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await updatePackagingTypeAction(type.id, name, kg);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(errors(result.error));
      toast.success(t("saved"));
    });
  }

  function remove() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await deletePackagingTypeAction(type.id);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(errors(result.error));
      toast.success(t("deleted", { count: result.items }));
    });
  }

  if (!canEdit) {
    return (
      <li className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm">
        <span dir="auto" className="truncate font-medium">
          {type.name}
        </span>
        <Badge variant="soft" className="tabular-nums">
          {formatPackingWeight(type.weightKg)} {common("kg")}
        </Badge>
      </li>
    );
  }

  return (
    <li
      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border px-2 py-1.5"
      data-testid="packaging-type"
    >
      <Input
        value={name}
        maxLength={60}
        aria-label={t("nameOf", { name: type.name })}
        disabled={pending}
        onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
        className="h-8 min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm"
      />
      <Input
        dir="ltr"
        inputMode="decimal"
        value={weight}
        aria-label={t("weightOf", { name: type.name })}
        disabled={pending}
        onChange={(event) => setWeight(event.target.value)}
        className="h-8 w-16 px-2 text-sm"
      />
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{common("kg")}</span>
      {confirming ? (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="xs"
            variant="destructive"
            title={t("confirmDelete")}
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={remove}
          >
            {t("yesDelete")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="xs"
            variant="ghost"
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}
          >
            {t("cancel")}
          </Button>
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span className="flex items-center">
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="icon-xs"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-label={t("saveOf", { name: type.name })}
            disabled={pending || !changed || name.trim() === "" || kg === null}
            onClick={save}
          >
            <Save />
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="icon-xs"
            variant="ghost"
            aria-label={t("deleteOf", { name: type.name })}
            disabled={pending}
            onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}
          >
            <Trash2 />
          </Button>
        </span>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { Building2, Cable, Printer, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SectionLayout } from "@/components/section-menu";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { brandStatus } from "@/server/brand";
import { getAlertSettings } from "@/server/alerts";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { requireScreen } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getStandInBehaviour } from "@/server/priority/behaviour";
import { getPriorityConnection } from "@/server/priority/settings";
import { categoryCounts } from "@/lib/catalog";
import { listLayouts, listLayoutsOfType } from "@/server/labels";
import { formatDateTime } from "@/lib/i18n/format";
import {
  getShippingSettings,
  getShippingToken,
  shippingStats,
} from "@/server/shipping-labels";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError } from "@/server/priority";
import { DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE, getCategoryWarehouses, getVendorOrder } from "@/server/receiving";
import { getPackagingTypes } from "@/server/packaging";
import { getShelfLives } from "@/server/shelf-lives";
import { getStorageTexts } from "@/server/storage-texts";
import { LabelsCard } from "./labels-card";
import { LogoCard } from "./logo-card";
import { PackagingTypesCard } from "./packaging-cards";
import { PriorityCard } from "./priority-card";
import { PriorityCheckCard } from "./priority-check-card";
import { CategoryWarehousesCard, VendorOrderCard } from "./receiving-cards";
import { ScaleCard } from "./scale-card";
import { ShippingCard } from "./shipping-card";
import { StandInCard } from "./stand-in-card";

const GROUPS = ["company", "priority", "receiving", "hardware"] as const;
type Group = (typeof GROUPS)[number];

const GROUP_ICONS: Record<Group, React.ComponentType> = {
  company: Building2,
  priority: Cable,
  receiving: Truck,
  hardware: Printer,
};

/**
 * System settings, in groups chosen from a side menu (a row of buttons on a
 * phone): the company logo and labels, the Priority connection, receiving, and
 * the scale and printer still to come. Each group appears for people allowed
 * to see something in it, and only the open group is loaded.
 */
export default async function SettingsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ section?: string }>;
}) {
  const access = await requireScreen("settings");
  const t = await getTranslations("settings");
  const nav = await getTranslations("nav");
  const screens = await getTranslations("screens");
  const shell = await getTranslations("shell.groups");
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS.settings;

  const showLogo = access.can("settings.labels.view") || access.can("settings.labels.edit");
  const showPriority = access.can("settings.priority.view") || access.can("settings.priority.edit");
  const showCategories =
    access.can("settings.categories.view") || access.can("settings.categories.edit");
  const showVendorOrder =
    access.can("settings.vendorOrder.view") || access.can("settings.vendorOrder.edit");
  const showHardware =
    access.can("settings.hardware.view") ||
    access.can("settings.hardware.edit") ||
    access.can("settings.hardware.scale");

  const allowed: Record<Group, boolean> = {
    company: showLogo,
    priority: showPriority,
    receiving: showCategories || showVendorOrder,
    hardware: showHardware,
  };
  const available = GROUPS.filter((group) => allowed[group]);
  const { section } = await searchParams;
  const open: Group | undefined = available.find((group) => group === section) ?? available[0];
  const href = (group: Group) =>
    group === available[0] ? "/settings" : `/settings?section=${group}`;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        icon={<Icon />}
        eyebrow={shell("system")}
        title={nav("settings")}
        description={screens("settings")}
        help={
          open === "company"
            ? "settingsCompany"
            : open === "priority"
              ? "settingsPriority"
              : open === "receiving"
                ? "settingsReceiving"
                : "settingsScale"
        }
      />

      {open ? (
        <SectionLayout
          label={t("groups.menu")}
          current={open}
          items={available.map((group) => {
            const GroupIcon = GROUP_ICONS[group];
            return {
              key: group,
              href: href(group),
              title: t(`groups.${group}.title`),
              hint: t(`groups.${group}.hint`),
              icon: <GroupIcon />,
            };
          })}
        >
          <section aria-labelledby="settings-group-title" className="space-y-6">
            <div className="rise space-y-1" style={{ "--i": 1 } as React.CSSProperties}>
              <h2 id="settings-group-title" className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">
                {t(`groups.${open}.title`)}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t(`groups.${open}.description`)}</p>
            </div>

            {open === "company" ? (
              <CompanyGroup canEdit={access.can("settings.labels.edit")} />
            ) : null}

            {open === "priority" ? (
              <PriorityGroup canEdit={access.can("settings.priority.edit")} />
            ) : null}

            {open === "receiving" ? (
              <ReceivingGroup
                showCategories={showCategories}
                showVendorOrder={showVendorOrder}
                canEditCategories={access.can("settings.categories.edit")}
                canEditVendorOrder={access.can("settings.vendorOrder.edit")}
              />
            ) : null}

            {open === "hardware" ? (
              <ScaleCard canConnect={access.can("settings.hardware.scale")} />
            ) : null}
          </section>
        </SectionLayout>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}

/** The company logo, and the way into the label designer. */
async function CompanyGroup({ canEdit }: { canEdit: boolean }) {
  const [status, layouts, shippingLayouts, shipping, stats] = await Promise.all([
    brandStatus(db),
    listLayouts(db),
    listLayoutsOfType(db, "shipping"),
    getShippingSettings(db),
    shippingStats(db),
  ]);
  // The address Priority calls is the address this page was opened at, plus the secret key. The key
  // is shown only to people who may change it.
  const token = canEdit ? await getShippingToken(db) : null;
  const requestHeaders = await headers();
  const host = requestHeaders.get("x-forwarded-host") ?? requestHeaders.get("host") ?? "localhost:3000";
  const proto =
    requestHeaders.get("x-forwarded-proto") ?? (host.startsWith("localhost") ? "http" : "https");
  return (
    <>
      <LogoCard
        custom={{
          light: status.light.custom,
          full: status.full.custom,
          mark: status.mark.custom,
        }}
        canEdit={canEdit}
      />
      <LabelsCard count={layouts.length} index={3} />
      <ShippingCard
        origin={`${proto}://${host}`}
        token={token}
        canEdit={canEdit}
        defaultCount={shipping.defaultCount}
        defaultUnit={shipping.defaultUnit}
        palletCopies={shipping.palletCopies}
        layoutId={shipping.layoutId}
        layouts={shippingLayouts.map((layout) => ({ id: layout.id, name: layout.name }))}
        received={stats.received}
        lastReceivedAt={stats.lastReceivedAt ? formatDateTime(stats.lastReceivedAt) : null}
        index={4}
      />
    </>
  );
}

/** The Priority connection, the data check, and the stand-in's behaviour. */
async function PriorityGroup({ canEdit }: { canEdit: boolean }) {
  const [connection, behaviour] = await Promise.all([
    getPriorityConnection(db),
    getStandInBehaviour(db),
  ]);
  return (
    <>
      <PriorityCard
        live={process.env.PRIORITY_MODE === "live"}
        baseUrl={connection.baseUrl}
        hasKey={connection.apiUserEnc !== null || Boolean(connection.apiUser)}
        hasPassword={connection.passwordEnc !== null}
        canEdit={canEdit}
      />
      <PriorityCheckCard configured={Boolean(connection.baseUrl)} />
      <StandInCard
        mode={behaviour.mode}
        delaySeconds={Math.round(behaviour.delayMs / 1000)}
        canEdit={canEdit}
      />
    </>
  );
}

/** The storage room and alert days per category, and the vendor receiving order. */
async function ReceivingGroup({
  showCategories,
  showVendorOrder,
  canEditCategories,
  canEditVendorOrder,
}: {
  showCategories: boolean;
  showVendorOrder: boolean;
  canEditCategories: boolean;
  canEditVendorOrder: boolean;
}) {
  // What the two cards list comes from Priority; when it does not answer they say so.
  let priorityDown = false;
  let categories: { category: string; count: number }[] = [];
  let warehouses: { code: string; name: string }[] = [];
  let vendorOrders: { docno: string; date: string }[] = [];
  try {
    const priority = getPriorityClient();
    const [items, houses, orders] = await Promise.all([
      priority.getItems(),
      priority.getWarehouses(),
      priority.getOrders(),
    ]);
    categories = categoryCounts(items);
    warehouses = houses;
    vendorOrders = orders
      .filter((o) => o.kind === "vendor")
      .map((o) => ({ docno: o.docno, date: o.date }));
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof PriorityError) || error.code !== "UNAVAILABLE") throw error;
    priorityDown = true;
  }
  const categoryChoices = showCategories ? await getCategoryWarehouses(db) : {};
  const alerts = showCategories ? await getAlertSettings(db) : null;
  const storageTexts = showCategories ? await getStorageTexts(db) : {};
  const shelfLives = showCategories ? await getShelfLives(db) : {};
  const packagingTypes = showCategories ? await getPackagingTypes(db) : [];
  const vendorChoice = showVendorOrder ? ((await getVendorOrder(db)) ?? "") : "";
  // A saved choice stays visible even when Priority cannot be asked right now.
  if (priorityDown) {
    categories = [
      ...new Set([
        ...Object.keys(categoryChoices),
        ...Object.keys(alerts?.byCategory ?? {}),
        ...Object.keys(storageTexts),
        ...Object.keys(shelfLives),
      ]),
    ].map((category) => ({ category, count: 0 }));
    warehouses = [...new Set(Object.values(categoryChoices))].map((code) => ({ code, name: code }));
    vendorOrders = vendorChoice ? [{ docno: vendorChoice, date: "" }] : [];
  }

  return (
    <>
      {showVendorOrder ? (
        <VendorOrderCard
          orders={vendorOrders}
          chosen={vendorChoice}
          canEdit={canEditVendorOrder}
          priorityDown={priorityDown}
          index={2}
        />
      ) : null}

      {showCategories ? (
        <PackagingTypesCard types={packagingTypes} canEdit={canEditCategories} index={3} />
      ) : null}

      {showCategories ? (
        <CategoryWarehousesCard
          categories={categories}
          warehouses={warehouses}
          chosen={categoryChoices}
          alertDays={alerts?.byCategory ?? {}}
          defaultAlertDays={alerts?.defaultDays ?? 7}
          storageTexts={storageTexts}
          shelfLives={shelfLives}
          defaultWarehouse={
            warehouses.find((w) => w.code === DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE)?.name ?? DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE
          }
          canEdit={canEditCategories}
          priorityDown={priorityDown}
          index={3}
        />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { CircleCheck, CircleX, PlugZap, Settings2, Unplug } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { DialogTitleBlock } from "@/components/dialog-parts";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogFooter } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  savePriorityConnectionAction,
  testPriorityConnectionAction,
  type ConnectionTest,
  type SettingsErrorCode,
} from "./actions";

export interface PriorityCardProps {
  /** Whether this system reads the real Priority (PRIORITY_MODE=live) or the stand-in with sample data. */
  live: boolean;
  baseUrl: string;
  /** Whether an access key is saved; the key itself never reaches the browser. */
  hasKey: boolean;
  hasPassword: boolean;
  canEdit: boolean;
}

/** How to reach Priority. Until phase 6 the stand-in answers; the details are stored for then. */
export function PriorityCard(props: PriorityCardProps) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.priority");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [testing, startTest] = useTransition();
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ConnectionTest | null>(null);

  const notSet = t("notSet");

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{t("title")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-5">
        <dl className="grid gap-x-8 gap-y-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Row label={t("mode")}>
            <Badge variant={props.live ? "success" : "info"} data-testid="priority-mode">
              <PlugZap />
              {props.live ? t("modeLive") : t("modeFake")}
            </Badge>
          </Row>
          <Row label={t("address")}>
            {props.baseUrl ? (
              <span dir="ltr" className="break-all">
                {props.baseUrl}
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">{notSet}</span>
            )}
          </Row>
          <Row label={t("key")}>
            {props.hasKey ? (
              <Badge variant="success">
                <CircleCheck />
                {t("keySaved")}
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">{notSet}</span>
            )}
          </Row>
          <Row label={t("password")}>
            {props.hasPassword ? (
              <Badge variant="success">
                <CircleCheck />
                {t("passwordSaved")}
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">{notSet}</span>
            )}
          </Row>
        </dl>

        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {props.live ? t("liveNoteLive") : t("liveNote")}
        </p>

        {result ? (
          <Alert variant={result.ok ? "default" : "destructive"}>
            {result.ok ? <CircleCheck /> : <CircleX />}
            <AlertDescription>
              {result.ok
                ? t("testOk", { count: result.warehouses, ms: result.ms })
                : t(`errors.${result.error}`)}
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            disabled={testing}
            onClick={() => startTest(async () => setResult(await testPriorityConnectionAction()))}
          >
            <Unplug data-icon="inline-start" />
            {testing ? t("testing") : t("test")}
          </Button>
          {props.canEdit ? (
            <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
              <Settings2 data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("edit")}
            </Button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </CardContent>

      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        {open ? <ConnectionForm {...props} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} /> : null}
      </Dialog>
    </Card>
  );
}

function Row({ label, children }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <dt className="text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.16em] text-gold uppercase">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-sm">{children}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

function ConnectionForm({
  baseUrl: initialUrl,
  hasKey,
  hasPassword,
  onClose,
}: PriorityCardProps & { onClose: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.priority");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<SettingsErrorCode | null>(null);
  const [baseUrl, setBaseUrl] = useState(initialUrl);
  const [apiUser, setApiUser] = useState("");
  const [removeKey, setRemoveKey] = useState(false);
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [removePassword, setRemovePassword] = useState(false);

  function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await savePriorityConnectionAction({
        baseUrl,
        // Untouched leaves the saved key and password; typing replaces them; the boxes remove them.
        apiUser: removeKey ? "" : apiUser || undefined,
        password: removePassword ? "" : password || undefined,
      });
      if (!result.ok) return setError(result.error);
      toast.success(t("saved"));
      router.refresh();
      onClose();
    });
  }

  return (
    <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
      <DialogTitleBlock
        icon={<Settings2 />}
        title={t("editTitle")}
        description={t("editDescription")}
      />
      <form id="priority-form" onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4" noValidate>
        {error ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{t(`errors.${error}`)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="priority-url">{t("address")}</Label>
          <Input
            id="priority-url"
            dir="ltr"
            inputMode="url"
            value={baseUrl}
            onChange={(e) => setBaseUrl(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="https://"
            autoComplete="off"
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("addressHint")}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="priority-user">{t("key")}</Label>
          <Input
            id="priority-user"
            type="password"
            dir="ltr"
            value={apiUser}
            onChange={(e) => setApiUser(e.target.value)}
            disabled={removeKey}
            placeholder={hasKey ? t("keyKeep") : undefined}
            autoComplete="new-password"
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("keyHint")}</p>
          {hasKey ? (
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <Checkbox
                checked={removeKey}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) => setRemoveKey(checked === true)}
              />
              {t("keyRemove")}
            </label>
          ) : null}
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="priority-password">{t("password")}</Label>
          <Input
            id="priority-password"
            type="password"
            dir="ltr"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            disabled={removePassword}
            placeholder={hasPassword ? t("passwordKeep") : undefined}
            autoComplete="new-password"
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("passwordHint")}</p>
          {hasPassword ? (
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <Checkbox
                checked={removePassword}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) => setRemovePassword(checked === true)}
              />
              {t("passwordRemove")}
            </label>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </form>
      <DialogFooter>
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="lg" onClick={onClose} disabled={pending}>
          {t("cancel")}
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit" form="priority-form" size="lg" disabled={pending}>
          {pending ? t("saving") : t("save")}
        </Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { CircleCheck, CircleX, ClipboardCopy, SearchCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import type { FormProbe } from "@/server/priority/odata";
import {
  checkPriorityFormsAction,
  checkPriorityWriteAction,
  sendTestBoxAction,
  findItemTextsAction,
  listPriorityFormsAction,
  type FormsCheck,
  type FormsList,
  type TestBox,
  type WriteCheck,
} from "./actions";

/** The forms the plan names; each is asked once. */
const FORMS = [
  "LOGPART",
  "WAREHOUSES",
  "PARTBAL",
  "DOCUMENTS_H/TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM",
  "WAREHOUSESZOOM",
  "WARHSTYPE",
  "USERWARHS",
  "FLOORWARHS",
  "LOCATIONSINWARHS",
  "STORAGEZONES",
] as const;

/** The answers as plain text, to paste into a message. Never contains the access key. */
function asText(probes: FormProbe[]): string {
  return probes
    .map((probe) => {
      if (probe.skipped) return `${probe.form}: NOT ASKED (to protect the account)`;
      const head = `${probe.form}: ${probe.ok ? "OK" : `FAILED ${probe.status ?? ""} ${probe.code ?? ""}`.trim()}`;
      if (!probe.ok) return `${head}\n  ${probe.error ?? ""}`;
      const lines = probe.fields.map((field) => `  ${field} = ${probe.sample[field] ?? ""}`);
      const varying = Object.entries(probe.varying ?? {}).map(
        ([field, values]) => `  DIFFERS ${field}: ${values.join(" | ")}`,
      );
      return [head, probe.error ? `  (${probe.error})` : "", ...lines, ...varying]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join("\n");
    })
    .join("\n\n");
}

/**
 * Asks the real Priority which forms and fields it has, so what the system reads is checked
 * against Priority and never guessed. Reads only; nothing is changed in Priority.
 */
export function PriorityCheckCard({ configured }: { configured: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.priorityCheck");
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [form, setForm] = useState("");
  const [item, setItem] = useState("");
  const [list, setList] = useState<FormsList | null>(null);

  async function copyList(forms: string[]) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(forms.join("\n"));
      toast.success(t("copied"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("copyFailed"));
    }
  }
  const [result, setResult] = useState<FormsCheck | null>(null);
  const [writeResult, setWriteResult] = useState<WriteCheck | null>(null);
  const [testDoc, setTestDoc] = useState("AS26000062");
  const [testItem, setTestItem] = useState("N2015D-S");
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<TestBox | null>(null);

  function check(forms: string[], item?: string) {
    startTransition(async () => setResult(await checkPriorityFormsAction(forms, item)));
  }

  async function copy(probes: FormProbe[]) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(asText(probes));
      toast.success(t("copied"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("copyFailed"));
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 3 } as React.CSSProperties}>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{t("title")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{t("description")}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-5">
        {!configured ? <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("notConfigured")}</p> : null}

        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("listHelp")}</p>
          <Button
            disabled={pending || !configured}
            onClick={() => startTransition(async () => setList(await listPriorityFormsAction()))}
          >
            <SearchCheck data-icon="inline-start" />
            {pending ? t("checking") : t("listForms")}
          </Button>
          {list && !list.ok ? (
            <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" data-testid="priority-list-error">
              <AlertDescription>
                {list.error === "COOLDOWN"
                  ? t("errors.COOLDOWN", { minutes: list.minutes })
                  : list.error === "REFUSED"
                    ? t("listRefused")
                    : t(`errors.${list.error}`)}
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          ) : null}
          {list?.ok ? (
            <div className="space-y-2" data-testid="priority-forms-list">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => copyList(list.forms)}>
                <ClipboardCopy data-icon="inline-start" />
                {t("copyList", { count: list.forms.length })}
              </Button>
              <p
                dir="ltr"
                className="max-h-40 overflow-auto font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground"
              >
                {list.forms.join(", ")}
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-border p-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("writeHelp")}</p>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            disabled={pending || !configured}
            onClick={() =>
              startTransition(async () => setWriteResult(await checkPriorityWriteAction()))
            }
          >
            <SearchCheck data-icon="inline-start" />
            {pending ? t("checking") : t("checkWrite")}
          </Button>
          <form
            className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              startTransition(async () =>
                setTestResult(await sendTestBoxAction(testDoc, testItem)),
              );
            }}
          >
            <p className="w-full text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("testBoxHelp")}</p>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="test-doc" className="text-xs">
                {t("testDoc")}
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="test-doc"
                dir="ltr"
                value={testDoc}
                onChange={(event) => setTestDoc(event.target.value)}
                className="h-10 w-44"
                autoComplete="off"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="test-item" className="text-xs">
                {t("testItem")}
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="test-item"
                dir="ltr"
                value={testItem}
                onChange={(event) => setTestItem(event.target.value)}
                className="h-10 w-44"
                autoComplete="off"
              />
            </div>
            <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={pending || !configured}>
              {t("sendTestBox")}
            </Button>
          </form>
          {testResult ? (
            <p
              dir="ltr"
              data-testid="priority-test-box-result"
              className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs break-words"
            >
              {testResult.ok
                ? `OK · ${testResult.barcode}`
                : `${testResult.error} · ${testResult.words ?? ""}`}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {writeResult ? (
            <p
              dir="ltr"
              data-testid="priority-write-result"
              className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs break-words"
            >
              {writeResult.ok
                ? `${writeResult.status ?? "no answer"} · ${writeResult.detail} · ${writeResult.ms} ms`
                : writeResult.error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
          <Button disabled={pending || !configured} onClick={() => check([...FORMS])}>
            <SearchCheck data-icon="inline-start" />
            {pending ? t("checking") : t("checkAll", { forms: FORMS.join(", ") })}
          </Button>
          <form
            className="flex items-end gap-2"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              const names = form
                .split(/[\s,;]+/)
                .map((name) => name.trim())
                .filter(Boolean);
              if (names.length > 0) check(names);
            }}
          >
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="priority-form-name" className="text-xs">
                {t("another")}
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="priority-form-name"
                dir="ltr"
                value={form}
                onChange={(event) => setForm(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="LOGPART, PARTPARAM"
                autoComplete="off"
                className="h-10 w-72"
              />
            </div>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="outline"
              disabled={pending || !configured || !form.trim()}
            >
              {t("checkOne")}
            </Button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <form
          className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (item.trim()) check(["LOGPART", "PARTBAL"], item.trim());
          }}
        >
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="priority-item-number" className="text-xs">
              {t("itemNumber")}
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="priority-item-number"
              dir="ltr"
              value={item}
              onChange={(event) => setItem(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="I2536F-S"
              autoComplete="off"
              className="h-10 w-48"
            />
          </div>
          <Button
            type="submit"
            variant="outline"
            disabled={pending || !configured || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/.test(item.trim())}
          >
            {t("checkItem")}
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            disabled={pending || !configured || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/.test(item.trim())}
            onClick={() =>
              startTransition(async () => setResult(await findItemTextsAction(item.trim())))
            }
          >
            <SearchCheck data-icon="inline-start" />
            {t("findTexts")}
          </Button>
        </form>

        {result && !result.ok ? (
          <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" data-testid="priority-check-error">
            <AlertDescription>
              {result.error === "COOLDOWN"
                ? t("errors.COOLDOWN", { minutes: result.minutes })
                : t(`errors.${result.error}`)}
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        ) : null}

        {result?.ok ? (
          <div className="space-y-3" data-testid="priority-probes">
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => copy(result.probes)}>
                <ClipboardCopy data-icon="inline-start" />
                {t("copy")}
              </Button>
            </div>
            {result.probes.map((probe) => (
              <details
                key={probe.form}
                className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card"
                open={!probe.ok && !probe.skipped}
              >
                <summary className="flex cursor-pointer list-none flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 py-3 outline-none focus-visible:bg-muted/60 [&::-webkit-details-marker]:hidden">
                  <span dir="ltr" className="font-mono text-sm font-semibold">
                    {probe.form}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {probe.skipped ? (
                      <Badge variant="outline">{t("skipped")}</Badge>
                    ) : probe.ok ? (
                      <Badge variant="success">
                        <CircleCheck />
                        {t("fieldsFound", { count: probe.fields.length })}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : (
                      <Badge variant="destructive">
                        <CircleX />
                        {probe.status ?? t("noAnswer")}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                      {t("time", { ms: probe.ms })}
                    </span>
                  </span>
                </summary>
                <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-border px-4 py-3 text-sm">
                  {probe.skipped ? (
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("skippedWhy")}</p>
                  ) : null}
                  {probe.error ? <p className="text-muted-foreground">{probe.error}</p> : null}
                  {probe.code === "AUTH_FAILED" || probe.code === "RATE_LIMITED" ? (
                    <p className="font-medium" data-testid="priority-refusal">
                      {t(`refusal.${probe.code}`)}
                    </p>
                  ) : null}
                  {probe.varying && Object.keys(probe.varying).length > 0 ? (
                    <dl dir="ltr" className="space-y-1 font-mono text-xs">
                      {Object.entries(probe.varying).map(([field, values]) => (
                        <div key={field} className="flex min-w-0 gap-2">
                          <dt className="shrink-0 font-semibold">{field}</dt>
                          <dd className="text-muted-foreground">{values.join(" | ")}</dd>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </dl>
                  ) : null}
                  {probe.fields.length > 0 ? (
                    <dl dir="ltr" className="grid gap-x-6 gap-y-1 font-mono text-xs sm:grid-cols-2">
                      {probe.fields.map((field) => (
                        <div key={field} className="flex min-w-0 gap-2">
                          <dt className="shrink-0 font-semibold">{field}</dt>
                          <dd className="truncate text-muted-foreground">{probe.sample[field]}</dd>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </dl>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              </details>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````ts
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { AlertsError, setCategoryAlertDays } from "@/server/alerts";
import { setCategoryShelfLife, ShelfLifeError } from "@/server/shelf-lives";
import { setCategoryStorageText, StorageTextError } from "@/server/storage-texts";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import {
  PackagingError,
  addPackagingType,
  deletePackagingType,
  updatePackagingType,
  type PackagingErrorCode,
} from "@/server/packaging";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import { getPriorityClient, PriorityError } from "@/server/priority";
import { ReceivingError, setCategoryWarehouse, setVendorOrder } from "@/server/receiving";

export type ReceivingSettingsError =
  "NOT_ALLOWED" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "INVALID_ORDER" | "UNAVAILABLE" | "UNKNOWN" | "GENERIC";

type Result = { ok: true } | { ok: false; error: ReceivingSettingsError };

function failure(error: unknown, what: string): Result {
  if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
  if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
  if (error instanceof PriorityError && error.code === "UNAVAILABLE")
    return { ok: false, error: "UNAVAILABLE" };
  if (error instanceof ReceivingError && error.code === "INVALID_ORDER")
    return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_ORDER" };
  if (
    error instanceof ReceivingError &&
    (error.code === "UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE" || error.code === "UNKNOWN_ORDER")
  )
    return { ok: false, error: "UNKNOWN" };
  console.error(`[settings] ${what} failed`, error);
  return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
}

/** Chooses (or with an empty code clears) the storage room a category's boxes go into. */
export async function setCategoryWarehouseAction(
  category: string,
  warehouseCode: string,
): Promise<Result> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const data = z
      .object({ category: z.string().max(200), warehouseCode: z.string().max(100) })
      .parse({ category, warehouseCode });
    await setCategoryWarehouse(
      db,
      getPriorityClient(),
      data.category,
      data.warehouseCode || null,
      access.actor,
    );
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error, "choosing a storage room");
  }
}

/**
 * Chooses (or with an empty value clears) the order all vendor boxes go under. Any order number
 * can be typed; "listed" says whether Priority lists it right now.
 */
export async function setVendorOrderAction(
  docno: string,
): Promise<{ ok: true; listed: boolean | null } | { ok: false; error: ReceivingSettingsError }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.vendorOrder.edit");
    const value = z.string().max(100).parse(docno);
    const { listed } = await setVendorOrder(
      db,
      getPriorityClient(),
      value.trim() || null,
      access.actor,
    );
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    return { ok: true, listed };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error, "choosing the vendor order") as {
      ok: false;
      error: ReceivingSettingsError;
    };
  }
}

/** Sets (or with null clears) how many days before expiry a category's boxes count as about to expire. */
export async function setCategoryAlertDaysAction(
  category: string,
  days: number | null,
): Promise<Result | { ok: false; error: "INVALID_DAYS" }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const data = z
      .object({ category: z.string().max(200), days: z.number().nullable() })
      .parse({ category, days });
    await setCategoryAlertDays(db, data.category, data.days, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/dashboard");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AlertsError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_DAYS" };
    return failure(error, "setting the alert days");
  }
}

/** Sets (or with an empty text clears) the storage text a category's labels print. */
export async function setCategoryStorageTextAction(
  category: string,
  text: string,
): Promise<Result | { ok: false; error: "TOO_LONG" }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const data = z
      .object({ category: z.string().max(200), text: z.string().max(2000) })
      .parse({ category, text });
    await setCategoryStorageText(db, data.category, data.text, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/catalog");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof StorageTextError) return { ok: false, error: "TOO_LONG" };
    return failure(error, "setting the storage text");
  }
}

/** Sets (or with null clears) the days from the slaughter date to the expiry date for a category. */
export async function setCategoryShelfLifeAction(
  category: string,
  days: number | null,
): Promise<Result | { ok: false; error: "INVALID_DAYS" }> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const data = z
      .object({ category: z.string().max(200), days: z.number().nullable() })
      .parse({ category, days });
    await setCategoryShelfLife(db, data.category, data.days, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/catalog");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof ShelfLifeError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_DAYS" };
    return failure(error, "setting the shelf life");
  }
}

type PackagingResult<T = object> =
  ({ ok: true } & T) | { ok: false; error: ReceivingSettingsError | PackagingErrorCode };

function packagingFailure(
  error: unknown,
  what: string,
): { ok: false; error: ReceivingSettingsError | PackagingErrorCode } {
  if (error instanceof PackagingError) return { ok: false, error: error.code };
  return failure(error, what) as { ok: false; error: ReceivingSettingsError };
}

const typeSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().max(200),
  weightKg: z.number().finite(),
});

/** Adds a kind of carton with its weight. */
export async function addPackagingTypeAction(
  name: string,
  weightKg: number,
): Promise<PackagingResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const data = typeSchema.parse({ name, weightKg });
    await addPackagingType(db, data, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return packagingFailure(error, "adding a kind of carton");
  }
}

/** Changes the name and weight of a kind of carton. */
export async function updatePackagingTypeAction(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  weightKg: number,
): Promise<PackagingResult> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const data = typeSchema.parse({ name, weightKg });
    await updatePackagingType(db, z.string().max(100).parse(id), data, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/receiving");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return packagingFailure(error, "changing a kind of carton");
  }
}

/** Deletes a kind of packaging; the items that used it go back to none. */
export async function deletePackagingTypeAction(
  id: string,
): Promise<PackagingResult<{ items: number }>> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.categories.edit");
    const items = await deletePackagingType(db, z.string().max(100).parse(id), access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/catalog");
    revalidatePath("/receiving");
    return { ok: true, items };
  } catch (error) {
    return packagingFailure(error, "deleting a kind of carton");
  }
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { CloudOff } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  setCategoryAlertDaysAction,
  setCategoryShelfLifeAction,
  setCategoryStorageTextAction,
  setCategoryWarehouseAction,
  setVendorOrderAction,
} from "./receiving-actions";

const SELECT_CLASS =
  "h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-60 sm:w-72";

function CardShell({
  title,
  description,
  index,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  index: number;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <Card
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
      className="rise gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0"
      style={{ "--i": index } as React.CSSProperties}
    >
      <div className="space-y-1 border-b border-border px-5 py-4">
        <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{title}</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
      </div>
      {children}
    </Card>
  );
}

function Unavailable({ text }: { text: string }) {
  return (
    <p className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-border bg-warning-soft px-5 py-3 text-sm text-warning">
      <CloudOff className="size-4 shrink-0" />
      {text}
    </p>
  );
}

/** Which storage room each category's boxes go into; a choice is saved at once. */
export function CategoryWarehousesCard({
  categories,
  warehouses,
  chosen: initial,
  defaultWarehouse,
  alertDays: initialDays,
  defaultAlertDays,
  storageTexts: initialTexts,
  shelfLives: initialLives,
  canEdit,
  priorityDown,
  index,
}: {
  categories: { category: string; count: number }[];
  warehouses: { code: string; name: string }[];
  chosen: Record<string, string>;
  defaultWarehouse: string;
  /** Days before expiry that count as "about to expire", for the categories that have their own. */
  alertDays: Record<string, number>;
  defaultAlertDays: number;
  /** The storage text each category's labels print when Priority gives the item none. */
  storageTexts: Record<string, string>;
  /** Days from the slaughter date to the expiry date, for the categories that have them. */
  shelfLives: Record<string, number>;
  canEdit: boolean;
  priorityDown: boolean;
  index: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.categoryWarehouses");
  const errors = useTranslations("settings.receivingErrors");
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(initial);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function choose(category: string, code: string) {
    const before = chosen;
    setChosen((current) => {
      const next = { ...current };
      if (code) next[category] = code;
      else delete next[category];
      return next;
    });
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setCategoryWarehouseAction(category, code);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setChosen(before);
        return void toast.error(errors(result.error));
      }
      toast.success(t("saved"));
    });
  }

  // Typing is local; the number is saved when the box is left. An empty box means the default.
  const [savedDays, setSavedDays] = useState(initialDays);
  const [days, setDays] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(initialDays).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value)])),
  );

  function saveDays(category: string) {
    const text = (days[category] ?? "").trim();
    const value = text === "" ? null : Number(text);
    const before = savedDays[category] ?? null;
    if (value === before) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setCategoryAlertDaysAction(category, value);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setDays((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: before === null ? "" : String(before) }));
        return void toast.error(
          result.error === "INVALID_DAYS" ? t("invalidDays") : errors(result.error),
        );
      }
      setSavedDays((current) => {
        const next = { ...current };
        if (value === null) delete next[category];
        else next[category] = value;
        return next;
      });
      toast.success(t("daysSaved"));
    });
  }

  // The shelf life: typed here, saved when the box is left. An empty box means none.
  const [savedLives, setSavedLives] = useState(initialLives);
  const [lives, setLives] = useState<Record<string, string>>(
    Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(initialLives).map(([key, value]) => [key, String(value)])),
  );

  function saveLife(category: string) {
    const text = (lives[category] ?? "").trim();
    const value = text === "" ? null : Number(text);
    const before = savedLives[category] ?? null;
    if (value === before) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setCategoryShelfLifeAction(category, value);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setLives((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: before === null ? "" : String(before) }));
        return void toast.error(
          result.error === "INVALID_DAYS" ? t("invalidShelfLife") : errors(result.error),
        );
      }
      setSavedLives((current) => {
        const next = { ...current };
        if (value === null) delete next[category];
        else next[category] = value;
        return next;
      });
      toast.success(t("shelfLifeSaved"));
    });
  }

  // Like the days: typed here, saved when the box is left. An empty box means none.
  const [savedTexts, setSavedTexts] = useState(initialTexts);
  const [texts, setTexts] = useState(initialTexts);

  function saveText(category: string) {
    const value = (texts[category] ?? "").trim();
    const before = savedTexts[category] ?? "";
    if (value === before) return;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setCategoryStorageTextAction(category, value);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setTexts((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: before }));
        return void toast.error(
          result.error === "TOO_LONG" ? t("storageTooLong") : errors(result.error),
        );
      }
      setSavedTexts((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: value }));
      toast.success(t("storageSaved"));
    });
  }

  const label = (category: string) => (category === "" ? t("uncategorized") : category);
  return (
    <CardShell
      title={t("title")}
      description={t("description", { warehouse: defaultWarehouse, days: defaultAlertDays })}
      index={index}
    >
      {priorityDown ? <Unavailable text={t("unavailable")} /> : null}
      {categories.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="px-6 py-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">{t("empty")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
          {categories.map(({ category, count }) => (
            <li
              key={category || "none"}
              className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-2 px-5 py-3"
            >
              <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
                <span dir="auto" className="truncate font-medium">
                  {label(category)}
                </span>
                <Badge variant="soft" className="tabular-nums">
                  {t("items", { count })}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-3 sm:w-auto">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("shelfLife")}
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    min={1}
                    max={3650}
                    dir="ltr"
                    aria-label={t("shelfLifeFor", { category: label(category) })}
                    placeholder="—"
                    value={lives[category] ?? ""}
                    disabled={!canEdit || pending}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setLives((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: event.target.value }))
                    }
                    onBlur={() => saveLife(category)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter") event.currentTarget.blur();
                    }}
                    className="h-10 w-24"
                  />
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("alertDays")}
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    min={1}
                    max={365}
                    dir="ltr"
                    aria-label={t("alertDaysFor", { category: label(category) })}
                    placeholder={String(defaultAlertDays)}
                    value={days[category] ?? ""}
                    disabled={!canEdit || pending}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setDays((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: event.target.value }))
                    }
                    onBlur={() => saveDays(category)}
                    onKeyDown={(event) => {
                      if (event.key === "Enter") event.currentTarget.blur();
                    }}
                    className="h-10 w-20"
                  />
                </label>
                <select
                  aria-label={t("choose", { category: label(category) })}
                  value={chosen[category] ?? ""}
                  disabled={!canEdit || pending || priorityDown}
                  onChange={(event) => choose(category, event.target.value)}
                  className={SELECT_CLASS}
                >
                  <option value="">{t("automatic", { warehouse: defaultWarehouse })}</option>
                  {warehouses.map((w) => (
                    <option key={w.code} value={w.code}>
                      {w.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <label className="w-full space-y-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                <span>{t("storageText")}</span>
                <textarea
                  dir="rtl"
                  rows={2}
                  maxLength={300}
                  aria-label={t("storageTextFor", { category: label(category) })}
                  placeholder={t("storagePlaceholder")}
                  value={texts[category] ?? ""}
                  disabled={!canEdit || pending}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setTexts((current) => ({ ...current, [category]: event.target.value }))
                  }
                  onBlur={() => saveText(category)}
                  className="block w-full resize-y rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-60"
                />
              </label>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </CardShell>
  );
}

/** The one order every vendor box is received under. */
export function VendorOrderCard({
  orders,
  chosen: initial,
  canEdit,
  priorityDown,
  index,
}: {
  orders: { docno: string; date: string }[];
  chosen: string;
  canEdit: boolean;
  priorityDown: boolean;
  index: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.vendorOrderCard");
  const errors = useTranslations("settings.receivingErrors");
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(initial);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");

  function choose(docno: string, fromTyping = false) {
    const before = chosen;
    setChosen(docno);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await setVendorOrderAction(docno);
      if (!result.ok) {
        setChosen(before);
        return void toast.error(errors(result.error));
      }
      if (fromTyping) setTyped("");
      // A number Priority does not list is saved all the same, with a word of care.
      if (result.listed === false) toast.warning(t("notListed"), { duration: 12_000 });
      else toast.success(t("saved"));
    });
  }

  return (
    <CardShell title={t("title")} description={t("description")} index={index}>
      {priorityDown ? <Unavailable text={t("unavailable")} /> : null}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-2 px-5 py-4">
        <label htmlFor="vendor-order" className="font-medium">
          {t("label")}
        </label>
        <select
          id="vendor-order"
          value={chosen}
          disabled={!canEdit || pending || priorityDown}
          onChange={(event) => choose(event.target.value)}
          className={SELECT_CLASS}
          dir="ltr"
        >
          <option value="">{t("automatic")}</option>
          {/* A number typed in, or chosen earlier, that Priority does not list stays in the list. */}
          {chosen && !orders.some((o) => o.docno === chosen) ? (
            <option value={chosen}>{chosen}</option>
          ) : null}
          {orders.map((o) => (
            <option key={o.docno} value={o.docno}>
              {o.docno}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>
      {canEdit ? (
        <form
          className="space-y-2 border-t border-border px-5 py-4"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (typed.trim()) choose(typed.trim(), true);
          }}
        >
          <label htmlFor="vendor-order-custom" className="block font-medium">
            {t("customLabel")}
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <input
              id="vendor-order-custom"
              data-testid="vendor-order-custom"
              value={typed}
              maxLength={40}
              dir="ltr"
              autoComplete="off"
              placeholder={t("customPlaceholder")}
              disabled={pending}
              onChange={(event) => setTyped(event.target.value)}
              className="h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-3 text-sm outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:opacity-60 sm:max-w-xs"
            />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || typed.trim() === ""}>
              {t("customSave")}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("customHint")}</p>
        </form>
      ) : null}
    </CardShell>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";

/** A settings section that a later phase builds: named, described, and marked with when it arrives. */
export function SectionCard({
  icon,
  title,
  description,
  soon,

  title: string;
  description: string;
````

````ts
"use server";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { z } from "zod";
import { MAX_LABELS, MAX_PALLET_COPIES, SHIPPING_UNITS } from "@/lib/labels/shipping";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { assertPermission, PermissionError } from "@/server/permissions";
import {
  makeTestOrder,
  regenerateShippingToken,
  saveShippingSettings,
  ShippingError,
} from "@/server/shipping-labels";

export type ShippingSettingsError =
  "NOT_ALLOWED" | "INVALID_INPUT" | "INVALID_COUNT" | "INVALID_COPIES" | "INVALID_LAYOUT" | "GENERIC";

type Failure = { ok: false; error: ShippingSettingsError };

function failure(error: unknown, what: string): Failure {
  if (error instanceof PermissionError) return { ok: false, error: "NOT_ALLOWED" };
  if (error instanceof z.ZodError) return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_INPUT" };
  if (error instanceof ShippingError && error.code === "INVALID_COUNT")
    return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_COUNT" };
  if (error instanceof ShippingError && error.code === "INVALID_COPIES")
    return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_COPIES" };
  if (error instanceof ShippingError && error.code === "INVALID_LAYOUT")
    return { ok: false, error: "INVALID_LAYOUT" };
  console.error(`[settings] ${what} failed`, error);
  return { ok: false, error: "GENERIC" };
}

/** How many labels a print starts with, and which shipping layout prints (empty: the oldest). */
export async function saveShippingSettingsAction(input: {
  defaultCount: number;
  defaultUnit: "box" | "pallet";
  palletCopies: number;
  layoutId: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: true } | Failure> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.labels.edit");
    const data = z
      .object({
        defaultCount: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_LABELS),
        defaultUnit: z.enum(SHIPPING_UNITS),
        palletCopies: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_PALLET_COPIES),
        layoutId: z.string().max(64),
      })
      .parse(input);
    await saveShippingSettings(db, data, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    revalidatePath("/shipping-labels");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error, "saving the shipping label settings");
  }
}

/** A new secret for the address: the old address stops working at once. */
export async function regenerateShippingKeyAction(): Promise<
  { ok: true; token: string } | Failure
> {
  try {
    const access = await assertPermission("settings.labels.edit");
    const token = await regenerateShippingToken(db, access.actor);
    revalidatePath("/settings");
    return { ok: true, token };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error, "changing the shipping labels key");
  }
}

/** Puts a made-up order in the Shipping labels list, to try the labels before Priority sends one. */
export async function makeTestOrderAction(): Promise<{ ok: true } | Failure> {
  try {
    await assertPermission("settings.labels.edit");
    await makeTestOrder(db);
    revalidatePath("/shipping-labels");
    return { ok: true };
  } catch (error) {
    return failure(error, "making a test order");
  }
}
````
