````tsx
"use client";

import { Hourglass } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { readLastActivity as readLast, writeLastActivity as writeLast } from "@/lib/idle";

/** Activity moves this far in time before it is written down again. */
const WRITE_EVERY_MS = 1000;
/** The warning appears this long before signing out (less for very short limits). */
const WARNING_MS = 60_000;

const EVENTS = ["pointerdown", "pointermove", "keydown", "wheel", "scroll", "touchstart"] as const;

/**
 * Signs the person out after `minutes` without touching the screen (a mouse move, a key press, a
 * scan, a touch). A minute before, a notice offers to stay signed in. 0 turns it off. The time of
 * the last activity is kept in the browser, so a page opened again after the time has passed (a
 * computer that slept, a browser opened again) signs out at once.
 */
export function IdleLogout({ minutes }: { minutes: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations("auth.idle");
  const router = useRouter();
  const limit = minutes * 60_000;
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const last = useRef(0);
  const warned = useRef(false);
  const stayRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (minutes <= 0) return;
    let leaving = false;
    const warning = Math.min(WARNING_MS, limit / 2);

    async function leave() {
      if (leaving) return;
      leaving = true;
      try {
        await authClient.signOut();
      } finally {
        router.push("/login?reason=idle");
        router.refresh();
      }
    }

    function touch() {
      // While the notice is up only its own button keeps the session, so a stray movement does not.
      if (warned.current) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - last.current < WRITE_EVERY_MS) return;
      last.current = now;
      writeLast(now);
    }

    function stay() {
      warned.current = false;
      last.current = Date.now();
      writeLast(last.current);
      setSecondsLeft(null);
    }
    stayRef.current = stay;

    function check() {
      // Another tab of the system may have been used since: its time counts too.
      last.current = Math.max(last.current, readLast() ?? 0);
      const idle = Date.now() - last.current;
      if (idle >= limit) return void leave();
      if (idle >= limit - warning) {
        warned.current = true;
        setSecondsLeft(Math.max(1, Math.ceil((limit - idle) / 1000)));
      } else if (warned.current) {
        // Activity in another tab while the notice was up.
        warned.current = false;
        setSecondsLeft(null);
      }
    }

    const stored = readLast();
    last.current = stored ?? Date.now();
    if (stored === null) writeLast(last.current);
    check();

    for (const name of EVENTS) window.addEventListener(name, touch, { passive: true });
    const timer = window.setInterval(check, 1000);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", check);
    return () => {
      for (const name of EVENTS) window.removeEventListener(name, touch);
      window.clearInterval(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", check);
    };
  }, [minutes, limit, router]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={secondsLeft !== null} onOpenChange={() => {}}>
      <DialogContent showCloseButton={false} data-testid="idle-warning">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="grid size-11 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold">
              <Hourglass className="size-5" aria-hidden />
            </span>
            <DialogTitle className="font-serif text-xl">{t("title")}</DialogTitle>
          </div>
          <DialogDescription>{t("body", { seconds: secondsLeft ?? 0 })}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Button type="button" autoFocus onClick={() => stayRef.current()}>
          {t("stay")}
        </Button>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { writeLastActivity } from "@/lib/idle";

/**
 * On the login and change-password pages: a person who is signing in starts fresh. Without this,
 * the time of the last activity from an earlier session would sign them straight out again.
 */
export function IdleReset() {
  useEffect(() => {
    writeLastActivity(Date.now());
  }, []);
  return null;
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { barcodeSvg, qrSvg } from "@/lib/labels/codes";
import { extraFontFamily } from "@/lib/labels/fonts";
import { pointsToMm } from "@/lib/labels/geometry";
import {
  lineText,
  type ElementStyle,
  type LabelElement,
  type LabelValues,
} from "@/lib/labels/model";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** The class of the three screen typefaces; the others are set by font-family (see fontStyle). */
const FONT_CLASS = (font: ElementStyle["font"]): string | undefined =>
  ({ sans: "font-sans", serif: "font-serif", mono: "font-mono" })[font as string];

/** The font-family of one of the typefaces added for labels, as a style. */
const fontStyle = (font: ElementStyle["font"]): React.CSSProperties | undefined => {
  const family = extraFontFamily(font);
  return family ? { fontFamily: family } : undefined;
};

const ALIGN_CLASS: Record<ElementStyle["align"], string> = {
  start: "text-start",
  center: "text-center",
  end: "text-end",
};

/** Where a line's value sits when the line has no words before it. */
const LINE_JUSTIFY: Record<ElementStyle["align"], string> = {
  start: "justify-start",
  center: "justify-center",
  end: "justify-end",
};

/** What a text, field, barcode or QR element shows or encodes, from the label's values. */
export function elementText(element: LabelElement, values: LabelValues): string {
  switch (element.type) {
    case "text":
      return element.text;
    case "field":
    case "barcode":
      return values[element.field];
    case "qr":
      if (element.source === "itemLabel") return values.qrItemLabel;
      if (element.source === "pallet") return values.qrPallet;
      return values[element.source];
    default:
      return "";
  }
}

/** `scale` is pixels per millimetre (the editor), or "mm" to size everything in real millimetres and points (printing). */
export type Scale = number | "mm";

/**
 * One element drawn inside the label. The editor and the test print use the same
 * drawing; only the unit differs.
 */
export function ElementView({
  element,
  scale,
  values,
}: {
  element: LabelElement;
  scale: Scale;
  values: LabelValues;
}) {
  const len = (mm: number): string | number => (scale === "mm" ? `${mm}mm` : mm * scale);
  const frame: React.CSSProperties = {
    position: "absolute",
    left: len(element.x),
    top: len(element.y),
    width: len(element.w),
    height: len(element.h),
  };

  switch (element.type) {
    case "line":
      return <div style={frame} className="bg-black" />;
    case "box":
      return (
        <div
          style={{ ...frame, borderWidth: len(element.borderMm) }}
          className="box-border border-solid border-black"
        />
      );
    case "lines": {
      // A length inside a "border-bottom: 0.25 dotted black" needs its unit, which a bare number lacks.
      const css = (mm: number) => (scale === "mm" ? `${mm}mm` : `${mm * scale}px`);
      const points = (size: number) => (scale === "mm" ? `${size}pt` : pointsToMm(size) * scale);
      return (
        <div
          style={{
            ...frame,
            borderWidth: len(element.borderMm),
            borderRadius: len(element.radiusMm),
          }}
          className="box-border flex flex-col overflow-hidden border-solid border-black text-black"
        >
          {element.lines.map((line, index) => {
            const last = index === element.lines.length - 1;
            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                dir={line.style.dir}
                style={{
                  ...fontStyle(line.style.font),
                  fontSize: points(line.style.fontSize),
                  lineHeight: 1.15,
                  paddingInline: len(0.8),
                  columnGap: len(1),
                  borderBottom:
                    last || element.separator === "none"
                      ? undefined
                      : `${css(0.25)} ${element.separator} black`,
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "box-border flex min-h-0 flex-1 items-center overflow-hidden",
                  line.label
                    ? line.style.align === "center"
                      ? "justify-center"
                      : "justify-between"
                    : LINE_JUSTIFY[line.style.align],
                  FONT_CLASS(line.style.font),
                  line.style.bold && "font-bold",
                )}
              >
                {line.label ? (
                  <span dir="auto" className="shrink-0">
                    {line.label}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
                <span
                  dir="auto"
                  style={{ textAlign: line.label ? undefined : line.style.align }}
                  className="min-w-0 break-words whitespace-pre-line"
                >
                  {lineText(line, values)}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }
    case "logo":
      return (
        // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- the label is drawn at exact millimetres
        <img
          src={`/api/brand/${element.variant}`}
          alt=""
          draggable={false}
          style={frame}
          className="object-contain select-none"
        />
      );
    case "barcode":
      return (
        <Code
          frame={frame}
          svg={(text) => barcodeSvg(text, element.showText)}
          text={elementText(element, values)}
          showText={element.showText}
        />
      );
    case "qr":
      return <Code frame={frame} svg={qrSvg} text={elementText(element, values)} />;
    default: {
      const { style } = element;
      return (
        <div
          style={{
            ...frame,
            ...fontStyle(style.font),
            fontSize: scale === "mm" ? `${style.fontSize}pt` : pointsToMm(style.fontSize) * scale,
            lineHeight: 1.15,
          }}
          dir={style.dir}
          className={cn(
            "overflow-hidden break-words text-black",
            FONT_CLASS(style.font),
            ALIGN_CLASS[style.align],
            style.bold && "font-bold",
          )}
        >
          {elementText(element, values)}
        </div>
      );
    }
  }
}

/** A barcode or QR code filling its box; an empty dashed box when the text cannot be encoded. */
function Code({
  frame,
  svg,
  text,
  showText,
}: {
  frame: React.CSSProperties;
  svg: (text: string) => string | null;
  text: string;
  showText?: boolean;
}) {
  // The picture depends only on the text (and whether the digits show), not on position or size.
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- `svg` is a fresh closure on every render
  const markup = useMemo(() => svg(text), [text, showText]);
  if (!markup) return <div style={frame} className="border border-dashed border-black/40" />;
  return <div style={frame} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: markup }} />;
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import type { LabelElement, LabelValues } from "@/lib/labels/model";
import { ElementView } from "./element-view";

/** What is printed: the label's size and elements, the values to fill it with, and how many copies. */
export interface PrintJob {
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  values: LabelValues;
  copies: number;
}

/**
 * Several items printed in one go, on the same label type: each item's labels in turn,
 * with one empty label between one item and the next so the person at the printer sees
 * where an item ends.
 */
export interface BatchPrintJob {
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  groups: { values: LabelValues; copies: number }[];
}

/**
 * Labels that each have their own values, one after the other: the labels of a shipping order,
 * "1 / 10", "2 / 10" and so on.
 */
export interface SequencePrintJob {
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  pages: LabelValues[];
}

/** The pages of a job in print order: a label's values, or null for an empty label. */
export function jobPages(job: PrintJob | BatchPrintJob | SequencePrintJob): (LabelValues | null)[] {
  if ("pages" in job) return job.pages;
  if (!("groups" in job)) return Array.from({ length: job.copies }, () => job.values);
  return job.groups.flatMap((group, index) => [
    ...(index > 0 ? [null] : []),
    ...Array.from({ length: group.copies }, () => group.values),
  ]);
}

/**
 * The labels as they will print, drawn at exact millimetres into a copy of the page
 * kept under <body> and never shown on screen (see globals.css). One block per copy;
 * each one is a page of its own, the size of the label. Render it while a job exists.
 */
export function LabelPrintSheet({ job }: { job: PrintJob | BatchPrintJob | SequencePrintJob }) {
  // False while the page is rendered on the server, true in the browser: the copy needs <body>.
  const inBrowser = useSyncExternalStore(
    () => () => {},
    () => true,
    () => false,
  );
  if (!inBrowser) return null;

  return createPortal(
    <div id="label-print-root" aria-hidden>
      {jobPages(job).map((values, page) => (
        <div
          key={page}
          className="label-copy"
          data-blank={values === null ? "true" : undefined}
          style={{
            position: "relative",
            width: `${job.widthMm}mm`,
            height: `${job.heightMm}mm`,
            overflow: "hidden",
            background: "white",
          }}
        >
          {values === null
            ? null
            : job.elements.map((element) => (
                <ElementView key={element.id} element={element} scale="mm" values={values} />
              ))}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

/**
 * Opens the browser's print window for the sheet on the page, on paper of the label's
 * size with no margin, with everything else hidden. Puts the screen back afterwards
 * (and calls `done`). The sheet must already be rendered.
 */
export function printLabelSheet(widthMm: number, heightMm: number, done?: () => void): void {
  const waiting = fontsToLoad();
  if (waiting.length === 0) return startPrint(widthMm, heightMm, done);
  // A typeface is fetched when it is first used, and the labels are not shown on screen: ask for
  // each one now and print when they have arrived (or after a few seconds, so a slow link still prints).
  void Promise.race([
    Promise.all(waiting.map((font) => document.fonts.load(font).catch(() => []))),
    new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, FONT_WAIT_MS)),
  ]).then(() => startPrint(widthMm, heightMm, done));
}

const FONT_WAIT_MS = 4000;

/** The typefaces (regular and bold) used by the labels on the page that have not arrived yet. */
function fontsToLoad(): string[] {
  const root = document.getElementById("label-print-root");
  if (!root || !document.fonts) return [];
  const used = new Set<string>();
  for (const element of root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("*")) {
    const style = getComputedStyle(element);
    used.add(`${style.fontWeight} 1em ${style.fontFamily}`);
  }
  return [...used].filter((font) => !document.fonts.check(font));
}

function startPrint(widthMm: number, heightMm: number, done?: () => void): void {
  const page = document.createElement("style");
  page.textContent = `@page { size: ${widthMm}mm ${heightMm}mm; margin: 0 }`;
  document.head.append(page);
  document.body.classList.add("printing-label");

  const finish = () => {
    document.body.classList.remove("printing-label");
    page.remove();
    window.removeEventListener("afterprint", finish);
    done?.();
  };
  window.addEventListener("afterprint", finish);
  window.print();
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Languages } from "lucide-react";
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { setLocale } from "@/lib/i18n/actions";
import { otherLocale, type Locale } from "@/lib/i18n/config";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * One button that switches the whole UI to the other language.
 * The label always names the language you will get, in that language.
 * `sidebar` is the dark-menu look; `iconOnly` hides the label (collapsed menu).
 */
export function LanguageSwitcher({
  className,
  tone = "light",
  iconOnly = false,
}: {
  className?: string;
  tone?: "light" | "sidebar";
  iconOnly?: boolean;
}) {
  const locale = useLocale() as Locale;
  const t = useTranslations("language");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function onClick() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      await setLocale(otherLocale(locale));
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Button
      variant={tone === "sidebar" ? "ghost" : "outline"}
      size={iconOnly ? "icon-sm" : "sm"}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={pending}
      aria-label={t("label")}
      title={t("switchTo")}
      className={cn(
        tone === "sidebar" &&
          "text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <Languages data-icon={iconOnly ? undefined : "inline-start"} />
      {iconOnly ? null : t("switchTo")}
    </Button>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

const EVERY = 45_000;

/**
 * For people who read the messages: looks now and then for a new one, and when one arrives shows
 * a notice with a button to open it, and refreshes the red number on the menu.
 */
export function MessageWatcher({ initialCount }: { initialCount: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations("contact");
  const router = useRouter();
  const last = useRef(initialCount);

  useEffect(() => {
    let stopped = false;
    async function check() {
      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/messages/unread", { cache: "no-store" });
        if (!response.ok || stopped) return;
        const data = (await response.json()) as {
          count: number;
          latest: { from: string; kind: string; screen: string } | null;
        };
        if (stopped) return;
        if (data.count > last.current && data.latest) {
          toast(t("notice.title", { name: data.latest.from }), {
            description: t("notice.body", {
              kind: t(`message.kinds.${data.latest.kind}` as never),
              screen: t(`message.screens.${data.latest.screen}` as never),
            }),
            duration: 20_000,
            action: { label: t("notice.open"), onClick: () => router.push("/admin?tab=messages") },
          });
        }
        if (data.count !== last.current) {
          last.current = data.count;
          router.refresh();
        }
      } catch {
        // No connection for a moment: the next look tries again.
      }
    }
    const timer = setInterval(check, EVERY);
    const onFocus = () => void check();
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    };
  }, [router, t]);

  return null;
}
````

````tsx
/**
 * A password box with an eye at its start: while the eye is pressed and held (mouse, finger, or the
 * space or enter key) the password is shown, and it is hidden again the moment it is let go.
 */
export function PasswordInput({
  className,
  ...props
}: Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof Input>, "type">) {
  const t = useTranslations("auth.login");
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  const show = () => setShown(true);
  const hide = () => setShown(false);

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <Input {...props} type={shown ? "text" : "password"} className={cn("ps-11", className)} />
      <button
        type="button"
        aria-label={t("reveal")}
        title={t("reveal")}
        data-testid="reveal-password"
        onPointerDown={show}
        onPointerUp={hide}
        onPointerLeave={hide}
        onPointerCancel={hide}
        onBlur={hide}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === " " || event.key === "Enter") {
            event.preventDefault();
            show();
          }
        }}
        onKeyUp={hide}
        // Keeps the cursor in the box, and stops a long press on a phone from opening a menu.
        onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
        onContextMenu={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
        className={cn(
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";

/**
 * A report as it prints: the children, drawn into a copy of the page kept under <body> and
 * never shown on screen (see globals.css). Render it while a report is being printed.
 */
export function ReportPrintSheet({
  children,
  dir,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  dir: "rtl" | "ltr";
}) {
  // False while the page is rendered on the server, true in the browser: the copy needs <body>.
  const inBrowser = useSyncExternalStore(
    () => () => {},
    () => true,
    () => false,
  );
  if (!inBrowser) return null;
  return createPortal(
    <div id="report-print-root" dir={dir} aria-hidden>
      {children}
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

/**
 * Opens the browser's print window for the report on the page (choosing "Save as PDF" there
 * makes the file), on A4 across the page. Puts the screen back afterwards and calls `done`.
 */
export function printReport(done?: () => void): void {
  const page = document.createElement("style");
  page.textContent = "@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 10mm }";
  document.head.append(page);
  document.body.classList.add("printing-report");

  const finish = () => {
    document.body.classList.remove("printing-report");
    page.remove();
    window.removeEventListener("afterprint", finish);
    done?.();
  };
  window.addEventListener("afterprint", finish);
  window.print();
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, GripVertical, ListOrdered } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { saveRoomOrderAction } from "@/app/(app)/dashboard/room-order-actions";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * Arranging the storage rooms by hand: a button turns arranging on, each room can then be dragged
 * to a new place (or moved with the arrows), and Done saves the order for everyone, on the
 * dashboard and in the inventory.
 */
export function useRoomArranger(codes: string[]) {
  const t = useTranslations("rooms");
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [over, setOver] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, startSaving] = useTransition();

  const editing = draft !== null;
  const order = draft ?? codes;

  function place(code: string, target: number) {
    setDraft((current) => {
      const list = [...(current ?? codes)];
      const from = list.indexOf(code);
      if (from < 0) return list;
      list.splice(from, 1);
      list.splice(Math.max(0, Math.min(target, list.length)), 0, code);
      return list;
    });
  }

  function save() {
    if (!draft) return;
    startSaving(async () => {
      const result = await saveRoomOrderAction(draft);
      if (!result.ok) return void toast.error(t("saveFailed"));
      toast.success(t("saved"));
      setDraft(null);
    });
  }

  /** What a room's wrapper needs to be dragged and dropped. */
  function dropProps(code: string) {
    return {
      draggable: editing,
      onDragStart: (event: React.DragEvent) => {
        event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
        event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", code);
        setDragging(code);
      },
      onDragEnd: () => {
        setDragging(null);
        setOver(null);
      },
      onDragOver: (event: React.DragEvent) => {
        if (!editing || !dragging) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        setOver(code);
      },
      onDrop: (event: React.DragEvent) => {
        if (!editing || !dragging) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        if (dragging !== code) place(dragging, order.indexOf(code));
        setDragging(null);
        setOver(null);
      },
      "data-dragging": dragging === code || undefined,
      "data-over": (over === code && dragging !== code) || undefined,
    };
  }

  return {
    order,
    editing,
    saving,
    start: () => setDraft([...codes]),
    cancel: () => setDraft(null),
    save,
    move: (code: string, by: -1 | 1) => place(code, order.indexOf(code) + by),
    dropProps,
  };
}

export type RoomArranger = ReturnType<typeof useRoomArranger>;

/** The button that turns arranging on, and Done / Cancel while it is on. */
export function ArrangeBar({ arranger }: { arranger: RoomArranger }) {
  const t = useTranslations("rooms");
  if (!arranger.editing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={arranger.start}>
          <ListOrdered data-icon="inline-start" />
          {t("arrange")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft/40 px-4 py-3">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("hint")}</p>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={arranger.cancel}>
          {t("cancel")}
        </Button>
        <Button type="button" size="sm" disabled={arranger.saving} onClick={arranger.save}>
          {t("done")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The handle and arrows laid over a room while arranging. */
export function RoomHandle({
  arranger,
  code,
  name,
}: {
  arranger: RoomArranger;
  code: string;
  name: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("rooms");
  const index = arranger.order.indexOf(code);
  return (
    <div className="absolute end-3 top-3 z-10 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-border bg-card/95 p-1 shadow-sm">
      <span
        aria-hidden
        className="grid size-7 cursor-grab place-items-center text-muted-foreground active:cursor-grabbing"
      >
        <GripVertical className="size-4" />
      </span>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="ghost"
        size="icon-sm"
        aria-label={t("earlier", { name })}
        disabled={index <= 0}
        onClick={() => arranger.move(code, -1)}
      >
        <ArrowUp />
      </Button>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="ghost"
        size="icon-sm"
        aria-label={t("later", { name })}
        disabled={index < 0 || index >= arranger.order.length - 1}
        onClick={() => arranger.move(code, 1)}
      >
        <ArrowDown />
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The wrapper that makes one room draggable while arranging. */
export function ArrangeSlot({
  arranger,
  code,
  name,
  children,
}: {
  arranger: RoomArranger;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      {...arranger.dropProps(code)}
      data-testid="room-slot"
      data-code={code}
      className={cn(
        "relative min-w-0 rounded-2xl",
        arranger.editing && "cursor-grab ring-1 ring-gold/40 data-[dragging]:opacity-40",
        arranger.editing && "data-[over]:ring-2 data-[over]:ring-primary",
      )}
    >
      {arranger.editing ? <RoomHandle arranger={arranger} code={code} name={name} /> : null}
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Plug, PlugZap, Unplug } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { BAUD_RATES, DEFAULT_BAUD_RATE, splitReadings, weightFromReading } from "@/lib/scale";

/** The parts of the browser's serial support (Chrome and Edge) the scale needs. */
interface SerialPortLike {
  open(options: { baudRate: number }): Promise<void>;
  close(): Promise<void>;
  readable: ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | null;
}
interface SerialLike {
  getPorts(): Promise<SerialPortLike[]>;
  requestPort(): Promise<SerialPortLike>;
}

function serial(): SerialLike | null {
  if (typeof navigator === "undefined") return null;
  return (navigator as Navigator & { serial?: SerialLike }).serial ?? null;
}

/** What this computer remembers about its scale: kept in the browser, per computer. */
const SETTINGS_KEY = "{{APP_ID}}.scale";
interface ScaleSettings {
  /** Connect by itself when the receiving screen opens (after the first connection). */
  auto: boolean;
  baudRate: number;
  reversed: boolean;
}
const DEFAULTS: ScaleSettings = { auto: false, baudRate: DEFAULT_BAUD_RATE, reversed: true };

function readSettings(): ScaleSettings {
  try {
    return { ...DEFAULTS, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY) ?? "{}") };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULTS;
  }
}
function writeSettings(settings: ScaleSettings) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
  } catch {
    // Not remembered; the scale still works for now.
  }
}

/** True when the scale was left connected on this computer, so the screen connects it again. */
export function scaleWasConnected(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== "undefined" && readSettings().auto;
}

const MAX_RAW = 300;

export type ScaleState = "off" | "connecting" | "on" | "error";

/**
 * The real scale: Connect takes it for this system (the first time Chrome asks which device it
 * is, once), Disconnect gives it back so the old program can use it. Each reading becomes the
 * weight text, the same as typing it on the simulated scale.
 */
export function RealScale({
  onWeight,
  onStateChange,
  controls = false,
  canConnect = false,
}: {
  onWeight: (text: string) => void;
  onStateChange: (state: ScaleState) => void;
  /** Show Connect / Disconnect and the setup: in the system settings. Elsewhere the scale only uses what was connected there. */
  controls?: boolean;
  /** Whether this person may connect and disconnect the scale. */
  canConnect?: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving.scale.real");
  const [state, setState] = useState<ScaleState>("off");
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<ScaleSettings>(DEFAULTS);
  const [raw, setRaw] = useState("");
  const port = useRef<SerialPortLike | null>(null);
  const reader = useRef<ReadableStreamDefaultReader<Uint8Array> | null>(null);
  const stopping = useRef(false);
  // Known only in the browser, so the server and the first browser render agree.
  const [supported, setSupported] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  function change(next: ScaleState) {
    setState(next);
    onStateChange(next);
  }

  function updateSettings(patch: Partial<ScaleSettings>) {
    setSettings((current) => {
      const next = { ...current, ...patch };
      writeSettings(next);
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function readLoop(opened: SerialPortLike, current: ScaleSettings) {
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = "";
    while (opened.readable && !stopping.current) {
      const r = opened.readable.getReader();
      reader.current = r;
      try {
        for (;;) {
          const { value, done } = await r.read();
          if (done) break;
          const text = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
          setRaw((old) => (old + text).slice(-MAX_RAW));
          const { readings, rest } = splitReadings(buffer + text);
          buffer = rest.slice(-100);
          const last = readings.at(-1);
          if (last !== undefined) {
            const kg = weightFromReading(last, current.reversed);
            if (kg !== null) onWeight(kg > 0 ? kg.toFixed(2) : "");
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // A break in the line: read again unless Disconnect was pressed.
      } finally {
        r.releaseLock();
      }
    }
  }

  async function connect(ask: boolean) {
    const api = serial();
    if (!api) return;
    setProblem(null);
    change("connecting");
    const current = readSettings();
    try {
      const known = await api.getPorts();
      const chosen = known[0] ?? (ask ? await api.requestPort() : null);
      if (!chosen) return change("off");
      // The screen just left may still be closing the port: when connecting by itself, try again.
      for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
        try {
          await chosen.open({ baudRate: current.baudRate });
          break;
        } catch (error) {
          const busy = error instanceof Error && error.name === "InvalidStateError";
          if (ask || !busy || attempt >= 4) throw error;
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400));
        }
      }
      port.current = chosen;
      stopping.current = false;
      updateSettings({ auto: true });
      change("on");
      void readLoop(chosen, current);
    } catch (error) {
      const name = error instanceof Error ? error.name : "";
      // Closing Chrome's list without choosing is not a problem.
      if (name === "NotFoundError") return change("off");
      setProblem(name === "InvalidStateError" || name === "NetworkError" ? t("busy") : t("failed"));
      change("error");
    }
  }

  async function disconnect() {
    stopping.current = true;
    updateSettings({ auto: false });
    try {
      await reader.current?.cancel();
    } catch {
      // Already stopped.
    }
    try {
      await port.current?.close();
    } catch {
      // Already closed.
    }
    port.current = null;
    onWeight("");
    change("off");
  }

  // The settings are read once the page is in the browser; a scale left connected connects again.
  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = readSettings();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect -- browser storage is only readable here
    setSettings(stored);
    setSupported(serial() !== null);
    if (stored.auto && serial()) void connect(false);
    return () => {
      stopping.current = true;
      void reader.current?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
      void port.current?.close().catch(() => undefined);
    };
    // Once, when the screen opens.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  if (supported === null) return null;

  if (!supported) {
    return (
      <p
        data-testid="scale-unsupported"
        className="rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm text-warning"
      >
        {t("unsupported")}
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3" data-testid="real-scale" data-state={state}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-3">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium">
          {state === "on" ? (
            <PlugZap className="size-4 text-success" aria-hidden />
          ) : (
            <Unplug className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
          )}
          {t(`states.${state}`)}
        </span>
        {controls && canConnect ? (
          state === "on" ? (
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => void disconnect()}>
              <Unplug data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("disconnect")}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button size="sm" disabled={state === "connecting"} onClick={() => void connect(true)}>
              <Plug data-icon="inline-start" />
              {t("connect")}
            </Button>
          )
        ) : null}
        {!controls && state !== "on" && state !== "connecting" ? (
          <Link href="/settings?section=hardware" className="text-sm text-primary underline">
            {t("manage")}
          </Link>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {controls && !canConnect ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("notAllowed")}</p>
      ) : null}
      {problem ? (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
          {problem}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {controls ? (
        <details className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2 text-sm">
          <summary className="cursor-pointer text-muted-foreground">{t("setup")}</summary>
          <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
            <label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              {t("speed")}
              <select
                value={settings.baudRate}
                disabled={state === "on"}
                onChange={(event) => updateSettings({ baudRate: Number(event.target.value) })}
                className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-input bg-card px-2 text-sm"
                dir="ltr"
              >
                {BAUD_RATES.map((rate) => (
                  <option key={rate} value={rate}>
                    {rate}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              {t("reversed")}
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="size-4 accent-primary"
                checked={settings.reversed}
                disabled={state === "on"}
                onChange={(event) => updateSettings({ reversed: event.target.checked })}
              />
            </label>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("raw")}</p>
              <pre
                dir="ltr"
                data-testid="scale-raw"
                className="max-h-28 overflow-auto rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 font-mono text-xs break-all whitespace-pre-wrap"
              >
                {raw || "—"}
              </pre>
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Scale } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG } from "@/lib/barcodes";

/** How long the weight must stay the same to count as stable. */
export const STABLE_AFTER_MS = 1000;

/** The weight typed or read, as a number, or null when it is empty or outside what a box can weigh. */
export function parseWeight(text: string): number | null {
  const value = Number(text.trim().replace(",", "."));
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0 || value > MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG) return null;
  return Math.round(value * 100) / 100;
}

/** True once `text` has not changed for STABLE_AFTER_MS. */
export function useStable(text: string): boolean {
  const [stableText, setStableText] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setStableText(text), STABLE_AFTER_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [text]);
  return text !== "" && stableText === text;
}

/**
 * The scale until the real one is connected (phase 3): the weight is typed here, and shown
 * the way the live reading will be. The real scale replaces only this component.
 */
export function SimulatedScale({
  text,
  onChange,
  stable,
  inputRef,
  live = false,
  below,
}: {
  text: string;
  onChange: (text: string) => void;
  stable: boolean;
  inputRef?: React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
  /** True while the real scale is connected: the weight comes from it, so it is not typed. */
  live?: boolean;
  /** Shown right under the scale's display, before the box for typing the weight. */
  below?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("receiving.scale");
  const common = useTranslations("common");
  const weight = parseWeight(text);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl bg-sidebar px-5 py-4 text-sidebar-foreground shadow-sm">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <p className="text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/70">{t("display")}</p>
          <span
            dir="ltr"
            data-testid="weight-display"
            className="block font-serif text-5xl font-semibold tabular-nums sm:text-6xl"
          >
            {weight === null ? "—" : weight.toFixed(2)}
            <span className="ms-2 text-2xl font-normal text-sidebar-foreground/70">
              {common("kg")}
            </span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <span
          data-testid="weight-state"
          className={
            stable && weight !== null
              ? "rounded-full bg-success px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white"
              : "text-xs text-sidebar-foreground/70"
          }
        >
          {weight === null ? t("none") : stable ? t("stable") : t("settling")}
        </span>
      </div>
      {below}
      {live ? null : (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <Label htmlFor="simulated-weight" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
            <Scale className="size-4" aria-hidden />
            {t("simulated")}
          </Label>
          <Input
            id="simulated-weight"
            ref={inputRef}
            dir="ltr"
            inputMode="decimal"
            autoComplete="off"
            placeholder="14.02"
            value={text}
            onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
          />
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("simulatedHint")}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { ScanLine } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

/**
 * The big scan bar at the top of a scanning screen: an icon (or a step number), a title and a
 * hint, and the input the scanner types into. Enter hands the text over and empties nothing by
 * itself; the screen decides.
 */
export function ScanBar({
  id,
  label,
  title,
  hint,
  placeholder,
  value,
  onChange,
  onEnter,
  disabled,
  inputRef,
  step,
  children,
}: {
  id: string;
  /** What the input is called (read by screen readers; the title is what is seen). */
  label: string;
  title: string;
  hint: string;
  placeholder: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  onEnter: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  inputRef?: React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
  /** A step number shown in place of the scan icon. */
  step?: number;
  /** Messages shown under the bar. */
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rise space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-card">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="grid size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 font-serif text-xl font-semibold text-primary">
            {step ?? <ScanLine className="size-6" aria-hidden />}
          </span>
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <h2 className="font-serif text-lg font-semibold">{title}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="relative w-full md:max-w-md">
          <Label htmlFor={id} className="sr-only">
            {label}
          </Label>
          <ScanLine
            aria-hidden
            className="pointer-events-none absolute end-3.5 top-1/2 size-5 -translate-y-1/2 text-primary"
          />
          <Input
            id={id}
            ref={inputRef}
            dir="ltr"
            autoFocus
            autoComplete="off"
            disabled={disabled}
            value={value}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            className="h-12 border-primary/40 pe-11 text-base focus-visible:border-primary"
            onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (event.key !== "Enter") return;
              event.preventDefault();
              onEnter();
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/page-header";
import { SCREEN_ICONS } from "@/components/screen-icons";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { SCREENS, type ScreenKey } from "@/server/permissions/registry";

/** Stand-in for a screen that a later step or phase builds. Shown only to users allowed on that screen. */
export async function ScreenPlaceholder({ screen }: { screen: ScreenKey }) {
  const t = await getTranslations();
  const { builtIn, group } = SCREENS[screen];
  const when =
    "step" in builtIn
      ? t("placeholder.comingInStep", { step: builtIn.step })
      : t("placeholder.comingSoon", { phase: builtIn.phase });
  const Icon = SCREEN_ICONS[screen];

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader
        icon={<Icon />}
        eyebrow={t(`shell.groups.${group}`)}
        title={t(`nav.${screen}`)}
        description={t(`screens.${screen}`)}
      />
      <Card className="rise" style={{ "--i": 2 } as React.CSSProperties}>
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-14 text-center">
          <span className="grid size-20 place-items-center rounded-full border border-gold/40 bg-gold-soft text-gold [&_svg]:size-9">
            <Icon />
          </span>
          <h2 className="font-serif text-2xl font-semibold">{t("placeholder.title")}</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{when}</p>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}
````

````tsx
"use client";

import { Menu } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { LogoMark } from "@/components/brand-logo";
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetTitle } from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { SidebarContent, type NavItem, type ShellUser } from "./sidebar-content";

const COLLAPSE_COOKIE = "sidebar";

/**
 * The frame around every screen after login. Desktop (1024px and up): a fixed,
 * collapsible navy side menu at the reading start. Phone and tablet: a navy top
 * bar with a menu button that opens the same menu in a slide-in sheet.
 */
export function AppShell({
  items,
  user,
  company,
  defaultCollapsed,
  children,
}: {
  items: NavItem[];
  user: ShellUser;
  company: string;
  defaultCollapsed: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("shell");
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(defaultCollapsed);
  const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false);

  function toggleCollapsed() {
    const next = !collapsed;
    setCollapsed(next);
    // Remembered per browser; the server reads it so the first paint is right.
    document.cookie = `${COLLAPSE_COOKIE}=${next ? "collapsed" : "open"}; path=/; max-age=31536000; samesite=lax`;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh">
      <aside
        className={cn(
          "sticky top-0 hidden h-dvh shrink-0 transition-[width] duration-200 lg:block",
          collapsed ? "w-24" : "w-72",
        )}
      >
        <SidebarContent
          items={items}
          user={user}
          company={company}
          collapsed={collapsed}
          onToggleCollapsed={toggleCollapsed}
        />
      </aside>

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex h-16 items-center gap-3 bg-sidebar px-4 text-white shadow-md lg:hidden">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSheetOpen(true)}
            aria-label={t("openMenu")}
            className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-xl text-white hover:bg-sidebar-accent"
          >
            <Menu className="size-6" />
          </button>
          <LogoMark className="size-9" />
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate font-serif text-lg font-semibold">
            {company}
          </span>
        </div>

        <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-[117rem] flex-1 space-y-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
          {children}
        </main>
      </div>

      <Sheet open={sheetOpen} onOpenChange={setSheetOpen}>
        <SheetContent
          side="start"
          showCloseButton={false}
          className="w-80 max-w-[85vw] border-0 bg-sidebar p-0"
        >
          <SheetTitle className="sr-only">{t("navigation")}</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription className="sr-only">{company}</SheetDescription>
          <SidebarContent
            items={items}
            user={user}
            company={company}
            onNavigate={() => setSheetOpen(false)}
            onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)}
          />
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````tsx
                      {item.badge ? (
                        <span
                          data-testid={`nav-badge-${item.key}`}
                          aria-label={t("attention", { count: item.badge })}
                          className={cn(
                            "grid place-items-center rounded-full bg-destructive font-semibold text-white",
                            collapsed
                              ? "absolute end-2 top-1.5 size-2.5"
                              : "h-5 min-w-5 px-1.5 text-xs",
                          )}
                        >
                          {collapsed ? null : item.badge}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </Link>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      <div
        className={cn(
          "shrink-0 border-t border-sidebar-border p-4",
          collapsed ? "flex flex-col items-center gap-3" : "flex items-center gap-3",
        )}
      >
        <Link
          href="/account"
          onClick={onNavigate}
          title={t("account")}
          aria-label={t("account")}
          className={cn(
            "flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3 rounded-lg outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sidebar-ring",
            collapsed ? "" : "flex-1",
          )}
        >
          <span
            className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-sidebar-primary/50 bg-sidebar-accent font-serif text-lg text-sidebar-primary"
            title={collapsed ? user.displayName : undefined}
          >
            {initial}
          </span>
          {collapsed ? null : (
            <span className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
              <span className="block truncate text-sm font-semibold text-sidebar-accent-foreground">
                {user.displayName}
              </span>
              {user.subtitle ? (
                <span className="block truncate text-xs text-sidebar-muted">{user.subtitle}</span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          )}
        </Link>
        <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-0.5", collapsed && "flex-col")}>
          <LanguageSwitcher tone="sidebar" iconOnly />
          <SignOutButton tone="sidebar" iconOnly />
        </div>
      </div>

      {onToggleCollapsed ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggleCollapsed}
          aria-label={collapsed ? t("expand") : t("collapse")}
          title={collapsed ? t("expand") : t("collapse")}
          className="absolute -end-3 top-12 z-10 grid size-6 place-items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-card text-foreground shadow-md transition-colors hover:bg-secondary"
        >
          <ChevronRight
            className={cn(
              "size-3.5 transition-transform",
              collapsed ? "rtl:rotate-180" : "ltr:rotate-180",
            )}
          />
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/components/sign-out-button.tsx`

````tsx
"use client";

import { LogOut } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTransition } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function SignOutButton({
  variant = "outline",
  size = "sm",
  tone = "light",
  iconOnly = false,
  className,
}: {
  variant?: "outline" | "ghost" | "secondary";
  size?: "sm" | "default";
  tone?: "light" | "sidebar";
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("auth");
  const router = useRouter();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  function onClick() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      await authClient.signOut();
      router.push("/login");
      router.refresh();
    });
  }

  return (
    <Button
      variant={tone === "sidebar" ? "ghost" : variant}
      size={iconOnly ? "icon-sm" : size}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={pending}
      aria-label={t("signOut")}
      title={t("signOut")}
      className={cn(
        tone === "sidebar" &&
          "text-sidebar-foreground hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <LogOut data-icon={iconOnly ? undefined : "inline-start"} className="rtl:-scale-x-100" />
      {iconOnly ? null : t("signOut")}
    </Button>
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/i18n/request.ts`

````ts
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getRequestConfig } from "next-intl/server";
import { defaultLocale, isLocale, LOCALE_COOKIE, timeZone } from "@/lib/i18n/config";
import { getSession } from "@/server/auth/session";

/**
 * Resolves the language for the current request: the logged-in user's saved
 * choice first, then the locale cookie (login page, before the first login).
 */
export default getRequestConfig(async () => {
  const session = await getSession().catch(() => null);
  const store = await cookies();
  const fromUser = session?.user.locale;
  const fromCookie = store.get(LOCALE_COOKIE)?.value;
  const locale = isLocale(fromUser) ? fromUser : isLocale(fromCookie) ? fromCookie : defaultLocale;

  return {
    locale,
    timeZone,
    messages: (await import(`../../messages/${locale}.json`)).default,
  };
});
````

### FILE: `src/instrumentation.ts`

````ts
/**
 * Runs once when the Next.js server starts: applies pending migrations and the
 * idempotent seed, so a fresh clone works with `pnpm dev` alone. Everything
 * Node-specific sits behind dynamic imports because this file is also compiled
 * for the Edge runtime.
 */
export async function register() {
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME !== "nodejs") return;
  const { prepareDatabase } = await import("./server/db/prepare");
  const { getDatabase } = await import("./server/db");

  const report = await prepareDatabase();
  const database = getDatabase();
  const seeded = report.ownerCreated || report.standInSeeded;
  console.log(
    `[db] ${database.kind} at ${database.location}: migrations applied` +
      (seeded
        ? `, seeded (owner=${report.ownerCreated}, boxes=${report.boxes}, settings=${report.settingsAdded})`
        : ""),
  );

  const { startSendWorker } = await import("./server/receiving/worker");
  const { getPriorityClient } = await import("./server/priority");
  startSendWorker(database.db, getPriorityClient);
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  addDays,
  buildBoxBarcode,
  fromDDMMYY,
  itemNumberDigits,
  localDate,
  parseBoxBarcode,
  parseVendorBarcode,
  slaughterDateOf,
  toDDMMYY,
  toISODate,
} from "./barcodes";

describe("slaughter date of a barcode", () => {
  it("is read from our own box barcode and from a vendor's, and nothing else", () => {
    expect(slaughterDateOf("000220151810261511261402")).toBe("2026-10-18");
    expect(slaughterDateOf("380009001100726090728634301998")).toBe("2026-07-10");
    expect(slaughterDateOf("TEST-BOX-0001")).toBeNull();
    expect(slaughterDateOf("")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("vendor barcode", () => {
  it("splits the example in PLAN.md", () => {
    const r = parseVendorBarcode("380009001100726090728634301998");
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!r.ok) return;
    expect(r.value.itemBarcodeTail).toBe("0009001");
    expect(toDDMMYY(r.value.slaughterDate)).toBe("100726");
    expect(toDDMMYY(r.value.expiryDate)).toBe("090728");
    expect(r.value.vendorRunning).toBe("63430");
    expect(r.value.weightKg).toBe(19.98);
  });

  it("refuses anything that does not start with 38", () => {
    expect(parseVendorBarcode("000212345671234561234561402")).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problem: "NOT_VENDOR",
    });
    expect(parseVendorBarcode("")).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "NOT_VENDOR" });
  });

  it("refuses wrong lengths, letters and impossible dates", () => {
    expect(parseVendorBarcode("38000900110072609072863430199")).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problem: "BAD_SHAPE",
    });
    expect(parseVendorBarcode("38000900110072609072863430199x")).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problem: "BAD_SHAPE",
    });
    expect(parseVendorBarcode("380009001311326090728634301998")).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problem: "BAD_DATE",
    });
  });
});

describe("item number digits", () => {
  it("keeps only the digits, never padded", () => {
    expect(itemNumberDigits("N2015D-S")).toBe("2015");
    expect(itemNumberDigits("N15234F-C")).toBe("15234");
  });
});

describe("box barcode", () => {
  const slaughter = localDate(2026, 10, 18);
  const expiry = localDate(2026, 11, 15);

  it("matches the example in PLAN.md", () => {
    expect(
      buildBoxBarcode({
        running: 2,
        itemDigits: "2015",
        slaughterDate: slaughter,
        expiryDate: expiry,
        weightKg: 14.02,
      }),
    ).toBe("000220151810261511261402");
  });

  it("is 25 digits for a 5-digit item number and parses back", () => {
    const code = buildBoxBarcode({
      running: 17,
      itemDigits: "15234",
      slaughterDate: slaughter,
      expiryDate: expiry,
      weightKg: 9.5,
    });
    expect(code).toHaveLength(25);
    expect(parseBoxBarcode(code)).toEqual({
      running: 17,
      itemDigits: "15234",
      slaughterDate: slaughter,
      expiryDate: expiry,
      weightKg: 9.5,
    });
  });

  it("rejects weights of 100 kg and more, and bad running numbers", () => {
    const base = { itemDigits: "2015", slaughterDate: slaughter, expiryDate: expiry };
    expect(() => buildBoxBarcode({ ...base, running: 1, weightKg: 100 })).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => buildBoxBarcode({ ...base, running: 0, weightKg: 1 })).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => buildBoxBarcode({ ...base, running: 10000, weightKg: 1 })).toThrow(RangeError);
  });

  it("returns null for codes of the wrong shape or impossible dates", () => {
    expect(parseBoxBarcode("12345")).toBe(null);
    expect(parseBoxBarcode("0002301532102615112614020")).toBe(null);
  });
});

describe("date helpers", () => {
  it("formats and parses DDMMYY", () => {
    expect(toDDMMYY(localDate(2026, 1, 5))).toBe("050126");
    expect(fromDDMMYY("050126")).toEqual(localDate(2026, 1, 5));
    expect(fromDDMMYY("310226")).toBe(null);
  });

  it("adds days and formats ISO dates", () => {
    expect(toISODate(addDays(localDate(2026, 12, 30), 3))).toBe("2027-01-02");
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/lib/barcodes.ts`

````ts
/**
 * In-house box barcode (PLAN.md, "Barcode formats"):
 *   running(4) + item digits(4 or 5) + slaughter DDMMYY + expiry DDMMYY + weight(4, kg x 100)
 * Example: 0002 2015 181026 151126 1402 -> 24 digits (25 with a 5-digit item number).
 */

export interface BoxBarcodeFields {
  running: number;
  itemDigits: string;
  slaughterDate: Date;
  expiryDate: Date;
  weightKg: number;
}

export const MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG = 99.99;

/** "N2015D-S" -> "3015", "N15234F-C" -> "10234". Priority item numbers carry letters; barcodes hold only the digits. */
export function itemNumberDigits(partname: string): string {
  return partname.replace(/\D/g, "");
}

export function buildBoxBarcode(f: BoxBarcodeFields): string {
  if (!Number.isInteger(f.running) || f.running < 1 || f.running > 9999) {
    throw new RangeError(`running number out of range: ${f.running}`);
  }
  if (!/^\d{4,5}$/.test(f.itemDigits)) {
    throw new RangeError(`item digits must be 4 or 5 digits: ${f.itemDigits}`);
  }
  const weightUnits = Math.round(f.weightKg * 100);
  if (weightUnits < 0 || weightUnits > 9999) {
    throw new RangeError(`weight out of range: ${f.weightKg}`);
  }
  return (
    String(f.running).padStart(4, "0") +
    f.itemDigits +
    toDDMMYY(f.slaughterDate) +
    toDDMMYY(f.expiryDate) +
    String(weightUnits).padStart(4, "0")
  );
}

export interface ParsedBoxBarcode {
  running: number;
  itemDigits: string;
  slaughterDate: Date;
  expiryDate: Date;
  weightKg: number;
}

/** First 4 = running, last 16 = dates and weight, whatever is between = item digits. */
export function parseBoxBarcode(code: string): ParsedBoxBarcode | null {
  if (!/^\d{24,25}$/.test(code)) return null;
  const running = Number(code.slice(0, 4));
  const itemDigits = code.slice(4, -16);
  const tail = code.slice(-16);
  const slaughterDate = fromDDMMYY(tail.slice(0, 6));
  const expiryDate = fromDDMMYY(tail.slice(6, 12));
  if (!slaughterDate || !expiryDate) return null;
  return { running, itemDigits, slaughterDate, expiryDate, weightKg: Number(tail.slice(12)) / 100 };
}

/**
 * Vendor box barcode (PLAN.md, "Vendor barcode"), 30 digits:
 *   38 + last 7 digits of our item barcode + slaughter DDMMYY + expiry DDMMYY + vendor running(5) + net weight(4, kg x 100)
 * Example: 38 0009001 100726 090728 63430 1998
 */
export interface ParsedVendorBarcode {
  /** The 7 digits to match against the end of an item's barcode. */
  itemBarcodeTail: string;
  slaughterDate: Date;
  expiryDate: Date;
  vendorRunning: string;
  weightKg: number;
}

export type VendorBarcodeProblem = "NOT_VENDOR" | "BAD_SHAPE" | "BAD_DATE";

/** The fields of a vendor barcode, or why the scan is not one. Only prefix 38 is accepted. */
export function parseVendorBarcode(
  code: string,
): { ok: true; value: ParsedVendorBarcode } | { ok: false; problem: VendorBarcodeProblem } {
  const text = code.trim();
  if (!text.startsWith("38")) return { ok: false, problem: "NOT_VENDOR" };
  if (!/^\d{30}$/.test(text)) return { ok: false, problem: "BAD_SHAPE" };
  const slaughterDate = fromDDMMYY(text.slice(9, 15));
  const expiryDate = fromDDMMYY(text.slice(15, 21));
  if (!slaughterDate || !expiryDate) return { ok: false, problem: "BAD_DATE" };
  return {
    ok: true,
    value: {
      itemBarcodeTail: text.slice(2, 9),
      slaughterDate,
      expiryDate,
      vendorRunning: text.slice(21, 26),
      weightKg: Number(text.slice(26)) / 100,
    },
  };
}

/**
 * The slaughter date a box's barcode carries (Priority does not store it), as YYYY-MM-DD:
 * from our own box barcode or from a vendor's. Null for any other barcode.
 */
export function slaughterDateOf(barcode: string): string | null {
  const own = parseBoxBarcode(barcode);
  if (own) return toISODate(own.slaughterDate);
  const vendor = parseVendorBarcode(barcode);
  return vendor.ok ? toISODate(vendor.value.slaughterDate) : null;
}

/** Date -> "DDMMYY" using the date's calendar day (UTC fields, see `localDate`). */
export function toDDMMYY(d: Date): string {
  const dd = String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const mm = String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const yy = String(d.getUTCFullYear() % 100).padStart(2, "0");
  return dd + mm + yy;
}

/** "DDMMYY" -> Date at UTC midnight, or null when not a real calendar date. */
export function fromDDMMYY(s: string): Date | null {
  if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(s)) return null;
  const dd = Number(s.slice(0, 2));
  const mm = Number(s.slice(2, 4));
  const yy = Number(s.slice(4, 6));
  const d = new Date(Date.UTC(2000 + yy, mm - 1, dd));
  const valid = d.getUTCDate() === dd && d.getUTCMonth() === mm - 1;
  return valid ? d : null;
}

/** A calendar date with no time of day, stored as UTC midnight so arithmetic is DST-proof. */
export function localDate(year: number, month: number, day: number): Date {
  return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
}

export function addDays(d: Date, days: number): Date {
  return new Date(d.getTime() + days * 86_400_000);
}

/** Date -> "YYYY-MM-DD" (Postgres date columns). */
export function toISODate(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
````

````ts
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";

export interface CategoryCount {
  /** Priority's category text, "" for items without one. */
  category: string;
  count: number;
}

/** Alphabetical order of Priority's texts: Hebrew letters in order, numbers by their value ("2" before "10"). */
const ALPHABETICAL = new Intl.Collator("he", { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });

/** The items in alphabetical order of their name, so an item is easy to find; ties by item number. */
export function sortByName(items: readonly PriorityItem[]): PriorityItem[] {
  return [...items].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      ALPHABETICAL.compare(a.name, b.name) || ALPHABETICAL.compare(a.itemNumber, b.itemNumber),
  );
}

/** Categories with their item counts, in alphabetical order; items without a category come last. */
export function categoryCounts(items: readonly PriorityItem[]): CategoryCount[] {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const item of items) counts.set(item.category, (counts.get(item.category) ?? 0) + 1);
  return [...counts]
    .map(([category, count]) => ({ category, count }))
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.category === "" || b.category === "") return a.category === "" ? 1 : -1;
      return ALPHABETICAL.compare(a.category, b.category);
    });
}

/**
 * The items of one category (null = all) that match the search text. The search
 * ignores case and looks at the item number, both names and the barcode; every
 * word typed must match somewhere, so "burger 150" finds "Classic beef burger 150 g".
 */
export function filterItems(
  items: readonly PriorityItem[],
  { category, query }: { category: string | null; query: string },
): PriorityItem[] {
  const words = query.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  return items.filter((item) => {
    if (category !== null && item.category !== category) return false;
    if (words.length === 0) return true;
    const haystack = [item.itemNumber, item.name, item.nameEn, item.barcode]
      .join(" ")
      .toLowerCase();
    return words.every((word) => haystack.includes(word));
  });
}
````

````ts
/** The pages that have their own help text (messages: help.pages.<topic>). */
export const HELP_TOPICS = [
  "dashboard",
  "catalog",
  "receiving",
  "vendor",
  "shipping",
  "inventory",
  "pallets",
  "settingsCompany",
  "settingsPriority",
  "settingsReceiving",
  "settingsScale",
  "labels",
  "labelEditor",
  "adminUsers",
  "adminLog",
  "adminSends",
  "adminSecurity",
  "adminMessages",
  "account",
] as const;

export type HelpTopic = (typeof HELP_TOPICS)[number];

export function isHelpTopic(value: unknown): value is HelpTopic {
  return typeof value === "string" && (HELP_TOPICS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

/** The screen a page belongs to, for a message sent from it. */
export function screenOfTopic(
  topic: HelpTopic,
):
  | "dashboard"
  | "catalog"
  | "receiving"
  | "vendor"
  | "shipping"
  | "inventory"
  | "settings"
  | "admin"
  | "account" {
  if (topic === "pallets") return "inventory";
  if (topic.startsWith("settings") || topic === "labels" || topic === "labelEditor") {
    return "settings";
  }
  if (topic.startsWith("admin")) return "admin";
  return topic as
    | "dashboard"
    | "catalog"
    | "receiving"
    | "vendor"
    | "shipping"
    | "inventory"
    | "account";
}
````

````ts
"use server";

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { isLocale, LOCALE_COOKIE, type Locale } from "@/lib/i18n/config";
import { logFor } from "@/server/activity-log";
import { getOptionalUser } from "@/server/auth/session";
import { db } from "@/server/db";
import { users } from "@/server/db/schema";

const ONE_YEAR = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365;

/**
 * Remembers the chosen language: in the cookie always, and on the user when
 * logged in (so it follows them to any device).
 */
export async function setLocale(locale: Locale): Promise<void> {
  if (!isLocale(locale)) throw new Error("Unsupported locale");

  const store = await cookies();
  store.set(LOCALE_COOKIE, locale, {
    path: "/",
    maxAge: ONE_YEAR,
    sameSite: "lax",
    httpOnly: true,
  });

  const current = await getOptionalUser();
  if (current && current.user.locale !== locale) {
    await db.update(users).set({ locale }).where(eq(users.id, current.user.id));
    await logFor(current.actor, "user.languageChanged", {
      entityType: "user",
      entityId: current.user.id,
      details: { locale },
    });
  }
}
````

````ts
export const locales = ["he", "en"] as const;
export type Locale = (typeof locales)[number];

export const defaultLocale: Locale = "he";

/** Cookie that remembers the language before login and for the login page. */
export const LOCALE_COOKIE = "locale";

export const timeZone = "Asia/Jerusalem";

export type Direction = "rtl" | "ltr";

export function isLocale(value: unknown): value is Locale {
  return typeof value === "string" && (locales as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

export function directionOf(locale: Locale): Direction {
  return locale === "he" ? "rtl" : "ltr";
}

export function otherLocale(locale: Locale): Locale {
  return locale === "he" ? "en" : "he";
}
````

````ts
import { timeZone } from "@/lib/i18n/config";

/**
 * Display formats are the same in both languages: DD/MM/YYYY, Latin digits,
 * weights with two decimals. These helpers never depend on the UI locale.
 */

const dateParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
  timeZone,
  day: "2-digit",
  month: "2-digit",
  year: "numeric",
});

const timeParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
  timeZone,
  hour: "2-digit",
  minute: "2-digit",
  hourCycle: "h23",
});

const number = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 });

const weight = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
  minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  maximumFractionDigits: 2,
});

/** 22/10/2026 */
export function formatDate(value: Date | string | number): string {
  return dateParts.format(toDate(value));
}

/** 22/10/2026 14:05 */
export function formatDateTime(value: Date | string | number): string {
  const d = toDate(value);
  return `${dateParts.format(d)} ${timeParts.format(d)}`;
}

/** 14:05 */
export function formatTime(value: Date | string | number): string {
  return timeParts.format(toDate(value));
}

/** 1402 -> "1,402" */
export function formatInteger(value: number): string {
  return number.format(value);
}

const packingWeight = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
  minimumFractionDigits: 2,
  maximumFractionDigits: 3,
});

/** 0.5 -> "0.50", 0.015 -> "0.015" (kilograms, to the gram: for what a bag or box weighs) */
export function formatPackingWeight(kg: number): string {
  return packingWeight.format(kg);
}

/** 14.0 -> "14.00" (kilograms) */
export function formatWeight(kg: number): string {
  return weight.format(kg);
}

/** Today's calendar date in the factory time zone, as YYYY-MM-DD. */
export function todayIso(now: Date = new Date()): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
    timeZone,
    year: "numeric",
    month: "2-digit",
    day: "2-digit",
  }).format(now);
}

export type DayPeriod = "morning" | "afternoon" | "evening" | "night";

/** For the greeting: morning 5-11, afternoon 12-16, evening 17-20, night otherwise (factory time). */
export function dayPeriod(now: Date = new Date()): DayPeriod {
  const hour = Number(
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone, hour: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" })
      .format(now)
      .slice(0, 2),
  );
  if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) return "morning";
  if (hour >= 12 && hour < 17) return "afternoon";
  if (hour >= 17 && hour < 21) return "evening";
  return "night";
}

/** A date written out in words in the UI language: "Thursday, 22 October 2026". */
export function formatLongDate(value: Date | string | number, locale: "he" | "en"): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale === "he" ? "he-IL" : "en-GB", {
    timeZone,
    weekday: "long",
    day: "numeric",
    month: "long",
    year: "numeric",
  }).format(toDate(value));
}

function toDate(value: Date | string | number): Date {
  return value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
}
````

````ts
/** Shared by every open tab of the system in this browser, so work in one tab keeps all of them. */
export const IDLE_STORAGE_KEY = "{{APP_ID}}.lastActivity";

export function readLastActivity(): number | null {
  try {
    const value = Number(window.localStorage.getItem(IDLE_STORAGE_KEY));
    return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function writeLastActivity(at: number): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(IDLE_STORAGE_KEY, String(at));
  } catch {
    // Without storage, only this tab's own activity counts.
  }
}
````
