````ts
import { slaughterDateOf } from "./barcodes";
import { daysBetween, expiryStatus, type ExpiryStatus } from "@/server/priority/summary";
import type { PriorityItem, PriorityStockBox, PriorityWarehouse } from "@/server/priority/types";

/**
 * The inventory screen's rows and filters. Pure, so the screen, the exports and the tests all
 * agree: one row per box in Priority's stock, with the item's names and category beside it.
 */

export interface InventoryRow {
  barcode: string;
  itemNumber: string;
  itemName: string;
  itemNameEn: string;
  category: string;
  warehouseCode: string;
  warehouseName: string;
  weightKg: number;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD, read out of the barcode; null when the barcode does not carry it. */
  slaughterDate: string | null;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  expiryDate: string;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  enteredDate: string;
  status: ExpiryStatus;
  /** Whole days until expiry; negative once expired. */
  daysLeft: number;
}

export function buildRows(
  boxes: readonly PriorityStockBox[],
  items: readonly PriorityItem[],
  warehouses: readonly PriorityWarehouse[],
  today: string,
  alertDaysFor: (category: string) => number,
): InventoryRow[] {
  const categoryOf = new Map(items.map((item) => [item.itemNumber, item.category]));
  const warehouseName = new Map(warehouses.map((w) => [w.code, w.name]));
  return boxes.map((box) => {
    const category = categoryOf.get(box.itemNumber) ?? "";
    return {
      barcode: box.barcode,
      itemNumber: box.itemNumber,
      itemName: box.itemName,
      itemNameEn: box.itemNameEn,
      category,
      warehouseCode: box.warehouseCode,
      warehouseName: warehouseName.get(box.warehouseCode) ?? box.warehouseCode,
      weightKg: box.weightKg,
      slaughterDate: slaughterDateOf(box.barcode),
      expiryDate: box.expiryDate,
      enteredDate: box.enteredDate,
      status: expiryStatus(box.expiryDate, today, alertDaysFor(category)),
      daysLeft: daysBetween(today, box.expiryDate),
    };
  });
}

export type StatusFilter = "all" | ExpiryStatus | "attention";

export interface InventoryFilters {
  /** Words matched against the item number and both names; every word must match. */
  item: string;
  /** Warehouse code, "" for all. */
  warehouse: string;
  /** Part of the box barcode. */
  barcode: string;
  /** Expiry between these dates (YYYY-MM-DD, either may be empty). */
  expiryFrom: string;
  expiryTo: string;
  /** Date entered between these dates. */
  enteredFrom: string;
  enteredTo: string;
  status: StatusFilter;
}

export const NO_FILTERS: InventoryFilters = {
  item: "",
  warehouse: "",
  barcode: "",
  expiryFrom: "",
  expiryTo: "",
  enteredFrom: "",
  enteredTo: "",
  status: "all",
};

export function hasFilters(filters: InventoryFilters): boolean {
  return (Object.keys(NO_FILTERS) as (keyof InventoryFilters)[]).some(
    (key) => filters[key] !== NO_FILTERS[key],
  );
}

export function filterRows(
  rows: readonly InventoryRow[],
  filters: InventoryFilters,
): InventoryRow[] {
  const words = filters.item.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const barcode = filters.barcode.trim();
  return rows.filter((row) => {
    if (filters.warehouse && row.warehouseCode !== filters.warehouse) return false;
    if (barcode && !row.barcode.includes(barcode)) return false;
    if (words.length > 0) {
      const haystack = [row.itemNumber, row.itemName, row.itemNameEn].join(" ").toLowerCase();
      if (!words.every((word) => haystack.includes(word))) return false;
    }
    if (filters.expiryFrom && row.expiryDate < filters.expiryFrom) return false;
    if (filters.expiryTo && row.expiryDate > filters.expiryTo) return false;
    if (filters.enteredFrom && row.enteredDate < filters.enteredFrom) return false;
    if (filters.enteredTo && row.enteredDate > filters.enteredTo) return false;
    if (filters.status === "attention") return row.status !== "valid";
    if (filters.status !== "all" && row.status !== filters.status) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

/** Expiring first, then by item name and barcode, so the most urgent boxes are on top. */
export function sortRows(rows: readonly InventoryRow[]): InventoryRow[] {
  return [...rows].sort(
    (a, b) =>
      a.expiryDate.localeCompare(b.expiryDate) ||
      a.itemName.localeCompare(b.itemName, "he") ||
      a.barcode.localeCompare(b.barcode),
  );
}

export interface ItemGroup {
  itemNumber: string;
  itemName: string;
  category: string;
  /** The item's boxes, in the order they came (the most urgent first). */
  rows: InventoryRow[];
  sums: InventoryTotals;
}

/** One group per item, the items in name order. */
export function groupByItem(rows: readonly InventoryRow[]): ItemGroup[] {
  const byItem = new Map<string, InventoryRow[]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const list = byItem.get(row.itemNumber);
    if (list) list.push(row);
    else byItem.set(row.itemNumber, [row]);
  }
  return [...byItem.values()]
    .map((list) => ({
      itemNumber: list[0].itemNumber,
      itemName: list[0].itemName,
      category: list[0].category,
      rows: list,
      sums: totals(list),
    }))
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        a.itemName.localeCompare(b.itemName, "he") || a.itemNumber.localeCompare(b.itemNumber),
    );
}

export interface InventoryTotals {
  boxes: number;
  kg: number;
  expired: number;
  soon: number;
}

export function totals(rows: readonly InventoryRow[]): InventoryTotals {
  let grams = 0;
  let expired = 0;
  let soon = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    grams += Math.round(row.weightKg * 1000);
    if (row.status === "expired") expired++;
    else if (row.status === "soon") soon++;
  }
  return { boxes: rows.length, kg: grams / 1000, expired, soon };
}
````

````ts
// The browser build is plain JavaScript (no canvas or DOM needed for SVG), so it also runs on the server.
import { toSVG } from "bwip-js/browser";
import { fromDDMMYY, toDDMMYY } from "../barcodes";

/**
 * Barcodes and QR codes as SVG, and the text an item label's QR code holds.
 * Everything here is pure: the same text always gives the same picture.
 */

const MAX_BARCODE_CHARS = 80;
const MAX_QR_CHARS = 500;
const PRINTABLE_ASCII = /^[\x20-\x7e]+$/;

/** Makes the picture fill its box: bars stretch, a QR code stays square. */
function fitted(svg: string, aspect: "none" | "xMidYMid meet"): string {
  return svg.replace("<svg ", `<svg width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="${aspect}" `);
}

/** A Code 128 barcode, or null when the text cannot be one (empty, too long, not plain ASCII). */
export function barcodeSvg(text: string, showText: boolean): string | null {
  if (text.length === 0 || text.length > MAX_BARCODE_CHARS || !PRINTABLE_ASCII.test(text))
    return null;
  try {
    const svg = toSVG({
      bcid: "code128",
      text,
      includetext: showText,
      textxalign: "center",
      textsize: 9,
      textgaps: 1,
      height: 12,
      paddingwidth: 0,
      paddingheight: 0,
    });
    return fitted(svg, "none");
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** A QR code, or null for empty or very long text. */
export function qrSvg(text: string): string | null {
  if (text.length === 0 || text.length > MAX_QR_CHARS) return null;
  try {
    // `eclevel` (error correction: L, M, Q or H) is a valid option the library's types leave out.
    const options = Object.assign(
      { bcid: "qrcode", text, paddingwidth: 0, paddingheight: 0 },
      { eclevel: "M" },
    );
    return fitted(toSVG(options), "xMidYMid meet");
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The QR code on an item label
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * What the QR code on an item label holds, so that receiving can fill in the item,
 * the production certificate and the dates by one scan. A fresh format (nothing is
 * carried over from the old system), versioned so it can grow:
 *
 *   {{QR_PREFIX}}1|<item number>|<certificate number>|<slaughter DDMMYY>|<production DDMMYY>|<expiry DDMMYY>
 *
 * Example: {{QR_PREFIX}}1|N2015D-S|123456|231026|261026|041126
 */
export interface ItemLabelQr {
  itemNumber: string;
  certificateNo: string;
  slaughterDate: Date;
  productionDate: Date;
  expiryDate: Date;
}

const QR_PREFIX = "{{QR_PREFIX}}1";
const QR_FIELD = /^[^|\s]+$/;

export function buildItemLabelQr(f: ItemLabelQr): string {
  for (const [name, value] of [
    ["item number", f.itemNumber],
    ["certificate number", f.certificateNo],
  ] as const) {
    if (!QR_FIELD.test(value))
      throw new RangeError(`${name} must be one word without "|": "${value}"`);
  }
  return [
    QR_PREFIX,
    f.itemNumber,
    f.certificateNo,
    toDDMMYY(f.slaughterDate),
    toDDMMYY(f.productionDate),
    toDDMMYY(f.expiryDate),
  ].join("|");
}

/** The fields of an item label's QR text, or null when the text is not one. */
export function parseItemLabelQr(text: string): ItemLabelQr | null {
  const parts = text.trim().split("|");
  if (parts.length !== 6 || parts[0] !== QR_PREFIX) return null;
  const [, itemNumber, certificateNo, slaughter, production, expiry] = parts;
  if (!QR_FIELD.test(itemNumber) || !QR_FIELD.test(certificateNo)) return null;
  const slaughterDate = fromDDMMYY(slaughter);
  const productionDate = fromDDMMYY(production);
  const expiryDate = fromDDMMYY(expiry);
  if (!slaughterDate || !productionDate || !expiryDate) return null;
  return { itemNumber, certificateNo, slaughterDate, productionDate, expiryDate };
}
````

````ts
  "gveret-levin": { family: "Gveret Levin", variable: "--font-label-gveret" },
};

/** The CSS font-family for a typeface a label stores, or null for the three the screens use. */
export function extraFontFamily(key: string): string | null {
  const font = (EXTRA_FONTS as Record<string, { family: string; variable: string }>)[key];
  return font ? `var(${font.variable}), "${font.family}", sans-serif` : null;
}
````

### FILE: `src/lib/labels/geometry.ts`

````ts
/** Where an element sits on the label, in millimetres. */
export interface Box {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
}

export interface Bounds {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export const GRID_MM = 0.5;

/** The smallest an element gets by dragging; thinner sizes are typed in. */
export const DRAG_MIN_MM = GRID_MM;

/** Rounds to the grid (default half a millimetre), and away from float noise. */
export function snap(value: number, step: number = GRID_MM): number {
  return Math.round(Math.round(value / step) * step * 1000) / 1000;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
}

/** Moves a box by (dx, dy), snapped, keeping it inside the label. */
export function moveBox(box: Box, dx: number, dy: number, bounds: Bounds): Box {
  return {
    ...box,
    x: clamp(snap(box.x + dx), 0, Math.max(0, bounds.width - box.w)),
    y: clamp(snap(box.y + dy), 0, Math.max(0, bounds.height - box.h)),
  };
}

/**
 * Moves several boxes together by (dx, dy), snapped. The group stays inside the label as a
 * whole, so the boxes keep their places relative to each other when the group reaches an edge.
 */
export function moveBoxes<T extends Box>(boxes: T[], dx: number, dy: number, bounds: Bounds): T[] {
  if (boxes.length === 0) return boxes;
  const left = Math.min(...boxes.map((b) => b.x));
  const top = Math.min(...boxes.map((b) => b.y));
  const right = Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.x + b.w));
  const bottom = Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.y + b.h));
  const moveX = clamp(snap(dx), -left, Math.max(-left, bounds.width - right));
  const moveY = clamp(snap(dy), -top, Math.max(-top, bounds.height - bottom));
  return boxes.map((b) => ({
    ...b,
    x: Math.round((b.x + moveX) * 1000) / 1000,
    y: Math.round((b.y + moveY) * 1000) / 1000,
  }));
}

/** The eight handles around a selected element: n = top, e = right, and so on. */
export type Handle = "n" | "s" | "e" | "w" | "ne" | "nw" | "se" | "sw";

/**
 * Drags one handle by (dx, dy): the opposite edges stay where they are. The
 * result is snapped, at least DRAG_MIN_MM in each direction, and inside the label.
 */
export function resizeBox(box: Box, handle: Handle, dx: number, dy: number, bounds: Bounds): Box {
  let left = box.x;
  let top = box.y;
  let right = box.x + box.w;
  let bottom = box.y + box.h;

  if (handle.includes("w")) left = clamp(snap(left + dx), 0, right - DRAG_MIN_MM);
  if (handle.includes("e")) right = clamp(snap(right + dx), left + DRAG_MIN_MM, bounds.width);
  if (handle.includes("n")) top = clamp(snap(top + dy), 0, bottom - DRAG_MIN_MM);
  if (handle.includes("s")) bottom = clamp(snap(bottom + dy), top + DRAG_MIN_MM, bounds.height);

  return { x: left, y: top, w: snap(right - left), h: snap(bottom - top) };
}

/** Points to millimetres, for font sizes. */
export const MM_PER_POINT = 25.4 / 72;

export function pointsToMm(points: number): number {
  return points * MM_PER_POINT;
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { parseItemLabelQr } from "./codes";
import {
  checkItemLabelInput,
  itemLabelDates,
  itemLabelValues,
  MAX_COPIES,
  parseIsoDate,
  type ItemLabelInput,
} from "./item-label";

const item: PriorityItem = {
  itemNumber: "N2015D-S",
  name: "המבורגר בקר קלאסי 150 גר׳",
  nameEn: "Classic beef burger 150 g",
  barcode: "2000000002015",
  category: "קציצות",
  weightKg: 12,
  shelfLifeDays: 12,
  storageText: "לשמור בקירור 0–4°C",
  packingCode: "קרטון",
  origin: "ישראל",
  inventoryManaged: true,
};

const good: ItemLabelInput = {
  slaughterDate: "2026-10-23",
  productionDate: "2026-10-26",
  certificateNo: "123456",
  copies: 3,
};

describe("parseIsoDate", () => {
  it("reads real calendar dates only", () => {
    expect(parseIsoDate("2026-10-23")?.toISOString()).toBe("2026-10-23T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(parseIsoDate("2028-02-29")).not.toBeNull();
    expect(parseIsoDate("2026-02-29")).toBeNull();
    expect(parseIsoDate("2026-13-01")).toBeNull();
    expect(parseIsoDate("23/10/2026")).toBeNull();
    expect(parseIsoDate("")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("checkItemLabelInput", () => {
  it("accepts good input, and a production date on the slaughter date", () => {
    expect(checkItemLabelInput(good)).toEqual([]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, productionDate: good.slaughterDate })).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("names every problem", () => {
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, slaughterDate: "" })).toEqual(["SLAUGHTER_DATE"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, productionDate: "nope" })).toEqual(["PRODUCTION_DATE"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, productionDate: "2026-10-22" })).toEqual(["DATES_ORDER"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, certificateNo: "   " })).toEqual(["CERTIFICATE"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, certificateNo: "12 34" })).toEqual(["CERTIFICATE"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, certificateNo: "12|34" })).toEqual(["CERTIFICATE"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, certificateNo: "9".repeat(31) })).toEqual([
      "CERTIFICATE",
    ]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, copies: 0 })).toEqual(["COPIES"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, copies: 1.5 })).toEqual(["COPIES"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, copies: MAX_COPIES + 1 })).toEqual(["COPIES"]);
    expect(
      checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, slaughterDate: "", certificateNo: "", copies: 0 }),
    ).toEqual(["SLAUGHTER_DATE", "CERTIFICATE", "COPIES"]);
  });

  it("ignores spaces around the certificate number", () => {
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, certificateNo: "  123456 " })).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("needs the country of origin when printing labels, but not when reading one at receiving", () => {
    const printing = { originRequired: true };
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, origin: "  " }, printing)).toEqual(["ORIGIN_MISSING"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good }, printing)).toEqual(["ORIGIN_MISSING"]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, origin: "Poland" }, printing)).toEqual([]);
    expect(checkItemLabelInput({ ...good, origin: "" })).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("the expiry date", () => {
  it("is the slaughter date plus the item's shelf life, across month ends and leap days", () => {
    const expiry = (slaughter: string, days: number) =>
      itemLabelDates(
        { ...item, shelfLifeDays: days },
        { slaughterDate: slaughter, productionDate: slaughter },
      )
        ?.expiry.toISOString()
        .slice(0, 10);
    expect(expiry("2026-10-23", 12)).toBe("2026-11-04");
    expect(expiry("2028-02-20", 10)).toBe("2028-03-01");
    expect(expiry("2026-12-25", 365)).toBe("2027-12-25");
    expect(expiry("2026-10-23", 0)).toBe("2026-10-23");
  });

    expect(parsed?.expiryDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)).toBe("2026-11-04");
  });
````

````ts
import { addDays } from "../barcodes";
import { formatDate, formatWeight } from "../i18n/format";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { buildItemLabelQr } from "./codes";
import { EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES, type LabelValues } from "./model";

/**
 * Printing an item label (catalog): what the person types, the rules for it, and the
 * values the layout is drawn with. Shared by the print window and the server, which
 * checks everything again before anything is printed.
 */

export const MAX_COPIES = 500;
export const MAX_CERTIFICATE_CHARS = 30;
export const MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS = 40;
/** Printing several items together: at most this many items, and this many labels in all. */
export const MAX_BATCH_ITEMS = 50;
export const MAX_BATCH_LABELS = 1000;

/** What is typed in the print window. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, as a date input gives them. */
export interface ItemLabelInput {
  slaughterDate: string;
  productionDate: string;
  certificateNo: string;
  copies: number;
  /** The country of origin typed for this print; empty uses the item's own (if Priority has one). */
  origin?: string;
}

export type ItemLabelProblem =
  | "SLAUGHTER_DATE"
  | "PRODUCTION_DATE"
  | "DATES_ORDER"
  | "CERTIFICATE"
  | "COPIES"
  | "ORIGIN"
  | "ORIGIN_MISSING";

/** "2026-10-23" to that day at UTC midnight, or null when it is not a real calendar date. */
export function parseIsoDate(value: string): Date | null {
  const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(value);
  if (!match) return null;
  const [year, month, day] = [Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]), Number(match[3])];
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  const real =
    date.getUTCFullYear() === year && date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 && date.getUTCDate() === day;
  return real ? date : null;
}

/**
 * Everything wrong with the input, empty when it can be printed. When printing item labels the
 * country of origin must be filled in (originRequired); reading a label at receiving has none.
 */
export function checkItemLabelInput(
  input: ItemLabelInput,
  { originRequired = false }: { originRequired?: boolean } = {},
): ItemLabelProblem[] {
  const problems: ItemLabelProblem[] = [];
  const slaughter = parseIsoDate(input.slaughterDate);
  const production = parseIsoDate(input.productionDate);
  if (!slaughter) problems.push("SLAUGHTER_DATE");
  if (!production) problems.push("PRODUCTION_DATE");
  if (slaughter && production && production < slaughter) problems.push("DATES_ORDER");
  // The certificate goes into the QR text: one word, without the separator.
  const certificate = input.certificateNo.trim();
  if (
    certificate.length === 0 ||
    certificate.length > MAX_CERTIFICATE_CHARS ||
    !/^[^|\s]+$/.test(certificate)
  ) {
    problems.push("CERTIFICATE");
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.copies) || input.copies < 1 || input.copies > MAX_COPIES) {
    problems.push("COPIES");
  }
  const origin = (input.origin ?? "").trim();
  if (originRequired && origin.length === 0) problems.push("ORIGIN_MISSING");
  else if (origin.length > MAX_ORIGIN_CHARS) problems.push("ORIGIN");
  return problems;
}

/** The slaughter, production and expiry dates; the expiry is the slaughter date plus the item's shelf life. */
export function itemLabelDates(
  item: PriorityItem,
  input: Pick<ItemLabelInput, "slaughterDate" | "productionDate">,
): { slaughter: Date; production: Date; expiry: Date } | null {
  const slaughter = parseIsoDate(input.slaughterDate);
  const production = parseIsoDate(input.productionDate);
  if (!slaughter || !production) return null;
  return { slaughter, production, expiry: addDays(slaughter, item.shelfLifeDays) };
}

/**
 * What a layout is drawn with for this item label. Priority's item fields are copied
 * exactly; the label's own fields that an item label does not have (weight, running
 * number, box barcode) are empty. Throws RangeError for input that does not pass
 * `checkItemLabelInput`.
 */
export function itemLabelValues(item: PriorityItem, input: ItemLabelInput): LabelValues {
  const problems = checkItemLabelInput(input);
  if (problems.length > 0)
    throw new RangeError(`item label input is not valid: ${problems.join(", ")}`);
  const { slaughter, production, expiry } = itemLabelDates(item, input)!;
  const certificateNo = input.certificateNo.trim();

  return {
    qrItemLabel: buildItemLabelQr({
      itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
      certificateNo,
      slaughterDate: slaughter,
      productionDate: production,
      expiryDate: expiry,
    }),
    itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
    name: item.name,
    nameEn: item.nameEn,
    itemBarcode: item.barcode,
    category: item.category,
    weightAvg: item.weightKg === null ? "" : formatWeight(item.weightKg),
    shelfLife: String(item.shelfLifeDays),
    storageText: item.storageText,
    packingCode: item.packingCode,
    origin: input.origin?.trim() || item.origin,
    slaughterDate: formatDate(slaughter),
    productionDate: formatDate(production),
    expiryDate: formatDate(expiry),
    weightKg: "",
    certificateNo,
    runningNumber: "",
    boxBarcode: "",
    palletNumber: "",
    palletBoxes: "",
    palletWeight: "",
    palletDate: "",
    palletContents: "",
    qrPallet: "",
    ...EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES,
  };
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { parseBoxBarcode } from "../barcodes";
import { EXTRA_FONT_KEYS, extraFontFamily } from "./fonts";
import { moveBox, moveBoxes, resizeBox, snap } from "./geometry";
import {
  DEFAULT_STYLE,
  FONTS,
  layoutSchema,
  lineText,
  type BoxLine,
  type LabelElement,
} from "./model";
import { sampleValues } from "./sample";

const bounds = { width: 100, height: 60 };

describe("snap", () => {
  it("rounds to half a millimetre", () => {
    expect(snap(10.24)).toBe(10);
    expect(snap(10.26)).toBe(10.5);
    expect(snap(-0.2)).toBe(-0);
    expect(snap(3.33, 1)).toBe(3);
  });
});

describe("moveBox", () => {
  const box = { x: 10, y: 10, w: 20, h: 10 };

  it("moves by the distance, snapped", () => {
    expect(moveBox(box, 5.2, -3.1, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 15, y: 7, w: 20, h: 10 });
  });

  it("stays inside the label on every side", () => {
    expect(moveBox(box, -50, -50, bounds)).toMatchObject({ x: 0, y: 0 });
    expect(moveBox(box, 500, 500, bounds)).toMatchObject({ x: 80, y: 50 });
  });
});

describe("moveBoxes", () => {
  const a = { x: 10, y: 10, w: 20, h: 10 };
  const b = { x: 40, y: 30, w: 30, h: 10 };

  it("moves every box by the same distance", () => {
    expect(moveBoxes([a, b], 5, -3, bounds)).toEqual([
      { x: 15, y: 7, w: 20, h: 10 },
      { x: 45, y: 27, w: 30, h: 10 },
    ]);
  });

  it("stops the group at an edge, so the boxes keep their distance from each other", () => {
    // b reaches the right edge (70 + 30 = 100) first, so a stops with it.
    const [movedA, movedB] = moveBoxes([a, b], 500, 0, bounds);
    expect(movedB.x + movedB.w).toBe(100);
    expect(movedB.x - movedA.x).toBe(b.x - a.x);
    const [upA, upB] = moveBoxes([a, b], 0, -500, bounds);
    expect(upA.y).toBe(0);
    expect(upB.y - upA.y).toBe(b.y - a.y);
  });

  it("does nothing for no boxes", () => {
    expect(moveBoxes([], 5, 5, bounds)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("resizeBox", () => {
  const box = { x: 10, y: 10, w: 20, h: 10 };

  it("moves only the dragged edges and keeps the opposite ones", () => {
    expect(resizeBox(box, "e", 5, 99, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 10, y: 10, w: 25, h: 10 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "w", -4, 0, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 6, y: 10, w: 24, h: 10 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "s", 0, 2, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 10, y: 10, w: 20, h: 12 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "n", 0, -3, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 10, y: 7, w: 20, h: 13 });
  });

  it("moves two edges for a corner", () => {
    expect(resizeBox(box, "se", 5, 5, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 10, y: 10, w: 25, h: 15 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "nw", -5, -5, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 5, y: 5, w: 25, h: 15 });
  });

  it("never gets smaller than the minimum or leaves the label", () => {
    expect(resizeBox(box, "e", -100, 0, bounds)).toMatchObject({ w: 0.5 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "n", 0, 100, bounds)).toMatchObject({ h: 0.5 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "e", 500, 0, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 10, y: 10, w: 90, h: 10 });
    expect(resizeBox(box, "w", -500, 0, bounds)).toEqual({ x: 0, y: 10, w: 30, h: 10 });
  });
});

      expect(() => parse({ lines: Array.from({ length: 12 }, () => line()) })).not.toThrow();
    });

    it("rejects an unknown separator, a negative frame and a line that shows an unknown field", () => {
      expect(() => parse({ separator: "wavy" })).toThrow();
      expect(() => parse({ borderMm: -1 })).toThrow();

      expect(lineText(line(), values)).toMatch(/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/);
      expect(lineText(line({ source: "expiryDate" }), values)).toMatch(/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/);
      expect(lineText(line({ source: "storageText" }), values)).toBe("שמור בקירור");
      expect(lineText(line({ source: "text", text: "אזהרה" }), values)).toBe("אזהרה");
    });
  });

  it("rejects more than 100 elements", () => {
    const many = Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => ({ ...text, id: `e${i}` }));
    expect(() => layoutSchema.parse({ ...valid, elements: many })).toThrow();
  });
});
````

````ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { EXTRA_FONT_KEYS } from "./fonts";

/**
 * A label layout: a size in millimetres and a list of elements placed on it, all
 * positions in millimetres from the top-left corner of the label. The label is a
 * physical object, so its coordinates do not mirror in right-to-left screens.
 */

export const LABEL_TYPES = ["item", "box", "pallet", "shipping"] as const;
export type LabelType = (typeof LABEL_TYPES)[number];

/** Fields from Priority's item record (read only, shown exactly as Priority has them). */
export const ITEM_FIELDS = [
  "itemNumber",
  "name",
  "nameEn",
  "itemBarcode",
  "category",
  "weightAvg",
  "shelfLife",
  "storageText",
  "packingCode",
  "origin",
] as const;

/** The label's own data: filled in when a label is printed. */
export const LABEL_FIELDS = [
  "slaughterDate",
  "productionDate",
  "expiryDate",
  "weightKg",
  "certificateNo",
  "runningNumber",
  "boxBarcode",
  // A pallet label's own data (see src/lib/pallets.ts).
  "palletNumber",
  "palletBoxes",
  "palletWeight",
  "palletDate",
  "palletContents",
] as const;

/** A shipping label's own data: the order Priority sent, and which label of the set this is. */
export const ORDER_FIELDS = [
  "orderNumber",
  "customerName",
  "customerNumber",
  "address",
  "city",
  "phone",
  "shipDate",
  "orderNotes",
  "labelNumber",
  "labelCount",
  "labelOf",
  "unitName",
] as const;

/** The order fields, all empty: what every label that is not a shipping label is drawn with. */
export const EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES: Record<(typeof ORDER_FIELDS)[number], string> = {
  orderNumber: "",
  customerName: "",
  customerNumber: "",
  address: "",
  city: "",
  phone: "",
  shipDate: "",
  orderNotes: "",
  labelNumber: "",
  labelCount: "",
  labelOf: "",
  unitName: "",
};

export const FIELD_KEYS = [...ITEM_FIELDS, ...LABEL_FIELDS, ...ORDER_FIELDS] as const;
export type FieldKey = (typeof FIELD_KEYS)[number];

/** The three typefaces of the screens, then the Hebrew-capable ones added for labels (fonts.ts). */
export const FONTS = ["sans", "serif", "mono", ...EXTRA_FONT_KEYS] as const;
export const ALIGNS = ["start", "center", "end"] as const;
/** The language of a text: right to left, left to right, or decided by its own letters. */
export const DIRECTIONS = ["auto", "rtl", "ltr"] as const;

export const MIN_LABEL_MM = 10;
export const MAX_LABEL_MM = 300;
/** Smallest size a layout may hold (a thin line); dragging stops at half a millimetre. */
export const MIN_ELEMENT_MM = 0.2;
export const MAX_ELEMENTS = 100;

const mm = z.number().finite().min(-MAX_LABEL_MM).max(MAX_LABEL_MM);
const size = z.number().finite().min(MIN_ELEMENT_MM).max(MAX_LABEL_MM);

export const styleSchema = z.object({
  /** Points (1 pt = 0.3528 mm). */
  fontSize: z.number().finite().min(4).max(120),
  bold: z.boolean(),
  font: z.enum(FONTS),
  align: z.enum(ALIGNS),
  dir: z.enum(DIRECTIONS),
});
export type ElementStyle = z.infer<typeof styleSchema>;

const base = {
  id: z.string().min(1).max(64),
  x: mm,
  y: mm,
  w: size,
  h: size,
};

/**
 * What a QR code holds: the whole item label (see codes.ts), the box or item barcode digits, or
 * a pallet's code (see src/lib/pallets.ts).
 */
export const QR_SOURCES = ["itemLabel", "boxBarcode", "itemBarcode", "pallet"] as const;
export type QrSource = (typeof QR_SOURCES)[number];

/** Which form of the company logo: the full dark logo, or the small mark. */
export const LOGO_VARIANTS = ["full", "mark"] as const;
export type LogoVariant = (typeof LOGO_VARIANTS)[number];

/** How the lines of a lines box are told apart. */
export const LINE_SEPARATORS = ["none", "dotted", "solid"] as const;
export type LineSeparator = (typeof LINE_SEPARATORS)[number];

/** What a line of a lines box shows: one of the label's fields, or a text typed in the designer. */
export const LINE_SOURCES = [...FIELD_KEYS, "text"] as const;
export type LineSource = (typeof LINE_SOURCES)[number];

export const MAX_BOX_LINES = 12;

/** One line of a lines box: the words before the value, the value, and how the line is written. */
export const boxLineSchema = z.object({
  /** The words before the value ("Slaughter date:"); empty for the value alone. */
  label: z.string().max(100),
  source: z.enum(LINE_SOURCES),
  /** The value when `source` is "text". */
  text: z.string().max(500),
  style: styleSchema,
});
export type BoxLine = z.infer<typeof boxLineSchema>;

/**
 * What a layout is drawn with: the preview values of every field, and the text an
 * item label's QR code holds. A real print fills the same shape with real data.
 */
export type LabelValues = Record<FieldKey, string> & { qrItemLabel: string; qrPallet: string };

export const elementSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
  z.object({ ...base, type: z.literal("text"), text: z.string().max(500), style: styleSchema }),
  z.object({ ...base, type: z.literal("field"), field: z.enum(FIELD_KEYS), style: styleSchema }),
  /** A Code 128 barcode of a field's text, optionally with the text printed under the bars. */
  z.object({
    ...base,
    type: z.literal("barcode"),
    field: z.enum(FIELD_KEYS),
    showText: z.boolean(),
  }),
  z.object({ ...base, type: z.literal("qr"), source: z.enum(QR_SOURCES) }),
  z.object({ ...base, type: z.literal("logo"), variant: z.enum(LOGO_VARIANTS) }),
  /** A solid bar; its height is the thickness. */
  z.object({ ...base, type: z.literal("line") }),
  /**
   * One frame holding several lines, each a label and a value (for example the three dates). The
   * lines share the height of the frame equally; the frame, its rounded corners and the line
   * between the lines are set here, and every line has its own typeface, size and language.
   */
  z.object({
    ...base,
    type: z.literal("lines"),
    /** 0 draws no frame. */
    borderMm: z.number().finite().min(0).max(5),
    radiusMm: z.number().finite().min(0).max(20),
    separator: z.enum(LINE_SEPARATORS),
    lines: z.array(boxLineSchema).min(1).max(MAX_BOX_LINES),
  }),
  /** An empty rectangle with a border of `borderMm`. */
  z.object({
    ...base,
    type: z.literal("box"),
    borderMm: z.number().finite().min(0.1).max(5),
  }),
]);
export type LabelElement = z.infer<typeof elementSchema>;
export type ElementType = LabelElement["type"];

export const layoutNameSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(80);

export const layoutSchema = z.object({
  name: layoutNameSchema,
  widthMm: z.number().finite().min(MIN_LABEL_MM).max(MAX_LABEL_MM),
  heightMm: z.number().finite().min(MIN_LABEL_MM).max(MAX_LABEL_MM),
  elements: z.array(elementSchema).max(MAX_ELEMENTS),
});
export type LayoutContent = z.infer<typeof layoutSchema>;

export const DEFAULT_STYLE: ElementStyle = {
  fontSize: 10,
  bold: false,
  font: "sans",
  align: "start",
  dir: "auto",
};

/** What a line of a lines box shows, from the label's values. */
export function lineText(line: BoxLine, values: LabelValues): string {
  return line.source === "text" ? line.text : values[line.source];
}

export function newElementId(): string {
  return crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
}
````

````ts
import { addDays, buildBoxBarcode, itemNumberDigits } from "../barcodes";
import { formatDate, formatWeight } from "../i18n/format";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";
import { buildItemLabelQr } from "./codes";
import type { LabelValues } from "./model";
import { sampleOrderValues } from "./shipping";

/**
 * What a label looks like with real-looking data, for the designer's preview and
 * the test print. Item fields come from a real item; the label's own data (dates,
 * weight, certificate number) is made up but follows the real formats.
 */
export function sampleValues(item: PriorityItem, today: Date): LabelValues {
  const slaughter = addDays(today, -3);
  const expiry = addDays(slaughter, item.shelfLifeDays);
  const weightKg = 14.02;
  const digits = itemNumberDigits(item.itemNumber);

  let boxBarcode = "";
  try {
    boxBarcode = buildBoxBarcode({
      running: 2,
      itemDigits: digits,
      slaughterDate: slaughter,
      expiryDate: expiry,
      weightKg,
    });
  } catch {
    // An item number without 4 or 5 digits cannot have a box barcode yet.
  }

  const certificateNo = "123456";
  let qrItemLabel = "";
  try {
    qrItemLabel = buildItemLabelQr({
      itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
      certificateNo,
      slaughterDate: slaughter,
      productionDate: today,
      expiryDate: expiry,
    });
  } catch {
    // An item number with a space or "|" cannot go in the QR text.
  }

  return {
    qrItemLabel,
    itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
    name: item.name,
    nameEn: item.nameEn,
    itemBarcode: item.barcode,
    category: item.category,
    weightAvg: item.weightKg === null ? "" : formatWeight(item.weightKg),
    shelfLife: String(item.shelfLifeDays),
    storageText: item.storageText,
    packingCode: item.packingCode,
    origin: item.origin,
    slaughterDate: formatDate(slaughter),
    productionDate: formatDate(today),
    expiryDate: formatDate(expiry),
    weightKg: formatWeight(weightKg),
    certificateNo,
    runningNumber: "0002",
    boxBarcode,
    // A made-up pallet, so a pallet layout previews with real-looking data.
    palletNumber: "12",
    palletBoxes: "24",
    palletWeight: formatWeight(336.5),
    palletDate: formatDate(today),
    palletContents: `${item.name} × 24`,
    qrPallet: "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|12",
    ...sampleOrderValues(today),
  };
}
````

````ts
import { layoutSchema } from "./model";

  copiesFor,

  address: "הרצל 15",
  city: "טבריה",
  phone: "04-6712345",
  shipDate: "09/11/2026",
  notes: "",
  labelCount: null,
};

describe("parseOrderPayload", () => {

    const result = parseOrderPayload({
      ORDNAME: "SO26000123",
      CUSTNAME: "C1042",
      CDES: "מרכול הגליל",
      CURDATE: "2026-11-09T00:00:00+02:00",
    });
    expect(result).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      order: expect.objectContaining({
        orderNumber: "SO26000123",
        customerNumber: "C1042",
        customerName: "מרכול הגליל",
        shipDate: "09/11/2026",
      }),
    });
  });

  it("reads readable names, in any capitals, with spaces or underscores", () => {
    const result = parseOrderPayload({
      "Order Number": "A-7",
      customer_name: "Cohen",
      City: "Haifa",
      Phone: "04-1",
      Notes: "keep cold",
      labels: "12",
    });
    expect(result.ok && result.order).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({
        orderNumber: "A-7",
        customerName: "Cohen",
        city: "Haifa",
        phone: "04-1",
        notes: "keep cold",
        labelCount: 12,
      }),
    );
  });

  it("finds the order inside a nested body or a list of one order", () => {
    const nested = parseOrderPayload({ body: { value: [{ ordname: "N1", cdes: "Levi" }] } });
    expect(nested.ok && nested.order.orderNumber).toBe("N1");
    expect(nested.ok && nested.order.customerName).toBe("Levi");
  });

  it("joins a second address line", () => {
    const result = parseOrderPayload({ ordname: "N2", address: "Herzl 15", address2: "Floor 3" });
    expect(result.ok && result.order.address).toBe("Herzl 15, Floor 3");
  });

  it("fails only when there is no order number", () => {
    expect(parseOrderPayload({ cdes: "Levi" })).toEqual({ ok: false });
    expect(parseOrderPayload({})).toEqual({ ok: false });
    expect(parseOrderPayload(null)).toEqual({ ok: false });
    expect(parseOrderPayload("text")).toEqual({ ok: false });
    expect(parseOrderPayload({ ordname: "   " })).toEqual({ ok: false });
  });

  it("keeps the number of labels Priority asked for between 1 and the largest", () => {
    const labels = (value: unknown) => {
      const result = parseOrderPayload({ ordname: "N", labels: value });
      return result.ok ? result.order.labelCount : "failed";
    };
    expect(labels(10)).toBe(10);
    expect(labels("3")).toBe(3);
    expect(labels(0)).toBeNull();
    expect(labels(-4)).toBeNull();
    expect(labels("many")).toBeNull();
    expect(labels(100000)).toBe(MAX_LABELS);
  });

  it("cuts a very long text", () => {
    const result = parseOrderPayload({ ordname: "N", cdes: "x".repeat(5000) });
    expect(result.ok && result.order.customerName.length).toBe(200);
  });
});

describe("readShipDate", () => {
  it("writes dates as DD/MM/YYYY and leaves other text alone", () => {
    expect(readShipDate("2026-11-09")).toBe("09/11/2026");
    expect(readShipDate("2026-11-09T00:00:00+02:00")).toBe("09/11/2026");
    expect(readShipDate("9.11.2026")).toBe("09/11/2026");
    expect(readShipDate("next Tuesday")).toBe("next Tuesday");
    expect(readShipDate("")).toBe("");
  });
});

describe("the labels of an order", () => {
  it("numbers every label out of the total", () => {
    const pages = shippingLabelPages(order, 10);
    expect(pages).toHaveLength(10);
    expect(pages.map((page) => page.labelOf)).toEqual(
      Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `Box ${i + 1} of 10`),
    );
    expect(pages[2].labelNumber).toBe("3");
    expect(pages[2].labelCount).toBe("10");
    expect(labelOf(1, 1)).toBe("Box 1 of 1");
    expect(labelOf(3, 10, "pallet")).toBe("Pallet 3 of 10");
    expect(labelOf(3, 10, "box", "he")).toBe("ארגז 3 מתוך 10");
    expect(labelOf(1, 4, "pallet", "he")).toBe("משטח 1 מתוך 4");
    expect(shippingLabelPages(order, 2, "pallet")[1].labelOf).toBe("Pallet 2 of 2");
    expect(shippingLabelPages(order, 2, "pallet", "he")[1].unitName).toBe("משטח");
  });

  it("prints each pallet number on several labels in a row, and a box on one", () => {
    // 10 pallets, 4 labels for each: Pallet 1 of 10 four times, then Pallet 2 of 10 four times...
    const pallets = shippingLabelPages(order, 10, "pallet", "en", copiesFor("pallet", 4));
    expect(pallets).toHaveLength(40);
    expect(pallets.slice(0, 4).map((p) => p.labelOf)).toEqual(Array(4).fill("Pallet 1 of 10"));
    expect(pallets.slice(4, 8).map((p) => p.labelOf)).toEqual(Array(4).fill("Pallet 2 of 10"));
    expect(pallets[39].labelOf).toBe("Pallet 10 of 10");
    // Boxes: one label each, whatever the number of labels for a pallet is.
    expect(copiesFor("box", 4)).toBe(1);
    const boxes = shippingLabelPages(order, 10, "box", "en", copiesFor("box", 4));
    expect(boxes.map((p) => p.labelOf)).toEqual(
      Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => `Box ${i + 1} of 10`),
    );
  });

  it("limits one print to a sensible number of labels", () => {
    expect(isValidPrint(10, 4)).toBe(true);
    expect(isValidPrint(200, 5)).toBe(true);
    expect(isValidPrint(200, 6)).toBe(false);
    expect(isValidPrint(0, 1)).toBe(false);
    expect(isValidPrint(5, 0)).toBe(false);
    expect(isValidPrint(5, 11)).toBe(false);
    expect(isValidPrint(1.5, 1)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("fills the order's details and leaves the fields of other labels empty", () => {
    const values = shippingLabelValues(order, 1, 4);
    expect(values.orderNumber).toBe("SO26000123");
    expect(values.customerName).toBe("מרכול הגליל");
    expect(values.city).toBe("טבריה");
    expect(values.name).toBe("");
    expect(values.palletNumber).toBe("");
    expect(values.qrItemLabel).toBe("");
  });

  it("starts from a valid layout that uses the order and the numbering", () => {
    expect(layoutSchema.safeParse(STARTER_SHIPPING_LAYOUT).success).toBe(true);
    const fields = STARTER_SHIPPING_LAYOUT.elements.flatMap((e) =>
      e.type === "field" || e.type === "barcode" ? [e.field] : [],
    );
    expect(fields).toContain("orderNumber");
    expect(fields).toContain("labelOf");
  });
});
````

````ts
import { formatDate } from "../i18n/format";
import { EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES, FIELD_KEYS, type LabelValues } from "./model";

/**
 * Shipping labels. After an order is picked and confirmed in Priority, Priority sends the order's
 * details to this system; the details become labels to put on the order's boxes ("3 / 10").
 * Nothing here picks or counts goods: it only reads what Priority sent and prints it.
 */

/** What is kept of an order Priority sent. */
export interface ShippingOrder {
  orderNumber: string;
  customerName: string;
  customerNumber: string;
  address: string;
  city: string;
  phone: string;
  /** DD/MM/YYYY when it could be read as a date, otherwise the text as sent. */
  shipDate: string;
  notes: string;
  /** How many labels Priority asked for (for example the number of cartons); null when it did not say. */
  labelCount: number | null;
}

export const MAX_LABELS = 200;

/** A pallet's number is printed on several labels (one for each side of the pallet). */
export const DEFAULT_PALLET_COPIES = 4;
export const MAX_PALLET_COPIES = 10;
/** The most labels one print may make (boxes or pallets times the labels of each). */
export const MAX_PRINT_LABELS = 1000;

/** Labels for each box or pallet: one for a box, `palletCopies` for a pallet. */
export function copiesFor(unit: "box" | "pallet", palletCopies: number): number {
  return unit === "pallet" ? palletCopies : 1;
}

export function isValidPrint(total: number, copies: number): boolean {
  return (
    Number.isInteger(total) &&
    total >= 1 &&
    total <= MAX_LABELS &&
    Number.isInteger(copies) &&
    copies >= 1 &&
    copies <= MAX_PALLET_COPIES &&
    total * copies <= MAX_PRINT_LABELS
  );
}

const MAX_TEXT = 200;
const MAX_NOTES = 500;

/**
 * The names Priority (or anything else) may send each detail under, written without spaces,
 * underscores or capitals. Priority's own column names are here too: ORDNAME is the order number,
 * CUSTNAME the customer number and CDES the customer's name.
 */
export const ORDER_ALIASES = {
  orderNumber: [
    "ordname",
    "ordernumber",
    "orderno",
    "ordernum",
    "orderid",
    "order",
    "ordno",
    "docno",
    "ordnumber",
    "מספרהזמנה",
    "הזמנה",
  ],
  customerName: [
    "cdes",
    "custdes",
    "customername",
    "customerdes",
    "customer",
    "clientname",
    "client",
    "name",
    "שםלקוח",
    "לקוח",
  ],
  customerNumber: [
    "custname",
    "customernumber",
    "customerno",
    "customercode",
    "customerid",
    "custno",
    "custnumber",
    "clientnumber",
    "מספרלקוח",
  ],
  address: [
    "address",
    "address1",
    "addr",
    "street",
    "shiptoaddress",
    "deliveryaddress",
    "כתובת",
    "רחוב",
  ],
  city: ["city", "town", "state", "statename", "shiptocity", "deliverycity", "עיר", "ישוב"],
  phone: ["phone", "tel", "telephone", "mobile", "cellphone", "phonenum", "phonenumber", "טלפון"],
  shipDate: [
    "shipdate",
    "curdate",
    "duedate",
    "deliverydate",
    "supplydate",
    "supplydate",
    "date",
    "תאריך",
    "תאריךאספקה",
  ],
  notes: ["notes", "note", "remarks", "remark", "details", "comments", "comment", "הערות"],
  labelCount: [
    "labels",
    "labelcount",
    "numlabels",
    "numberoflabels",
    "copies",
    "boxes",
    "cartons",
    "packages",
    "packagecount",
    "מספרמדבקות",
    "מספרארגזים",
  ],
} as const;

/** Names written the same way for comparison: lower case, letters and digits only. */
export function normalizeKey(key: string): string {
  return key.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, "");
}

const SECOND_ADDRESS = ["address2", "addr2"];

/** Every plain value of what was sent, with its name; objects inside are searched too. */
function flatten(input: unknown, found: Map<string, string>, depth = 0): void {
  if (depth > 4 || input === null || input === undefined) return;
  if (Array.isArray(input)) {
    // Priority sends a list of one order; the first is the one.
    if (input.length > 0) flatten(input[0], found, depth + 1);
    return;
  }
  if (typeof input !== "object") return;
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
      const name = normalizeKey(key);
      const text = String(value).trim();
      if (name && text && !found.has(name)) found.set(name, text);
    } else {
      flatten(value, found, depth + 1);
    }
  }
}

function pick(found: Map<string, string>, names: readonly string[]): string {
  for (const name of names) {
    const value = found.get(name);
    if (value) return value;
  }
  return "";
}

/** 2026-11-09 or 2026-11-09T00:00:00+02:00 becomes 09/11/2026; anything else is kept as sent. */
export function readShipDate(text: string): string {
  const iso = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})(?:$|[T ])/.exec(text);
  if (iso) return `${iso[3]}/${iso[2]}/${iso[1]}`;
  const dots = /^(\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})[./-](\d{4})$/.exec(text);
  if (dots) return `${dots[1].padStart(2, "0")}/${dots[2].padStart(2, "0")}/${dots[3]}`;
  return text;
}

export type ParsedOrder = { ok: true; order: ShippingOrder } | { ok: false };

/**
 * Reads the order out of whatever Priority sent (JSON, form fields or the address line), whatever
 * it calls the details. Fails only when there is no order number.
 */
export function parseOrderPayload(input: unknown): ParsedOrder {
  const found = new Map<string, string>();
  flatten(input, found);

  const orderNumber = pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.orderNumber).slice(0, 60);
  if (!orderNumber) return { ok: false };

  const secondLine = pick(found, SECOND_ADDRESS);
  const address = [pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.address), secondLine].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
  const asked = Number.parseInt(pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.labelCount), 10);

  return {
    ok: true,
    order: {
      orderNumber,
      customerName: pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.customerName).slice(0, MAX_TEXT),
      customerNumber: pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.customerNumber).slice(0, 60),
      address: address.slice(0, MAX_TEXT),
      city: pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.city).slice(0, MAX_TEXT),
      phone: pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.phone).slice(0, 60),
      shipDate: readShipDate(pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.shipDate)).slice(0, 40),
      notes: pick(found, ORDER_ALIASES.notes).slice(0, MAX_NOTES),
      labelCount: Number.isInteger(asked) && asked >= 1 ? Math.min(asked, MAX_LABELS) : null,
    },
  };
}

/** What the labels of an order are for: one per box, or one per pallet. */
export const SHIPPING_UNITS = ["box", "pallet"] as const;
export type ShippingUnit = (typeof SHIPPING_UNITS)[number];

export function isShippingUnit(value: unknown): value is ShippingUnit {
  return value === "box" || value === "pallet";
}

type Language = "he" | "en";

const WORDS: Record<Language, { box: string; pallet: string; of: string }> = {
  he: { box: "ארגז", pallet: "משטח", of: "מתוך" },
  en: { box: "Box", pallet: "Pallet", of: "of" },
};

/** The word on the label: "Box" or "Pallet" (in Hebrew, "ארגז" or "משטח"). */
export function unitWord(unit: ShippingUnit, language: Language): string {
  return WORDS[language][unit];
}

/** "Box 3 of 10", "Pallet 1 of 4" (in Hebrew, "ארגז 3 מתוך 10"). */
export function labelOf(
  number: number,
  total: number,
  unit: ShippingUnit = "box",
  language: Language = "en",
): string {
  const words = WORDS[language];
  return `${words[unit]} ${number} ${words.of} ${total}`;
}

function blankValues(): LabelValues {
  const values = { qrItemLabel: "", qrPallet: "" } as LabelValues;
  for (const key of FIELD_KEYS) values[key] = "";
  return values;
}

/** The values a shipping layout is drawn with for one label of a set. */
export function shippingLabelValues(
  order: ShippingOrder,
  number: number,
  total: number,
  unit: ShippingUnit = "box",
  language: Language = "en",
): LabelValues {
  return {
    ...blankValues(),
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    customerName: order.customerName,
    customerNumber: order.customerNumber,
    address: order.address,
    city: order.city,
    phone: order.phone,
    shipDate: order.shipDate,
    orderNotes: order.notes,
    labelNumber: String(number),
    labelCount: String(total),
    labelOf: labelOf(number, total, unit, language),
    unitName: unitWord(unit, language),
  };
}

/**
 * Every label of a set, in print order: Box 1 of total, Box 2 of total, and so on. With `copies`
 * more than one (the labels of a pallet), each number is printed that many times in a row:
 * Pallet 1 of 10 four times, then Pallet 2 of 10 four times.
 */
export function shippingLabelPages(
  order: ShippingOrder,
  total: number,
  unit: ShippingUnit = "box",
  language: Language = "en",
  copies = 1,
): LabelValues[] {
  return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, index) =>
    Array.from({ length: copies }, () =>
      shippingLabelValues(order, index + 1, total, unit, language),
    ),
  ).flat();
}

/** A made-up order, for the designer's preview and the test order. */
export function sampleOrder(today: Date): ShippingOrder {
  return {
    orderNumber: "SO26000123",
    customerName: "מרכול הגליל בע״מ",
    customerNumber: "C1042",
    address: "הרצל 15",
    city: "טבריה",
    phone: "04-6712345",
    shipDate: formatDate(today),
    notes: "לשמור בקירור. לפרוק בדלת האחורית.",
    // No number of labels of its own: the print window starts from 1 (the default).
    labelCount: null,
  };
}

export function sampleOrderValues(today: Date): Record<keyof typeof EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES, string> {
  const values = shippingLabelValues(sampleOrder(today), 1, 10);
  const result = { ...EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES };
  for (const key of Object.keys(result) as (keyof typeof result)[]) result[key] = values[key];
  return result;
}
````

### FILE: `src/lib/labels/starters.ts`

````ts
import {
  DEFAULT_STYLE,
  type BoxLine,
  type ElementStyle,
  type LabelElement,
  type LabelType,
} from "./model";

/**
 * The layouts a new installation starts with, so the designer never opens empty.
 * They are ordinary layouts: everything in them can be changed or deleted.
 */

export interface StarterLayout {
  name: string;
  type: LabelType;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
}

const style = (overrides: Partial<ElementStyle>): ElementStyle => ({
  ...DEFAULT_STYLE,
  ...overrides,
});

function text(
  id: string,
  [x, y, w, h]: [number, number, number, number],
  value: string,
  overrides: Partial<ElementStyle> = {},
): LabelElement {
  return { id, type: "text", x, y, w, h, text: value, style: style(overrides) };
}

function field(
  id: string,
  [x, y, w, h]: [number, number, number, number],
  key: Extract<LabelElement, { type: "field" }>["field"],
  overrides: Partial<ElementStyle> = {},
): LabelElement {
  return { id, type: "field", x, y, w, h, field: key, style: style(overrides) };
}

/** One line, or several lines, of a frameless lines box. */
function lines(
  id: string,
  [x, y, w, h]: [number, number, number, number],
  rows: [string, BoxLine["source"]][],
  overrides: Partial<ElementStyle> = {},
): LabelElement {
  return {
    id,
    type: "lines",
    x,
    y,
    w,
    h,
    borderMm: 0,
    radiusMm: 0,
    separator: "none",
    lines: rows.map(([label, source]) => ({ label, source, text: "", style: style(overrides) })),
  };
}
````

### FILE: `src/lib/packaging.ts`

````ts
/** Whole grams: weights are kept to the gram, so sums never drift. */
export const grams = (kg: number): number => Math.round(kg * 1000);

/**
 * The weight to keep for a box: the scale reading less the packing, to the hundredth of a
 * kilogram. Null when nothing is left (or less than 0.01 kg).
 */
export function netWeight(grossKg: number, tareKg: number): number | null {
  const left = grams(grossKg) - grams(tareKg);
  const hundredths = Math.round(left / 10);
  return hundredths >= 1 ? hundredths / 100 : null;
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { buildPalletQr, palletContents, palletLabelValues, parsePalletQr } from "./pallets";

describe("pallet QR code", () => {
  it("holds the pallet number and reads back", () => {
    expect(buildPalletQr(12)).toBe("{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|12");
    expect(parsePalletQr("{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|12")).toBe(12);
    expect(parsePalletQr("  {{QR_PREFIX}}P1|7\n")).toBe(7);
  });

  it("is not made for a number that is not a pallet's", () => {
    expect(() => buildPalletQr(0)).toThrow(RangeError);
    expect(() => buildPalletQr(1.5)).toThrow(RangeError);
  });

  it("is recognised only when it really is one", () => {
    for (const text of [
      "",
      "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|",
      "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|0",
      "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|-3",
      "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|12|3",
      "{{QR_PREFIX}}P2|12",
      "{{QR_PREFIX}}1|N2015D-S|123456|231026|261026|041126", // an item label
      "000220151810261511261402", // a box barcode
      "{{QR_PREFIX_LOWER}}p1|12",
    ]) {
      expect(parsePalletQr(text)).toBeNull();
    }
  });
});

describe("pallet label", () => {
  const boxes = [
    { itemName: "המבורגר בקר", weightKg: 10.25 },
    { itemName: "שיפודי בקר מתובלים", weightKg: 9.5 },
    { itemName: "המבורגר בקר", weightKg: 8 },
  ];

  it("names each item with how many boxes of it, the biggest group first", () => {
    expect(palletContents(boxes)).toBe("המבורגר בקר × 2, שיפודי בקר מתובלים × 1");
  });

  it("cuts a very long summary", () => {
    const many = Array.from({ length: 80 }, (_, i) => ({
      itemName: `פריט מספר ${i} בשם ארוך`,
      weightKg: 1,
    }));
    const text = palletContents(many);
    expect(text.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(300);
    expect(text.endsWith("…")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("is drawn with the pallet's number, count, exact weight, date and QR", () => {
    const values = palletLabelValues({ number: 12, createdDate: "2026-10-28", boxes });
    expect(values).toMatchObject({
      palletNumber: "12",
      palletBoxes: "3",
      palletDate: "28/10/2026",
      qrPallet: "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1|12",
      name: "",
      boxBarcode: "",
    });
    expect(values.palletWeight).toBe("27.75");
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/lib/pallets.ts`

````ts
import { formatDate, formatWeight } from "./i18n/format";
import { EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES, type LabelValues } from "./labels/model";

/**
 * Pallets: a summary of boxes that stand together, made so that one scan of one QR code names
 * all of them. A pallet never changes stock; it is only a list of box barcodes.
 */

/** A pallet's QR code holds its number: {{QR_PREFIX}}P1|12 (version 1 of the pallet code). */
const PREFIX = "{{QR_PREFIX}}P1";

export function buildPalletQr(number: number): string {
  if (!Number.isInteger(number) || number < 1)
    throw new RangeError(`not a pallet number: ${number}`);
  return `${PREFIX}|${number}`;
}

/** The pallet number in a scanned text, or null when the text is not a pallet's QR code. */
export function parsePalletQr(text: string): number | null {
  const match = /^{{QR_PREFIX}}P1\|(\d{1,9})$/.exec(text.trim());
  if (!match) return null;
  const number = Number(match[1]);
  return number >= 1 ? number : null;
}

export const MAX_PALLET_BOXES = 500;

/** What the label of a pallet is made from. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. */
export interface PalletLabelData {
  number: number;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  createdDate: string;
  boxes: { itemName: string; weightKg: number }[];
}

const MAX_CONTENTS_CHARS = 300;

/** "Beef burger × 12, Fresh ground beef × 4": each item with how many boxes of it, the biggest group first. */
export function palletContents(boxes: PalletLabelData["boxes"]): string {
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const box of boxes) counts.set(box.itemName, (counts.get(box.itemName) ?? 0) + 1);
  const text = [...counts]
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0], "he"))
    .map(([name, count]) => `${name} × ${count}`)
    .join(", ");
  return text.length > MAX_CONTENTS_CHARS ? `${text.slice(0, MAX_CONTENTS_CHARS - 1)}…` : text;
}

/** The values a pallet layout is drawn with; the fields of item and box labels stay empty. */
export function palletLabelValues(pallet: PalletLabelData): LabelValues {
  let grams = 0;
  for (const box of pallet.boxes) grams += Math.round(box.weightKg * 1000);
  return {
    qrItemLabel: "",
    itemNumber: "",
    name: "",
    nameEn: "",
    itemBarcode: "",
    category: "",
    weightAvg: "",
    shelfLife: "",
    storageText: "",
    packingCode: "",
    origin: "",
    slaughterDate: "",
    productionDate: "",
    expiryDate: "",
    weightKg: "",
    certificateNo: "",
    runningNumber: "",
    boxBarcode: "",
    palletNumber: String(pallet.number),
    palletBoxes: String(pallet.boxes.length),
    palletWeight: formatWeight(grams / 1000),
    palletDate: formatDate(pallet.createdDate),
    palletContents: palletContents(pallet.boxes),
    qrPallet: buildPalletQr(pallet.number),
    ...EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES,
  };
}
````

````ts
import { formatDate, formatWeight } from "../i18n/format";
import { EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES, type LabelValues } from "../labels/model";
import type { PriorityItem } from "@/server/priority/types";

/** What a received box is, as far as its label is concerned (dates are YYYY-MM-DD). */
export interface BoxLabelData {
  barcode: string;
  running: string;
  weightKg: number;
  slaughterDate: string;
  productionDate: string | null;
  expiryDate: string;
  certificateNo: string | null;
}

/**
 * The values the one box layout is drawn with: Priority's item fields exactly as they are,
 * and the box's own weight, dates, certificate, running number and barcode. The item label's
 * QR is empty (a box label carries the box barcode instead).
 */
export function boxLabelValues(item: PriorityItem, box: BoxLabelData): LabelValues {
  return {
    qrItemLabel: "",
    itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
    name: item.name,
    nameEn: item.nameEn,
    itemBarcode: item.barcode,
    category: item.category,
    weightAvg: item.weightKg === null ? "" : formatWeight(item.weightKg),
    shelfLife: String(item.shelfLifeDays),
    storageText: item.storageText,
    packingCode: item.packingCode,
    origin: item.origin,
    slaughterDate: formatDate(box.slaughterDate),
    productionDate: box.productionDate ? formatDate(box.productionDate) : "",
    expiryDate: formatDate(box.expiryDate),
    weightKg: formatWeight(box.weightKg),
    certificateNo: box.certificateNo ?? "",
    runningNumber: box.running,
    boxBarcode: box.barcode,
    palletNumber: "",
    palletBoxes: "",
    palletWeight: "",
    palletDate: "",
    palletContents: "",
    qrPallet: "",
    ...EMPTY_ORDER_VALUES,
  };
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { todayListStart } from "./today";

describe("today's list", () => {
  // Israel is UTC+3 in summer (until the last Sunday of October) and UTC+2 in winter.
  it("starts at 21:00 of the day before until 21:00 comes", () => {
    // 28 Oct 2026, 09:00 in Israel (UTC+2 by then) = 07:00 UTC
    expect(todayListStart(new Date("2026-10-28T07:00:00Z")).toISOString()).toBe(
      "2026-10-27T19:00:00.000Z",
    );
  });

  it("starts over at 21:00 sharp", () => {
    expect(todayListStart(new Date("2026-10-28T18:59:59Z")).toISOString()).toBe(
      "2026-10-27T19:00:00.000Z",
    );
    expect(todayListStart(new Date("2026-10-28T19:00:00Z")).toISOString()).toBe(
      "2026-10-28T19:00:00.000Z",
    );
    expect(todayListStart(new Date("2026-10-28T20:00:00Z")).toISOString()).toBe(
      "2026-10-28T19:00:00.000Z",
    );
  });

  it("follows the summer clock too", () => {
    // 15 July 2026, 10:00 in Israel (UTC+3) = 07:00 UTC; the reset before it was 21:00 on the 14th.
    expect(todayListStart(new Date("2026-07-15T07:00:00Z")).toISOString()).toBe(
      "2026-07-14T18:00:00.000Z",
    );
  });
});
````

````ts
import { timeZone } from "../i18n/config";

/** Today's list starts over at this hour (local time) every day. */
export const LIST_RESET_HOUR = 21;

/** The same hour as text, for the screens ("21:00"). */
export const LIST_RESET_TIME = `${String(LIST_RESET_HOUR).padStart(2, "0")}:00`;

/** The wall clock in the factory's time zone at an instant. */
function wallClock(at: Date) {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
      timeZone,
      year: "numeric",
      month: "2-digit",
      day: "2-digit",
      hour: "2-digit",
      hourCycle: "h23",
      minute: "2-digit",
    })
      .formatToParts(at)
      .map((p) => [p.type, Number(p.value)]),
  ) as Record<"year" | "month" | "day" | "hour" | "minute", number>;
  return parts;
}

/** The instant a local wall-clock time happens in the factory's time zone. */
function instantOf(year: number, month: number, day: number, hour: number): Date {
  const guess = Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour);
  // How far the zone is ahead of UTC at that moment (also right across a clock change).
  const seen = wallClock(new Date(guess));
  const asUtc = Date.UTC(seen.year, seen.month - 1, seen.day, seen.hour, seen.minute);
  return new Date(guess - (asUtc - guess));
}

/**
 * The start of today's list: the latest 21:00 (factory time) that is not in the future.
 * Boxes received since then are on the list; at 21:00 it starts empty again.
 */
export function todayListStart(now: Date = new Date()): Date {
  const clock = wallClock(now);
  const todayReset = instantOf(clock.year, clock.month, clock.day, LIST_RESET_HOUR);
  if (now >= todayReset) return todayReset;
  const yesterday = new Date(Date.UTC(clock.year, clock.month - 1, clock.day - 1));
  return instantOf(
    yesterday.getUTCFullYear(),
    yesterday.getUTCMonth() + 1,
    yesterday.getUTCDate(),
    LIST_RESET_HOUR,
  );
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { splitReadings, weightFromReading } from "./scale";

describe("reading the scale", () => {
  it("reads the XK3190-A12's reversed readings", () => {
    expect(weightFromReading("=02.4100", true)).toBe(14.2);
    expect(weightFromReading("=00.0000", true)).toBe(0);
    expect(weightFromReading("=20.5-00", true)).toBe(-5.02);
    // Not reversed, when the scale is set that way.
    expect(weightFromReading("=0014.20", false)).toBe(14.2);
  });

  it("reads a line of text with the weight in it", () => {
    expect(weightFromReading("ST,GS,+0014.20kg", true)).toBe(14.2);
    expect(weightFromReading("  13,5 kg", true)).toBe(13.5);
    expect(weightFromReading("US,GS,-0000.40kg", true)).toBe(-0.4);
  });

  it("finds nothing in noise", () => {
    expect(weightFromReading("", true)).toBeNull();
    expect(weightFromReading("=", true)).toBeNull();
    expect(weightFromReading("OL", true)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("splits what arrives into whole readings and keeps the unfinished end", () => {
    expect(splitReadings("=02.4100=02.41")).toEqual({ readings: ["=02.4100"], rest: "=02.41" });
    expect(splitReadings("ST,GS,+0014.20kg\r\nST,GS,+00")).toEqual({
      readings: ["ST,GS,+0014.20kg"],
      rest: "ST,GS,+00",
    });
    expect(splitReadings("")).toEqual({ readings: [], rest: "" });
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/lib/scale.ts`

````ts
import { MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG } from "./barcodes";

/**
 * Reading the weight out of what the scale sends over its cable. The factory's indicator is a
 * Yaohua XK3190-A12, which in its continuous mode sends "=" followed by the weight with its
 * characters in reverse order ("=02.4100" is 14.20 kg). Other indicators send a line of text
 * with the weight in it ("ST,GS,+0014.20kg"). Both are understood; which one is used is decided
 * by the "=" at the start of each reading.
 */

/** The speeds a scale usually talks at; 9600 is the XK3190-A12's own setting. */
export const BAUD_RATES = [1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 19200] as const;
export const DEFAULT_BAUD_RATE = 9600;

/** One reading as text ("=02.4100" or "ST,GS,+0014.20kg") to kilograms, or null when it has none. */
export function weightFromReading(reading: string, reversed: boolean): number | null {
  const text = reading.trim();
  if (text === "") return null;
  let digits: string;
  if (text.startsWith("=")) {
    const body = text.slice(1).replace(/[^\d.-]/g, "");
    digits = reversed ? [...body].reverse().join("") : body;
  } else {
    const match = /[-+]?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?/.exec(text);
    if (!match) return null;
    digits = match[0].replace(",", ".");
  }
  // A minus sign the reversal put at the end belongs at the front.
  const negative = digits.includes("-");
  const value = Number(digits.replace(/-/g, ""));
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || digits.replace(/[-.]/g, "") === "") return null;
  const kg = negative ? -value : value;
  if (kg > MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG * 10) return null;
  return Math.round(kg * 100) / 100;
}

/**
 * Splits what has arrived so far into whole readings: each "=" starts one, and so does each new
 * line. Gives the readings and what is left over, which waits for the next piece.
 */
export function splitReadings(buffer: string): { readings: string[]; rest: string } {
  const parts = buffer.split(/(?==)|\r\n|\r|\n/);
  const rest = parts.pop() ?? "";
  return { readings: parts.filter((part) => part.trim() !== ""), rest };
}
````

### FILE: `src/lib/scan-sounds.ts`

````ts
/**
 * The sounds of a scan, made in the browser (no files): three kinds a person can tell apart
 * without looking at the screen.
 *   saved     - one short high beep: the box is recorded in the system.
 *   refused   - two lower beeps: the system read the scan but did not record it (already received,
 *               not a vendor barcode, unknown item...). The screen says why.
 *   unreached - one long low buzz: the scan did not get into the system at all (no connection).
 */
export type ScanSound = "saved" | "refused" | "unreached";

const STORAGE_KEY = "scanSound";

interface Tone {
  at: number;
  length: number;
  hz: number;
  wave: OscillatorType;
}

const TONES: Record<ScanSound, Tone[]> = {
  saved: [{ at: 0, length: 0.14, hz: 1318, wave: "sine" }],
  refused: [
    { at: 0, length: 0.16, hz: 560, wave: "square" },
    { at: 0.24, length: 0.16, hz: 560, wave: "square" },
  ],
  unreached: [{ at: 0, length: 0.7, hz: 170, wave: "sawtooth" }],
};

let context: AudioContext | null = null;

/** Opens the sound on the first key press or click, when the browser allows it. */
export function prepareSound(): void {
  try {
    const Ctor =
      window.AudioContext ??
      (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!Ctor) return;
    context ??= new Ctor();
    if (context.state === "suspended") void context.resume();
  } catch {
    // No sound is not a reason to stop receiving.
  }
}

export function playScanSound(sound: ScanSound): void {
  try {
    prepareSound();
    if (!context) return;
    const start = context.currentTime + 0.02;
    for (const tone of TONES[sound]) {
      const oscillator = context.createOscillator();
      const volume = context.createGain();
      oscillator.type = tone.wave;
      oscillator.frequency.value = tone.hz;
      const from = start + tone.at;
      volume.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, from);
      volume.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.3, from + 0.01);
      volume.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, from + tone.length - 0.03);
      volume.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, from + tone.length);
      oscillator.connect(volume).connect(context.destination);
      oscillator.start(from);
      oscillator.stop(from + tone.length + 0.02);
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}

/** Whether the person turned the scan sounds on (the default) or off on this computer. */
export function readSoundOn(): boolean {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) !== "off";
  } catch {
    return true;
  }
}

const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

/** For useSyncExternalStore: tells the screen when the choice changes. */
export function subscribeSound(listener: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  return () => void listeners.delete(listener);
}

export function saveSoundOn(on: boolean): void {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, on ? "on" : "off");
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
  for (const listener of listeners) listener();
}
````

### FILE: `src/lib/user-agent.ts`

````ts
export interface AgentInfo {
  /** For example "Chrome"; null when the browser is not known. */
  browser: string | null;
  /** For example "Windows"; null when the system is not known. */
  system: string | null;
}

const BROWSERS: [string, RegExp][] = [
  ["Edge", /Edg(?:e|A|iOS)?\//],
  ["Opera", /OPR\/|Opera/],
  ["Firefox", /Firefox\/|FxiOS\//],
  ["Chrome", /Chrome\/|CriOS\//],
  ["Safari", /Safari\//],
];

const SYSTEMS: [string, RegExp][] = [
  ["Android", /Android/],
  ["iPhone", /iPhone|iPod/],
  ["iPad", /iPad/],
  ["Windows", /Windows/],
  ["Mac", /Macintosh|Mac OS X/],
  ["Linux", /Linux|X11/],
];

/** A short, readable description of a browser from its user-agent text. */
export function describeAgent(userAgent: string | null | undefined): AgentInfo {
  if (!userAgent) return { browser: null, system: null };
  const browser = BROWSERS.find(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(userAgent))?.[0] ?? null;
  const system = SYSTEMS.find(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(userAgent))?.[0] ?? null;
  return { browser, system };
}
````

````ts
import { getSessionCookie } from "better-auth/cookies";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";

/**
 * Optimistic redirects only (cookie presence, no database): pages verify the
 * session for real in src/server/auth/session.ts.
 */
export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
  const hasSessionCookie = Boolean(getSessionCookie(request));

  // /login is always reachable: a cookie may belong to a session that no longer
  // exists, and the login page itself sends users with a valid session to "/".
  if (pathname === "/login") return NextResponse.next();
  if (!hasSessionCookie) {
    const login = new URL("/login", request.url);
    if (pathname !== "/") login.searchParams.set("next", pathname);
    return NextResponse.redirect(login);
  }
  return NextResponse.next();
}

export const config = {
  // Everything except the auth API, Next internals, static files and the icons and preview picture
  // that browsers and link previews (WhatsApp) fetch without signing in.
  matcher: [
    "/((?!api/|_next/|favicon\\.ico|(?:icon|apple-icon|opengraph-image)(?:$|/)|.*\\..*).*)",
  ],
};
````

````ts
import { getDatabase, type Db } from "../db";
import { activityLog, type DeviceType } from "../db/schema";

/**
 * One row per action. Rows are never edited or deleted. The user's display name
 * is frozen on the row so history reads the same after renames or disabling.
 */
export interface ActivityEntry {
  action: string;
  userId?: string | null;
  userDisplay: string;
  deviceType?: DeviceType | null;
  entityType?: string | null;
  entityId?: string | null;
  details?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  ip?: string | null;
}

/** Who performs an action, for logging. */
export interface Actor {
  id: string | null;
  display: string;
  deviceType?: DeviceType | null;
  ip?: string | null;
}

export const SYSTEM_ACTOR: Actor = { id: null, display: "system" };

export async function logActivity(entry: ActivityEntry, db: Db = getDatabase().db): Promise<void> {
  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    action: entry.action,
    userId: entry.userId ?? null,
    userDisplay: entry.userDisplay,
    deviceType: entry.deviceType ?? null,
    entityType: entry.entityType ?? null,
    entityId: entry.entityId ?? null,
    details: entry.details ?? null,
    ip: entry.ip ?? null,
  });
}

/** Shorthand for an action performed by `actor` on an entity. */
export function logFor(
  actor: Actor,
  action: string,
  rest: Omit<ActivityEntry, "action" | "userId" | "userDisplay" | "deviceType" | "ip"> = {},
  db?: Db,
): Promise<void> {
  return logActivity(
    {
      action,
      userId: actor.id,
      userDisplay: actor.display,
      deviceType: actor.deviceType ?? null,
      ip: actor.ip ?? null,
      ...rest,
    },
    db,
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/alerts/index.ts`

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { DEFAULT_ALERT_DAYS } from "../priority/summary";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * Expiry alerts: how many days before the expiry date a box counts as "about to expire".
 * Set per item category (Priority's own category text); a category with no choice of its
 * own uses DEFAULT_ALERT_DAYS.
 */

export const MIN_ALERT_DAYS = 1;
export const MAX_ALERT_DAYS = 365;

const KEY = "alerts.daysByCategory";

export class AlertsError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: "INVALID_DAYS") {
    super(code);
    this.name = "AlertsError";
  }
}

export interface AlertSettings {
  defaultDays: number;
  /** Category text to its days; categories not in here use the default. */
  byCategory: Record<string, number>;
}

export async function getAlertSettings(db: Db): Promise<AlertSettings> {
  const stored = await readSetting<Record<string, number>>(db, KEY);
  return { defaultDays: DEFAULT_ALERT_DAYS, byCategory: stored?.value ?? {} };
}

export function alertDaysFor(settings: AlertSettings, category: string): number {
  return settings.byCategory[category] ?? settings.defaultDays;
}

/** Sets (or with null clears) the days for a category. Whole days from 1 to 365. */
export async function setCategoryAlertDays(
  db: Db,
  category: string,
  days: number | null,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  if (days !== null && (!Number.isInteger(days) || days < MIN_ALERT_DAYS || days > MAX_ALERT_DAYS))
    throw new AlertsError("INVALID_DAYS");
  const current = await getAlertSettings(db);
  const next = { ...current.byCategory };
  if (days === null) delete next[category];
  else next[category] = days;
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, next, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.alertDaysChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: KEY,
      details: { category, from: current.byCategory[category] ?? null, to: days },
    },
    db,
  );
}
````

````ts
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  AssistantError,
  DEFAULT_MODEL,
  askAssistant,

};

function fakeFetch(answer: string, status = 200) {
  const calls: Array<{ url: string; init: RequestInit }> = [];
  const impl = (async (url: string, init: RequestInit) => {
    calls.push({ url, init });
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ content: [{ type: "text", text: answer }] }), { status });
  }) as unknown as typeof fetch;
  return { impl, calls };
}

async function code(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<string> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (error) {
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(AssistantError);
    return (error as AssistantError).code;
  }
  throw new Error("expected an AssistantError");
}

beforeEach(() => resetRate());

describe("the question helper", () => {
  it("is off until a key is set, and then says so instead of calling anyone", async () => {
    expect(assistantConfigured({})).toBe(false);
    expect(assistantConfigured({ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "  " })).toBe(false);
    expect(assistantConfigured({ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "k" })).toBe(true);
    const { impl, calls } = fakeFetch("x");
    expect(await code(askAssistant(input, { env: {}, fetchImpl: impl }))).toBe("NOT_CONFIGURED");
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);
  });

        history: [

          { role: "assistant", text: "In the menu." },
        ],
      },

    );
    expect(answer).toContain("Press Print a label");
    const [call] = calls;
    expect(call.url).toBe("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages");
    const headers = call.init.headers as Record<string, string>;
    expect(headers["x-api-key"]).toBe("secret-key");
    const body = JSON.parse(call.init.body as string);
    expect(body.model).toBe(DEFAULT_MODEL);
    expect(body.system[0].text).toContain("THE MANUAL:");
    expect(body.system[0].cache_control).toEqual({ type: "ephemeral" });
    expect(body.system[1].text).toContain("Item catalog");
    expect(body.messages.map((m: { role: string }) => m.role)).toEqual(["user", "assistant", "user"]);
    expect(body.messages.at(-1).content).toBe("How do I print a label?");
  });

  it("answers in Hebrew from the Hebrew manual for a Hebrew screen", async () => {
    const { impl, calls } = fakeFetch("שלום");
    await askAssistant({ ...input, locale: "he" }, { env: { ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "k" }, fetchImpl: impl });
    const body = JSON.parse(calls[0].init.body as string);
    expect(body.system[0].text).toContain("Hebrew");
    expect(body.system[0].text).toMatch(/[֐-׿]/);
  });

  it("refuses an empty or very long question, and a failing service is reported", async () => {
    const env = { ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "k" };
    const { impl } = fakeFetch("x");
    expect(await code(askAssistant({ ...input, question: " " }, { env, fetchImpl: impl }))).toBe(
      "INVALID_INPUT",
    );
    expect(
      await code(askAssistant({ ...input, question: "x".repeat(601) }, { env, fetchImpl: impl })),
    ).toBe("INVALID_INPUT");
    const down = fakeFetch("", 500);
    expect(await code(askAssistant(input, { env, fetchImpl: down.impl }))).toBe("UNAVAILABLE");
  });

  it("lets one person ask only so many questions", () => {
    const now = 1_000_000;
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) checkRate("u1", now + i);
    expect(() => checkRate("u1", now + 100)).toThrow(AssistantError);
    // Another person is not held back, and the first one may ask again after ten minutes.
    expect(() => checkRate("u2", now + 100)).not.toThrow();
    expect(() => checkRate("u1", now + 11 * 60 * 1000)).not.toThrow();
  });
});
````
