````ts
import { PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH } from "../auth/password";
import { getDatabase } from "./index";
import { hasOwner, seed, type OwnerSeed, type SeedReport } from "./seed";

export function ownerFromEnv(): OwnerSeed {
  return {
    email: process.env.SEED_OWNER_EMAIL || "owner@example.com",
    password: process.env.SEED_OWNER_PASSWORD || "change-me-on-first-login",
    name: process.env.SEED_OWNER_NAME || "Owner",
  };
}

/**
 * Runs pending migrations and the idempotent seed. Called once at server start
 * (src/instrumentation.ts) and by the db:migrate / db:seed scripts.
 */
export async function prepareDatabase(): Promise<SeedReport> {
  const database = getDatabase();
  await database.migrate();
  // A live system never starts with the stand-in owner password that is public in the code.
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production" && !(await hasOwner(database.db))) {
    const password = process.env.SEED_OWNER_PASSWORD ?? "";
    if (!process.env.SEED_OWNER_EMAIL || password.length < PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH)
      throw new Error(
        `Set SEED_OWNER_EMAIL and SEED_OWNER_PASSWORD (at least ${PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH} characters) to create the first owner.`,
      );
  }
  return seed(database.db, ownerFromEnv());
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/db/schema.ts`

````ts
/**
 * Phase 1 tables. Column names are snake_case in the database (drizzle `casing`),
 * camelCase here. The users/sessions/accounts/verifications tables follow the
 * shape Better Auth expects (step 4) with the system's own columns added.
 *
 * Tables prefixed fake_priority_ belong to the Priority stand-in only.
 */
import {
  bigint,
  bigserial,
  boolean,
  date,
  index,
  integer,
  jsonb,
  numeric,
  pgEnum,
  pgTable,
  primaryKey,
  text,
  timestamp,
  uniqueIndex,
} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { LabelElement } from "../../lib/labels/model";

export const labelTypeEnum = pgEnum("label_type", ["item", "box", "pallet", "shipping"]);
export const deviceTypeEnum = pgEnum("device_type", ["desktop", "phone"]);
export const localeEnum = pgEnum("locale", ["he", "en"]);
export const priorityDocTypeEnum = pgEnum("priority_doc_type", ["production", "vendor"]);

export type DeviceType = (typeof deviceTypeEnum.enumValues)[number];

const id = () =>
  text()
    .primaryKey()
    .$defaultFn(() => crypto.randomUUID());

const timestamps = {
  createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  updatedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow()
    .$onUpdate(() => new Date()),
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Users, sessions, permissions
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const users = pgTable("users", {
  id: id(),
  email: text().notNull().unique(),
  emailVerified: boolean().notNull().default(false),
  /** Full name (Better Auth requires a `name` field). */
  name: text().notNull(),
  displayName: text().notNull(),
  jobTitle: text().notNull().default(""),
  image: text(),
  locale: localeEnum().notNull().default("he"),
  isOwner: boolean().notNull().default(false),
  isDisabled: boolean().notNull().default(false),
  mustChangePassword: boolean().notNull().default(true),
  /** Whether a code from an authenticator app is asked for after the password. */
  twoFactorEnabled: boolean().notNull().default(false),
  ...timestamps,
});

/** The authenticator-app secret and backup codes of a user (encrypted by Better Auth). */
export const twoFactors = pgTable(
  "two_factors",
  {
    id: id(),
    userId: text()
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    secret: text().notNull(),
    backupCodes: text().notNull(),
    /** False until the person has typed one correct code, proving the app is set up. */
    verified: boolean().notNull().default(true),
    failedVerificationCount: integer().notNull().default(0),
    lockedUntil: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
  },
  (t) => [index("two_factors_user_id_idx").on(t.userId)],
);

export const sessions = pgTable(
  "sessions",
  {
    id: id(),
    userId: text()
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    token: text().notNull().unique(),
    expiresAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
    ipAddress: text(),
    userAgent: text(),
    deviceType: deviceTypeEnum().notNull().default("desktop"),
    ...timestamps,
  },
  (t) => [index("sessions_user_id_idx").on(t.userId)],
);

export const accounts = pgTable(
  "accounts",
  {
    id: id(),
    userId: text()
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    /** Provider-side id: the user id for "credential", the Google subject for "google". */
    accountId: text().notNull(),
    providerId: text().notNull(),
    /** Hashed password for the credential provider (see src/server/auth/password.ts). */
    password: text(),
    accessToken: text(),
    refreshToken: text(),
    idToken: text(),
    accessTokenExpiresAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
    refreshTokenExpiresAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
    scope: text(),
    ...timestamps,
  },
  (t) => [index("accounts_user_id_idx").on(t.userId)],
);

export const verifications = pgTable(
  "verifications",
  {
    id: id(),
    identifier: text().notNull(),
    value: text().notNull(),
    expiresAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
    ...timestamps,
  },
  (t) => [index("verifications_identifier_idx").on(t.identifier)],
);

export const userPermissions = pgTable(
  "user_permissions",
  {
    userId: text()
      .notNull()
      .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    permission: text().notNull(),
  },
  (t) => [primaryKey({ columns: [t.userId, t.permission] })],
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Activity log and settings
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const activityLog = pgTable(
  "activity_log",
  {
    id: bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    at: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Null for events without a known user (for example a failed login for an unknown email). */
    userId: text().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    /** Frozen at write time so the row reads the same after the user is renamed or disabled. */
    userDisplay: text().notNull(),
    deviceType: deviceTypeEnum(),
    action: text().notNull(),
    entityType: text(),
    entityId: text(),
    details: jsonb().$type<Record<string, unknown>>(),
    ip: text(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("activity_log_at_idx").on(t.at),
    index("activity_log_user_id_idx").on(t.userId),
    index("activity_log_action_idx").on(t.action),
  ],
);

export const settings = pgTable("settings", {
  key: text().primaryKey(),
  value: jsonb().$type<unknown>().notNull(),
  updatedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow()
    .$onUpdate(() => new Date()),
  updatedBy: text(),
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Label layouts (phase 2)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const labelLayouts = pgTable(
  "label_layouts",
  {
    id: id(),
    name: text().notNull(),
    /** Fixed at creation. There is exactly one "box" layout, the same for all items. */
    type: labelTypeEnum().notNull(),
    widthMm: numeric({ precision: 6, scale: 1, mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    heightMm: numeric({ precision: 6, scale: 1, mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    elements: jsonb().$type<LabelElement[]>().notNull().default([]),
    createdBy: text(),
    ...timestamps,
  },
  (t) => [uniqueIndex("label_layouts_name_idx").on(sql`lower(${t.name})`)],
);

/**
 * An order Priority sent for shipping labels. One row per order number: when Priority sends the
 * same order again, the row is updated (the labels are printed from the newest details).
 * `raw` is everything that was received, as sent.
 */
export const shippingOrders = pgTable(
  "shipping_orders",
  {
    id: id(),
    orderNumber: text().notNull(),
    customerName: text().notNull().default(""),
    customerNumber: text().notNull().default(""),
    address: text().notNull().default(""),
    city: text().notNull().default(""),
    phone: text().notNull().default(""),
    shipDate: text().notNull().default(""),
    notes: text().notNull().default(""),
    /** How many labels Priority asked for; null when it did not say. */
    labelCount: integer(),
    raw: jsonb().$type<unknown>(),
    /** True for the test order made from the settings, not sent by Priority. */
    isTest: boolean().notNull().default(false),
    receivedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** How many times Priority sent this order. */
    timesReceived: integer().notNull().default(1),
    lastPrintedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
    lastPrintedBy: text(),
    timesPrinted: integer().notNull().default(0),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("shipping_orders_number_idx").on(t.orderNumber),
    index("shipping_orders_received_idx").on(t.receivedAt),
  ],
);

/**
 * Which item layout a category of items prints with by default. The category is
 * Priority's own text ("" for items without one), so it has no table to point at.
 * Deleting a layout removes the defaults that used it.
 */
export const labelCategoryDefaults = pgTable("label_category_defaults", {
  category: text().primaryKey(),
  layoutId: text()
    .notNull()
    .references(() => labelLayouts.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  updatedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true })
    .notNull()
    .defaultNow()
    .$onUpdate(() => new Date()),
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Receiving (phase 4)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const boxSourceEnum = pgEnum("box_source", ["production", "vendor"]);
export const sendStatusEnum = pgEnum("send_status", ["pending", "sent", "failed"]);

/**
 * Every box this system ever received, from its own label or a vendor's. The barcode is
 * unique forever: a received barcode stays blocked, so a box can never be counted twice.
 */
export const boxes = pgTable(
  "boxes",
  {
    id: id(),
    barcode: text().notNull().unique(),
    source: boxSourceEnum().notNull(),
    itemNumber: text().notNull(),
    /** In-house: our running number for the item. Vendor: the vendor's own number (5 digits). */
    running: text().notNull(),
    slaughterDate: date().notNull(),
    /** Null for vendor boxes (the vendor barcode does not carry it). */
    productionDate: date(),
    expiryDate: date().notNull(),
    certificateNo: text(),
    weightKg: numeric({ precision: 6, scale: 2, mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    /** The Priority order the box is sent under. */
    docno: text().notNull(),
    warehouseCode: text().notNull(),
    receivedBy: text().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    /** Frozen at write time, like the activity log. */
    receivedByDisplay: text().notNull(),
    receivedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("boxes_received_at_idx").on(t.receivedAt),
    index("boxes_item_idx").on(t.itemNumber),
  ],
);

/** The last running number given to each item (by its item digits), so a number is never reused. */
export const boxCounters = pgTable("box_counters", {
  itemDigits: text().primaryKey(),
  last: integer().notNull().default(0),
});

/**
 * The queue of boxes to send to Priority. A box is saved first, then sent; a failure
 * keeps the row for a retry. `failed` means the retries ran out and an admin must look.
 */
export const prioritySends = pgTable(
  "priority_sends",
  {
    id: bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    boxId: text()
      .notNull()
      .unique()
      .references(() => boxes.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    status: sendStatusEnum().notNull().default("pending"),
    attempts: integer().notNull().default(0),
    /** A Priority error code or a short message. */
    lastError: text(),
    nextAttemptAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    sentAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
    createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [index("priority_sends_status_idx").on(t.status, t.nextAttemptAt)],
);

/**
 * The queue of box moves between warehouses to send to Priority. Like the receiving queue: a
 * move is saved first, then sent, and a failed send keeps its row for a retry. A box may be
 * moved many times, so the barcode is not unique here.
 */
export const priorityMoves = pgTable(
  "priority_moves",
  {
    id: bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    barcode: text().notNull(),
    fromWarehouse: text().notNull(),
    toWarehouse: text().notNull(),
    status: sendStatusEnum().notNull().default("pending"),
    attempts: integer().notNull().default(0),
    lastError: text(),
    nextAttemptAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    sentAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
    createdBy: text().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    /** Frozen at write time, like the activity log. */
    createdByDisplay: text().notNull(),
    createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("priority_moves_status_idx").on(t.status, t.nextAttemptAt),
    index("priority_moves_barcode_idx").on(t.barcode),
  ],
);

/**
 * A pallet: a fixed list of boxes that one QR code names. It never changes stock. The number is
 * what the QR holds; a pallet is never deleted, so a printed number always means the same list.
 */
export const pallets = pgTable("pallets", {
  number: bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
  createdBy: text().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
  /** Frozen at write time, like the activity log. */
  createdByDisplay: text().notNull(),
  createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
});

/** The boxes on a pallet, as they were when it was made (the live stock is read from Priority). */
export const palletBoxes = pgTable(
  "pallet_boxes",
  {
    palletNumber: bigint({ mode: "number" })
      .notNull()
      .references(() => pallets.number, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    barcode: text().notNull(),
    itemNumber: text().notNull(),
    itemName: text().notNull(),
    weightKg: numeric({ precision: 6, scale: 2, mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    position: integer().notNull(),
  },
  (t) => [
    primaryKey({ columns: [t.palletNumber, t.barcode] }),
    index("pallet_boxes_barcode_idx").on(t.barcode),
  ],
);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Priority stand-in (column names follow the Priority fields in PLAN.md)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const fakePriorityItems = pgTable("fake_priority_items", {
  partname: text().primaryKey(),
  partdes: text().notNull(),
  epartdes: text().notNull().default(""),
  barcode: text().notNull().default(""),
  familydes: text().notNull().default(""),
  weight: numeric({ precision: 10, scale: 2, mode: "number" }),
  expiredays: integer().notNull().default(0),
  specs: text().notNull().default(""),
  packingcode: text().notNull().default(""),
  originname: text().notNull().default(""),
  inventorymanaged: boolean().notNull().default(true),
});

export const fakePriorityWarehouses = pgTable("fake_priority_warehouses", {
  warhsname: text().primaryKey(),
  warhsdes: text().notNull(),
});

export const fakePriorityInventory = pgTable(
  "fake_priority_inventory",
  {
    id: bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    partname: text()
      .notNull()
      .references(() => fakePriorityItems.partname),
    warhsname: text()
      .notNull()
      .references(() => fakePriorityWarehouses.warhsname),
    /** Box barcode (lot / pallet number in Priority). */
    actname: text().notNull().unique(),
    tbalance: numeric({ precision: 10, scale: 2, mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    tunitname: text().notNull().default('ק"ג'),
    expirydate: date().notNull(),
    /** Date the box entered stock. */
    curdate: date().notNull(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("fake_priority_inventory_partname_idx").on(t.partname),
    index("fake_priority_inventory_warhsname_idx").on(t.warhsname),
  ],
);

export const fakePriorityOrders = pgTable("fake_priority_orders", {
  docno: text().primaryKey(),
  doctype: priorityDocTypeEnum().notNull().default("production"),
  partname: text().references(() => fakePriorityItems.partname),
  curdate: date().notNull(),
  quant: numeric({ precision: 10, scale: 2, mode: "number" }),
  status: text().notNull().default("open"),
});

/** Lines written by receiving (phase 4); one per box, like TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM. */
export const fakePriorityReceivedLines = pgTable("fake_priority_received_lines", {
  id: bigserial({ mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
  docno: text()
    .notNull()
    .references(() => fakePriorityOrders.docno),
  topalletname: text().notNull().unique(),
  tquant: numeric({ precision: 10, scale: 2, mode: "number" }).notNull(),
  partname: text()
    .notNull()
    .references(() => fakePriorityItems.partname),
  barcode: text().notNull().default(""),
  pdes: text().notNull().default(""),
  toppExpirydate: date().notNull(),
  warhsname: text()
    .notNull()
    .references(() => fakePriorityWarehouses.warhsname),
  createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Messages from people to the administrators
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const messageKindEnum = pgEnum("message_kind", [
  "question",
  "request",
  "problem",
  "suggestion",
]);
export const messageStatusEnum = pgEnum("message_status", ["new", "done"]);

/**
 * A question, request, problem or suggestion a person sends from any page. It is divided by kind,
 * by the screen it is about and by what about it, so the reader sees exactly what is meant.
 */
export const adminMessages = pgTable(
  "admin_messages",
  {
    id: id(),
    createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
    senderId: text().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    /** Frozen at write time, like the activity log. */
    senderDisplay: text().notNull(),
    kind: messageKindEnum().notNull(),
    /** A screen key (dashboard, catalog…), or "signin" / "other". */
    screen: text().notNull(),
    /** What about it: a key from the list of its kind (howTo, permission, printing…). */
    subject: text().notNull(),
    urgent: boolean().notNull().default(false),
    details: text().notNull(),
    /** The page the person was on. */
    pagePath: text().notNull().default(""),
    deviceType: deviceTypeEnum(),
    locale: localeEnum().notNull().default("he"),
    status: messageStatusEnum().notNull().default("new"),
    handledBy: text().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    handledByDisplay: text(),
    handledAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),
    /** The administrator's answer, shown to the sender. */
    reply: text(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("admin_messages_status_idx").on(t.status, t.createdAt),
    index("admin_messages_sender_idx").on(t.senderId, t.createdAt),
  ],
);
````

````ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { and, count, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { addDays, buildBoxBarcode, itemNumberDigits, toISODate } from "../../lib/barcodes";
import {
  STARTER_LAYOUTS,
  STARTER_PALLET_LAYOUT,
  STARTER_SHIPPING_LAYOUT,
  STARTER_MEAT_ITEM_LAYOUT,
  STARTER_PREMIUM_ITEM_LAYOUT,
  type StarterLayout,
} from "../../lib/labels/starters";
import { hashPassword } from "../auth/password";
import type { Db } from "./connection";
import {
  accounts,
  fakePriorityInventory,
  fakePriorityItems,
  fakePriorityOrders,
  fakePriorityWarehouses,
  labelLayouts,
  settings,
  users,
} from "./schema";

const SEED_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "db", "seed", "priority");

export interface OwnerSeed {
  email: string;
  password: string;
  name: string;
}

/** Settings every installation starts with. Keys are read by later steps. */
export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: Record<string, unknown> = {
  "fakePriority.behaviour": { mode: "normal", delayMs: 5000 },
  "vendorReceiving.orderDocno": "AS26000001",
};

export interface SeedReport {
  ownerCreated: boolean;
  settingsAdded: number;
  standInSeeded: boolean;
  boxes: number;
}

/**
 * Idempotent: creates the owner only when there are no users, the stand-in data
 * only when there are no items, and settings only for keys that are missing.
 */
export async function seed(db: Db, owner: OwnerSeed, now = new Date()): Promise<SeedReport> {
  const ownerCreated = await seedOwner(db, owner);
  const settingsAdded = await seedSettings(db);
  await seedLabelLayouts(db);
  await seedPalletLayout(db);
  await seedShippingLayout(db);
  await seedPremiumItemLayout(db);
  await seedMeatItemLayout(db);
  await resizePremiumItemLayout(db);
  const boxes = await seedPriorityStandIn(db, now);
  return { ownerCreated, settingsAdded, standInSeeded: boxes > 0, boxes };
}

export async function seedOwner(db: Db, owner: OwnerSeed): Promise<boolean> {
  const [{ value: userCount }] = await db.select({ value: count() }).from(users);
  if (userCount > 0) return false;

  const email = owner.email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const [created] = await db
    .insert(users)
    .values({
      email,
      emailVerified: true,
      name: owner.name,
      displayName: owner.name,
      jobTitle: "",
      locale: "he",
      isOwner: true,
      mustChangePassword: true,
    })
    .returning({ id: users.id });

  await db.insert(accounts).values({
    userId: created.id,
    accountId: created.id,
    providerId: "credential",
    password: await hashPassword(owner.password),
  });
  return true;
}

export async function seedSettings(db: Db): Promise<number> {
  const rows = Object.entries(DEFAULT_SETTINGS).map(([key, value]) => ({ key, value }));
  const inserted = await db
    .insert(settings)
    .values(rows)
    .onConflictDoNothing()
    .returning({ key: settings.key });
  return inserted.length;
}

const LABEL_STARTERS_KEY = "labels.startersSeeded";

/**
 * Gives a new installation one item layout and the box layout to start from. Done
 * once (remembered in settings), so layouts that were deleted on purpose stay deleted.
 */
export async function seedLabelLayouts(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  const marked = await db
    .insert(settings)
    .values({ key: LABEL_STARTERS_KEY, value: true })
    .onConflictDoNothing()
    .returning({ key: settings.key });
  if (marked.length === 0) return false;

  const [{ value: existing }] = await db.select({ value: count() }).from(labelLayouts);
  if (existing > 0) return false;
  await db.insert(labelLayouts).values(STARTER_LAYOUTS);
  return true;
}

const PALLET_STARTER_KEY = "labels.palletStarterSeeded";

/**
 * Gives every installation, new or old, one pallet label to start from (pallets came after the
 * first release). Done once, so a pallet layout deleted on purpose stays deleted.
 */
export async function seedPalletLayout(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  const marked = await db
    .insert(settings)
    .values({ key: PALLET_STARTER_KEY, value: true })
    .onConflictDoNothing()
    .returning({ key: settings.key });
  if (marked.length === 0) return false;

  const [{ value: existing }] = await db
    .select({ value: count() })
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.type, "pallet"));
  if (existing > 0) return false;
  await db.insert(labelLayouts).values(STARTER_PALLET_LAYOUT);
  return true;
}

const PREMIUM_STARTER_KEY = "labels.premiumStarterSeeded";

/**
 * Gives every installation the premium item label (for ready-printed stock) once, so one deleted
 * on purpose stays deleted. Skipped when a layout of that name is already there.
 */
export async function seedPremiumItemLayout(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  return seedLayoutOnce(db, PREMIUM_STARTER_KEY, STARTER_PREMIUM_ITEM_LAYOUT);
}

/** One shipping label to start from (shipping labels came after the first release), given once. */
export async function seedShippingLayout(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  return seedLayoutOnce(db, "labels.shippingStarterSeeded", STARTER_SHIPPING_LAYOUT);
}

/** The meat item label for ready-printed stock (100 × 160 mm), given once like the premium one. */
export async function seedMeatItemLayout(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  return seedLayoutOnce(db, "labels.meatStarterSeeded", STARTER_MEAT_ITEM_LAYOUT);
}

/** Adds a layout once (remembered under `key`), unless one of that name is already there. */
async function seedLayoutOnce(db: Db, key: string, layout: StarterLayout): Promise<boolean> {
  const marked = await db
    .insert(settings)
    .values({ key, value: true })
    .onConflictDoNothing()
    .returning({ key: settings.key });
  if (marked.length === 0) return false;

  const [{ value: existing }] = await db
    .select({ value: count() })
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.name, layout.name));
  if (existing > 0) return false;
  await db.insert(labelLayouts).values(layout);
  return true;
}

const PREMIUM_RESIZE_KEY = "labels.premiumStarterResized";

/**
 * The premium label first came out at a guessed 100 × 300 mm; the paper is 77 × 245 mm. Done
 * once, and only to a layout still at the guessed size, so one changed by hand is left alone.
 */
export async function resizePremiumItemLayout(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  const marked = await db
    .insert(settings)
    .values({ key: PREMIUM_RESIZE_KEY, value: true })
    .onConflictDoNothing()
    .returning({ key: settings.key });
  if (marked.length === 0) return false;

  const updated = await db
    .update(labelLayouts)
    .set({
      widthMm: STARTER_PREMIUM_ITEM_LAYOUT.widthMm,
      heightMm: STARTER_PREMIUM_ITEM_LAYOUT.heightMm,
      elements: STARTER_PREMIUM_ITEM_LAYOUT.elements,
    })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(labelLayouts.name, STARTER_PREMIUM_ITEM_LAYOUT.name),
        eq(labelLayouts.widthMm, 100),
        eq(labelLayouts.heightMm, 300),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ id: labelLayouts.id });
  return updated.length > 0;
}

interface ItemSeed {
  partname: string;
  partdes: string;
  epartdes: string;
  barcode: string;
  familydes: string;
  weight: number;
  expiredays: number;
  specs: string;
  packingcode: string;
  originname: string;
}

interface WarehouseSeed {
  warhsname: string;
  warhsdes: string;
}

interface OrderSeed {
  docno: string;
  doctype: "production" | "vendor";
  partname: string | null;
  curdate: string;
  quant: number | null;
  status: string;
}

function readJson<T>(file: string): T {
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(SEED_DIR, file), "utf8")) as T;
}

/** Returns the number of boxes created, 0 when the stand-in already had items. */
export async function seedPriorityStandIn(db: Db, now: Date): Promise<number> {
  const [{ value: itemCount }] = await db.select({ value: count() }).from(fakePriorityItems);
  if (itemCount > 0) return 0;

  const items = readJson<ItemSeed[]>("items.json");
  const warehouses = readJson<WarehouseSeed[]>("warehouses.json");
  const orders = readJson<OrderSeed[]>("orders.json");

  assertUniqueCatalog(items);

  await db.insert(fakePriorityWarehouses).values(warehouses);
  await db.insert(fakePriorityItems).values(items.map((i) => ({ ...i, inventorymanaged: true })));
  await db.insert(fakePriorityOrders).values(orders);

  const boxes = generateBoxes(items, now);
  await db.insert(fakePriorityInventory).values(boxes);
  return boxes.length;
}

/** The checks the plan asks for whenever the catalog is pulled: unique item digits and unique last-7 barcode digits. */
function assertUniqueCatalog(items: ItemSeed[]): void {
  const digits = new Map<string, string>();
  const last7 = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const item of items) {
    const d = itemNumberDigits(item.partname);
    if (digits.has(d))
      throw new Error(`Seed: item digits ${d} shared by ${digits.get(d)} and ${item.partname}`);
    digits.set(d, item.partname);
    const l = item.barcode.slice(-7);
    if (last7.has(l))
      throw new Error(`Seed: barcode tail ${l} shared by ${last7.get(l)} and ${item.partname}`);
    last7.set(l, item.partname);
  }
}

type BoxRow = typeof fakePriorityInventory.$inferInsert;

/**
 * Boxes for every item, deterministic for a given day: a few expired, a few
 * close to expiry, most fine. Fresh items (D in the item number) sit in Main,
 * frozen ones (F) in 200.
 */
function generateBoxes(items: ItemSeed[], now: Date): BoxRow[] {
  const today = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate()));
  const random = mulberry32(20261022);
  const rows: BoxRow[] = [];

  for (const item of items) {
    const frozen = /F/.test(item.partname.replace(/^M/, ""));
    const warhsname = frozen ? "200" : "Main";
    const boxCount = 3 + Math.floor(random() * 6);
    const shelf = item.expiredays;

    for (let running = 1; running <= boxCount; running++) {
      // Age in days as a share of shelf life: ~15% expired, ~20% expiring within a week.
      const roll = random();
      const ageDays =
        roll < 0.15
          ? shelf + 1 + Math.floor(random() * 10)
          : roll < 0.35
            ? Math.max(0, shelf - 1 - Math.floor(random() * 6))
            : Math.floor(random() * Math.max(1, shelf - 7));
      const slaughterDate = addDays(today, -ageDays);
      const expiryDate = addDays(slaughterDate, shelf);
      const weightKg = Math.round(item.weight * (0.85 + random() * 0.3) * 100) / 100;
      const actname = buildBoxBarcode({
        running,
        itemDigits: itemNumberDigits(item.partname),
        slaughterDate,
        expiryDate,
        weightKg,
      });
      rows.push({
        partname: item.partname,
        warhsname,
        actname,
        tbalance: weightKg,
        expirydate: toISODate(expiryDate),
        curdate: toISODate(addDays(slaughterDate, 1)),
      });
    }
  }
  return rows;
}

function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

export async function hasOwner(db: Db): Promise<boolean> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ id: users.id })
    .from(users)
    .where(eq(users.isOwner, true))
    .limit(1);
  return rows.length > 0;
}
````

````ts
import { and, asc, eq, ne, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { labelLayouts } from "../db/schema";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";
import {
  layoutSchema,
  type LabelElement,
  type LabelType,
  type LayoutContent,
} from "@/lib/labels/model";

export type LabelLayoutErrorCode = "NOT_FOUND" | "NAME_TAKEN" | "BOX_EXISTS";

export class LabelLayoutError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: LabelLayoutErrorCode) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "LabelLayoutError";
  }
}

export interface LabelLayout {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: LabelType;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements: LabelElement[];
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

export type LabelLayoutSummary = Omit<LabelLayout, "elements"> & { elementCount: number };

function toLayout(row: typeof labelLayouts.$inferSelect): LabelLayout {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    type: row.type,
    widthMm: row.widthMm,
    heightMm: row.heightMm,
    elements: row.elements,
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
    updatedAt: row.updatedAt,
  };
}

const TYPE_ORDER: Record<LabelType, number> = { item: 0, box: 1, pallet: 2, shipping: 3 };

/** All layouts, item labels first, then the box label, then pallet labels; by name within a type. */
export async function listLayouts(db: Db): Promise<LabelLayoutSummary[]> {
  const rows = await db.select().from(labelLayouts).orderBy(asc(labelLayouts.name));
  return rows
    .map((row) => {
      const { elements, ...rest } = toLayout(row);
      return { ...rest, elementCount: elements.length };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => TYPE_ORDER[a.type] - TYPE_ORDER[b.type]);
}

/** The one box label layout, or null when it was deleted. */
export async function getBoxLayout(db: Db): Promise<LabelLayout | null> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(labelLayouts).where(eq(labelLayouts.type, "box")).limit(1);
  return row ? toLayout(row) : null;
}

/** The pallet layout a pallet label prints with: the oldest one, or null when none exists. */
export async function getPalletLayout(db: Db): Promise<LabelLayout | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.type, "pallet"))
    .orderBy(asc(labelLayouts.createdAt))
    .limit(1);
  return row ? toLayout(row) : null;
}

/** All layouts of one type with their elements, oldest first. */
export async function listLayoutsOfType(db: Db, type: LabelType): Promise<LabelLayout[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.type, type))
    .orderBy(asc(labelLayouts.createdAt), asc(labelLayouts.name));
  return rows.map(toLayout);
}

export async function getLayout(db: Db, id: string): Promise<LabelLayout | null> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(labelLayouts).where(eq(labelLayouts.id, id)).limit(1);
  return row ? toLayout(row) : null;
}

async function assertNameFree(db: Db, name: string, exceptId?: string): Promise<void> {
  const same = sql`lower(${labelLayouts.name}) = lower(${name})`;
  const [taken] = await db
    .select({ id: labelLayouts.id })
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(exceptId ? and(same, ne(labelLayouts.id, exceptId)) : same)
    .limit(1);
  if (taken) throw new LabelLayoutError("NAME_TAKEN");
}

async function assertNoBoxLayout(db: Db): Promise<void> {
  const [existing] = await db
    .select({ id: labelLayouts.id })
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.type, "box"))
    .limit(1);
  if (existing) throw new LabelLayoutError("BOX_EXISTS");
}

export interface NewLayout {
  name: string;
  type: LabelType;
  widthMm: number;
  heightMm: number;
  elements?: LabelElement[];
}

/** Creates a layout. A new one starts empty unless given elements. There is only ever one box layout. */
export async function createLayout(db: Db, input: NewLayout, actor: Actor): Promise<LabelLayout> {
  const content = layoutSchema.parse({ ...input, elements: input.elements ?? [] });
  await assertNameFree(db, content.name);
  if (input.type === "box") await assertNoBoxLayout(db);

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(labelLayouts)
    .values({
      name: content.name,
      type: input.type,
      widthMm: content.widthMm,
      heightMm: content.heightMm,
      elements: content.elements,
      createdBy: actor.id,
    })
    .returning();
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.labelLayoutCreated",
    { entityType: "label_layout", entityId: row.id, details: { name: row.name, type: row.type } },
    db,
  );
  return toLayout(row);
}

/** Replaces a layout's name, size and elements. Its type never changes. */
export async function saveLayout(
  db: Db,
  id: string,
  input: LayoutContent,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<LabelLayout> {
  const content = layoutSchema.parse(input);
  if (!(await getLayout(db, id))) throw new LabelLayoutError("NOT_FOUND");
  await assertNameFree(db, content.name, id);

  const [row] = await db
    .update(labelLayouts)
    .set({
      name: content.name,
      widthMm: content.widthMm,
      heightMm: content.heightMm,
      elements: content.elements,
    })
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.id, id))
    .returning();
  if (!row) throw new LabelLayoutError("NOT_FOUND");
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.labelLayoutSaved",
    {
      entityType: "label_layout",
      entityId: id,
      details: { name: row.name, elements: content.elements.length },
    },
    db,
  );
  return toLayout(row);
}

/** A copy named "<name> (copy)", or "(copy 2)" and so on. Not for the box layout: there is only one. */
export async function duplicateLayout(db: Db, id: string, actor: Actor): Promise<LabelLayout> {
  const source = await getLayout(db, id);
  if (!source) throw new LabelLayoutError("NOT_FOUND");
  if (source.type === "box") throw new LabelLayoutError("BOX_EXISTS");

  let name = `${source.name} (copy)`;
  for (let n = 2; ; n++) {
    try {
      await assertNameFree(db, name);
      break;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof LabelLayoutError)) throw error;
      name = `${source.name} (copy ${n})`;
    }
  }
  const copy = await createLayout(
    db,
    {
      name,
      type: source.type,
      widthMm: source.widthMm,
      heightMm: source.heightMm,
      elements: source.elements,
    },
    actor,
  );
  return copy;
}

export async function deleteLayout(db: Db, id: string, actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  const [row] = await db.delete(labelLayouts).where(eq(labelLayouts.id, id)).returning();
  if (!row) throw new LabelLayoutError("NOT_FOUND");
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.labelLayoutDeleted",
    { entityType: "label_layout", entityId: id, details: { name: row.name, type: row.type } },
    db,
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Item layouts, for the print window
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** All item layouts with their elements (what a print window needs), oldest first. */
export async function listItemLayouts(db: Db): Promise<LabelLayout[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(labelLayouts)
    .where(eq(labelLayouts.type, "item"))
    .orderBy(asc(labelLayouts.createdAt), asc(labelLayouts.name));
  return rows.map(toLayout);
}

const DEFAULT_ITEM_LAYOUT_KEY = "labels.defaultItemLayout";

/** The item layout chosen in advance when printing from the catalog; it can still be changed. */
export async function getDefaultItemLayout(db: Db): Promise<string | null> {
  const stored = await readSetting<string>(db, DEFAULT_ITEM_LAYOUT_KEY);
  return stored?.value || null;
}

/** Makes an item layout the default (null for none). Only an item layout can be the default. */
export async function setDefaultItemLayout(db: Db, id: string | null, actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  let name: string | null = null;
  if (id !== null) {
    const layout = await getLayout(db, id);
    if (!layout || layout.type !== "item") throw new LabelLayoutError("NOT_FOUND");
    name = layout.name;
  }
  // A setting cannot hold null: no default is kept as an empty text.
  await writeSetting(db, DEFAULT_ITEM_LAYOUT_KEY, id ?? "", actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.labelDefaultChanged",
    { entityType: "settings", entityId: DEFAULT_ITEM_LAYOUT_KEY, details: { layout: name } },
    db,
  );
}
````

````ts
import nodemailer from "nodemailer";

/**
 * Sending email through the company's mail account (SMTP). Everything comes from the environment,
 * so nothing secret is stored in the code or the database:
 * SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT (465 = secure from the start), SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM.
 * Without them the system works as before and people are told the email was not sent.
 */

export interface MailMessage {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  text: string;
  html: string;
}

/** The name people see as the sender; the address comes from SMTP_FROM or SMTP_USER. */
export const SENDER_NAME = "{{SENDER_NAME}}";

/** "{{SENDER_NAME}} <address>", with the address taken from SMTP_FROM ("Name <address>" or just the address). */
export function senderOf(env: Record<string, string | undefined>): {
  name: string;
  address: string;
} {
  const configured = env.SMTP_FROM?.trim();
  const address = configured?.match(/<([^<>]+)>/)?.[1] ?? configured ?? env.SMTP_USER ?? "";
  return { name: SENDER_NAME, address };
}

export function mailConfigured(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): boolean {
  return Boolean(env.SMTP_HOST && env.SMTP_USER && env.SMTP_PASSWORD);
}

/** True when the message was handed to the mail server; false when mail is not set up or failed. */
export async function sendMail(
  message: MailMessage,
  env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!mailConfigured(env)) return false;
  const port = Number(env.SMTP_PORT) || 465;
  try {
    const transport = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: env.SMTP_HOST,
      port,
      secure: port === 465,
      auth: { user: env.SMTP_USER, pass: env.SMTP_PASSWORD },
      connectionTimeout: 10_000,
      greetingTimeout: 10_000,
      socketTimeout: 15_000,
    });
    await transport.sendMail({ from: senderOf(env), ...message });
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[mail] sending failed", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    return false;
  }
}
````

````ts
import type { MailMessage } from "./index";

export interface WelcomeInput {
  to: string;
  name: string;
  temporaryPassword: string;
  /** The address of the system, for example {{APP_URL}} */
  appUrl: string;
  locale: "he" | "en";
}

const escapeHtml = (text: string) =>
  text.replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" })[c]!);

/** The email a new user gets: the link to sign in, the email to sign in with and the temporary password. */
export function welcomeEmail({
  to,
  name,
  temporaryPassword,
  appUrl,
  locale,
}: WelcomeInput): MailMessage {
  const link = `${appUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/login`;
  const he = locale === "he";

  const subject = he ? "פרטי הכניסה שלך למערכת {{COMPANY_NAME_HE}}" : "Your sign-in details for {{COMPANY_NAME}}";
  const lines = he
    ? [
        `שלום ${name},`,
        "נפתח עבורך משתמש במערכת {{COMPANY_NAME_HE}}.",
        `קישור להתחברות: ${link}`,
        `אימייל: ${to}`,
        `סיסמה זמנית: ${temporaryPassword}`,
        "בכניסה הראשונה תתבקש/י לבחור סיסמה חדשה. אל תעביר/י את הסיסמה הזמנית הלאה.",
      ]
    : [
        `Hello ${name},`,
        "A user was created for you in the {{COMPANY_NAME}} system.",
        `Sign in here: ${link}`,
        `Email: ${to}`,
        `Temporary password: ${temporaryPassword}`,
        "You will be asked to choose a new password the first time you sign in. Do not share the temporary password.",
      ];

  const html = `<div dir="${he ? "rtl" : "ltr"}" style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#1f2a24">
<p>${escapeHtml(lines[0])}</p>
<p>${escapeHtml(lines[1])}</p>
<p><a href="${escapeHtml(link)}" style="display:inline-block;background:{{BRAND_COLOR}};color:#fff;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none">${he ? "כניסה למערכת" : "Sign in"}</a></p>
<p>${he ? "אימייל" : "Email"}: <b dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(to)}</b><br>${he ? "סיסמה זמנית" : "Temporary password"}: <b dir="ltr" style="font-family:monospace;font-size:17px">${escapeHtml(temporaryPassword)}</b></p>
<p style="color:#5b6b61">${escapeHtml(lines[5])}</p>
</div>`;

  return { to, subject, text: lines.join("\n"), html };
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/messages/index.ts`

````ts
import { and, count, desc, eq, gte, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { adminMessages, type DeviceType } from "../db/schema";

/**
 * Messages from people to the administrators. A message is divided before it is sent: its kind
 * (a question, a request, a problem or a suggestion), the screen it is about, and what about it,
 * so whoever reads it sees at once what is meant. The text is the person's own words.
 */

import {
  MAX_DETAILS,
  MESSAGE_KINDS,
  MESSAGE_SCREENS,
  MESSAGE_SUBJECTS,
  MESSAGES_PER_HOUR,
  MIN_DETAILS,
} from "../../lib/messages";

export {
  MAX_DETAILS,
  MESSAGE_KINDS,
  MESSAGE_SCREENS,
  MESSAGE_SUBJECTS,
  MESSAGES_PER_HOUR,
  MIN_DETAILS,
};
export type { MessageKind, MessageScreen } from "../../lib/messages";

export type MessageErrorCode = "INVALID_INPUT" | "RATE_LIMITED" | "NOT_FOUND";

export class MessageError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: MessageErrorCode) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "MessageError";
  }
}

const inputSchema = z
  .object({
    kind: z.enum(MESSAGE_KINDS),
    screen: z.enum(MESSAGE_SCREENS),
    subject: z.string(),
    urgent: z.boolean(),
    details: z.string().trim().min(MIN_DETAILS).max(MAX_DETAILS),
    pagePath: z.string().max(200).default(""),
    locale: z.enum(["he", "en"]),
  })
  .refine((v) => (MESSAGE_SUBJECTS[v.kind] as readonly string[]).includes(v.subject));

export type MessageInput = z.input<typeof inputSchema>;

export async function sendMessage(
  db: Db,
  actor: Actor,
  deviceType: DeviceType,
  raw: MessageInput,
): Promise<string> {
  const parsed = inputSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) throw new MessageError("INVALID_INPUT");
  const input = parsed.data;

  if (actor.id) {
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const [recent] = await db
      .select({ n: count() })
      .from(adminMessages)
      .where(and(eq(adminMessages.senderId, actor.id), gte(adminMessages.createdAt, since)));
    if ((recent?.n ?? 0) >= MESSAGES_PER_HOUR) throw new MessageError("RATE_LIMITED");
  }

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(adminMessages)
    .values({
      senderId: actor.id,
      senderDisplay: actor.display,
      kind: input.kind,
      screen: input.screen,
      subject: input.subject,
      urgent: input.urgent,
      details: input.details,
      pagePath: input.pagePath.startsWith("/") ? input.pagePath : "",
      deviceType,
      locale: input.locale,
    })
    .returning({ id: adminMessages.id });
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "messages.sent",
    {
      entityType: "message",
      entityId: row.id,
      details: {
        kind: input.kind,
        screen: input.screen,
        subject: input.subject,
        urgent: input.urgent,
      },
    },
    db,
  );
  return row.id;
}

export type MessageRow = typeof adminMessages.$inferSelect;

/** New messages first (urgent ones on top), then the answered ones, newest first. */
export async function listMessages(
  db: Db,
  filter: "new" | "done" | "all" = "all",
  limit = 200,
): Promise<MessageRow[]> {
  const where =
    filter === "all" ? undefined : eq(adminMessages.status, filter === "new" ? "new" : "done");
  return db
    .select()
    .from(adminMessages)
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(
      sql`(${adminMessages.status} = 'new') desc`,
      desc(adminMessages.urgent),
      desc(adminMessages.createdAt),
    )
    .limit(limit);
}

export async function countNewMessages(db: Db): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ n: count() })
    .from(adminMessages)
    .where(eq(adminMessages.status, "new"));
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

/** The newest message not answered yet, for the notice. */
export async function latestNewMessage(db: Db): Promise<MessageRow | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(adminMessages)
    .where(eq(adminMessages.status, "new"))
    .orderBy(desc(adminMessages.createdAt))
    .limit(1);
  return row ?? null;
}

/** Marks a message as done, with an optional answer for the sender. */
export async function handleMessage(
  db: Db,
  actor: Actor,
  id: string,
  reply: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const text = reply.trim().slice(0, MAX_DETAILS);
  const [row] = await db
    .update(adminMessages)
    .set({
      status: "done",
      handledBy: actor.id,
      handledByDisplay: actor.display,
      handledAt: new Date(),
      reply: text || null,
    })
    .where(eq(adminMessages.id, id))
    .returning({ id: adminMessages.id });
  if (!row) throw new MessageError("NOT_FOUND");
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "messages.handled",
    { entityType: "message", entityId: id, details: { answered: text !== "" } },
    db,
  );
}

/** A person's own latest messages, with the answers. */
export async function listMessagesOf(db: Db, userId: string, limit = 10): Promise<MessageRow[]> {
  return db
    .select()
    .from(adminMessages)
    .where(eq(adminMessages.senderId, userId))
    .orderBy(desc(adminMessages.createdAt))
    .limit(limit);
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/packaging/index.ts`

````ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { grams, netWeight } from "../../lib/packaging";
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * The packaging an item is packed in: kinds of packaging, each with its own weight. A box is
 * weighed on the scale with its packaging, so the weight kept in the inventory (and printed on
 * the label, and sent to Priority) is the scale reading less the packaging. The kind is chosen
 * for each item, in the catalog.
 */

export { netWeight };

export interface PackagingType {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** What one empty carton weighs, in kilograms (to the gram). */
  weightKg: number;
}

export const MAX_PACKAGING_KG = 20;
export const MAX_PACKAGING_NAME = 60;
export const MAX_PACKAGING_TYPES = 200;

export type PackagingErrorCode = "INVALID_NAME" | "INVALID_WEIGHT" | "NOT_FOUND" | "TOO_MANY";

export class PackagingError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: PackagingErrorCode) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "PackagingError";
  }
}

const TYPES_KEY = "packaging.types";
/** Item number to the id of its packaging. */
const ITEMS_KEY = "packaging.byItem";

function checkWeight(weightKg: number): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(weightKg) || weightKg < 0 || grams(weightKg) > MAX_PACKAGING_KG * 1000)
    throw new PackagingError("INVALID_WEIGHT");
}

function cleanName(name: string): string {
  const text = name.trim();
  if (text.length === 0 || text.length > MAX_PACKAGING_NAME)
    throw new PackagingError("INVALID_NAME");
  return text;
}

export async function getPackagingTypes(db: Db): Promise<PackagingType[]> {
  const stored = (await readSetting<(PackagingType & { kind?: string })[]>(db, TYPES_KEY))?.value;
  // An earlier version also kept bags; only cartons are used now.
  const types = (stored ?? []).filter((type) => type.kind !== "bag");
  return types
    .map(({ id, name, weightKg }) => ({ id, name, weightKg }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "he"));
}

async function saveTypes(db: Db, types: PackagingType[], actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  await writeSetting(db, TYPES_KEY, types, actor.id);
}

/** The packaging chosen for each item (only those that have one). */
export async function getItemPackaging(db: Db): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const stored = (await readSetting<Record<string, string>>(db, ITEMS_KEY))?.value ?? {};
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(stored).filter(([, id]) => typeof id === "string" && id),
  );
}

export async function addPackagingType(
  db: Db,
  input: { name: string; weightKg: number },
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<PackagingType> {
  checkWeight(input.weightKg);
  const name = cleanName(input.name);
  const types = await getPackagingTypes(db);
  if (types.length >= MAX_PACKAGING_TYPES) throw new PackagingError("TOO_MANY");
  const created: PackagingType = {
    id: randomUUID(),
    name,
    weightKg: grams(input.weightKg) / 1000,
  };
  await saveTypes(db, [...types, created], actor);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.packagingTypeAdded",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: created.id,
      details: { name, weightKg: created.weightKg },
    },
    db,
  );
  return created;
}

export async function updatePackagingType(
  db: Db,
  id: string,
  input: { name: string; weightKg: number },
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  checkWeight(input.weightKg);
  const name = cleanName(input.name);
  const types = await getPackagingTypes(db);
  const before = types.find((type) => type.id === id);
  if (!before) throw new PackagingError("NOT_FOUND");
  const weightKg = grams(input.weightKg) / 1000;
  await saveTypes(
    db,
    types.map((type) => (type.id === id ? { ...type, name, weightKg } : type)),
    actor,
  );
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.packagingTypeChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: id,
      details: {
        name,
        from: { name: before.name, weightKg: before.weightKg },
        to: { name, weightKg },
      },
    },
    db,
  );
}

/** Removes a packaging type, and from every item that used it. Boxes already received keep their weight. */
export async function deletePackagingType(db: Db, id: string, actor: Actor): Promise<number> {
  const types = await getPackagingTypes(db);
  const before = types.find((type) => type.id === id);
  if (!before) throw new PackagingError("NOT_FOUND");
  await saveTypes(
    db,
    types.filter((type) => type.id !== id),
    actor,
  );

  const chosen = await getItemPackaging(db);
  const next = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(chosen).filter(([, typeId]) => typeId !== id));
  const items = Object.keys(chosen).length - Object.keys(next).length;
  if (items > 0) await writeSetting(db, ITEMS_KEY, next, actor.id);

  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.packagingTypeDeleted",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: id,
      details: { name: before.name, weightKg: before.weightKg, items },
    },
    db,
  );
  return items;
}

/** Chooses (or with null clears) the packaging of an item. */
export async function setItemPackaging(
  db: Db,
  itemNumber: string,
  typeId: string | null,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  if (typeId !== null) {
    const types = await getPackagingTypes(db);
    if (!types.some((type) => type.id === typeId)) throw new PackagingError("NOT_FOUND");
  }
  const chosen = await getItemPackaging(db);
  const next = { ...chosen };
  if (typeId === null) delete next[itemNumber];
  else next[itemNumber] = typeId;
  await writeSetting(db, ITEMS_KEY, next, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "catalog.packagingChanged",
    {
      entityType: "item",
      entityId: itemNumber,
      details: { item: itemNumber, from: chosen[itemNumber] ?? null, to: typeId },
    },
    db,
  );
}

export interface Tare {
  box: PackagingType | null;
  /** What the packaging weighs, in kilograms. */
  totalKg: number;
}

export const NO_TARE: Tare = { box: null, totalKg: 0 };

/** The packaging of every item that has one, for the screens that need to show its weight. */
export async function getTares(db: Db): Promise<Record<string, Tare>> {
  const [types, chosen] = await Promise.all([getPackagingTypes(db), getItemPackaging(db)]);
  const byId = new Map(types.map((type) => [type.id, type]));
  const out: Record<string, Tare> = {};
  for (const [itemNumber, typeId] of Object.entries(chosen)) {
    const box = byId.get(typeId);
    if (box) out[itemNumber] = { box, totalKg: box.weightKg };
  }
  return out;
}

export async function getTare(db: Db, itemNumber: string): Promise<Tare> {
  return (await getTares(db))[itemNumber] ?? NO_TARE;
}
````

````ts
import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { MAX_PALLET_BOXES, type PalletLabelData } from "../../lib/pallets";
import { toISODate } from "../../lib/barcodes";
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { palletBoxes, pallets } from "../db/schema";
import { PriorityError, type PriorityClient, type PriorityStockBox } from "../priority/types";

/**
 * Pallets. A pallet is a fixed list of boxes under one number, so one scan of one QR code names
 * them all (to see what is on a pallet, or to move them together). Making one never changes
 * stock, and what stands on a pallet is never edited afterwards.
 */

export type PalletErrorCode =
  "NOTHING_SELECTED" | "TOO_MANY" | "NOT_IN_STOCK" | "NOT_FOUND" | "PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE";

export class PalletError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: PalletErrorCode,
    /** For NOT_IN_STOCK: the barcodes Priority does not have in stock. */
    public readonly barcodes: string[] = [],
  ) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "PalletError";
  }
}

async function readStock(priority: PriorityClient): Promise<PriorityStockBox[]> {
  try {
    return await priority.getStockBoxes();
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof PriorityError && error.code === "UNAVAILABLE")
      throw new PalletError("PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE");
    throw error;
  }
}

/** Makes a pallet of the boxes, in the order given. Every box must be in stock in Priority now. */
export async function createPallet(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  barcodes: string[],
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<{ number: number; boxes: number }> {
  const wanted = [...new Set(barcodes.map((b) => b.trim()).filter(Boolean))];
  if (wanted.length === 0) throw new PalletError("NOTHING_SELECTED");
  if (wanted.length > MAX_PALLET_BOXES) throw new PalletError("TOO_MANY");

  const stock = new Map((await readStock(priority)).map((box) => [box.barcode, box]));
  const missing = wanted.filter((barcode) => !stock.has(barcode));
  if (missing.length > 0) throw new PalletError("NOT_IN_STOCK", missing);

  const number = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [pallet] = await tx
      .insert(pallets)
      .values({ createdBy: actor.id, createdByDisplay: actor.display })
      .returning({ number: pallets.number });
    await tx.insert(palletBoxes).values(
      wanted.map((barcode, position) => {
        const box = stock.get(barcode)!;
        return {
          palletNumber: pallet.number,
          barcode,
          itemNumber: box.itemNumber,
          itemName: box.itemName,
          weightKg: box.weightKg,
          position,
        };
      }),
    );
    return pallet.number;
  });

  await logFor(
    actor,
    "inventory.palletCreated",
    {
      entityType: "pallet",
      entityId: String(number),
      details: { pallet: number, boxes: wanted.length },
    },
    db,
  );
  return { number, boxes: wanted.length };
}

/** What the label of a pallet is made from, or null when there is no such pallet. */
export async function getPalletLabelData(db: Db, number: number): Promise<PalletLabelData | null> {
  const [pallet] = await db.select().from(pallets).where(eq(pallets.number, number)).limit(1);
  if (!pallet) return null;
  const boxes = await db
    .select({ itemName: palletBoxes.itemName, weightKg: palletBoxes.weightKg })
    .from(palletBoxes)
    .where(eq(palletBoxes.palletNumber, number))
    .orderBy(palletBoxes.position);
  return { number, createdDate: toISODate(pallet.createdAt), boxes };
}

export interface PalletBox {
  barcode: string;
  itemNumber: string;
  itemName: string;
  /** The weight when the pallet was made. */
  weightKg: number;
  /** False when Priority no longer has the box in stock (it was picked, or moved out). */
  inStock: boolean;
  /** Where the box is now; null when it is not in stock. */
  warehouseCode: string | null;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD; null when not in stock. */
  expiryDate: string | null;
}

export interface PalletView {
  number: number;
  createdAt: Date;
  createdBy: string;
  boxes: PalletBox[];
}

/** A pallet with each of its boxes checked against Priority's stock as it is now. */
export async function viewPallet(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  number: number,
): Promise<PalletView> {
  const [pallet] = await db.select().from(pallets).where(eq(pallets.number, number)).limit(1);
  if (!pallet) throw new PalletError("NOT_FOUND");
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(palletBoxes)
    .where(eq(palletBoxes.palletNumber, number))
    .orderBy(palletBoxes.position);
  const stock = new Map((await readStock(priority)).map((box) => [box.barcode, box]));
  return {
    number,
    createdAt: pallet.createdAt,
    createdBy: pallet.createdByDisplay,
    boxes: rows.map((row) => {
      const live = stock.get(row.barcode);
      return {
        barcode: row.barcode,
        itemNumber: row.itemNumber,
        itemName: row.itemName,
        weightKg: row.weightKg,
        inStock: live !== undefined,
        warehouseCode: live?.warehouseCode ?? null,
        expiryDate: live?.expiryDate ?? null,
      };
    }),
  };
}

export interface PalletSummary {
  number: number;
  createdAt: Date;
  createdBy: string;
  boxes: number;
  kg: number;
}

/** The latest pallets, newest first. */
export async function listPallets(db: Db, limit = 50): Promise<PalletSummary[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      number: pallets.number,
      createdAt: pallets.createdAt,
      createdBy: pallets.createdByDisplay,
      boxes: sql<number>`count(${palletBoxes.barcode})`.mapWith(Number),
      grams: sql<number>`coalesce(sum(round(${palletBoxes.weightKg} * 1000)), 0)`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(pallets)
    .leftJoin(palletBoxes, eq(palletBoxes.palletNumber, pallets.number))
    .groupBy(pallets.number)
    .orderBy(desc(pallets.number))
    .limit(limit);
  return rows.map(({ grams, ...row }) => ({ ...row, kg: grams / 1000 }));
}
````

````ts
import type { DeviceType } from "../db/schema";
import {
  SCREEN_KEYS,
  screenPermissions,
  viewPermission,
  type Permission,
  type ScreenKey,
} from "./registry";

/**
 * Pure permission logic, shared by server checks, the menu and the editor.
 * The owner passes every check. Everyone else needs the key itself and the
 * device permission matching the session's device type.
 */
export interface AccessInput {
  isOwner: boolean;
  deviceType: DeviceType;
  permissions: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

export function isDeviceAllowed(a: AccessInput): boolean {
  return a.isOwner || a.permissions.has(`device.${a.deviceType}`);
}

export function can(a: AccessInput, permission: Permission): boolean {
  return a.isOwner || (isDeviceAllowed(a) && a.permissions.has(permission));
}

/** Any key of the screen opens it (a screen with no keys is hidden entirely). */
export function canAccessScreen(a: AccessInput, screen: ScreenKey): boolean {
  if (a.isOwner) return true;
  if (!isDeviceAllowed(a)) return false;
  return screenPermissions(screen).some((p) => a.permissions.has(p));
}

/** Screens for the menu, in menu order. */
export function visibleScreens(a: AccessInput): ScreenKey[] {
  return SCREEN_KEYS.filter((screen) => canAccessScreen(a, screen));
}

export type ScreenLevel = "none" | "view" | "edit";

/**
 * The three-way summary the permission editor shows per screen:
 * none = no keys, view = only the view key, edit = any action beyond viewing.
 */
export function screenLevel(permissions: ReadonlySet<string>, screen: ScreenKey): ScreenLevel {
  const keys = screenPermissions(screen).filter((p) => permissions.has(p));
  if (keys.length === 0) return "none";
  if (keys.length === 1 && keys[0] === viewPermission(screen)) return "view";
  return "edit";
}
````

````ts
import "server-only";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { cache } from "react";
import { requireActiveUser, type CurrentUser } from "../auth/session";
import { db } from "../db";
import {
  can as canPure,
  canAccessScreen as canAccessScreenPure,
  isDeviceAllowed,
  visibleScreens as visibleScreensPure,
  type AccessInput,
} from "./evaluate";
import { loadPermissionSet } from "./load";
import { ALL_PERMISSIONS, type Permission, type ScreenKey } from "./registry";

export type { Permission, ScreenKey } from "./registry";
export { loadPermissionSet } from "./load";

/** The logged-in user together with everything needed to decide what they may do. */
export interface Access extends CurrentUser {
  isOwner: boolean;
  permissions: ReadonlySet<Permission>;
  deviceAllowed: boolean;
  can(permission: Permission): boolean;
  canAccessScreen(screen: ScreenKey): boolean;
  visibleScreens(): ScreenKey[];
}

export class PermissionError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly permission: Permission) {
    super(`Missing permission: ${permission}`);
    this.name = "PermissionError";
  }
}

export function buildAccess(current: CurrentUser, permissions: ReadonlySet<Permission>): Access {
  const input: AccessInput = {
    isOwner: Boolean(current.user.isOwner),
    deviceType: current.deviceType,
    permissions,
  };
  return {
    ...current,
    isOwner: input.isOwner,
    permissions,
    deviceAllowed: isDeviceAllowed(input),
    can: (permission) => canPure(input, permission),
    canAccessScreen: (screen) => canAccessScreenPure(input, screen),
    visibleScreens: () => visibleScreensPure(input),
  };
}

/** Access for the current request: logged in, enabled, password already changed. Read once per request. */
export const getAccess = cache(async (): Promise<Access> => {
  const current = await requireActiveUser();
  const permissions = current.user.isOwner
    ? new Set<Permission>(ALL_PERMISSIONS)
    : await loadPermissionSet(db, current.user.id);
  return buildAccess(current, permissions);
});

/** For pages: the screen is "not found" for users without any of its keys or not allowed on this device. */
export async function requireScreen(screen: ScreenKey): Promise<Access> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  if (!access.canAccessScreen(screen)) notFound();
  return access;
}

/** For pages: "not found" without the permission (the plan: hidden sections never show). */
export async function requirePermission(permission: Permission): Promise<Access> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  if (!access.can(permission)) notFound();
  return access;
}

/** For server actions and route handlers: throws instead of rendering not-found. */
export async function assertPermission(permission: Permission): Promise<Access> {
  const access = await getAccess();
  if (!access.can(permission)) throw new PermissionError(permission);
  return access;
}
````

````ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { userPermissions } from "../db/schema";
import { isPermission, type Permission } from "./registry";

/** The keys granted to a user. Kept apart from index.ts so tests and scripts can use it without Next's server-only guard. */
export async function loadPermissionSet(database: Db, userId: string): Promise<Set<Permission>> {
  const rows = await database
    .select({ permission: userPermissions.permission })
    .from(userPermissions)
    .where(eq(userPermissions.userId, userId));
  return new Set(
    rows.map((r) => r.permission).filter((key): key is Permission => isPermission(key)),
  );
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/permissions/registry.ts`

````ts
/**
 * The permission registry: every screen, every action that can be allowed one
 * by one, and the two device permissions. This mirrors the table in PLAN.md
 * ("Permissions") and is the single source of truth for the permission editor,
 * the menu and every server-side check.
 *
 * Keys are "<screen>.<action>" (for example "catalog.print") and
 * "device.desktop" / "device.phone". Every screen has a "view" action; any key
 * of a screen grants access to that screen, and a screen with no keys at all
 * disappears from the user's menu.
 */

interface ScreenDefinition {
  /** Route inside the app. */
  path: string;
  /** Order in the side menu. */
  order: number;
  /** Section of the side menu the screen sits in. */
  group: "operations" | "system";
  /** When the real screen arrives: a build phase from PLAN.md, or a phase 1 step. */
  builtIn: { phase: number } | { step: number };
  /** Actions that can be allowed one by one; "view" is always first. */
  actions: readonly string[];
}

export const SCREENS = {
  dashboard: {
    path: "/dashboard",
    order: 1,
    group: "operations",
    builtIn: { phase: 5 },
    actions: ["view", "refresh", "reorder"],
  },
  catalog: {
    path: "/catalog",
    order: 2,
    group: "operations",
    builtIn: { phase: 2 },
    actions: ["view", "details", "print", "changeCopies", "packaging"],
  },
  receiving: {
    path: "/receiving",
    order: 3,
    group: "operations",
    builtIn: { phase: 4 },
    actions: ["view", "scan", "manual", "reprint", "autoPrint", "todayList"],
  },
  vendor: {
    path: "/vendor-receiving",
    order: 4,
    group: "operations",
    builtIn: { phase: 4 },
    actions: ["view", "scan", "reprint", "todayList"],
  },
  shipping: {
    path: "/shipping-labels",
    order: 5,
    group: "operations",
    builtIn: { phase: 4 },
    actions: ["view", "print", "delete"],
  },
  inventory: {
    path: "/inventory",
    order: 6,
    group: "operations",
    builtIn: { phase: 5 },
    actions: ["view", "filters", "export", "pallets", "palletsScan"],
  },
  settings: {
    path: "/settings",
    order: 7,
    group: "system",
    builtIn: { step: 9 },
    actions: [
      "view",
      "labels.view",
      "labels.edit",
      "hardware.view",
      "hardware.edit",
      "hardware.scale",
      "categories.view",
      "categories.edit",
      "vendorOrder.view",
      "vendorOrder.edit",
      "priority.view",
      "priority.edit",
    ],
  },
  admin: {
    path: "/admin",
    order: 8,
    group: "system",
    builtIn: { step: 8 },
    actions: [
      "view",
      "users.create",
      "users.edit",
      "users.disable",
      "users.delete",
      "permissions",
      "resetPassword",
      "activityLog",
      "sends",
      "security",
      "messages",
    ],
  },
} as const satisfies Record<string, ScreenDefinition>;

export type ScreenKey = keyof typeof SCREENS;

export type ScreenPermission = {
  [S in ScreenKey]: `${S}.${(typeof SCREENS)[S]["actions"][number]}`;
}[ScreenKey];

export const DEVICE_PERMISSIONS = ["device.desktop", "device.phone"] as const;
export type DevicePermission = (typeof DEVICE_PERMISSIONS)[number];

export type Permission = ScreenPermission | DevicePermission;

export const SCREEN_KEYS = (Object.keys(SCREENS) as ScreenKey[]).sort(
  (a, b) => SCREENS[a].order - SCREENS[b].order,
);

export function screenPermissions(screen: ScreenKey): Permission[] {
  return SCREENS[screen].actions.map((action) => `${screen}.${action}` as Permission);
}

export function viewPermission(screen: ScreenKey): Permission {
  return `${screen}.view` as Permission;
}

export const ALL_PERMISSIONS: readonly Permission[] = [
  ...SCREEN_KEYS.flatMap(screenPermissions),
  ...DEVICE_PERMISSIONS,
];

const PERMISSION_SET: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(ALL_PERMISSIONS);

export function isPermission(value: unknown): value is Permission {
  return typeof value === "string" && PERMISSION_SET.has(value);
}

export function isScreenKey(value: unknown): value is ScreenKey {
  return typeof value === "string" && value in SCREENS;
}

/** "catalog.print" -> "catalog"; device permissions have no screen. */
export function screenOf(permission: Permission): ScreenKey | null {
  const screen = permission.slice(0, permission.indexOf("."));
  return isScreenKey(screen) ? screen : null;
}

/** The screen whose route is the start of `pathname`, if any. */
export function screenForPath(pathname: string): ScreenKey | null {
  for (const key of SCREEN_KEYS) {
    const path = SCREENS[key].path;
    if (pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(`${path}/`)) return key;
  }
  return null;
}
````

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";
import { STAND_IN_MODES, type StandInMode } from "./modes";
import { PriorityError } from "./types";

/**
 * How the Priority stand-in behaves, so the system can be tried when Priority
 * is slow or not answering. Only the stand-in reads this; the real client of
 * phase 6 simply meets the real thing.
 */

export { STAND_IN_MODES, type StandInMode } from "./modes";

export interface StandInBehaviour {
  mode: StandInMode;
  /** Pause added to every call in "slow" mode. */
  delayMs: number;
}

/** Same key the seed writes. */
const KEY = "fakePriority.behaviour";

export const DEFAULT_BEHAVIOUR: StandInBehaviour = { mode: "normal", delayMs: 5000 };

export function isStandInMode(value: unknown): value is StandInMode {
  return typeof value === "string" && (STAND_IN_MODES as readonly string[]).includes(value);
}

export async function getStandInBehaviour(db: Db): Promise<StandInBehaviour> {
  const stored = await readSetting<Partial<StandInBehaviour>>(db, KEY);
  const mode = isStandInMode(stored?.value.mode) ? stored.value.mode : DEFAULT_BEHAVIOUR.mode;
  const delayMs =
    typeof stored?.value.delayMs === "number" && stored.value.delayMs >= 0
      ? stored.value.delayMs
      : DEFAULT_BEHAVIOUR.delayMs;
  return { mode, delayMs };
}

export async function setStandInMode(db: Db, mode: StandInMode, actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  const current = await getStandInBehaviour(db);
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, { ...current, mode }, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.standInChanged",
    { entityType: "settings", entityId: KEY, details: { from: current.mode, to: mode } },
    db,
  );
}

/** Called at the start of every stand-in call: waits when slow, throws when down. */
export async function applyBehaviour(db: Db): Promise<void> {
  const { mode, delayMs } = await getStandInBehaviour(db);
  if (mode === "down") throw new PriorityError("UNAVAILABLE");
  if (mode === "slow") await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
}
````

````ts
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "../db/connection";
import { seed } from "../db/seed";
import { clearCooldown, getCooldown, minutesLeft, startCooldown, startsCooldown } from "./cooldown";
import { skippedProbe } from "./odata";
import { getPriorityConnection, savePriorityConnection } from "./settings";

const SECRET = "test-secret-that-is-long-enough-1234567890";
const actor = { id: null, display: "test" };
let database: Database;

beforeAll(async () => {
  database = createDatabase({ url: null, pgliteDataDir: null });
  await database.migrate();
  await seed(database.db, { email: "boss@example.com", password: "Temp-1234", name: "Boss" });
}, 60_000);

describe("the rest after Priority refuses", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-28T10:00:00Z");

  it("is only started by a wrong key or a locked account", () => {
    expect(startsCooldown("AUTH_FAILED")).toBe(true);
    expect(startsCooldown("RATE_LIMITED")).toBe(true);
    for (const code of ["UNAVAILABLE", "NOT_FOUND", "BAD_REQUEST", null] as const)
      expect(startsCooldown(code)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("lasts 10 minutes after a wrong key and 30 after a lock, then is over", async () => {
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db, now)).toBeNull();

    const wrong = await startCooldown(database.db, "AUTH_FAILED", now);
    expect(wrong.until).toBe("2026-10-28T10:10:00.000Z");
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db, new Date("2026-10-28T10:09:59Z"))).toMatchObject({
      code: "AUTH_FAILED",
    });
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db, new Date("2026-10-28T10:10:00Z"))).toBeNull();

    const locked = await startCooldown(database.db, "RATE_LIMITED", now);
    expect(locked.until).toBe("2026-10-28T10:30:00.000Z");
    expect(minutesLeft(locked, now)).toBe(30);
    expect(minutesLeft(locked, new Date("2026-10-28T10:29:30Z"))).toBe(1);
    expect(minutesLeft(locked, new Date("2026-10-28T11:00:00Z"))).toBe(1);

    await clearCooldown(database.db);
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db, now)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("is cleared by saving a different key or address, not by saving the same ones", async () => {
    const future = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60_000);
    await savePriorityConnection(
      database.db,
      { baseUrl: "https://erp.example.com/odata", apiUser: "KEY-ONE" },
      actor,
      SECRET,
    );
    await startCooldown(database.db, "RATE_LIMITED", new Date());
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db)).not.toBeNull();

    // The same address, key untouched: still resting.
    await savePriorityConnection(
      database.db,
      { baseUrl: (await getPriorityConnection(database.db)).baseUrl },
      actor,
      SECRET,
    );
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db)).not.toBeNull();

    // A new key: a fresh try is allowed.
    await savePriorityConnection(
      database.db,
      { baseUrl: "https://erp.example.com/odata", apiUser: "KEY-TWO" },
      actor,
      SECRET,
    );
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db, future)).toBeNull();
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db)).toBeNull();

    // So is a new address.
    await startCooldown(database.db, "AUTH_FAILED", new Date());
    await savePriorityConnection(
      database.db,
      { baseUrl: "https://other.example.com/odata" },
      actor,
      SECRET,
    );
    expect(await getCooldown(database.db)).toBeNull();
  });
});
````

````ts
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { deleteSetting, readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";
import type { PriorityErrorCode } from "./types";

/**
 * A rest after Priority refuses us. A wrong key counts as a failed sign-in, and after a few of
 * them Priority locks the account, so after the first refusal nothing asks Priority again for a
 * while: not a second click, not the other forms of the same check. Kept in the database so it
 * holds across restarts and across the two processes of `pnpm dev`.
 */

const KEY = "priority.cooldown";

/** How long to leave Priority alone after it said "no" or "locked". */
export const COOLDOWN_MINUTES: Partial<Record<PriorityErrorCode, number>> = {
  AUTH_FAILED: 10,
  RATE_LIMITED: 30,
};

export interface Cooldown {
  /** ISO time until which Priority is left alone. */
  until: string;
  code: PriorityErrorCode;
}

/** Whether this answer from Priority should start a rest. */
export function startsCooldown(code: PriorityErrorCode | null): code is PriorityErrorCode {
  return code !== null && COOLDOWN_MINUTES[code] !== undefined;
}

export async function getCooldown(db: Db, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<Cooldown | null> {
  const stored = await readSetting<Cooldown>(db, KEY);
  if (!stored || new Date(stored.value.until) <= now) return null;
  return stored.value;
}

export async function startCooldown(
  db: Db,
  code: PriorityErrorCode,
  now: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<Cooldown> {
  const minutes = COOLDOWN_MINUTES[code] ?? 10;
  const cooldown: Cooldown = {
    until: new Date(now.getTime() + minutes * 60_000).toISOString(),
    code,
  };
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, cooldown, null);
  return cooldown;
}

/** New credentials deserve a fresh try. */
export async function clearCooldown(db: Db): Promise<void> {
  await deleteSetting(db, KEY);
}

export function minutesLeft(cooldown: Cooldown, now: Date = new Date()): number {
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((new Date(cooldown.until).getTime() - now.getTime()) / 60_000));
}
````
