````ts
import { desc, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { timeZone } from "../../lib/i18n/config";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { boxes } from "../db/schema";
import type { PriorityStockBox } from "./types";

/** How much of a box's barcode Priority's stock list keeps (see live.ts). */
const LOT_LENGTH = 16;

const lotKey = (itemNumber: string, weightKg: number, barcode: string) =>
  `${itemNumber}|${weightKg.toFixed(2)}|${barcode.slice(0, LOT_LENGTH)}`;

/**
 * The "date entered" of a box is the day it was received here (factory time), not Priority's
 * "last date", which moves whenever anything happens to the stock line and is the load date for
 * stock that was brought in all at once. Boxes this system did not receive keep Priority's date.
 *
 * A stock line normally carries the box's full barcode. When Priority only gives the short lot
 * (the first 16 characters, as happens for vendor boxes, whose running number sits at the end),
 * the line is matched to a box received here by item, lot and weight; boxes that match the same
 * way are interchangeable, so each takes the newest not yet used (the oldest leave stock first).
 */
export async function withReceivedDates(
  db: Db,
  stock: PriorityStockBox[],
): Promise<PriorityStockBox[]> {
  if (stock.length === 0) return stock;
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      barcode: boxes.barcode,
      itemNumber: boxes.itemNumber,
      weightKg: boxes.weightKg,
      day: sql<string>`to_char(${boxes.receivedAt} at time zone ${timeZone}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')`,
    })
    .from(boxes)
    .orderBy(desc(boxes.receivedAt));

  const exact = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.barcode, row.day]));
  const inStock = new Set(stock.map((box) => box.barcode));

  // Boxes received here that no stock line names in full, grouped by lot, newest first.
  const byLot = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (inStock.has(row.barcode)) continue;
    const key = lotKey(row.itemNumber, row.weightKg, row.barcode);
    byLot.set(key, [...(byLot.get(key) ?? []), row.day]);
  }

  return stock.map((box) => {
    const day =
      exact.get(box.barcode) ??
      byLot.get(lotKey(box.itemNumber, box.weightKg, box.barcode))?.shift();
    return day ? { ...box, enteredDate: day } : box;
  });
}
````

````ts
import { asc, desc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { todayIso } from "../../lib/i18n/format";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import {
  fakePriorityInventory,
  fakePriorityItems,
  fakePriorityOrders,
  fakePriorityReceivedLines,
  fakePriorityWarehouses,
} from "../db/schema";
import { applyBehaviour } from "./behaviour";
import {
  PriorityError,
  type PriorityClient,
  type PriorityItem,
  type PriorityOrder,
  type PriorityStockBox,
  type PriorityWarehouse,
  type ReceiveBoxInput,
} from "./types";

/**
 * The Priority stand-in: reads and writes the sample data in the fake_priority_*
 * tables. Every call first obeys the stand-in behaviour (normal, slow, down).
 */
export class FakePriorityClient implements PriorityClient {
  constructor(private readonly db: Db) {}

  async getItems(): Promise<PriorityItem[]> {
    await applyBehaviour(this.db);
    const rows = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(fakePriorityItems)
      .orderBy(asc(fakePriorityItems.partname));
    return rows.map((r) => ({
      itemNumber: r.partname,
      name: r.partdes,
      nameEn: r.epartdes,
      barcode: r.barcode,
      category: r.familydes,
      weightKg: r.weight,
      shelfLifeDays: r.expiredays,
      storageText: r.specs,
      packingCode: r.packingcode,
      origin: r.originname,
      inventoryManaged: r.inventorymanaged,
    }));
  }

  async getWarehouses(): Promise<PriorityWarehouse[]> {
    await applyBehaviour(this.db);
    const rows = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(fakePriorityWarehouses)
      .orderBy(asc(fakePriorityWarehouses.warhsdes));
    return rows.map((r) => ({ code: r.warhsname, name: r.warhsdes }));
  }

  async getStockBoxes(): Promise<PriorityStockBox[]> {
    await applyBehaviour(this.db);
    const rows = await this.db
      .select({
        barcode: fakePriorityInventory.actname,
        itemNumber: fakePriorityInventory.partname,
        itemName: fakePriorityItems.partdes,
        itemNameEn: fakePriorityItems.epartdes,
        warehouseCode: fakePriorityInventory.warhsname,
        weightKg: fakePriorityInventory.tbalance,
        expiryDate: fakePriorityInventory.expirydate,
        enteredDate: fakePriorityInventory.curdate,
      })
      .from(fakePriorityInventory)
      .innerJoin(fakePriorityItems, eq(fakePriorityInventory.partname, fakePriorityItems.partname))
      .orderBy(asc(fakePriorityInventory.expirydate));
    return rows;
  }

  async getOrders(): Promise<PriorityOrder[]> {
    await applyBehaviour(this.db);
    const rows = await this.db
      .select()
      .from(fakePriorityOrders)
      .orderBy(desc(fakePriorityOrders.curdate), desc(fakePriorityOrders.docno));
    return rows.map((r) => ({
      docno: r.docno,
      kind: r.doctype,
      itemNumber: r.partname,
      date: r.curdate,
      status: r.status,
    }));
  }

  async receiveBox(input: ReceiveBoxInput): Promise<void> {
    await applyBehaviour(this.db);
    await this.db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const [order] = await tx
        .select({ docno: fakePriorityOrders.docno })
        .from(fakePriorityOrders)
        .where(eq(fakePriorityOrders.docno, input.docno))
        .limit(1);
      if (!order) throw new PriorityError("UNKNOWN_ORDER");

      const [item] = await tx
        .select()
        .from(fakePriorityItems)
        .where(eq(fakePriorityItems.partname, input.itemNumber))
        .limit(1);
      if (!item) throw new PriorityError("UNKNOWN_ITEM");

      const [warehouse] = await tx
        .select({ code: fakePriorityWarehouses.warhsname })
        .from(fakePriorityWarehouses)
        .where(eq(fakePriorityWarehouses.warhsname, input.warehouseCode))
        .limit(1);
      if (!warehouse) throw new PriorityError("UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE");

      const [existing] = await tx
        .select({ id: fakePriorityInventory.id })
        .from(fakePriorityInventory)
        .where(eq(fakePriorityInventory.actname, input.barcode))
        .limit(1);
      if (existing) throw new PriorityError("DUPLICATE_BOX");

      await tx.insert(fakePriorityReceivedLines).values({
        docno: input.docno,
        topalletname: input.barcode,
        tquant: input.weightKg,
        partname: input.itemNumber,
        barcode: item.barcode,
        pdes: item.partdes,
        toppExpirydate: input.expiryDate,
        warhsname: input.warehouseCode,
      });
      await tx.insert(fakePriorityInventory).values({
        partname: input.itemNumber,
        warhsname: input.warehouseCode,
        actname: input.barcode,
        tbalance: input.weightKg,
        expirydate: input.expiryDate,
        curdate: todayIso(),
      });
    });
  }
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/priority/index.ts`

````ts
import { db } from "../db";
import { appSecret } from "../settings/secret";
import { getShelfLives, withShelfLives } from "../shelf-lives";
import { getStorageTexts, withStorageTexts } from "../storage-texts";
import { withReceivedDates } from "./entered-dates";
import { FakePriorityClient } from "./fake";
import { LiveReadPriorityClient } from "./live";
import type { PriorityClient } from "./types";

export { PriorityError } from "./types";
export type {
  PriorityClient,
  PriorityErrorCode,
  PriorityItem,
  PriorityOrder,
  PriorityStockBox,
  PriorityWarehouse,
  ReceiveBoxInput,
} from "./types";

let live: LiveReadPriorityClient | null = null;

/**
 * The Priority connection for this process, chosen by PRIORITY_MODE:
 * "fake" (the default) is the stand-in; "live" reads items, warehouses and stock from the real
 * Priority, keeps orders on the stand-in, and refuses writes until Priority allows them.
 */
export function getPriorityClient(): PriorityClient {
  const mode = process.env.PRIORITY_MODE || "fake";
  if (mode === "live") {
    if (!live) {
      live = new LiveReadPriorityClient(db, appSecret);
      // Read once at start, so the first page opened does not wait for Priority.
      void Promise.allSettled([live.getItems(), live.getStockBoxes()]);
    }
    return withCategoryTexts(live);
  }
  return withCategoryTexts(new FakePriorityClient(db));
}

/**
 * The same client, whose items take their category's storage text and shelf life (days from the
 * slaughter date to the expiry date) where Priority has none.
 */
function withCategoryTexts(client: PriorityClient): PriorityClient {
  return {
    getItems: async () => {
      const [items, texts, days] = await Promise.all([
        client.getItems(),
        getStorageTexts(db),
        getShelfLives(db),
      ]);
      return withShelfLives(withStorageTexts(items, texts), days);
    },
    getWarehouses: () => client.getWarehouses(),
    getStockBoxes: async () => withReceivedDates(db, await client.getStockBoxes()),
    getOrders: () => client.getOrders(),
    receiveBox: (input) => client.receiveBox(input),
  };
}
````

````ts
function answering(forms: Record<string, unknown[] | number>) {

    const answer = forms[form];
    if (typeof answer === "number") return new Response("{}", { status: answer });
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ value: answer ?? [] }), { status: 200 });
  }) as unknown as typeof fetch;
  return { asked, fetchImpl };
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/priority/live.ts`

````ts
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { getCooldown, startCooldown, startsCooldown } from "./cooldown";
import { readSetting } from "../settings";
import { OdataError, OdataHttp } from "./odata";
import { postReceiptLine } from "./write";
import { getPriorityConnection, readPriorityCredentials } from "./settings";
import {
  PriorityError,
  type PriorityClient,
  type PriorityItem,
  type PriorityOrder,
  type PriorityStockBox,
  type PriorityWarehouse,
  type ReceiveBoxInput,
} from "./types";

const PAGE = 500;
/** The statuses of a receipt document that is still open for boxes (a draft, or to be done). */
const OPEN_STATUSES = ["טיוטא", "טיוטה", "לביצוע"];
/** How much of a box's barcode the stock list keeps. */
const LOT_LENGTH = 16;
const MAX_PAGES = 100;
/** Pages ask Priority only this often; the factory's own program uses the same API. */
const KEEP_MS = 60_000;
/** An answer older than KEEP_MS but younger than this is still shown while a new one is fetched. */
const STALE_MS = 30 * 60_000;

type Row = Record<string, unknown>;

const text = (value: unknown): string => (typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "");
const number = (value: unknown): number => (typeof value === "number" ? value : 0);
/** "2026-10-22T00:00:00Z" becomes "2026-10-22". */
const day = (value: unknown): string => text(value).slice(0, 10);

/**
 * Reads items, warehouses and stock from the real Priority (read only). Orders and writing boxes
 * are not live yet: orders come from the stand-in, and a write is refused so a box is never
 * pretended to be sent. Never retries a refusal by itself: after one, Priority is left alone.
 */
export class LiveReadPriorityClient implements PriorityClient {
  private readonly kept = new Map<string, { at: number; rows: Promise<Row[]> }>();
  private readonly refreshing = new Map<string, Promise<Row[]>>();

  constructor(
    private readonly db: Db,
    private readonly secret: () => string,
    private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
  ) {}

  private async ask(
    form: string,
    select: string,
    filter?: string,
    expand?: string,
  ): Promise<Row[]> {
    const key = `${form}|${select}|${filter ?? ""}|${expand ?? ""}`;
    const hit = this.kept.get(key);
    const age = hit ? Date.now() - hit.at : Infinity;
    if (hit && age < KEEP_MS) return hit.rows;
    // An older answer is shown at once while a fresh one is fetched for the next page.
    if (hit && age < STALE_MS) {
      void this.refresh(key, form, select, filter, expand).catch(() => {});
      return hit.rows;
    }
    return this.refresh(key, form, select, filter, expand);
  }

  private async refresh(
    key: string,
    form: string,
    select: string,
    filter?: string,
    expand?: string,
  ): Promise<Row[]> {
    const pending = this.refreshing.get(key);
    if (pending) return pending;
    const rows = this.fetchAll(form, select, filter, expand);
    const run = rows.then(
      (value) => {
        this.kept.set(key, { at: Date.now(), rows });
        this.refreshing.delete(key);
        return value;
      },
      (error) => {
        this.refreshing.delete(key);
        throw error;
      },
    );
    this.refreshing.set(key, run);
    return run;
  }

  private async fetchAll(
    form: string,
    select: string,
    filter?: string,
    expand?: string,
  ): Promise<Row[]> {
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(
      await getPriorityConnection(this.db),
      this.secret(),
    );
    if (!credentials) throw new PriorityError("UNAVAILABLE");
    if (await getCooldown(this.db)) throw new PriorityError("AUTH_FAILED");
    const http = new OdataHttp(credentials, this.fetchImpl);
    const all: Row[] = [];
    try {
      for (let page = 0; page < MAX_PAGES; page++) {
        const query: Record<string, string> = {
          $select: select,
          $top: String(PAGE),
          $skip: String(page * PAGE),
        };
        if (filter) query.$filter = filter;
        if (expand) query.$expand = expand;
        const data = await http.get<{ value?: Row[] }>(form, query);
        const rows = Array.isArray(data.value) ? data.value : [];
        all.push(...rows);
        if (rows.length < PAGE) break;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof OdataError) {
        if (startsCooldown(error.code)) await startCooldown(this.db, error.code);
        throw new PriorityError(error.code);
      }
      throw error;
    }
    return all;
  }

  async getItems(): Promise<PriorityItem[]> {
    const rows = await this.ask(
      "LOGPART",
      "PARTNAME,PARTDES,EPARTDES,BARCODE,FAMILYDES,PRIZ_WKARTON,PRIZ_LABTEXT,STATDES,INVFLAG",
    );
    return rows
      .filter((row) => text(row.PARTNAME) && text(row.STATDES) === "פעיל")
      .map((row) => ({
        itemNumber: text(row.PARTNAME),
        name: text(row.PARTDES),
        nameEn: text(row.EPARTDES),
        barcode: text(row.BARCODE),
        category: text(row.FAMILYDES),
        weightKg: number(row.PRIZ_WKARTON) > 0 ? number(row.PRIZ_WKARTON) : null,
        // The dates of a box come from its order; no shelf-life days are kept on the item.
        shelfLifeDays: 0,
        storageText: text(row.PRIZ_LABTEXT),
        packingCode: "",
        origin: "",
        inventoryManaged: text(row.INVFLAG) === "Y",
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.itemNumber.localeCompare(b.itemNumber));
  }

  /**
   * The form WAREHOUSES is not open to the API, so the rooms are gathered from the screens that
   * name them: stock lines (even empty ones) and receipt documents, which also carry the room's
   * description. A room that has never had stock or a document cannot be seen this way.
   */
  async getWarehouses(): Promise<PriorityWarehouse[]> {
    const [everyLine, documents] = await Promise.all([
      this.ask("PARTBAL", "WARHSNAME"),
      this.ask("DOCUMENTS_H", "WARHSNAME,WARHSDES"),
    ]);
    const names = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const row of documents) {
      const code = text(row.WARHSNAME);
      if (code && !names.get(code)) names.set(code, text(row.WARHSDES));
    }
    for (const row of everyLine) {
      const code = text(row.WARHSNAME);
      if (code && !names.has(code)) names.set(code, "");
    }
    return [...names.entries()]
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
      .map(([code, description]) => ({ code, name: description || code }));
  }

  private stockRows(): Promise<Row[]> {
    return this.ask(
      "PARTBAL",
      "ACTNAME,PARTNAME,PARTDES,WARHSNAME,BALANCE,TOPP_EXPIRYDATE,LASTDATE",
      "BALANCE gt 0",
    );
  }

  /**
   * The stock list keeps only the first 16 characters of a box's barcode, so every box of one
   * lot looks the same there. The full barcode is on the goods receipt line (TOPALLETNAME). A
   * stock line is matched to its receipt line by item, lot prefix and weight; boxes that match
   * the same way are interchangeable, so each takes the next unused barcode.
   */
  private async fullBarcodes(): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
    const found = new Map<string, string[]>();
    let documents: Row[];
    try {
      documents = await this.ask(
        "DOCUMENTS_H",
        "DOCNO",
        undefined,
        "TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM($select=PARTNAME,TQUANT,TOPALLETNAME,TOACTNAME)",
      );
    } catch (error) {
      // Without the receipt lines the short number is still better than no stock at all.
      if (error instanceof PriorityError && error.code !== "AUTH_FAILED") {
        console.warn(`[priority] the receipt lines could not be read (${error.code})`);
        return found;
      }
      throw error;
    }
    for (const document of documents) {
      const lines = document.TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM;
      if (!Array.isArray(lines)) continue;
      for (const line of lines as Row[]) {
        const full = text(line.TOPALLETNAME) || text(line.TOACTNAME);
        const part = text(line.PARTNAME);
        if (!full || !part) continue;
        const key = `${part}|${number(line.TQUANT).toFixed(2)}|${full.slice(0, LOT_LENGTH)}`;
        found.set(key, [...(found.get(key) ?? []), full]);
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  async getStockBoxes(): Promise<PriorityStockBox[]> {
    const [rows, full] = await Promise.all([this.stockRows(), this.fullBarcodes()]);
    console.log(`[priority] ${full.size} receipt line groups read for ${rows.length} stock lines`);
    const unused = new Map([...full].map(([key, barcodes]) => [key, [...barcodes]]));
    return rows
      .filter((row) => text(row.ACTNAME) && text(row.PARTNAME))
      .map((row) => ({
        barcode:
          unused
            .get(
              `${text(row.PARTNAME)}|${number(row.BALANCE).toFixed(2)}|${text(row.ACTNAME).slice(0, LOT_LENGTH)}`,
            )
            ?.shift() ?? text(row.ACTNAME),
        itemNumber: text(row.PARTNAME),
        itemName: text(row.PARTDES),
        itemNameEn: "",
        warehouseCode: text(row.WARHSNAME),
        weightKg: number(row.BALANCE),
        expiryDate: day(row.TOPP_EXPIRYDATE),
        enteredDate: day(row.LASTDATE),
      }));
  }

  /**
   * The open receipt documents in Priority: the ones still a draft or waiting to be done. A box is
   * recorded under the document whose number is the certificate number on its item label, in that
   * document's storage room. The vendor document is the one chosen in the settings.
   */
  async getOrders(): Promise<PriorityOrder[]> {
    const [rows, vendor] = await Promise.all([
      this.ask("DOCUMENTS_H", "DOCNO,CURDATE,WARHSNAME,ASSCODESTATUS"),
      readSetting<string>(this.db, "receiving.vendorOrder"),
    ]);
    return rows
      .filter((row) => text(row.DOCNO))
      .map((row) => ({
        docno: text(row.DOCNO),
        kind:
          text(row.DOCNO) === (vendor?.value ?? "") ? ("vendor" as const) : ("production" as const),
        itemNumber: null,
        date: day(row.CURDATE),
        status: OPEN_STATUSES.includes(text(row.ASSCODESTATUS)) ? "open" : text(row.ASSCODESTATUS),
        warehouseCode: text(row.WARHSNAME) || undefined,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || b.docno.localeCompare(a.docno));
  }

  async receiveBox(input: ReceiveBoxInput): Promise<void> {
    // Writing into the real Priority is switched on on purpose (PRIORITY_WRITE=on), after a test.
    // Until then the box waits and goes by itself once writing is on.
    if (process.env.PRIORITY_WRITE !== "on") throw new PriorityError("WRITE_NOT_OPEN");
    const credentials = readPriorityCredentials(
      await getPriorityConnection(this.db),
      this.secret(),
    );
    if (!credentials) throw new PriorityError("UNAVAILABLE");
    const http = new OdataHttp(credentials, this.fetchImpl);
    await postReceiptLine(http, input);
  }
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  ACCESS_KEY_PASSWORD,
  OdataError,
  OdataHttp,
  errorDetail,
  findItemTexts,
  isFormName,
  probeForm,
  subformsIn,
} from "./odata";
import type { PriorityCredentials } from "./settings";

const credentials: PriorityCredentials = {
  baseUrl: "https://p.example.online/odata/Priority/tabula.ini/democo/",
  user: "KEY0123456789",
  password: null,
};

interface Call {
  url: string;
  init: RequestInit;
}

/** A pretend Priority: answers every request with the given status and body, and remembers what it was asked. */
function pretend(status: number, body: unknown) {
  const calls: Call[] = [];
  const fetchImpl = (async (url: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {
    calls.push({ url: String(url), init: init ?? {} });
    return new Response(typeof body === "string" ? body : JSON.stringify(body), { status });
  }) as typeof fetch;
  return { calls, http: new OdataHttp(credentials, fetchImpl) };
}

const basic = (call: Call) =>
  Buffer.from(
    String((call.init.headers as Record<string, string>).Authorization).slice(6),
    "base64",
  ).toString();

describe("signing in", () => {
  it("sends the access key as the user name and Priority's fixed word as the password", async () => {
    const { calls, http } = pretend(200, { value: [] });
    await http.get("LOGPART");
    expect(basic(calls[0])).toBe(`KEY0123456789:${ACCESS_KEY_PASSWORD}`);
    expect(calls[0].init.method).toBe("GET");
    expect((calls[0].init.headers as Record<string, string>).Accept).toBe("application/json");
  });

  it("uses the stored password when there is one", async () => {
    const calls: Call[] = [];
    const http = new OdataHttp({ ...credentials, password: "pw" }, (async (url, init) => {
      calls.push({ url: String(url), init: init ?? {} });
      return new Response("{}", { status: 200 });
    }) as typeof fetch);
    await http.get("LOGPART");
    expect(basic(calls[0])).toBe("KEY0123456789:pw");
  });

  it("never puts the key or the password in the address", async () => {
    const { calls, http } = pretend(200, {});
    await http.get("LOGPART", { $top: "1" });
    expect(calls[0].url).not.toContain("KEY0123456789");
  });
});

describe("addresses", () => {
  it("join the base address, the form and the options with single slashes", () => {
    const http = new OdataHttp(credentials);
    expect(http.url("LOGPART")).toBe(
      "https://p.example.online/odata/Priority/tabula.ini/democo/LOGPART",
    );
    expect(http.url("/LOGPART", { $top: "1", $filter: "PARTNAME eq 'A B'" })).toBe(
      "https://p.example.online/odata/Priority/tabula.ini/democo/LOGPART?$top=1&$filter=PARTNAME%20eq%20'A%20B'",
    );
  });

  it("accept only plain form names", () => {
    expect(isFormName("LOGPART")).toBe(true);
    expect(isFormName("PARTBAL_SUBFORM")).toBe(true);
    for (const bad of ["", "../x", "LOG PART", "A?b=1", "1ABC", "A/B", "A".repeat(61)])
      expect(isFormName(bad)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("when Priority does not take the request", () => {
  async function code(status: number, body: unknown = "") {
    const { http } = pretend(status, body);
    try {
      await http.get("LOGPART");
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(OdataError);
      return (error as OdataError).code;
    }
    throw new Error("expected an error");
  }

  it("tells a wrong key, a missing form, a refused request and an unreachable Priority apart", async () => {
    expect(await code(401)).toBe("AUTH_FAILED");
    expect(await code(403)).toBe("AUTH_FAILED");
    expect(await code(404)).toBe("NOT_FOUND");
    expect(await code(400, { error: { message: "Unknown field" } })).toBe("BAD_REQUEST");
    for (const status of [408, 500, 502, 503, 504]) expect(await code(status)).toBe("UNAVAILABLE");
  });

  it("calls a locked account 'rate limited', which is never retried by itself", async () => {
    expect(
      await code(429, {
        error: { message: "Account locked due to too many failed login attempts." },
      }),
    ).toBe("RATE_LIMITED");
  });

  it("calls a network failure or a timeout 'unavailable', so it retries later", async () => {
    for (const name of ["TypeError", "TimeoutError", "AbortError"]) {
      const http = new OdataHttp(credentials, (async () => {
        throw Object.assign(new Error("boom"), { name });
      }) as typeof fetch);
      await expect(http.get("LOGPART")).rejects.toMatchObject({
        code: "UNAVAILABLE",
        status: null,
      });
    }
  });

  it("does not mistake a page of HTML for data", async () => {
    const { http } = pretend(200, "<html><body>Sign in</body></html>");
    await expect(http.get("LOGPART")).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "BAD_REQUEST" });
  });

  it("keeps Priority's own words, short, and never the credentials", async () => {
    const { http } = pretend(400, { error: { message: "Field FOO does not exist in LOGPART" } });
    await expect(http.get("LOGPART")).rejects.toMatchObject({
      detail: "Field FOO does not exist in LOGPART",
    });
    expect(errorDetail("<error><message>Bad   thing</message></error>")).toBe("Bad thing");
    expect(errorDetail("x".repeat(1000)).length).toBe(300);
    expect(errorDetail(JSON.stringify({ message: "plain message" }))).toBe("plain message");
  });
});

describe("checking a form", () => {
  it("lists the fields of the first row and a short sample of each value", async () => {
    const { calls, http } = pretend(200, {
      "@odata.context": "x",
      value: [
        {
          PARTNAME: "N2015D-S",

    expect(probe.fields).toEqual(["PARTNAME", "PARTDES", "WEIGHT", "NOTE", "LONG"]);
    expect(probe.sample).toMatchObject({ PARTNAME: "N2015D-S", WEIGHT: "12.5", NOTE: "" });
    expect(probe.sample.LONG.length).toBe(60);
  });

  it("says so when the form answers but has no rows", async () => {

    expect(await probeForm(missing.http, "NOPE")).toMatchObject({

});

describe("finding an item's texts", () => {
  const metadata = `<Schema><EntityType Name="LOGPART"><Property Name="PARTNAME"/>
    <NavigationProperty Name="PARTTEXT_SUBFORM" Type="x"/><NavigationProperty Name="PARTSPEC_SUBFORM" Type="y"/>
    </EntityType><EntityType Name="OTHER"><NavigationProperty Name="NOT_THIS" Type="z"/></EntityType></Schema>`;

  it("reads the sub-form names of one form from Priority's description", () => {
    expect(subformsIn(metadata, "LOGPART")).toEqual(["PARTTEXT_SUBFORM", "PARTSPEC_SUBFORM"]);
    expect(subformsIn(metadata, "NOPE")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("looks through every sub-form of the item and reports where words are kept", async () => {
    const asked: string[] = [];
    const fetchImpl = (async (url: string | URL | Request) => {
      const address = decodeURIComponent(String(url));
      asked.push(address);
      if (address.includes("$metadata")) return new Response(metadata, { status: 200 });
      if (address.includes("PARTTEXT_SUBFORM"))
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ value: [{ TEXT: "יש לשמור ב-18- מעלות", LINE: 1 }] }));
      if (address.includes("PARTSPEC_SUBFORM"))
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: { message: "לא ניתן" } }), { status: 400 });
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ PARTNAME: "M1", PARTDES: "בריסקט", PRICE: 3 }));
    }) as typeof fetch;
    const probes = await findItemTexts(new OdataHttp(credentials, fetchImpl), "M1");
    const by = (form: string) => probes.find((p) => p.form === form)!;
    expect(by("LOGPART('M1')").sample).toEqual({ PARTDES: "בריסקט" });
    expect(by("LOGPART('M1')/PARTTEXT_SUBFORM").sample).toEqual({ TEXT: "יש לשמור ב-18- מעלות" });
    expect(by("LOGPART('M1')/PARTSPEC_SUBFORM")).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 400 });
    expect(asked.some((url) => url.includes("NOT_THIS"))).toBe(false);
  });
});
````

````ts
import { PriorityError, type PriorityErrorCode } from "./types";
import type { PriorityCredentials } from "./settings";

/**
 * Talking to Priority's OData API. This file reads, and has one deliberate way to ask whether
 * writing is allowed (probeWrite), which sends a request that can never create anything. Signing in is Priority's access-key way: HTTP Basic with the key as the user name and,
 * when no password was stored, the fixed word "PAT" as the password. No app id or app key.
 */

/** The password Priority expects together with an access key. */
export const ACCESS_KEY_PASSWORD = "PAT";

const TIMEOUT_MS = 20_000;
/** Longest piece of Priority's own error text kept; long enough to read, short enough to be safe. */
const MAX_DETAIL = 300;
const FORM_NAME = /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,59}$/;

/** What went wrong, with Priority's own words when it gave any (never the credentials). */
export class OdataError extends PriorityError {
  constructor(
    code: PriorityErrorCode,
    public readonly status: number | null,
    public readonly detail: string,
  ) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "OdataError";
  }
}

export function isFormName(name: string): boolean {
  return FORM_NAME.test(name);
}

function codeForStatus(status: number): PriorityErrorCode {
  if (status === 401 || status === 403) return "AUTH_FAILED";
  if (status === 404) return "NOT_FOUND";
  // A locked account or "too many requests": asking again makes it worse, so it is not "unavailable".
  if (status === 429) return "RATE_LIMITED";
  if (status === 408 || status >= 500) return "UNAVAILABLE";
  return "BAD_REQUEST";
}

/** Priority's error text out of a JSON or XML or plain body, short and on one line. */
export function errorDetail(body: string): string {
  let text = body.trim();
  try {
    const json = JSON.parse(text) as { error?: { message?: unknown } | string; message?: unknown };
    const message =
      typeof json.error === "string"
        ? json.error
        : typeof json.error?.message === "string"
          ? json.error.message
          : typeof json.message === "string"
            ? json.message
            : null;
    if (message) text = message;
  } catch {
    // Not JSON: use the text as it is (XML tags are stripped below).
  }
  return text
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, MAX_DETAIL);
}

export class OdataHttp {
  constructor(
    private readonly credentials: PriorityCredentials,
    private readonly fetchImpl: typeof fetch = fetch,
  ) {}

  private authorization(): string {
    const password = this.credentials.password ?? ACCESS_KEY_PASSWORD;
    return `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${this.credentials.user}:${password}`, "utf8").toString("base64")}`;
  }

  /** The address of a form, with the options (like $top) after it. */
  url(path: string, query: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
    const base = this.credentials.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    const options = Object.entries(query)
      .map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`)
      .join("&");
    return `${base}/${path.replace(/^\/+/, "")}${options ? `?${options}` : ""}`;
  }

  /** One GET of the raw answer. Throws OdataError: UNAVAILABLE when Priority cannot be reached. */
  private async fetchBody(
    path: string,
    query: Record<string, string>,
    accept: string,
  ): Promise<{ status: number; body: string }> {
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await this.fetchImpl(this.url(path, query), {
        method: "GET",
        headers: { Authorization: this.authorization(), Accept: accept },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: "no-store",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.name : "error";
      throw new OdataError("UNAVAILABLE", null, `no answer (${reason})`);
    }
    const body = await response.text().catch(() => "");
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new OdataError(codeForStatus(response.status), response.status, errorDetail(body));
    }
    return { status: response.status, body };
  }

  /**
   * Asks whether this key may write, without writing: one POST to a line that does not exist,
   * carrying a field that does not exist, so Priority can only refuse it. The words of the refusal
   * show whether it was the permission ("not allowed") or only the made-up data. Never throws.
   */
  async probeWrite(path: string): Promise<{ status: number | null; detail: string; ms: number }> {
    const started = Date.now();
    try {
      const response = await this.fetchImpl(this.url(path), {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: this.authorization(),
          Accept: "application/json",
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ZZ_WRITE_CHECK_NOT_A_FIELD: "x" }),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: "no-store",
      });
      const body = await response.text().catch(() => "");
      return { status: response.status, detail: errorDetail(body), ms: Date.now() - started };
    } catch (error) {
      const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.name : "error";
      return { status: null, detail: `no answer (${reason})`, ms: Date.now() - started };
    }
  }

  /** One POST that adds a row. Throws OdataError with Priority's own words when it refuses. */
  async post(
    path: string,
    body: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<{ status: number; detail: string; raw: string }> {
    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await this.fetchImpl(this.url(path), {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: this.authorization(),
          Accept: "application/json",
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: "no-store",
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.name : "error";
      throw new OdataError("UNAVAILABLE", null, `no answer (${reason})`);
    }
    const text = await response.text().catch(() => "");
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new OdataError(codeForStatus(response.status), response.status, errorDetail(text));
    }
    return { status: response.status, detail: errorDetail(text), raw: text };
  }

  /** One GET of a text answer, such as Priority's description of its data ($metadata). */
  async getText(path: string): Promise<string> {
    return (await this.fetchBody(path, {}, "application/xml")).body;
  }

  /** One GET. Throws OdataError: UNAVAILABLE when Priority cannot be reached or is failing. */
  async get<T = unknown>(path: string, query: Record<string, string> = {}): Promise<T> {
    const response = await this.fetchBody(path, query, "application/json");
    const body = response.body;
    try {
      return JSON.parse(body) as T;
    } catch {
      // A page of HTML instead of data usually means a wrong address or a login page.
      throw new OdataError(
        "BAD_REQUEST",
        response.status,
        "the answer is not data (check the address)",
      );
    }
  }
}

export interface FormProbe {
  form: string;
  ok: boolean;
  status: number | null;
  /** The field names of the first row, in Priority's order. */
  fields: string[];
  /** The first row, each value cut short, to show what the data looks like. */
  sample: Record<string, string>;
  /** With an item number: the fields whose value differs between its first rows, with the values. */
  varying?: Record<string, string[]>;
  /** Priority's own words, or ours, when it did not work. */
  error: string | null;
  code: PriorityErrorCode | null;
  /** True when it was not asked at all, to protect the account after an earlier refusal. */
  skipped: boolean;
  ms: number;
}

const SAMPLE_VALUE = 60;

function show(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
  const text = typeof value === "object" ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value);
  return text.length > SAMPLE_VALUE ? `${text.slice(0, SAMPLE_VALUE - 1)}…` : text;
}

/**
 * Asks Priority for one row of a form to learn which fields it really has, so the mapping is
 * checked against Priority and never guessed. Nothing is changed.
 */
export async function probeForm(
  http: OdataHttp,
  form: string,
  itemNumber?: string,
): Promise<FormProbe> {
  const started = performance.now();
  const done = (rest: Omit<FormProbe, "form" | "ms">): FormProbe => ({
    form,
    ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
    ...rest,
  });
  const [parent, subform] = form.split("/");
  if (!isFormName(parent) || (subform !== undefined && !isFormName(subform))) {
    return done({
      ok: false,
      status: null,
      fields: [],
      sample: {},
      error: "not a form name",
      code: null,
      skipped: false,
    });
  }
  try {
    // With an item number the row shown is that item's, so a real item can be looked at.
    const query: Record<string, string> = { $top: itemNumber ? "8" : "1" };
    if (itemNumber) query.$filter = `PARTNAME eq '${itemNumber}'`;
    // "FORM/SUBFORM" shows the first line of the sub-form of the first few records that have one.
    if (subform) {
      query.$top = "20";
      query.$expand = subform;
    }
    const data = await http.get<{ value?: Record<string, unknown>[] }>(parent, query);
    if (subform && Array.isArray(data.value)) {
      data.value = data.value.flatMap((record) => {
        const lines = record[subform];
        return Array.isArray(lines) && lines.length > 0
          ? [lines[0] as Record<string, unknown>]
          : [];
      });
    }
    const row = Array.isArray(data.value) ? data.value[0] : undefined;
    const fields = row ? Object.keys(row).filter((key) => !key.startsWith("@")) : [];
    const rows = Array.isArray(data.value) ? data.value : [];
    const varying: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    if (itemNumber && rows.length > 1) {
      for (const key of fields) {
        const values = rows.map((each) => show(each[key]));
        if (new Set(values).size > 1) varying[key] = values;
      }
    }
    return done({
      ok: true,
      status: 200,
      fields,
      sample: Object.fromEntries(fields.map((key) => [key, show(row?.[key])])),
      ...(itemNumber ? { varying } : {}),
      error: row ? null : "the form answered but has no rows",
      code: null,
      skipped: false,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof OdataError) {
      return done({
        ok: false,
        status: error.status,
        fields: [],
        sample: {},
        error: error.detail || error.code,
        code: error.code,
        skipped: false,
      });
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

/** What the check shows for a form it left alone because Priority had just refused it. */
export function skippedProbe(form: string): FormProbe {
  return {
    form,
    ok: false,
    status: null,
    fields: [],
    sample: {},
    error: null,
    code: null,
    skipped: true,
    ms: 0,
  };
}

/** The sub-forms looked at when Priority's own list of them cannot be read. */
const LIKELY_ITEM_SUBFORMS = [
  "PARTTEXT_SUBFORM",
  "PARTTEXTLANG_SUBFORM",
  "PARTSPEC_SUBFORM",
  "PARTPACK_SUBFORM",
  "PARTARC_SUBFORM",
];
const MAX_SUBFORMS = 60;

/** The names of a form's sub-forms, from Priority's description of its data ($metadata). */
export function subformsIn(metadata: string, form: string): string[] {
  const start = metadata.search(new RegExp(String.raw`<EntityType\s+Name="${form}"`));
  if (start < 0) return [];
  const end = metadata.indexOf("</EntityType>", start);
  const block = metadata.slice(start, end < 0 ? undefined : end);
  return [...block.matchAll(/<NavigationProperty\s+Name="([A-Za-z0-9_]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
}

/** The texts in rows: every field that holds words, one entry per row and field. */
function textsOf(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]): Record<string, string> {
  const found: Record<string, string> = {};
  rows.slice(0, 5).forEach((row, index) => {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
      if (key.startsWith("@") || typeof value !== "string") continue;
      const text = value.trim();
      if (!/[A-Za-z\u0590-\u05FF]{2}/.test(text)) continue;
      const shown = text.length > 200 ? `${text.slice(0, 199)}…` : text;
      found[rows.length > 1 ? `${key} (${index + 1})` : key] = shown;
    }
  });
  return found;
}

/**
 * Looks through every sub-form of one item (LOGPART) for the words it holds, to find where a text
 * such as the storage text is kept. Reads only. Stops at the first refusal of the key.
 */
export async function findItemTexts(http: OdataHttp, itemNumber: string): Promise<FormProbe[]> {
  const probes: FormProbe[] = [];
  let subforms = LIKELY_ITEM_SUBFORMS;
  const listed = performance.now();
  try {
    const metadata = await http.getText("$metadata");
    const named = subformsIn(metadata, "LOGPART");
    if (named.length > 0) subforms = named.slice(0, MAX_SUBFORMS);
    probes.push({
      form: "LOGPART sub-forms",
      ok: true,
      status: 200,
      fields: ["SUBFORMS"],
      sample: { SUBFORMS: subforms.join(", ") },
      error: named.length > 0 ? null : "not listed by Priority; the usual ones are tried",
      code: null,
      skipped: false,
      ms: Math.round(performance.now() - listed),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof OdataError)) throw error;
    if (error.code === "AUTH_FAILED" || error.code === "RATE_LIMITED") throw error;
  }

  const key = `LOGPART('${itemNumber}')`;
  for (const name of [key, ...subforms.map((sub) => `${key}/${sub}`)]) {
    const started = performance.now();
    try {
      const data = await http.get<{ value?: Record<string, unknown>[] } & Record<string, unknown>>(
        name,
        name === key ? {} : { $top: "5" },
      );
      const rows = Array.isArray(data.value) ? data.value : [data];
      const sample = textsOf(rows);
      const fields = Object.keys(sample);
      probes.push({
        form: name,
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        fields,
        sample,
        error: fields.length > 0 ? null : "no text here",
        code: null,
        skipped: false,
        ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof OdataError)) throw error;
      if (error.code === "AUTH_FAILED" || error.code === "RATE_LIMITED") throw error;
      probes.push({
        form: name,
        ok: false,
        status: error.status,
        fields: [],
        sample: {},
        error: error.detail || error.code,
        code: error.code,
        skipped: false,
        ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
      });
    }
  }
  return probes;
}
````

### FILE: `src/server/priority/settings.ts`

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";
import { clearCooldown } from "./cooldown";
import { decryptSecret, encryptSecret } from "../settings/secret";

/**
 * How to reach Priority. The stand-in answers until the live connection is switched on; these
 * details are kept for it. Priority's access key (sent as the user name) and the password, if
 * there is one, are stored encrypted and are never sent back to the browser.
 */

export interface PriorityConnection {
  /** Address of Priority's API, for example https://erp.example.com/odata/Priority/tabula.ini/company */
  baseUrl: string;
  /** The access key (Priority's user name), encrypted; null when none was entered. */
  apiUserEnc: string | null;
  /** The password, encrypted; null when none was entered (access keys sign in without one). */
  passwordEnc: string | null;
  /** Older installations stored the user name as plain text; read only, replaced on the next save. */
  apiUser?: string;
}

const KEY = "priority.connection";

const EMPTY: PriorityConnection = { baseUrl: "", apiUserEnc: null, passwordEnc: null };

export async function getPriorityConnection(
  db: Db,
): Promise<PriorityConnection & { updatedAt: Date | null }> {
  const stored = await readSetting<Partial<PriorityConnection>>(db, KEY);
  return { ...EMPTY, ...stored?.value, updatedAt: stored?.updatedAt ?? null };
}

export class PriorityConnectionError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: "INVALID_URL") {
    super(code);
    this.name = "PriorityConnectionError";
  }
}

export interface PriorityConnectionInput {
  baseUrl: string;
  /** undefined keeps the stored access key, "" removes it, anything else replaces it. */
  apiUser?: string;
  /** undefined keeps the stored password, "" removes it, anything else replaces it. */
  password?: string;
}

function replaceSecret(
  current: string | null,
  input: string | undefined,
  secret: string,
): string | null {
  if (input === undefined) return current;
  return input === "" ? null : encryptSecret(input, secret);
}

export async function savePriorityConnection(
  db: Db,
  input: PriorityConnectionInput,
  actor: Actor,
  secret: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const baseUrl = input.baseUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
  if (baseUrl) {
    let parsed: URL;
    try {
      parsed = new URL(baseUrl);
    } catch {
      throw new PriorityConnectionError("INVALID_URL");
    }
    if (parsed.protocol !== "https:" && parsed.protocol !== "http:") {
      throw new PriorityConnectionError("INVALID_URL");
    }
  }

  const current = await getPriorityConnection(db);
  const apiUser = input.apiUser?.trim();
  const apiUserEnc = replaceSecret(current.apiUserEnc, apiUser, secret);
  const passwordEnc = replaceSecret(current.passwordEnc, input.password, secret);

  const next: PriorityConnection = { baseUrl, apiUserEnc, passwordEnc };
  // An old plain user name stays usable until an access key replaces it or it is removed.
  if (current.apiUser && apiUser === undefined) next.apiUser = current.apiUser;
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, next, actor.id);
  // A different address or key deserves a fresh try: the rest after a refusal no longer applies.
  if (input.apiUser !== undefined || baseUrl !== current.baseUrl) await clearCooldown(db);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.priorityChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: KEY,
      // Never the key or the password themselves, only what changed.
      details: {
        baseUrl,
        keyChanged: input.apiUser !== undefined,
        passwordChanged: input.password !== undefined,
      },
    },
    db,
  );
}

/** What is needed to call Priority, in the clear; null when the address or the key is missing or unreadable. */
export interface PriorityCredentials {
  baseUrl: string;
  user: string;
  /** Null when none was stored: the live client then uses Priority's fixed word for access keys. */
  password: string | null;
}

export function readPriorityCredentials(
  connection: PriorityConnection,
  secret: string,
): PriorityCredentials | null {
  const user = connection.apiUserEnc
    ? decryptSecret(connection.apiUserEnc, secret)
    : (connection.apiUser ?? "") || null;
  if (!connection.baseUrl || !user) return null;
  const password = connection.passwordEnc ? decryptSecret(connection.passwordEnc, secret) : null;
  if (connection.passwordEnc && password === null) return null;
  return { baseUrl: connection.baseUrl, user, password };
}

/** For callers that only need the password. */
export function readPriorityPassword(
  connection: PriorityConnection,
  secret: string,
): string | null {
  return connection.passwordEnc ? decryptSecret(connection.passwordEnc, secret) : null;
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { daysBetween, expiryStatus, summarize } from "./summary";
import type { PriorityStockBox, PriorityWarehouse } from "./types";

const warehouses: PriorityWarehouse[] = [
  { code: "Main", name: "מקרר ראשי" },
  { code: "200", name: "מקפיא ראשי" },
  { code: "Empty", name: "מחסן ריק" },
];

function box(over: Partial<PriorityStockBox>): PriorityStockBox {
  return {
    barcode: "000000000000000000000000",
    itemNumber: "N2015D-S",
    itemName: "המבורגר בקר",
    itemNameEn: "Beef burger",
    warehouseCode: "Main",
    weightKg: 10,
    expiryDate: "2026-12-01",
    enteredDate: "2026-10-20",
    ...over,
  };
}

describe("expiry status", () => {
  const today = "2026-10-22";

  it("counts whole days between dates, across month ends", () => {
    expect(daysBetween("2026-10-22", "2026-10-29")).toBe(7);
    expect(daysBetween("2026-10-30", "2026-11-02")).toBe(3);
    expect(daysBetween("2026-10-22", "2026-10-21")).toBe(-1);
  });

  it("is expired before today, soon from today through the alert window, valid after", () => {
    expect(expiryStatus("2026-10-21", today, 7)).toBe("expired");
    expect(expiryStatus("2026-10-22", today, 7)).toBe("soon");
    expect(expiryStatus("2026-10-29", today, 7)).toBe("soon");
    expect(expiryStatus("2026-10-30", today, 7)).toBe("valid");
  });
});

describe("warehouse summaries", () => {
  const today = "2026-10-22";
  const boxes = [
    box({ weightKg: 10.25 }),
    box({ weightKg: 9.5, expiryDate: "2026-10-25" }),
    box({ weightKg: 8, expiryDate: "2026-10-01" }),
    box({ weightKg: 8, expiryDate: "2026-10-02" }),
    box({
      itemNumber: "N3001F-C",
      itemName: "בקר טחון טרי",
      weightKg: 14,
      expiryDate: "2026-10-23",
    }),
    box({ warehouseCode: "200", itemNumber: "N2020F-S", itemName: "שיפודי בקר מתובלים", weightKg: 12.1 }),
  ];
  const result = summarize(warehouses, boxes, today, 7);

  it("keeps the warehouse order and includes empty warehouses", () => {
    expect(result.map((w) => w.code)).toEqual(["Main", "200", "Empty"]);
    expect(result[2]).toMatchObject({ boxes: 0, kg: 0, items: 0, attention: [] });
  });

  it("totals kilograms exactly, without floating point drift", () => {
    expect(result[0].kg).toBe(49.75);
    expect(result[1].kg).toBe(12.1);
  });

  it("splits boxes into valid, soon and expired", () => {
    expect(result[0]).toMatchObject({ boxes: 5, items: 2, valid: 1, soon: 2, expired: 2 });
    expect(result[1]).toMatchObject({ boxes: 1, valid: 1, soon: 0, expired: 0, attention: [] });
  });

  it("groups attention by item, most urgent first", () => {
    expect(
      result[0].attention.map(({ itemNumber, itemName, expired, soon }) => ({
        itemNumber,
        itemName,
        expired,
        soon,
      })),
    ).toEqual([
      { itemNumber: "N2015D-S", itemName: "המבורגר בקר", expired: 2, soon: 1 },
      { itemNumber: "N3001F-C", itemName: "בקר טחון טרי", expired: 0, soon: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it("lists the boxes behind each line, the ones expiring first on top", () => {
    const burgers = result[0].attention[0];
    expect(burgers.boxes.map((b) => [b.expiryDate, b.status])).toEqual([
      ["2026-10-01", "expired"],
      ["2026-10-02", "expired"],
      ["2026-10-25", "soon"],
    ]);
    expect(burgers.boxes[0]).toMatchObject({ weightKg: 8, enteredDate: "2026-10-20" });
  });

  it("takes the alert days per box when given a function", () => {
    // Beef burgers warn 2 days ahead only, the ground beef 30 days ahead.
    const custom = summarize(warehouses, boxes, today, (b) =>
      b.itemNumber === "N2015D-S" ? 2 : 30,
    );
    expect(custom[0]).toMatchObject({ soon: 1, expired: 2, valid: 2 });
  });
});
````

````ts
import type { PriorityStockBox, PriorityWarehouse } from "./types";

/**
 * Days before expiry that count as "about to expire" for a category with no choice of its own.
 * The choice per category is made in settings (see src/server/alerts).
 */
export const DEFAULT_ALERT_DAYS = 7;

/** One box that needs attention, for the details that open under its item's line. */
export interface AttentionBox {
  barcode: string;
  weightKg: number;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  expiryDate: string;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  enteredDate: string;
  status: "soon" | "expired";
}

export interface AttentionLine {
  itemNumber: string;
  /** Hebrew item name from Priority, shown as is. */
  itemName: string;
  expired: number;
  soon: number;
  /** The boxes behind the counts, the ones expiring first on top. */
  boxes: AttentionBox[];
}

export interface WarehouseSummary {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  kg: number;
  boxes: number;
  items: number;
  valid: number;
  soon: number;
  expired: number;
  /** Items with expired or about-to-expire boxes, most urgent first. */
  attention: AttentionLine[];
}

export type ExpiryStatus = "valid" | "soon" | "expired";

/** Whole days from one YYYY-MM-DD date to another (negative when `to` is earlier). */
export function daysBetween(from: string, to: string): number {
  const a = Date.parse(`${from}T00:00:00Z`);
  const b = Date.parse(`${to}T00:00:00Z`);
  return Math.round((b - a) / 86_400_000);
}

export function expiryStatus(expiryDate: string, today: string, alertDays: number): ExpiryStatus {
  const days = daysBetween(today, expiryDate);
  if (days < 0) return "expired";
  if (days <= alertDays) return "soon";
  return "valid";
}

/** One summary per warehouse, in the order given; a warehouse with no boxes still appears. */
export function summarize(
  warehouses: PriorityWarehouse[],
  boxes: PriorityStockBox[],
  today: string,
  /** One number for every box, or a function that gives the days for each box (per category). */
  alertDays: number | ((box: PriorityStockBox) => number) = DEFAULT_ALERT_DAYS,
): WarehouseSummary[] {
  const daysFor = typeof alertDays === "function" ? alertDays : () => alertDays;
  return warehouses.map((warehouse) => {
    const here = boxes.filter((b) => b.warehouseCode === warehouse.code);
    let valid = 0;
    let soon = 0;
    let expired = 0;
    let grams = 0;
    const byItem = new Map<string, AttentionLine>();

    for (const box of here) {
      grams += Math.round(box.weightKg * 1000);
      const status = expiryStatus(box.expiryDate, today, daysFor(box));
      if (status === "valid") {
        valid++;
        continue;
      }
      if (status === "soon") soon++;
      else expired++;
      const line = byItem.get(box.itemNumber) ?? {
        itemNumber: box.itemNumber,
        itemName: box.itemName,
        expired: 0,
        soon: 0,
        boxes: [],
      };
      line[status]++;
      line.boxes.push({
        barcode: box.barcode,
        weightKg: box.weightKg,
        expiryDate: box.expiryDate,
        enteredDate: box.enteredDate,
        status,
      });
      byItem.set(box.itemNumber, line);
    }

    for (const line of byItem.values()) {
      line.boxes.sort(
        (a, b) => a.expiryDate.localeCompare(b.expiryDate) || a.barcode.localeCompare(b.barcode),
      );
    }
    const attention = [...byItem.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        b.expired - a.expired || b.soon - a.soon || a.itemName.localeCompare(b.itemName, "he"),
    );

    return {
      code: warehouse.code,
      name: warehouse.name,
      kg: grams / 1000,
      boxes: here.length,
      items: new Set(here.map((b) => b.itemNumber)).size,
      valid,
      soon,
      expired,
      attention,
    };
  });
}
````

````ts
/**
 * What the weighing system reads from Priority. Everything above this
 * interface is ignorant of whether the data comes from the stand-in
 * (phase 1) or from Priority's own API (phase 6). Phase 4 adds the writes
 * (receiving a box, moving a box); this is the read side the dashboard needs.
 */

export interface PriorityWarehouse {
  /** Priority's warehouse code, for example "Main" or "200". */
  code: string;
  /** Name as defined in Priority, shown exactly as is. */
  name: string;
}

/**
 * One item of the catalog, read only: the LOGPART fields the weighing system uses.
 * Text is shown exactly as Priority has it, whatever language the screen is in.
 */
export interface PriorityItem {
  /** מק״ט, for example "N2015D-S". */
  itemNumber: string;
  name: string;
  nameEn: string;
  /** The item's fixed barcode. */
  barcode: string;
  category: string;
  /** Average carton weight; null when Priority has none. */
  weightKg: number | null;
  shelfLifeDays: number;
  /** Storage text for labels (differs for fresh and frozen). */
  storageText: string;
  packingCode: string;
  origin: string;
  inventoryManaged: boolean;
}

/** One box in stock: a single line of inventory, down to the box barcode. */
export interface PriorityStockBox {
  barcode: string;
  itemNumber: string;
  itemName: string;
  itemNameEn: string;
  warehouseCode: string;
  weightKg: number;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  expiryDate: string;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  enteredDate: string;
}

/** A production order (הזמנת יצור) or the fixed vendor receiving order, read only. */
export interface PriorityOrder {
  docno: string;
  kind: "production" | "vendor";
  /** The item a production order makes; null for the vendor order. */
  itemNumber: string | null;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  date: string;
  status: string;
  /** The storage room of the order's own document in Priority, when it has one. */
  warehouseCode?: string;
}

/** A box received into stock: one line on a receiving document, like TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM in Priority. */
export interface ReceiveBoxInput {
  /** Whether it was weighed in the factory or bought from a vendor. */
  source: "production" | "vendor";
  /** The order or document the box belongs to. */
  docno: string;
  barcode: string;
  itemNumber: string;
  weightKg: number;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  expiryDate: string;
  warehouseCode: string;
}

export type PriorityErrorCode =
  /** Priority does not answer (down, network, timeout). Safe to retry later. */
  | "UNAVAILABLE"
  /** Priority answered but does not accept the access key or password. */
  | "AUTH_FAILED"
  /** Priority turns requests away (an account locked after failed sign-ins, or too many requests). Not retried by itself. */
  | "RATE_LIMITED"
  /** Priority has no such form (or the address is wrong). */
  | "NOT_FOUND"
  /** Priority refused the request itself (a field or a value it does not know). */
  | "BAD_REQUEST"
  /** This system may not write to Priority yet (write permission is not open). The box waits. */
  | "WRITE_NOT_OPEN"
  | "DUPLICATE_BOX"
  | "UNKNOWN_BOX"
  | "UNKNOWN_ITEM"
  | "UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE"
  | "UNKNOWN_ORDER";

export class PriorityError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: PriorityErrorCode) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "PriorityError";
  }
}

export interface PriorityClient {
  /** The item catalog, ordered by item number. */
  getItems(): Promise<PriorityItem[]>;
  getWarehouses(): Promise<PriorityWarehouse[]>;
  getStockBoxes(): Promise<PriorityStockBox[]>;
  /** Production orders and the vendor order, newest first. */
  getOrders(): Promise<PriorityOrder[]>;
  /** Adds one box to stock. Throws PriorityError. */
  receiveBox(input: ReceiveBoxInput): Promise<void>;
}
````

````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { OdataHttp } from "./odata";
import { postReceiptLine } from "./write";

const credentials = {
  baseUrl: "https://priority.test/odata/Priority/x.ini/democo",
  user: "key",
  password: null,
};
const box = {
  source: "production" as const,
  docno: "AS26000059",
  barcode: "000130150101260101271150",
  itemNumber: "N2015D-S",
  weightKg: 11.5,
  expiryDate: "2026-11-15",
  warehouseCode: "Main",
};

/** A Priority that answers each request in turn: [status, body]. */
function priority(answers: [number, unknown][]) {
  const asked: { method: string; url: string; body?: string }[] = [];
  const fetchImpl = (async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
    asked.push({ method: init?.method ?? "GET", url, body: init?.body as string | undefined });
    const [status, body] = answers.shift() ?? [500, {}];
    return new Response(typeof body === "string" ? body : JSON.stringify(body), { status });
  }) as unknown as typeof fetch;
  return { asked, http: new OdataHttp(credentials, fetchImpl) };
}

const complaint = { FORM: { InterfaceErrors: { text: "composed quantity but no issues" } } };

describe("sending a box line to Priority", () => {
  it("adds the line with the composed quantity at zero and the box as the pallet", async () => {
    const { asked, http } = priority([
      [200, { value: [] }],
      [201, {}],
    ]);
    await postReceiptLine(http, box);
    const post = asked.find((a) => a.method === "POST")!;
    expect(post.url).toContain("DOCUMENTS_H(DOCNO='AS26000059',TYPE='H')/TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM");
    expect(JSON.parse(post.body!)).toMatchObject({
      PARTNAME: "N2015D-S",
      TQUANT: 11.5,
      PQUANT: 0,
      PTQUANT: 0,
      TOPALLETNAME: box.barcode,
    });
  });

  it("counts the box as received when Priority complains but kept the line", async () => {
    const { http } = priority([
      [200, { value: [] }],
      [400, complaint],
      [200, { value: [{ KLINE: 1001 }] }],
    ]);
    await expect(postReceiptLine(http, box)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("refuses the box when Priority complained and has no such line", async () => {
    const { http } = priority([
      [200, { value: [] }],
      [400, complaint],
      [200, { value: [] }],
    ]);
    await expect(postReceiptLine(http, box)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "BAD_REQUEST" });
  });

  it("never adds a box that is already in the document", async () => {
    const { asked, http } = priority([[200, { value: [{ KLINE: 1 }] }]]);
    await postReceiptLine(http, box);
    expect(asked.some((a) => a.method === "POST")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("keeps the box waiting when Priority says writing is not allowed", async () => {
    const { http } = priority([
      [200, { value: [] }],
      [403, "no permission"],
    ]);
    await expect(postReceiptLine(http, box)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "WRITE_NOT_OPEN" });
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/server/priority/write.ts`

````ts
import { OdataError, type OdataHttp } from "./odata";
import { PriorityError, type ReceiveBoxInput } from "./types";

const DOCNO = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/;
const BARCODE = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,60}$/;

/** The line of one box, the way the current program writes it. */
function lineOf(input: ReceiveBoxInput) {
  return {
    PARTNAME: input.itemNumber,
    // The weight is the quantity put into the box. The composed quantity stays zero, otherwise
    // Priority asks for component issues. The taken-in quantity is left out: Priority fills it
    // itself, and naming it makes Priority look for a lot that already exists.
    TQUANT: input.weightKg,
    PQUANT: 0,
    PTQUANT: 0,
    // Only the box (pallet) name: Priority creates the lot itself. Naming the lot too makes it
    // look for one that already exists.
    TOPALLETNAME: input.barcode,
    TOPP_EXPIRYDATE: `${input.expiryDate}T00:00:00Z`,
  };
}

const linesOf = (docno: string) => `DOCUMENTS_H(DOCNO='${docno}',TYPE='H')/TRANSORDER_H_SUBFORM`;

/** True when the document already holds a line for this box. */
async function lineExists(http: OdataHttp, docno: string, barcode: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const found = await http.get<{ value?: unknown[] }>(linesOf(docno), {
    $select: "KLINE",
    $filter: `TOPALLETNAME eq '${barcode}'`,
  });
  return (found.value?.length ?? 0) > 0;
}

/**
 * Adds one box as a line to a receipt document in Priority, the way the current program does:
 * the box barcode (as the pallet), the item, the weight and the expiry date, under the document's
 * number. Priority creates the lot itself, and answers with a complaint about the "composed
 * quantity" even though it saved the line, so the answer alone is not trusted: the document is
 * asked whether the line is there. A box already in the document is never added twice.
 * Throws PriorityError; the words Priority gave are in OdataError.detail.
 */
export async function postReceiptLine(http: OdataHttp, input: ReceiveBoxInput): Promise<void> {
  if (!DOCNO.test(input.docno)) throw new PriorityError("UNKNOWN_ORDER");
  if (!BARCODE.test(input.barcode)) throw new PriorityError("BAD_REQUEST");
  if (await lineExists(http, input.docno, input.barcode)) return;
  try {
    await http.post(linesOf(input.docno), lineOf(input));
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof OdataError)) throw error;
    // No permission to write: the box waits instead of failing.
    if (error.status === 403) throw new PriorityError("WRITE_NOT_OPEN");
    // Priority complained but kept the line: that is a box received.
    if (error.status !== null && (await lineExists(http, input.docno, input.barcode))) return;
    const words = error.detail;
    if (/מק.?ט|PARTNAME/.test(words)) throw new PriorityError("UNKNOWN_ITEM");
    if (/כבר קיים|already exists|duplicate/i.test(words)) throw new PriorityError("DUPLICATE_BOX");
    throw error;
  }
}
````
