````ts
import { and, asc, desc, eq, gte, inArray, lte, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { todayListStart } from "../../lib/receiving/today";
import {
  MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG,
  buildBoxBarcode,
  itemNumberDigits,
  parseVendorBarcode,
  toISODate,
} from "../../lib/barcodes";
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { boxCounters, boxes, prioritySends } from "../db/schema";
import {
  PriorityError,
  type PriorityClient,
  type PriorityItem,
  type PriorityOrder,
} from "../priority/types";
import { getTare, netWeight } from "../packaging";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * Receiving (phase 4): a box is saved here first, with its barcode and running number,
 * then sent to Priority from a queue. If Priority is slow or down the box is still
 * saved (and its label can print); the send retries on its own.
 */

export type ReceivingErrorCode =
  | "INVALID_WEIGHT"
  | "INVALID_DATES"
  | "UNKNOWN_ITEM"
  | "UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE"
  | "UNKNOWN_ORDER"
  | "INVALID_ORDER"
  | "NO_ORDER"
  | "RUNNING_EXHAUSTED"
  | "NOT_VENDOR"
  | "BAD_VENDOR_BARCODE"
  | "ITEM_NOT_FOUND"
  | "AMBIGUOUS_ITEM"
  | "ALREADY_RECEIVED"
  | "PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE";

export class ReceivingError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly code: ReceivingErrorCode,
    /** For ALREADY_RECEIVED: when and by whom the barcode was received. */
    public readonly existing?: { receivedAt: Date; receivedBy: string },
  ) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "ReceivingError";
  }
}

export const DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE = "Main";
/** After this many failed tries (about a day of retrying) a send is marked failed for an admin. */
export const MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS = 20;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Settings the screens depend on
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const CATEGORY_WAREHOUSES_KEY = "receiving.categoryWarehouses";
const VENDOR_ORDER_KEY = "receiving.vendorOrder";

/** Priority's category text to the warehouse code its boxes go into. */
export async function getCategoryWarehouses(db: Db): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  return (await readSetting<Record<string, string>>(db, CATEGORY_WAREHOUSES_KEY))?.value ?? {};
}

/** The one order all vendor boxes go under; null until the owner picks it. */
export async function getVendorOrder(db: Db): Promise<string | null> {
  return (await readSetting<string>(db, VENDOR_ORDER_KEY))?.value || null;
}

/** Chooses (or with null clears) the warehouse a category's boxes go into. Checked against Priority. */
export async function setCategoryWarehouse(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  category: string,
  warehouseCode: string | null,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  if (warehouseCode !== null) {
    const warehouses = await priority.getWarehouses();
    if (!warehouses.some((w) => w.code === warehouseCode))
      throw new ReceivingError("UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE");
  }
  const current = await getCategoryWarehouses(db);
  const next = { ...current };
  if (warehouseCode === null) delete next[category];
  else next[category] = warehouseCode;
  await writeSetting(db, CATEGORY_WAREHOUSES_KEY, next, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.categoryWarehouseChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: CATEGORY_WAREHOUSES_KEY,
      details: { category, from: current[category] ?? null, to: warehouseCode },
    },
    db,
  );
}

/** What an order number may be made of: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. */
const ORDER_NUMBER = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$/;

/**
 * Chooses (or with null clears) the order vendor boxes go under. It can be any order number: the
 * owner may want a different order later, one Priority does not offer in a list yet. The answer says
 * whether Priority lists the number right now (null: not asked, or Priority did not answer); a
 * number it does not list is still saved, and the boxes wait in the send queue until it exists.
 */
export async function setVendorOrder(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  docno: string | null,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<{ listed: boolean | null }> {
  const number = docno === null ? null : docno.trim();
  let listed: boolean | null = null;
  if (number !== null) {
    if (!ORDER_NUMBER.test(number)) throw new ReceivingError("INVALID_ORDER");
    try {
      listed = (await priority.getOrders()).some((o) => o.docno === number);
    } catch {
      listed = null;
    }
  }
  const current = await getVendorOrder(db);
  await writeSetting(db, VENDOR_ORDER_KEY, number ?? "", actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.vendorOrderChanged",
    { entityType: "settings", entityId: VENDOR_ORDER_KEY, details: { from: current, to: number } },
    db,
  );
  return { listed };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The catalog, with a saved copy for when Priority does not answer
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const SNAPSHOT_KEY = "receiving.catalogSnapshot";
/** The saved copy is refreshed at most this often. */
const SNAPSHOT_EVERY_MS = 10 * 60_000;

interface CatalogSnapshot {
  items: PriorityItem[];
  orders: PriorityOrder[];
  savedAt: string;
}

export interface Catalog {
  items: PriorityItem[];
  orders: PriorityOrder[];
  /** True when Priority did not answer and the last saved copy is used. */
  saved: boolean;
}

/**
 * Items and orders from Priority. Every good read refreshes a saved copy; when Priority
 * is unreachable that copy is used instead, so boxes can still be weighed, saved and
 * labelled (the send to Priority retries later). Without a saved copy there is nothing to
 * go on and PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE is thrown.
 */
export async function readCatalog(db: Db, priority: PriorityClient): Promise<Catalog> {
  try {
    const [items, orders] = await Promise.all([priority.getItems(), priority.getOrders()]);
    const snapshot = await readSetting<CatalogSnapshot>(db, SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    const age = snapshot ? Date.now() - new Date(snapshot.value.savedAt).getTime() : Infinity;
    if (age > SNAPSHOT_EVERY_MS) {
      const copy: CatalogSnapshot = { items, orders, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      await writeSetting(db, SNAPSHOT_KEY, copy, null);
    }
    return { items, orders, saved: false };
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof PriorityError && error.code === "UNAVAILABLE")) throw error;
    const snapshot = await readSetting<CatalogSnapshot>(db, SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    if (!snapshot) throw new ReceivingError("PRIORITY_UNAVAILABLE");
    return { items: snapshot.value.items, orders: snapshot.value.orders, saved: true };
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Receiving a box
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface ReceivedBox {
  /** The item as Priority (or the saved copy) described it, for the label. */
  item: PriorityItem;
  id: string;
  barcode: string;
  itemNumber: string;
  itemName: string;
  running: string;
  weightKg: number;
  slaughterDate: string;
  productionDate: string | null;
  expiryDate: string;
  certificateNo: string | null;
  docno: string;
  warehouseCode: string;
  /** Whether Priority has the box yet; "pending" means the send is queued and will retry; "failed" needs an admin. */
  sent: "sent" | "pending" | "failed";
}

function checkWeight(weightKg: number): void {
  const units = Math.round(weightKg * 100);
  if (!Number.isFinite(weightKg) || units < 1 || units > Math.round(MAX_BOX_WEIGHT_KG * 100))
    throw new ReceivingError("INVALID_WEIGHT");
}

function isUniqueViolation(error: unknown): boolean {
  // Drizzle wraps the driver error; the Postgres code is on the error or its cause.
  const e = error as { code?: string; cause?: { code?: string } };
  return e?.code === "23505" || e?.cause?.code === "23505";
}

async function alreadyReceived(db: Db, barcode: string): Promise<ReceivingError | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ at: boxes.receivedAt, by: boxes.receivedByDisplay })
    .from(boxes)
    .where(eq(boxes.barcode, barcode))
    .limit(1);
  return row
    ? new ReceivingError("ALREADY_RECEIVED", { receivedAt: row.at, receivedBy: row.by })
    : null;
}

async function warehouseFor(db: Db, item: PriorityItem): Promise<string> {
  return (await getCategoryWarehouses(db))[item.category] || DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE;
}

export interface InHouseBoxInput {
  itemNumber: string;
  certificateNo: string;
  slaughterDate: Date;
  productionDate: Date;
  expiryDate: Date;
  /** What the scale showed: the box with its packing. The weight kept is this less the packing. */
  weightKg: number;
}

/**
 * A box packed in-house: gets the next running number for its item, its 24 or 25 digit
 * barcode, and goes under the item's latest open production order.
 */
export async function receiveInHouseBox(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  input: InHouseBoxInput,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<ReceivedBox> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.weightKg) || input.weightKg <= 0)
    throw new ReceivingError("INVALID_WEIGHT");
  if (input.expiryDate < input.slaughterDate || input.productionDate < input.slaughterDate)
    throw new ReceivingError("INVALID_DATES");

  const { items, orders } = await readCatalog(db, priority);
  const item = items.find((i) => i.itemNumber === input.itemNumber);
  if (!item) throw new ReceivingError("UNKNOWN_ITEM");
  // The scale shows the box with its bag and carton: what is kept is the goods alone.
  const tare = await getTare(db, item.itemNumber);
  const weightKg = netWeight(input.weightKg, tare.totalKg);
  if (weightKg === null) throw new ReceivingError("INVALID_WEIGHT");
  checkWeight(weightKg);
  // The certificate number on the item label is the number of the open order the box goes under;
  // without a match, the item's latest open order (the practice data names an item per order).
  const order =
    orders.find(
      (o) =>
        o.kind === "production" && o.status === "open" && o.docno === input.certificateNo.trim(),
    ) ??
    orders.find(
      (o) => o.kind === "production" && o.itemNumber === item.itemNumber && o.status === "open",
    );
  if (!order) throw new ReceivingError("NO_ORDER");
  // The order's own storage room when Priority names one, else the item category's.
  const warehouseCode = order.warehouseCode || (await warehouseFor(db, item));
  const itemDigits = itemNumberDigits(item.itemNumber);

  const box = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [counter] = await tx
      .insert(boxCounters)
      .values({ itemDigits, last: 1 })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: boxCounters.itemDigits,
        set: { last: sql`${boxCounters.last} + 1` },
      })
      .returning({ last: boxCounters.last });
    if (counter.last > 9999) throw new ReceivingError("RUNNING_EXHAUSTED");

    const barcode = buildBoxBarcode({
      running: counter.last,
      itemDigits,
      slaughterDate: input.slaughterDate,
      expiryDate: input.expiryDate,
      weightKg,
    });
    const [row] = await tx
      .insert(boxes)
      .values({
        barcode,
        source: "production",
        itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
        running: String(counter.last).padStart(4, "0"),
        slaughterDate: toISODate(input.slaughterDate),
        productionDate: toISODate(input.productionDate),
        expiryDate: toISODate(input.expiryDate),
        certificateNo: input.certificateNo,
        weightKg,
        docno: order.docno,
        warehouseCode,
        receivedBy: actor.id,
        receivedByDisplay: actor.display,
      })
      .returning();
    await tx.insert(prioritySends).values({ boxId: row.id, nextAttemptAt: firstTryAfter() });
    return row;
  });

  await logFor(
    actor,
    "receiving.boxReceived",
    {
      entityType: "box",
      entityId: box.barcode,
      details: {
        source: "production",
        item: item.itemNumber,
        weightKg: box.weightKg,
        ...(tare.totalKg > 0 ? { scaleKg: input.weightKg, packagingKg: tare.totalKg } : {}),
        docno: box.docno,
      },
    },
    db,
  );
  const sent = await sendBox(db, priority, box.id);
  return toReceived(box, item, sent);
}

/**
 * A box bought from the vendor, stocked as is. The vendor's barcode is the box barcode;
 * one already received is refused for good, with when and by whom.
 */
export async function receiveVendorBox(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  scanned: string,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<ReceivedBox> {
  const parsed = parseVendorBarcode(scanned);
  if (!parsed.ok)
    throw new ReceivingError(parsed.problem === "NOT_VENDOR" ? "NOT_VENDOR" : "BAD_VENDOR_BARCODE");
  const vendor = parsed.value;
  const barcode = scanned.trim();
  checkWeight(vendor.weightKg);
  if (vendor.expiryDate < vendor.slaughterDate) throw new ReceivingError("INVALID_DATES");

  const known = await alreadyReceived(db, barcode);
  if (known) throw known;

  const { items, orders } = await readCatalog(db, priority);
  const matches = items.filter((i) => i.barcode.endsWith(vendor.itemBarcodeTail));
  if (matches.length === 0) throw new ReceivingError("ITEM_NOT_FOUND");
  if (matches.length > 1) throw new ReceivingError("AMBIGUOUS_ITEM");
  const item = matches[0];

  // The owner's choice in settings; until one is made, the vendor order Priority has (if only one).
  let docno = await getVendorOrder(db);
  if (!docno) {
    const vendorOrders = orders.filter((o) => o.kind === "vendor");
    docno = vendorOrders.length === 1 ? vendorOrders[0].docno : null;
  }
  if (!docno) throw new ReceivingError("NO_ORDER");
  const warehouseCode = await warehouseFor(db, item);

  let box;
  try {
    box = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const [row] = await tx
        .insert(boxes)
        .values({
          barcode,
          source: "vendor",
          itemNumber: item.itemNumber,
          running: vendor.vendorRunning,
          slaughterDate: toISODate(vendor.slaughterDate),
          expiryDate: toISODate(vendor.expiryDate),
          weightKg: vendor.weightKg,
          docno,
          warehouseCode,
          receivedBy: actor.id,
          receivedByDisplay: actor.display,
        })
        .returning();
      await tx.insert(prioritySends).values({ boxId: row.id, nextAttemptAt: firstTryAfter() });
      return row;
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Two scans at the same moment: the second hits the unique barcode.
    if (isUniqueViolation(error)) {
      const raced = await alreadyReceived(db, barcode);
      if (raced) throw raced;
    }
    throw error;
  }

  await logFor(
    actor,
    "receiving.boxReceived",
    {
      entityType: "box",
      entityId: box.barcode,
      details: { source: "vendor", item: item.itemNumber, weightKg: box.weightKg, docno },
    },
    db,
  );
  const sent = await sendBox(db, priority, box.id);
  return toReceived(box, item, sent);
}

function toReceived(
  box: typeof boxes.$inferSelect,
  item: PriorityItem,
  sent: "sent" | "pending" | "failed",
): ReceivedBox {
  return {
    item,
    id: box.id,
    barcode: box.barcode,
    itemNumber: box.itemNumber,
    itemName: item.name,
    running: box.running,
    weightKg: box.weightKg,
    slaughterDate: box.slaughterDate,
    productionDate: box.productionDate,
    expiryDate: box.expiryDate,
    certificateNo: box.certificateNo,
    docno: box.docno,
    warehouseCode: box.warehouseCode,
    sent,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Today's list
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface TodayBox {
  id: string;
  barcode: string;
  source: "production" | "vendor";
  itemNumber: string;
  running: string;
  weightKg: number;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  slaughterDate: string;
  /** YYYY-MM-DD */
  expiryDate: string;
  receivedAt: Date;
  receivedBy: string;
  sent: "sent" | "pending" | "failed";
}

/**
 * The boxes received since the list last started over at 21:00, newest first. It is a view
 * of the box records the system keeps anyway, the same for every user and computer.
 */
export async function listTodayBoxes(
  db: Db,
  source: "production" | "vendor",
  now: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<TodayBox[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: boxes.id,
      barcode: boxes.barcode,
      source: boxes.source,
      itemNumber: boxes.itemNumber,
      running: boxes.running,
      weightKg: boxes.weightKg,
      slaughterDate: boxes.slaughterDate,
      expiryDate: boxes.expiryDate,
      receivedAt: boxes.receivedAt,
      receivedBy: boxes.receivedByDisplay,
      sent: prioritySends.status,
    })
    .from(boxes)
    .innerJoin(prioritySends, eq(prioritySends.boxId, boxes.id))
    .where(and(gte(boxes.receivedAt, todayListStart(now)), eq(boxes.source, source)))
    .orderBy(desc(boxes.receivedAt))
    .limit(500);
  return rows;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The send queue
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * A new box is sent at once by the request that saved it; the background timer only picks it
 * up if that did not happen within this time, so the two never send the same box together.
 */
export const FIRST_TRY_GRACE_MS = 60_000;
/** How long a send that the timer picked up is left alone, in case it is still on its way. */
export const CLAIM_MS = 2 * 60_000;

function firstTryAfter(): Date {
  return new Date(Date.now() + FIRST_TRY_GRACE_MS);
}

/** How often a box waiting for Priority to open writing is tried again. */
export const WRITE_CLOSED_RETRY_MS = 5 * 60_000;

/** Wait before the next try: 30 s, 1 min, 2 min ... at most 15 minutes. */
export function retryDelayMs(attempts: number): number {
  return Math.min(30_000 * 2 ** Math.max(0, attempts - 1), 15 * 60_000);
}

/**
 * Sends one queued box to Priority. Returns "sent" when Priority has it, "pending" when it
 * could not be reached (it will retry), and "failed" when Priority refused it for good.
 */
export async function sendBox(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  boxId: string,
  now: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<"sent" | "pending" | "failed"> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ send: prioritySends, box: boxes })
    .from(prioritySends)
    .innerJoin(boxes, eq(boxes.id, prioritySends.boxId))
    .where(eq(prioritySends.boxId, boxId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!row) return "failed";
  if (row.send.status === "sent") return "sent";
  if (row.send.status === "failed") return "failed";

  try {
    await priority.receiveBox({
      source: row.box.source,
      docno: row.box.docno,
      barcode: row.box.barcode,
      itemNumber: row.box.itemNumber,
      weightKg: row.box.weightKg,
      expiryDate: row.box.expiryDate,
      warehouseCode: row.box.warehouseCode,
    });
    await db
      .update(prioritySends)
      .set({ status: "sent", attempts: row.send.attempts + 1, lastError: null, sentAt: now })
      .where(eq(prioritySends.id, row.send.id));
    return "sent";
  } catch (error) {
    const code = error instanceof PriorityError ? error.code : "ERROR";
    // Priority already has this box: an earlier send got through but was not recorded here.
    if (code === "DUPLICATE_BOX") {
      await db
        .update(prioritySends)
        .set({
          status: "sent",
          attempts: row.send.attempts + 1,
          lastError: "DUPLICATE_BOX",
          sentAt: now,
        })
        .where(eq(prioritySends.id, row.send.id));
      return "sent";
    }
    // Writing to Priority is not open yet: the box simply waits, without counting as a failed try.
    if (code === "WRITE_NOT_OPEN") {
      await db
        .update(prioritySends)
        .set({
          status: "pending",
          lastError: code,
          nextAttemptAt: new Date(now.getTime() + WRITE_CLOSED_RETRY_MS),
        })
        .where(eq(prioritySends.id, row.send.id));
      return "pending";
    }
    const attempts = row.send.attempts + 1;
    // Only "cannot reach Priority" is worth retrying; anything else needs a person.
    const retry = code === "UNAVAILABLE" && attempts < MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS;
    await db
      .update(prioritySends)
      .set({
        status: retry ? "pending" : "failed",
        attempts,
        lastError: code,
        nextAttemptAt: new Date(now.getTime() + retryDelayMs(attempts)),
      })
      .where(eq(prioritySends.id, row.send.id));
    return retry ? "pending" : "failed";
  }
}

/** Tries every queued send that is due. Safe to call often; returns how many were sent. */
export async function sendDue(
  db: Db,
  priority: PriorityClient,
  now: Date = new Date(),
  limit = 50,
): Promise<number> {
  const candidates = await db
    .select({ id: prioritySends.id })
    .from(prioritySends)
    .where(and(eq(prioritySends.status, "pending"), lte(prioritySends.nextAttemptAt, now)))
    .orderBy(asc(prioritySends.id))
    .limit(limit);
  if (candidates.length === 0) return 0;
  // Claim them first: a send that another process took in the meantime is no longer due.
  const due = await db
    .update(prioritySends)
    .set({ nextAttemptAt: new Date(now.getTime() + CLAIM_MS) })
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(
          prioritySends.id,
          candidates.map((c) => c.id),
        ),
        eq(prioritySends.status, "pending"),
        lte(prioritySends.nextAttemptAt, now),
      ),
    )
    .returning({ boxId: prioritySends.boxId });
  let sent = 0;
  for (const { boxId } of due) {
    if ((await sendBox(db, priority, boxId, now)) === "sent") sent += 1;
  }
  return sent;
}

export interface UnsentBox {
  id: number;
  barcode: string;
  source: "production" | "vendor";
  itemNumber: string;
  weightKg: number;
  docno: string;
  warehouseCode: string;
  receivedAt: Date;
  receivedBy: string;
  status: "pending" | "failed";
  attempts: number;
  lastError: string | null;
  nextAttemptAt: Date;
}

/** Boxes Priority does not have yet: the ones still retrying, and the ones that need a person. */
export async function listUnsent(db: Db): Promise<UnsentBox[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: prioritySends.id,
      barcode: boxes.barcode,
      source: boxes.source,
      itemNumber: boxes.itemNumber,
      weightKg: boxes.weightKg,
      docno: boxes.docno,
      warehouseCode: boxes.warehouseCode,
      receivedAt: boxes.receivedAt,
      receivedBy: boxes.receivedByDisplay,
      status: prioritySends.status,
      attempts: prioritySends.attempts,
      lastError: prioritySends.lastError,
      nextAttemptAt: prioritySends.nextAttemptAt,
    })
    .from(prioritySends)
    .innerJoin(boxes, eq(boxes.id, prioritySends.boxId))
    .where(inArray(prioritySends.status, ["pending", "failed"]))
    .orderBy(desc(prioritySends.status), asc(boxes.receivedAt))
    .limit(500);
  return rows.filter((r): r is typeof r & { status: "pending" | "failed" } => r.status !== "sent");
}

/** Puts failed sends back in the queue, for an admin who has fixed what was wrong. */
export async function retryFailed(db: Db, ids: number[], actor: Actor): Promise<number> {
  if (ids.length === 0) return 0;
  const rows = await db
    .update(prioritySends)
    .set({ status: "pending", attempts: 0, nextAttemptAt: new Date() })
    .where(and(inArray(prioritySends.id, ids), eq(prioritySends.status, "failed")))
    .returning({ id: prioritySends.id });
  await logFor(actor, "receiving.sendRetried", { details: { count: rows.length } }, db);
  return rows.length;
}
````

````ts
    const unsent = await listUnsent(database.db);
    const entry = unsent.find((u) => u.barcode === waiting.barcode)!;
    expect(entry.status).toBe("pending");
    expect(entry.lastError).toBe("UNAVAILABLE");
    expect(unsent.some((u) => u.barcode === box.barcode)).toBe(false);
    await sendDue(database.db, priority, new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60_000));
    expect((await listUnsent(database.db)).some((u) => u.barcode === waiting.barcode)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("keeps a box waiting, not failed, while Priority does not accept writes yet", async () => {
    const closed = Object.create(priority) as FakePriorityClient;
    closed.receiveBox = async () => {
      throw new PriorityError("WRITE_NOT_OPEN");
    };
    const box = await receiveInHouseBox(database.db, closed, input, actor);
    expect(box.sent).toBe("pending");
    const entry = (await listUnsent(database.db)).find((u) => u.barcode === box.barcode)!;
    expect(entry.status).toBe("pending");
    expect(entry.attempts).toBe(0);
    expect(entry.lastError).toBe("WRITE_NOT_OPEN");
    // Once writing is open, the next round sends it by itself.
    await sendDue(database.db, priority, new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60_000));
    expect((await listUnsent(database.db)).some((u) => u.barcode === box.barcode)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("waits longer after each failure, up to fifteen minutes", () => {
    expect(retryDelayMs(1)).toBe(30_000);
    expect(retryDelayMs(2)).toBe(60_000);
    expect(retryDelayMs(30)).toBe(15 * 60_000);
    expect(MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS).toBeGreaterThan(5);
  });
});

describe("receiving settings", () => {
  it("sends a category's boxes to the warehouse chosen for it, and only a real warehouse can be chosen", async () => {
    const items = await priority.getItems();
````

````ts
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import type { PriorityClient } from "../priority/types";
import { sendDue } from "./index";

const EVERY_MS = 30_000;
const STARTED = Symbol.for("{{APP_ID}}.sendWorker");

/**
 * Retries the sends to Priority that are due, every 30 seconds, for as long as the server
 * runs, so boxes saved while Priority was down reach it without anyone opening a screen.
 * Safe next to other processes (`pnpm dev` runs two): a send is claimed before it is tried.
 * Started once per process.
 */
export function startSendWorker(db: Db, priority: () => PriorityClient, everyMs = EVERY_MS): void {
  const registry = globalThis as unknown as Record<symbol, boolean>;
  if (registry[STARTED]) return;
  registry[STARTED] = true;

  let running = false;
  const timer = setInterval(async () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    try {
      const client = priority();
      const sent = await sendDue(db, client);
      if (sent > 0) console.log(`[receiving] sent ${sent} waiting box(es) to Priority`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("[receiving] the send timer failed", error);
    } finally {
      running = false;
    }
  }, everyMs);
  timer.unref();
}
````

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * The order the storage rooms are shown in on the dashboard and in the inventory, arranged by
 * hand. Every person has their own order, kept apart from everyone else's. A person who has not
 * arranged them yet sees the order saved before orders were personal (if there is one), and rooms
 * that are not in the saved order (new ones) come last, in Priority's order.
 */

/** The order saved before every person had their own: the starting point for those with none. */
const SHARED_KEY = "rooms.order";
/** A person's own order. Not under "rooms." so it is never copied to another system. */
const personalKey = (userId: string) => `userRooms.${userId}`;
const MAX_ROOMS = 200;

export class RoomOrderError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: "INVALID_ORDER") {
    super(code);
    this.name = "RoomOrderError";
  }
}

/** The room codes in this person's order; empty until one is saved. */
export async function getRoomOrder(db: Db, userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const own = await readSetting<string[]>(db, personalKey(userId));
  if (Array.isArray(own?.value)) return own.value;
  const shared = await readSetting<string[]>(db, SHARED_KEY);
  return Array.isArray(shared?.value) ? shared.value : [];
}

/** Saves this person's order, each room once. Nobody else's order changes. */
export async function setRoomOrder(
  db: Db,
  userId: string,
  codes: string[],
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  const unique = [...new Set(codes.map((code) => code.trim()).filter(Boolean))];
  if (unique.length === 0 || unique.length > MAX_ROOMS) throw new RoomOrderError("INVALID_ORDER");
  await writeSetting(db, personalKey(userId), unique, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.roomOrderChanged",
    { entityType: "settings", entityId: personalKey(userId), details: { rooms: unique.length } },
    db,
  );
}

/** The rooms in the saved order; any not in it follow, in the order they came in. */
export function inRoomOrder<T extends { code: string }>(rooms: T[], order: string[]): T[] {
  const place = new Map(order.map((code, index) => [code, index]));
  return rooms
    .map((room, index) => ({ room, index }))
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        (place.get(a.room.code) ?? Infinity) - (place.get(b.room.code) ?? Infinity) ||
        a.index - b.index,
    )
    .map((entry) => entry.room);
}
````

````ts
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "../db/connection";
import { writeSetting } from "../settings";
import { seed } from "../db/seed";
import { getRoomOrder, inRoomOrder, RoomOrderError, setRoomOrder } from "./index";

let database: Database;
const actor = { id: null, display: "test" };

beforeAll(async () => {
  database = createDatabase({ url: null, pgliteDataDir: null });
  await database.migrate();
  await seed(database.db, { email: "boss@example.com", password: "Temp-1234", name: "Boss" });
}, 60_000);

describe("the order of the storage rooms", () => {
  it("is saved once per room and read back", async () => {
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "ann")).toEqual([]);
    await setRoomOrder(database.db, "ann", ["200", "Main", "200", " 100 "], actor);
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "ann")).toEqual(["200", "Main", "100"]);
    await expect(setRoomOrder(database.db, "ann", [], actor)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
      RoomOrderError,
    );
  });

  it("is each person's own: arranging the rooms changes nothing for anyone else", async () => {
    await setRoomOrder(database.db, "ann", ["300", "200"], actor);
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "bob")).toEqual([]);
    await setRoomOrder(database.db, "bob", ["Main", "100"], actor);
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "bob")).toEqual(["Main", "100"]);
    // Ann's order is still hers.
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "ann")).toEqual(["300", "200"]);
  });

  it("starts a person who has not arranged the rooms from the order saved before orders were personal", async () => {
    await writeSetting(database.db, "rooms.order", ["100", "Main"], null);
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "carol")).toEqual(["100", "Main"]);
    // Her own order, once she makes one, replaces it for her only.
    await setRoomOrder(database.db, "carol", ["Main"], actor);
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "carol")).toEqual(["Main"]);
    expect(await getRoomOrder(database.db, "dave")).toEqual(["100", "Main"]);
  });

  it("puts the rooms in the saved order and new rooms last", () => {
    const rooms = [{ code: "Main" }, { code: "100" }, { code: "300" }, { code: "200" }];
    expect(inRoomOrder(rooms, ["200", "Main"]).map((r) => r.code)).toEqual([
      "200",
      "Main",
      "100",
      "300",
    ]);
    expect(inRoomOrder(rooms, []).map((r) => r.code)).toEqual(["Main", "100", "300", "200"]);
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/server/security/alerts.ts`

````ts
import { and, desc, gte, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { activityLog } from "../db/schema";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * Warnings about sign-in attempts that look like someone breaking in, read from the activity log:
 * - "locked": an account was locked after wrong passwords and someone kept trying;
 * - "guessing": wrong passwords for one email, a few times in a day (before it locks);
 * - "codes": wrong two-step codes from one address, a few times in a day;
 * - "google": a Google sign-in refused (an account that is not registered, or one with a code).
 * Which warnings have been seen is kept as one time in the settings.
 */

export type AlertKind = "locked" | "guessing" | "codes" | "google";

export interface SecurityAlert {
  kind: AlertKind;
  /** The email (locked, guessing) or the address (codes, google) it is about. */
  subject: string;
  count: number;
  lastAt: Date;
  /** Addresses the attempts came from. */
  ips: string[];
}

const SEEN_KEY = "security.alertsSeenAt";
const WEEK = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
/** Wrong passwords or codes in a day before they count as a warning. */
export const ALERT_THRESHOLD = 3;

const ACTIONS = [
  "auth.loginFailed",
  "auth.loginBlocked",
  "auth.twoFactorFailed",
  "auth.googleRefused",
];

interface Row {
  action: string;
  at: Date;
  ip: string | null;
  email: string;
}

function group(rows: Row[], key: (row: Row) => string, since: number) {
  const groups = new Map<string, { count: number; lastAt: Date; ips: Set<string> }>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.at.getTime() < since) continue;
    const name = key(row);
    const entry = groups.get(name) ?? { count: 0, lastAt: row.at, ips: new Set<string>() };
    entry.count += 1;
    if (row.at > entry.lastAt) entry.lastAt = row.at;
    if (row.ip) entry.ips.add(row.ip);
    groups.set(name, entry);
  }
  return groups;
}

/** The warnings of the last week, newest first. */
export async function getSecurityAlerts(db: Db, now = new Date()): Promise<SecurityAlert[]> {
  const weekAgo = now.getTime() - WEEK;
  const dayAgo = now.getTime() - DAY;
  const found = await db
    .select({
      action: activityLog.action,
      at: activityLog.at,
      ip: activityLog.ip,
      userDisplay: activityLog.userDisplay,
      details: activityLog.details,
    })
    .from(activityLog)
    .where(and(inArray(activityLog.action, ACTIONS), gte(activityLog.at, new Date(weekAgo))))
    .orderBy(desc(activityLog.at))
    .limit(5000);

  const rows: Row[] = found.map((r) => ({
    action: r.action,
    at: r.at,
    ip: r.ip,
    email: String(
      (r.details as { email?: unknown } | null)?.email ?? r.userDisplay ?? "",
    ).toLowerCase(),
  }));
  const of = (action: string) => rows.filter((row) => row.action === action);

  const alerts: SecurityAlert[] = [];
  const add = (kind: AlertKind, groups: ReturnType<typeof group>, minimum: number): void => {
    for (const [subject, entry] of groups) {
      if (entry.count < minimum) continue;
      alerts.push({
        kind,
        subject,
        count: entry.count,
        lastAt: entry.lastAt,
        ips: [...entry.ips],
      });
    }
  };

  add(
    "locked",
    group(of("auth.loginBlocked"), (r) => r.email || "?", weekAgo),
    1,
  );
  add(
    "guessing",
    group(of("auth.loginFailed"), (r) => r.email || "?", dayAgo),
    ALERT_THRESHOLD,
  );
  add(
    "codes",
    group(of("auth.twoFactorFailed"), (r) => r.ip ?? "?", dayAgo),
    ALERT_THRESHOLD,
  );
  add(
    "google",
    group(of("auth.googleRefused"), (r) => r.ip ?? "?", weekAgo),
    1,
  );

  return alerts.sort((a, b) => b.lastAt.getTime() - a.lastAt.getTime());
}

export async function getAlertsSeenAt(db: Db): Promise<Date | null> {
  const stored = await readSetting<string>(db, SEEN_KEY);
  const date = typeof stored?.value === "string" ? new Date(stored.value) : null;
  return date && !Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? date : null;
}

export function countUnseen(alerts: SecurityAlert[], seenAt: Date | null): number {
  return alerts.filter((alert) => !seenAt || alert.lastAt > seenAt).length;
}

/** How many warnings are new since someone last marked them as seen. */
export async function getUnseenAlertCount(db: Db): Promise<number> {
  const [alerts, seenAt] = await Promise.all([getSecurityAlerts(db), getAlertsSeenAt(db)]);
  return countUnseen(alerts, seenAt);
}

export async function markAlertsSeen(db: Db, actorId: string | null, now = new Date()) {
  await writeSetting(db, SEEN_KEY, now.toISOString(), actorId);
}
````

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * Signing out someone who has left the system open: after this many minutes of not touching the
 * screen, the person is signed out. 0 means never. Set in the system settings.
 */

const KEY = "security.idleMinutes";

/** Without a saved choice the system signs out after half an hour. */
export const DEFAULT_IDLE_MINUTES = 30;
export const MAX_IDLE_MINUTES = 1440;

export function isIdleMinutes(value: unknown): value is number {
  return (
    typeof value === "number" && Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= MAX_IDLE_MINUTES
  );
}

export async function getIdleMinutes(db: Db): Promise<number> {
  const stored = await readSetting<number>(db, KEY);
  return isIdleMinutes(stored?.value) ? stored.value : DEFAULT_IDLE_MINUTES;
}

export async function setIdleMinutes(db: Db, minutes: number, actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  const before = await getIdleMinutes(db);
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, minutes, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.idleTimeoutChanged",
    { entityType: "settings", entityId: KEY, details: { from: before, to: minutes } },
    db,
  );
}
````

````ts
  });

  it("keeps the chosen time, including 0 for never, and logs each change", async () => {
    const actor = { id: null, display: "test" };
    await setIdleMinutes(database.db, 10, actor);
    expect(await getIdleMinutes(database.db)).toBe(10);
    await setIdleMinutes(database.db, 0, actor);

      { from: 10, to: 0 },
      { from: 30, to: 10 },
    ]);
  });

  it("accepts only whole minutes from 0 to a day", () => {
    expect(isIdleMinutes(0)).toBe(true);
    expect(isIdleMinutes(MAX_IDLE_MINUTES)).toBe(true);
    expect(isIdleMinutes(MAX_IDLE_MINUTES + 1)).toBe(false);
    expect(isIdleMinutes(-1)).toBe(false);
    expect(isIdleMinutes(2.5)).toBe(false);
    expect(isIdleMinutes("10")).toBe(false);
  });
});
````

````ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Actor } from "../activity-log";
import { AdminError, createUser } from "../auth/admin";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "../db/connection";
import { sessions, users } from "../db/schema";
import { endSession, listActiveSessions } from "./sessions";

let database: Database;
const actor: Actor = { id: null, display: "system", deviceType: null, ip: null };
const HOUR = 60 * 60 * 1000;

beforeAll(async () => {
  database = createDatabase({ url: null, pgliteDataDir: null });
  await database.migrate();
}, 60_000);

async function addUser(email: string, isOwner = false): Promise<string> {
  const created = await createUser(
    database.db,
    { email, name: email, displayName: "", permissions: [] },
    actor,
  );
  if (isOwner) await database.db.update(users).set({ isOwner }).where(eq(users.id, created.id));
  return created.id;
}

async function addSession(userId: string, token: string, expiresInMs: number, ip: string) {
  const [row] = await database.db
    .insert(sessions)
    .values({
      userId,
      token,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + expiresInMs),
      ipAddress: ip,
      userAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36",
    })
    .returning({ id: sessions.id });
  return row.id;
}

describe("signed-in places", () => {
  it("lists the places still signed in, not the ones that ran out", async () => {
    const worker = await addUser("w@example.com");
    await addSession(worker, "live", HOUR, "1.1.1.1");
    await addSession(worker, "old", -HOUR, "2.2.2.2");

    const list = await listActiveSessions(database.db);
    expect(list).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(list[0]).toMatchObject({ userId: worker, email: "w@example.com", ip: "1.1.1.1" });
  });
````

````ts
import { desc, eq, gt } from "drizzle-orm";
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import { AdminError } from "../auth/admin";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { sessions, users, type DeviceType } from "../db/schema";

/** One place where someone is signed in right now. */
export interface ActiveSession {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  isOwner: boolean;
  deviceType: DeviceType;
  ip: string | null;
  userAgent: string | null;
  signedInAt: Date;
  /** The last time the session was refreshed; it moves forward about once an hour. */
  lastSeenAt: Date;
}

/** Every session that has not run out, the most recently active first. */
export async function listActiveSessions(db: Db, now = new Date()): Promise<ActiveSession[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: sessions.id,
      userId: sessions.userId,
      displayName: users.displayName,
      name: users.name,
      email: users.email,
      isOwner: users.isOwner,
      deviceType: sessions.deviceType,
      ip: sessions.ipAddress,
      userAgent: sessions.userAgent,
      signedInAt: sessions.createdAt,
      lastSeenAt: sessions.updatedAt,
    })
    .from(sessions)
    .innerJoin(users, eq(users.id, sessions.userId))
    .where(gt(sessions.expiresAt, now))
    .orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt));

  return rows.map(({ displayName, name, ...row }) => ({
    ...row,
    name: displayName || name,
  }));
}

/** Signs one place out; whoever is there has to sign in again. */
export async function endSession(
  db: Db,
  sessionId: string,
  actor: Actor,
  options: { mayEndOwner: boolean },
): Promise<void> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ userId: sessions.userId, email: users.email, isOwner: users.isOwner })
    .from(sessions)
    .innerJoin(users, eq(users.id, sessions.userId))
    .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId))
    .limit(1);
  if (!row) throw new AdminError("USER_NOT_FOUND");
  if (row.isOwner && !options.mayEndOwner) throw new AdminError("OWNER_PROTECTED");

  await db.delete(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "admin.sessionEnded",
    { entityType: "user", entityId: row.userId, details: { email: row.email } },
    db,
  );
}
````

````ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { settings } from "../db/schema";

/** Key-value settings kept in the database (the `settings` table). Callers own the shape of each value. */

export async function readSetting<T>(db: Db, key: string): Promise<{ value: T; updatedAt: Date } | null> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(settings).where(eq(settings.key, key)).limit(1);
  return row ? { value: row.value as T, updatedAt: row.updatedAt } : null;
}

export async function writeSetting(
  db: Db,
  key: string,
  value: unknown,
  updatedBy: string | null,
): Promise<void> {
  await db
    .insert(settings)
    .values({ key, value, updatedBy })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({ target: settings.key, set: { value, updatedBy, updatedAt: new Date() } });
}

export async function deleteSetting(db: Db, key: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.delete(settings).where(eq(settings.key, key));
}
````

````ts
import { createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

/**
 * Encrypts a secret (the Priority API password) before it is stored, so a copy
 * of the database alone does not reveal it. AES-256-GCM with a key derived from
 * AUTH_SECRET; changing AUTH_SECRET makes stored secrets unreadable and they
 * must be entered again. Format: "v1.<iv>.<tag>.<ciphertext>" in base64url.
 */

function keyFrom(secret: string): Buffer {
  return createHash("sha256").update(`weighing-settings:${secret}`).digest();
}

export function encryptSecret(plain: string, secret: string): string {
  const iv = randomBytes(12);
  const cipher = createCipheriv("aes-256-gcm", keyFrom(secret), iv);
  const body = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(plain, "utf8"), cipher.final()]);
  return ["v1", iv, cipher.getAuthTag(), body].map((p) => (typeof p === "string" ? p : p.toString("base64url"))).join(".");
}

/** The original text, or null when the value is damaged or was encrypted with another secret. */
export function decryptSecret(stored: string, secret: string): string | null {
  const [version, iv, tag, body] = stored.split(".");
  if (version !== "v1" || !iv || !tag || !body) return null;
  try {
    const decipher = createDecipheriv("aes-256-gcm", keyFrom(secret), Buffer.from(iv, "base64url"));
    decipher.setAuthTag(Buffer.from(tag, "base64url"));
    return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(Buffer.from(body, "base64url")), decipher.final()]).toString("utf8");
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The server's secret from the environment; throws if the app was started without one. */
export function appSecret(): string {
  const secret = process.env.AUTH_SECRET;
  if (!secret) throw new Error("AUTH_SECRET is not set");
  return secret;
}
````

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import type { PriorityItem } from "../priority/types";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * The days a box keeps from its slaughter date, set per item category. The expiry date on a label
 * is the slaughter date plus these days. An item whose own shelf life in Priority is more than
 * nothing keeps it; the category's days fill in for the items Priority gives none.
 */

export const MIN_SHELF_LIFE_DAYS = 1;
export const MAX_SHELF_LIFE_DAYS = 3650;

const KEY = "receiving.shelfLifeDaysByCategory";

export class ShelfLifeError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: "INVALID_DAYS") {
    super(code);
    this.name = "ShelfLifeError";
  }
}

/** Category text to its days; categories not in here have none of their own. */
export async function getShelfLives(db: Db): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const stored = await readSetting<Record<string, number>>(db, KEY);
  return stored?.value ?? {};
}

/** Sets (or with null clears) the shelf life of a category. Whole days from 1 to 3650. */
export async function setCategoryShelfLife(
  db: Db,
  category: string,
  days: number | null,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  if (
    days !== null &&
    (!Number.isInteger(days) || days < MIN_SHELF_LIFE_DAYS || days > MAX_SHELF_LIFE_DAYS)
  )
    throw new ShelfLifeError("INVALID_DAYS");
  const current = await getShelfLives(db);
  const next = { ...current };
  if (days === null) delete next[category];
  else next[category] = days;
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, next, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.shelfLifeChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: KEY,
      details: { category, from: current[category] ?? null, to: days },
    },
    db,
  );
}

/** The items, each with its category's days where Priority gives it none. */
export function withShelfLives(
  items: PriorityItem[],
  days: Record<string, number>,
): PriorityItem[] {
  return items.map((item) =>
    item.shelfLifeDays > 0 || !days[item.category]
      ? item
      : { ...item, shelfLifeDays: days[item.category] },
  );
}
````

````ts
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "../db/connection";
import { seed } from "../db/seed";
import type { PriorityItem } from "../priority/types";
import { getShelfLives, setCategoryShelfLife, ShelfLifeError, withShelfLives } from "./index";

let database: Database;
const actor = { id: null, display: "test" };

beforeAll(async () => {
  database = createDatabase({ url: null, pgliteDataDir: null });
  await database.migrate();
  await seed(database.db, { email: "boss@example.com", password: "Temp-1234", name: "Boss" });
}, 60_000);

const item = (category: string, shelfLifeDays: number) =>
  ({ itemNumber: "M1", category, shelfLifeDays }) as PriorityItem;

describe("shelf life per category", () => {
  it("is saved, cleared, and refused when not whole days from 1 to 3650", async () => {
    await setCategoryShelfLife(database.db, "בשר טרי", 12, actor);
    expect(await getShelfLives(database.db)).toEqual({ "בשר טרי": 12 });
    await setCategoryShelfLife(database.db, "בשר טרי", null, actor);
    expect(await getShelfLives(database.db)).toEqual({});
    for (const bad of [0, -3, 1.5, 3651]) {
      await expect(setCategoryShelfLife(database.db, "בשר טרי", bad, actor)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
        ShelfLifeError,
      );
    }
  });

  it("fills only the items that Priority gives no days", () => {
    const days = { קפוא: 540 };
    const [own, filled, other] = withShelfLives(
      [item("קפוא", 30), item("קפוא", 0), item("טרי", 0)],
      days,
    );
    expect(own.shelfLifeDays).toBe(30);
    expect(filled.shelfLifeDays).toBe(540);
    expect(other.shelfLifeDays).toBe(0);
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/server/shipping-labels/index.ts`

````ts
import { createHash, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import type { AnyPgColumn } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { count, desc, eq, ilike, max, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  DEFAULT_PALLET_COPIES,
  isShippingUnit,
  MAX_PALLET_COPIES,
  MAX_LABELS,
  sampleOrder,
  type ShippingOrder,
  type ShippingUnit,
} from "../../lib/labels/shipping";
import { logFor, SYSTEM_ACTOR, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import { settings, shippingOrders } from "../db/schema";
import { getLayout, listLayoutsOfType, type LabelLayout } from "../labels";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * Shipping labels. Priority sends an order here once it is picked and confirmed there; the order
 * is kept, and its labels are printed from the Shipping labels screen. This system never picks,
 * counts or changes anything in Priority.
 */

export type ShippingErrorCode = "NOT_FOUND" | "INVALID_COUNT" | "INVALID_COPIES" | "INVALID_LAYOUT";

export class ShippingError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: ShippingErrorCode) {
    super(code);
    this.name = "ShippingError";
  }
}

export type ShippingRow = typeof shippingOrders.$inferSelect;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The secret in the address Priority calls
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const TOKEN_KEY = "shippingLabels.token";

function newToken(): string {
  return randomBytes(24).toString("base64url");
}

/** The secret part of the address. Made the first time it is needed. */
export async function getShippingToken(db: Db): Promise<string> {
  const stored = await readSetting<string>(db, TOKEN_KEY);
  if (stored?.value) return stored.value;
  // Two requests at the same moment must end up with the same secret.
  await db.insert(settings).values({ key: TOKEN_KEY, value: newToken() }).onConflictDoNothing();
  const again = await readSetting<string>(db, TOKEN_KEY);
  if (!again?.value) throw new Error("could not make the shipping labels key");
  return again.value;
}

/** Replaces the secret: the address Priority has stops working until Priority is given the new one. */
export async function regenerateShippingToken(db: Db, actor: Actor): Promise<string> {
  const token = newToken();
  await writeSetting(db, TOKEN_KEY, token, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.shippingKeyChanged",
    { entityType: "settings", entityId: TOKEN_KEY },
    db,
  );
  return token;
}

function digest(value: string): Buffer {
  return createHash("sha256").update(value).digest();
}

/** Whether `given` is the secret of the address (compared in constant time). */
export async function tokenMatches(db: Db, given: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const real = await getShippingToken(db);
  return timingSafeEqual(digest(given), digest(real));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Settings: how many labels by default, and which layout
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const COUNT_KEY = "shippingLabels.defaultCount";
const LAYOUT_KEY = "shippingLabels.layout";
const UNIT_KEY = "shippingLabels.defaultUnit";
const PALLET_COPIES_KEY = "shippingLabels.palletCopies";

export interface ShippingSettings {
  defaultCount: number;
  /** What the labels are for when printing starts: boxes or pallets. */
  defaultUnit: ShippingUnit;
  /** How many labels each pallet number gets. */
  palletCopies: number;
  /** The chosen shipping layout, or "" for the oldest one. */
  layoutId: string;
}

export async function getShippingSettings(db: Db): Promise<ShippingSettings> {
  const [count, layout, unit, copies] = await Promise.all([
    readSetting<number>(db, COUNT_KEY),
    readSetting<string>(db, LAYOUT_KEY),
    readSetting<string>(db, UNIT_KEY),
    readSetting<number>(db, PALLET_COPIES_KEY),
  ]);
  const c = Number(copies?.value);
  const n = Number(count?.value);
  return {
    defaultCount: Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= MAX_LABELS ? n : 1,
    layoutId: layout?.value ?? "",
    defaultUnit: isShippingUnit(unit?.value) ? unit.value : "box",
    palletCopies:
      Number.isInteger(c) && c >= 1 && c <= MAX_PALLET_COPIES ? c : DEFAULT_PALLET_COPIES,
  };
}

export async function saveShippingSettings(
  db: Db,
  input: ShippingSettings,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(input.defaultCount) ||
    input.defaultCount < 1 ||
    input.defaultCount > MAX_LABELS
  )
    throw new ShippingError("INVALID_COUNT");
  if (
    !Number.isInteger(input.palletCopies) ||
    input.palletCopies < 1 ||
    input.palletCopies > MAX_PALLET_COPIES
  )
    throw new ShippingError("INVALID_COPIES");
  if (input.layoutId) {
    const layout = await getLayout(db, input.layoutId);
    if (!layout || layout.type !== "shipping") throw new ShippingError("INVALID_LAYOUT");
  }
  await writeSetting(db, COUNT_KEY, input.defaultCount, actor.id);
  await writeSetting(db, LAYOUT_KEY, input.layoutId, actor.id);
  await writeSetting(db, UNIT_KEY, input.defaultUnit, actor.id);
  await writeSetting(db, PALLET_COPIES_KEY, input.palletCopies, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.shippingLabelsChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: LAYOUT_KEY,
      details: {
        defaultCount: input.defaultCount,
        unit: input.defaultUnit,
        palletCopies: input.palletCopies,
        layout: input.layoutId || null,
      },
    },
    db,
  );
}

/** The layout the shipping labels print with: the chosen one, else the oldest; null when none exists. */
export async function getShippingLayout(db: Db): Promise<LabelLayout | null> {
  const { layoutId } = await getShippingSettings(db);
  if (layoutId) {
    const chosen = await getLayout(db, layoutId);
    if (chosen && chosen.type === "shipping") return chosen;
  }
  return (await listLayoutsOfType(db, "shipping"))[0] ?? null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Orders
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** The new text, or the stored one when the new one is empty. */
function keep(value: string, column: AnyPgColumn) {
  return sql`coalesce(nullif(${value}, ''), ${column})`;
}

/**
 * Keeps an order Priority sent. The same order number again updates the earlier row (the newest
 * details win) and counts one more time received.
 */
export async function receiveOrder(
  db: Db,
  order: ShippingOrder,
  raw: unknown,
  options: { isTest?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<{ id: string; updated: boolean }> {
  const values = {
    customerName: order.customerName,
    customerNumber: order.customerNumber,
    address: order.address,
    city: order.city,
    phone: order.phone,
    shipDate: order.shipDate,
    notes: order.notes,
    labelCount: order.labelCount,
    raw: raw ?? null,
    isTest: options.isTest ?? false,
    receivedAt: new Date(),
  };
  const [row] = await db
    .insert(shippingOrders)
    .values({ orderNumber: order.orderNumber, ...values })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: shippingOrders.orderNumber,
      // A resend that leaves a detail out keeps what the order had before.
      set: {
        ...values,
        customerName: keep(values.customerName, shippingOrders.customerName),
        customerNumber: keep(values.customerNumber, shippingOrders.customerNumber),
        address: keep(values.address, shippingOrders.address),
        city: keep(values.city, shippingOrders.city),
        phone: keep(values.phone, shippingOrders.phone),
        shipDate: keep(values.shipDate, shippingOrders.shipDate),
        notes: keep(values.notes, shippingOrders.notes),
        labelCount: sql`coalesce(${values.labelCount}, ${shippingOrders.labelCount})`,
        timesReceived: sql`${shippingOrders.timesReceived} + 1`,
      },
    })
    .returning({ id: shippingOrders.id, timesReceived: shippingOrders.timesReceived });
  await logFor(
    SYSTEM_ACTOR,
    options.isTest ? "shipping.testOrder" : "shipping.orderReceived",
    {
      entityType: "shipping_order",
      entityId: row.id,
      details: { order: order.orderNumber, times: row.timesReceived },
    },
    db,
  );
  return { id: row.id, updated: row.timesReceived > 1 };
}

const LIST_LIMIT = 200;

/** The newest orders first; `search` looks in the order number, customer and city. */
export async function listOrders(db: Db, search = ""): Promise<ShippingRow[]> {
  const text = search.trim();
  const like = `%${text.replace(/[\\%_]/g, "\\$&")}%`;
  return db
    .select()
    .from(shippingOrders)
    .where(
      text
        ? or(
            ilike(shippingOrders.orderNumber, like),
            ilike(shippingOrders.customerName, like),
            ilike(shippingOrders.customerNumber, like),
            ilike(shippingOrders.city, like),
          )
        : undefined,
    )
    .orderBy(desc(shippingOrders.receivedAt))
    .limit(LIST_LIMIT);
}

/** How many orders Priority has sent (not the test order), and when the last one came. */
export async function shippingStats(
  db: Db,
): Promise<{ received: number; lastReceivedAt: Date | null }> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ received: count(), last: max(shippingOrders.receivedAt) })
    .from(shippingOrders)
    .where(eq(shippingOrders.isTest, false));
  return { received: row?.received ?? 0, lastReceivedAt: row?.last ?? null };
}

export async function getOrder(db: Db, id: string): Promise<ShippingRow | null> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(shippingOrders).where(eq(shippingOrders.id, id)).limit(1);
  return row ?? null;
}

export function toShippingOrder(row: ShippingRow): ShippingOrder {
  return {
    orderNumber: row.orderNumber,
    customerName: row.customerName,
    customerNumber: row.customerNumber,
    address: row.address,
    city: row.city,
    phone: row.phone,
    shipDate: row.shipDate,
    notes: row.notes,
    labelCount: row.labelCount,
  };
}

/** Notes that `count` labels of an order were sent to the printer. */
export async function markPrinted(db: Db, id: string, count: number, actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  const [row] = await db
    .update(shippingOrders)
    .set({
      lastPrintedAt: new Date(),
      lastPrintedBy: actor.display,
      timesPrinted: sql`${shippingOrders.timesPrinted} + 1`,
    })
    .where(eq(shippingOrders.id, id))
    .returning({ orderNumber: shippingOrders.orderNumber });
  if (!row) throw new ShippingError("NOT_FOUND");
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "shipping.labelsPrinted",
    {
      entityType: "shipping_order",
      entityId: id,
      details: { order: row.orderNumber, labels: count },
    },
    db,
  );
}

export async function deleteOrder(db: Db, id: string, actor: Actor): Promise<void> {
  const [row] = await db
    .delete(shippingOrders)
    .where(eq(shippingOrders.id, id))
    .returning({ orderNumber: shippingOrders.orderNumber });
  if (!row) throw new ShippingError("NOT_FOUND");
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "shipping.orderDeleted",
    { entityType: "shipping_order", entityId: id, details: { order: row.orderNumber } },
    db,
  );
}

/** A made-up order, so the setup can be tried before Priority sends anything real. */
export async function makeTestOrder(db: Db): Promise<{ id: string }> {
  const order = sampleOrder(new Date());
  const { id } = await receiveOrder(
    db,
    { ...order, orderNumber: "TEST-0001" },
    { test: true },
    { isTest: true },
  );
  return { id };
}
````

````ts
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { sampleOrder } from "@/lib/labels/shipping";
import { listActivity } from "../auth/admin-queries";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "../db/connection";
import { seed } from "../db/seed";
import { listLayoutsOfType } from "../labels";
import {
  deleteOrder,
  getOrder,
  getShippingLayout,
  getShippingSettings,
  getShippingToken,
  listOrders,
  makeTestOrder,
  markPrinted,
  receiveOrder,
  regenerateShippingToken,
  saveShippingSettings,
  shippingStats,
  ShippingError,
  tokenMatches,
  toShippingOrder,
} from "./index";

const actor = { id: null, display: "test" };

let database: Database;

beforeAll(async () => {
  database = createDatabase({ url: null, pgliteDataDir: null });
  await database.migrate();
  await seed(database.db, { email: "boss@example.com", password: "Temp-1234", name: "Boss" });
}, 60_000);

const base = sampleOrder(new Date("2026-11-09T10:00:00Z"));

describe("the key in the address", () => {
  it("is made once, long, and recognised only when exact", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    const token = await getShippingToken(db);
    expect(token.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(30);
    expect(await getShippingToken(db)).toBe(token);
    expect(await tokenMatches(db, token)).toBe(true);
    expect(await tokenMatches(db, token + "x")).toBe(false);
    expect(await tokenMatches(db, token.slice(0, -1))).toBe(false);
    expect(await tokenMatches(db, "")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("can be replaced, and then the old one no longer works", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    const old = await getShippingToken(db);
    const fresh = await regenerateShippingToken(db, actor);
    expect(fresh).not.toBe(old);
    expect(await tokenMatches(db, old)).toBe(false);
    expect(await tokenMatches(db, fresh)).toBe(true);
    const log = await listActivity(db, { action: "settings.shippingKeyChanged", page: 1 });
    expect(log.rows.length).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe("orders from Priority", () => {
  it("keeps an order, and the same order sent again updates it instead of adding another", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    const first = await receiveOrder(db, { ...base, orderNumber: "SO100" }, { a: 1 });
    expect(first.updated).toBe(false);
    const again = await receiveOrder(
      db,
      { ...base, orderNumber: "SO100", city: "חיפה", labelCount: 7 },
      { a: 2 },
    );
    expect(again.id).toBe(first.id);
    expect(again.updated).toBe(true);

    const row = await getOrder(db, first.id);
    expect(row?.city).toBe("חיפה");
    expect(row?.labelCount).toBe(7);
    expect(row?.timesReceived).toBe(2);
    expect(row?.raw).toEqual({ a: 2 });
    expect((await listOrders(db, "SO100")).length).toBe(1);
  });

  it("searches by order number, customer, customer number and city", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    await receiveOrder(
      db,
      {
        ...base,
        orderNumber: "SO200",
        customerName: "Zeta Foods",
        customerNumber: "ZZ9",
        city: "Eilat",
      },
      {},
    );
    expect((await listOrders(db, "so200")).map((o) => o.orderNumber)).toEqual(["SO200"]);
    expect((await listOrders(db, "zeta")).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await listOrders(db, "ZZ9")).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await listOrders(db, "eilat")).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await listOrders(db, "no such thing")).length).toBe(0);
    // The characters of a search pattern are plain text here.
    expect((await listOrders(db, "%")).length).toBe(0);
  });

  it("notes each print and the number of labels, and can delete an order", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    const { id } = await receiveOrder(db, { ...base, orderNumber: "SO300" }, {});
    expect((await getOrder(db, id))?.timesPrinted).toBe(0);
    await markPrinted(db, id, 10, actor);
    await markPrinted(db, id, 3, actor);
    const printed = await getOrder(db, id);
    expect(printed?.timesPrinted).toBe(2);
    expect(printed?.lastPrintedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
    expect(toShippingOrder(printed!).orderNumber).toBe("SO300");

    const log = await listActivity(db, { action: "shipping.labelsPrinted", page: 1 });
    expect(log.rows.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);

    await deleteOrder(db, id, actor);
    expect(await getOrder(db, id)).toBeNull();
    await expect(deleteOrder(db, id, actor)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "NOT_FOUND" });
    await expect(markPrinted(db, id, 1, actor)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "NOT_FOUND" });
  });

  it("counts what Priority sent, not the test order", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    const before = await shippingStats(db);
    await makeTestOrder(db);
    await makeTestOrder(db);
    const after = await shippingStats(db);
    expect(after.received).toBe(before.received);
    expect((await listOrders(db, "TEST-0001")).length).toBe(1);
    expect(before.received).toBe(2);
    expect(after.lastReceivedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
  });
});

describe("settings and the layout", () => {
  it("starts at one label and the first shipping layout", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    expect(await getShippingSettings(db)).toEqual({
      defaultCount: 1,
      defaultUnit: "box",
      palletCopies: 4,
      layoutId: "",
    });
    const layouts = await listLayoutsOfType(db, "shipping");
    expect(layouts.length).toBe(1);
    expect((await getShippingLayout(db))?.id).toBe(layouts[0].id);
  });

  it("saves the number and the layout, and refuses what is not valid", async () => {
    const db = database.db;
    const [layout] = await listLayoutsOfType(db, "shipping");
    await saveShippingSettings(
      db,
      { defaultCount: 12, defaultUnit: "pallet", palletCopies: 6, layoutId: layout.id },
      actor,
    );
    expect(await getShippingSettings(db)).toEqual({
      defaultCount: 12,
      defaultUnit: "pallet",
      palletCopies: 6,
      layoutId: layout.id,
    });

    for (const bad of [0, -1, 1.5, 201]) {
      await expect(
        saveShippingSettings(
          db,
          { defaultCount: bad, defaultUnit: "box", palletCopies: 4, layoutId: "" },
          actor,
        ),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "INVALID_COUNT" });
    }
    for (const bad of [0, 11, 2.5]) {
      await expect(
        saveShippingSettings(
          db,
          { defaultCount: 2, defaultUnit: "box", palletCopies: bad, layoutId: "" },
          actor,
        ),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "INVALID_COPIES" });
    }
    // An item layout is not a shipping layout.
    const { listLayouts } = await import("../labels");
    const item = (await listLayouts(db)).find((l) => l.type === "item")!;
    await expect(
      saveShippingSettings(
        db,
        { defaultCount: 2, defaultUnit: "box", palletCopies: 4, layoutId: item.id },
        actor,
      ),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ShippingError);
    await expect(
      saveShippingSettings(
        db,
        { defaultCount: 2, defaultUnit: "box", palletCopies: 4, layoutId: "missing" },
        actor,
      ),
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "INVALID_LAYOUT" });
    expect((await getShippingSettings(db)).defaultCount).toBe(12);
  });
});
````

### FILE: `src/server/storage-texts/index.ts`

````ts
import { logFor, type Actor } from "../activity-log";
import type { Db } from "../db/connection";
import type { PriorityItem } from "../priority/types";
import { readSetting, writeSetting } from "../settings";

/**
 * The storage text a label prints ("keep frozen at -18°C ..."), set per item category. An item
 * whose own storage text in Priority is empty takes its category's; Priority's own text wins.
 */

export const MAX_STORAGE_TEXT = 300;

const KEY = "labels.storageTextByCategory";

export class StorageTextError extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly code: "TOO_LONG") {
    super(code);
    this.name = "StorageTextError";
  }
}

/** Category text to its storage text; categories not in here have none of their own. */
export async function getStorageTexts(db: Db): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const stored = await readSetting<Record<string, string>>(db, KEY);
  return stored?.value ?? {};
}

/** Sets (or with an empty text clears) the storage text of a category. */
export async function setCategoryStorageText(
  db: Db,
  category: string,
  text: string,
  actor: Actor,
): Promise<void> {
  const value = text.trim();
  if (value.length > MAX_STORAGE_TEXT) throw new StorageTextError("TOO_LONG");
  const current = await getStorageTexts(db);
  const next = { ...current };
  if (value === "") delete next[category];
  else next[category] = value;
  await writeSetting(db, KEY, next, actor.id);
  await logFor(
    actor,
    "settings.storageTextChanged",
    {
      entityType: "settings",
      entityId: KEY,
      details: { category, from: current[category] ?? null, to: value || null },
    },
    db,
  );
}

/** The items, each with its category's storage text where Priority gives none. */
export function withStorageTexts(
  items: PriorityItem[],
  texts: Record<string, string>,
): PriorityItem[] {
  return items.map((item) =>
    item.storageText || !texts[item.category]
      ? item
      : { ...item, storageText: texts[item.category] },
  );
}
````

````ts
import { beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "../db/connection";
import { seed } from "../db/seed";
import type { PriorityItem } from "../priority/types";
import {
  getStorageTexts,
  setCategoryStorageText,
  StorageTextError,
  withStorageTexts,
} from "./index";

let database: Database;
const actor = { id: null, display: "test" };

beforeAll(async () => {
  database = createDatabase({ url: null, pgliteDataDir: null });
  await database.migrate();
  await seed(database.db, { email: "boss@example.com", password: "Temp-1234", name: "Boss" });
}, 60_000);

const item = (category: string, storageText: string) =>
  ({ itemNumber: "M1", category, storageText }) as PriorityItem;

describe("storage texts per category", () => {
  it("are saved, cleared with an empty text, and refused when too long", async () => {
    await setCategoryStorageText(database.db, "בשר קפוא", "  יש לשמור ב-18-  ", actor);
    expect(await getStorageTexts(database.db)).toEqual({ "בשר קפוא": "יש לשמור ב-18-" });
    await setCategoryStorageText(database.db, "בשר קפוא", "", actor);
    expect(await getStorageTexts(database.db)).toEqual({});
    await expect(
      setCategoryStorageText(database.db, "בשר קפוא", "x".repeat(301), actor),
    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(StorageTextError);
  });

  it("fill only the items Priority gives no storage text", () => {
    const texts = { קפוא: "לשמור בהקפאה" };
    const [own, filled, other] = withStorageTexts(
      [item("קפוא", "משלו"), item("קפוא", ""), item("טרי", "")],
      texts,
    );
    expect(own.storageText).toBe("משלו");
    expect(filled.storageText).toBe("לשמור בהקפאה");
    expect(other.storageText).toBe("");
  });
});
````
